title: Account Development Representative - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained — both on the job and through formal programs led by a world-class Sales team — to take on your next role as a closing Account Executive.

On a daily basis, you will build and work a portfolio of target accounts for our EMEA business in France: researching each account for commercial signal, prioritising which contacts to approach and in what order, and running a connected, multi-touch outbound motion that generates qualified pipeline rather than one-off meetings.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CET. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: your efforts will result in real-world impact — helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: if you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You're excited by AI: you'll use cutting-edge AI tools every day and sell some of the most advanced AI in the physical operations space.
  • You think several moves ahead: you'd rather build a real relationship across an account than force a single contact to a decision they're not ready to make.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: one day you'll be researching a transport operator, the next a food distribution centre. Our best reps dig into the businesses they support to make a sharper case for why Samsara matters to them specifically.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: in this role you will get hung up on and told no. You need the resilience to prepare, call again, and adjust.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go further than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Research target accounts before outreach — pulling commercial signal out of public information (financials, news, hiring activity, compliance or safety pressure) to build a specific, defensible point of view on where Samsara adds value.
  • Build and prioritise an account-level contact plan, identifying who to approach first across a range of stakeholders (e.g. MD, Operations/Transport Manager, Compliance/H&S, Finance) and being able to justify that choice.
  • Run a connected, multi-touch outbound motion across phone, email and LinkedIn — using early conversations to gather information and multi-thread the account, not just to book a meeting at any cost.
  • Write personalised, researched outreach (including cold emails) that carries a specific point of view into every call, rather than working from a generic script.
  • Read what a contact gives you on the call and adapt in real time — including recognising when the right move is to gather information and position a follow-up with someone else, rather than push for a meeting the contact can't actually commit to.
  • Keep meticulous account and contact records in Salesforce.
  • Become a product expert and represent the Samsara brand at trade shows and events.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1–3 years professional experience, ideally in customer-facing roles
  • 6–12 months experience in a sales or equivalent target driven role
  • Highly motivated and committed, with a strong desire to work in target-driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding targets in previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Curious, and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French
  • AI literacy and ability to showcase examples of leveraging AI in your work

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Comfort turning unstructured information (an annual report, a website, a news article) into a clear commercial argument
  • Experience multi-threading or navigating multiple stakeholders within a single sale
  • A genuine willingness to prepare — to research and write — before a call, rather than relying on improvising well under pressure
  • Experience in closing-sales roles or similar target driven environment
  • A proven track record of achievement beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space.

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility. With emphasis on continued professional development, training doesn't stop after onboarding — we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and competitors, develop hard skills, and work with mentors to progress through three levels:

  • ADR I — focus on inbound leads: a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with interested prospects. Learning opportunities include call sessions with senior Sales team members, tool training (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, and objection handling.
  • ADR II — work on top-of-funnel movement, creating high-quality sales engagements, and supporting Account Executives. Enrolled in specialised training including professional writing, persona-based messaging, cold calling 2.0, and AE collaboration.
  • ADR III — work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers. Partner on large accounts, implement territory plans, join weekly strategy meetings, and schedule/attend customer demos, alongside a mentorship program ahead of an AE interview.

Please submit an English CV with your application.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Account Executive - DACH
descriptionHtml:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

We offer a highly competitive compensation package with On-Target Earnings (OTE) designed to reward high performance and results. This includes a strong base salary complemented by an uncapped commission structure, meaning there is no limit to what you can earn — your success directly drives your income. Top performers have the opportunity to significantly exceed OTE, supported by a transparent, performance-driven bonus plan that truly rewards achievement.

What you will do

  • Build and develop your own client portfolio by identifying and acquiring new business opportunities within your assigned market.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients to foster long-term partnerships.

  • Proactively qualify new leads through daily outbound calls, follow-ups, and consistent pipeline management.

  • Engaging in conversations with potential and existing clients, and guiding them through the sales process.

  • Work closely with the technology team to provide feedback on platform functionality and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Collaborate with both buyers and suppliers to address any issues, inquiries, or challenges that may arise during the trading process.

  • Monitor your performance against monthly targets and KPIs, taking ownership of revenue growth within your portfolio.

  • Stay informed about market trends, product demand, and industry dynamics to make informed trading decisions.

Who you are 

  • You have prior experience in Business Development, Sales, Key Account Management, or Account Management

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • You demonstrate excellent German skills and strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment.

  • A basic understanding of national and international trade and supply chain management is a plus.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

title: Account Executive DACH - Mid-Market (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Agicap

Created in Lyon in 2016 by three French entrepreneurs, Agicap is one of the fastest scale-ups in Europe, with over 8000 customers, 650 employees and fast revenue growth (7x between 2021 and 2024). Agicap is part of the French Tech 120, rewarding the most promising startups in France.

Agicap allows Finance teams of Mid-Market companies to efficiently manage and forecast their cash, pay their suppliers and get paid. By combining a Treasury Management System, and Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable solutions into a single platform, Agicap aims at becoming the next leading Treasury Management platform for mid-market companies.

We have raised €145M since our creation, with prestigious VC funds including AVP, Greenoaks, Partech and BlackFin, with a last round in November 2024.

These additional resources further fuel our product innovation, allowing us to grow significantly and accelerate our international expansion across the world.

We believe our success comes from our highly passionate and dedicated teams, committed to building a company where people can grow and build their careers. We are constantly looking for great talents, aiming for excellence and ready to join our ambitious adventure!

Home page

Customer Stories

Our Values


About the Account Executive - Mid-Market role:

We are growing our Team in Düsseldorf! In daily collaboration with the Business Development team, Outbound SDR, Inbound SDR, and Partnership Managers, your mission will be to generate new business by acquiring new logos. As a Mid Market Account Executive at Agicap, you will be responsible for driving sales and expanding our customer base within the mid-market segment. You will play a crucial role in identifying new business opportunities, building relationships with potential clients, and closing deals to achieve your sales targets.
You will be responsible for:
  • Defining and implementing a sectoral development strategy with your SDRs.
  • Identifying and targeting mid-market companies that could benefit from Agicap’s financial management solutions.
  • Conducting product demonstrations and presentations to showcase the value of Agicap’s offerings.
  • Developing and maintaining a robust sales pipeline through prospecting, networking, and referrals.
  • Building and nurturing relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers within target organizations.
  • Negotiating contracts and closing sales to meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets.
  • Staying informed about industry developments, competitor activities, and market trends.
  • Regularly monitoring and analyzing your performance with Management to identify areas for improvement.
  • Providing feedback to the Marketing, Business Development, and Product teams to improve processes and the product.
  • Sharing your commercial expertise and good ideas to enhance the team’s performance.

    • What we are looking for:
  • Native/Bilingual level of German
  • 2-4 years of experience in B2B Sales, preferably in the SaaS industry and with mid-market space, and with some experience working in a finance department/audit/consulting/TS.
  • Studies background in a top business or Engineering school.
  • A passion for sales and a proven track record of meeting and exceeding targets.
  • A tenacious, resilient salesperson who never gives up and is driven by results.
  • Someone who can put themselves in the shoes of business leaders to understand their current and future cash flow needs.
  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills, excellent verbal communication, and a high level of intellectual curiosity.
  • Great ambition, with the drive to meet and even exceed objectives.
  • A strong business acumen and above-average interpersonal skills.
  • A team spirit and a desire to share knowledge, helping colleagues grow.

    • 7 Reasons to Join Agicap as an AE:
  • Exceptional product-market fit, confirmed by our latest funding round:
  • Crucial need → cash = the lifeblood of business, top priority for CFOs (PwC)
  • Strongly differentiated solution, leader in Europe (G2)
  • Gigantic market: over 350k companies in DACH alone
  • Unique company culture: meritocracy, high standards, continuous learning, European scale-up (>50% revenue outside France)
  • Opportunities for functional and geographical growth
  • Strong financial situation
  • Team of rockstars, friendly and skilled
  • A growth engine of a large Outbound SDR team, Inbound & Partner leads to help you scale fast!
  • Competitive package - with uncapped commissions!

    • Our benefits:
    - Competitive Compensation: Attractive package including both fixed and variable components. - Professional Development: Access a “Mini-MBA” with a focus on Finance & Treasury via the Agicap Academy. - Global Collaboration: Join a diverse international team with occasional trips to our headquarters in France. - Meal & Grocery Allowance: Receive up to €108/month tax-free for lunch or groceries, easily managed via the Hrmony app. - Tenure Rewards: Enjoy a €30 monthly shopping voucher after one year and up to two additional vacation days based on your length of service. - Team Culture: Be part of a dynamic environment with global offsites (like our recent annual seminar in Chamonix-Mont-Blanc) and local team events. AGICAP is committed to providing equal opportunities for everyone, and we foster an inclusive work environment that values diversity!

title: Account Executive, Enterprise (Berlin, Germany)
descriptionHtml:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We are looking for a Enterprise Account Executive who will play a critical role driving sales and maximizing expansion opportunities with a defined list of Enterprise customers. You will be responsible for targeting, building and nurturing positive relationships with key C-level decision-makers, understanding complex business needs, and delivering innovative solutions across our product suite. This is an opportunity to accelerate your career, learn from leading sellers in the industry and build an incredible network of cross functional partners throughout Figma.

This is a full time role that can be held from Berlin hub or remotely in Germany.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Manage a defined list of named enterprise accounts to consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets
  • Apply effective discovery and value-selling techniques to build and strengthen C-level relationships for every account in your book
  • Align with executives on business challenges and gain sponsorship for enterprise wide deployments for a suite of products, identifying where Figma’s roadmap and innovations fit in the long term
  • Conduct thorough analysis to create strategic account plans that outline company priorities and initiatives, multi-threading at at senior level to build on expansion opportunities
  • Co-create with cross-functional partners to expertly position Figma, drive deals forward and ensure customer success
  • Leverage opportunities to advance executive level relationships through in-person meetings and networking opportunities

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • Experience closing sales, over multiple years, for a software or SaaS business with the Enterprise customers (5000+ FTEs), selling to executives
  • Consistent performance meeting pipeline generation targets for net new business
  • Demonstrated experience successfully managing complex sales cycles (9 months+)
  • Proficiency in a sales methodology and process that creates value for customers
  • Fluency in German

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience selling solutions to technical audiences at the highest level in Engineering, Product and Design teams
  • Demonstrated ability to succeed in a changing environment
  • Certified in deal qualification and prospect discovery

At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to

Examples of accommodations include but are not limited to: 

  • Holding interviews in an accessible location
  • Enabling closed captioning on video conferencing
  • Ensuring all written communication be compatible with screen readers
  • Changing the mode or format of interviews 

To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and facilitate a more personal connection, we require all candidates keep their cameras on during video interviews. Additionally, if hired you will be required to attend in person onboarding.

By applying for this job, the candidate acknowledges and agrees that any personal data contained in their application or supporting materials will be processed in accordance with Figma's Candidate Privacy Notice.

Application limits: To help candidates focus on the opportunities most relevant to their skills and experience, Figma limits the number and frequency of applications. These limits apply to all roles:

  • Candidates may submit up to 5 applications during any rolling 30-day period.

title: Account Manager EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Horizon Trading Solutions is an independent global technology company focused on electronic trading, supporting agency and principal business activities across equities and derivatives.

For over 20 years, we have equipped leading capital market participants with algorithmic trading technology and direct connectivity to more than 80 exchanges worldwide.

We are currently looking for an Account Manager EMEA to strengthen to drive sustainable revenue growth and increase the value of Horizon’s existing client accounts by developing structured account plans, identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities, securing renewals and strengthening relationships with key decision-makers. The Account Manager acts as the commercial owner of each account and coordinates internal teams to turn client knowledge into profitable growth.

Key Responsibilities

1. Grow the Existing Client Portfolio

  • Develop and manage an account plan for each priority account, covering growth potential, stakeholder mapping, key challenges, competition, opportunities and actions.
  • Identify, qualify and convert upsell, cross-sell, geographic expansion and functional expansion opportunities.
  • Build a reliable, documented expansion pipeline and keep it regularly updated in the CRM.
  • Prepare business cases and commercial proposals, and lead negotiations and contracting through to closing.

2. Secure Retention and Renewals

  • Anticipate renewals and churn risks, with a retention plan shared with the relevant teams.
  • Monitor product usage, client satisfaction, value delivered and commercial pain points across the portfolio.
  • Lead account reviews and executive business reviews, providing actionable recommendations.

3. Build Executive Relationships

  • Build lasting relationships with sponsors and decision-makers across business, IT, trading, operations and procurement.
  • Understand each client’s strategy, organisation and priorities in order to develop new use cases.
  • Represent the voice of the client internally while protecting Horizon’s commercial interests.

4. Coordinate Internal Execution

  • Coordinate Client Services, Customer Delivery, Product, PreSales, Legal and Finance around the account objectives.
  • Ensure clear handovers and follow through on commitments made to clients.
  • Share market signals, client needs and competitive insights that can inform the product roadmap.

5. Manage Performance

  • Track growth, retention, pipeline, forecast, stakeholder coverage and margin indicators.
  • Produce evidence-based forecasts, explain variances and recommend corrective actions.
  • Contribute to commercial discipline, sales methodologies and the team’s continuous improvement.

Expected Outcomes Within 12 Months

  • 100% of priority accounts have an approved account plan that is updated quarterly.
  • Achievement of the annual recurring revenue and/or revenue expansion target across the assigned portfolio (quantified target to be defined).
  • A qualified expansion pipeline maintained at a level consistent with the annual objective (recommended benchmark: at least 3x the target).
  • Renewal rate and net revenue retention in line with agreed objectives, with no strategic renewal identified too late.
  • Multi-threaded mapping of decision-makers and influencers across all strategic accounts.
  • Reliable monthly forecast, up-to-date CRM data, and clearly documented risks and opportunities.

What we are looking for

  • At least five years of experience in account management, sales or complex B2B business development.
  • Experience in finance or capital markets is mandatory: investment banking, brokerage, asset management, fintech, financial software or a comparable environment.
  • Demonstrable results in growing existing accounts, complex negotiations and managing long sales cycles.
  • Ability to engage effectively with both business and technical stakeholders, including at executive level.
  • Understanding of SaaS/licensing models, recurring revenue, renewals and account profitability.
  • Exposure to trading technology, software platforms, APIs/connectivity or IT projects would be a strong advantage.
  • Professional fluency in French and English is essential; another European language would be an advantage.

Skills and Behaviours

  • Growth mindset and results orientation
  • Knowledge of financial markets and understanding of client challenges
  • Account planning and prioritisation skills
  • Influencing, active listening and relationship-building skills
  • Commercial negotiation and value-based selling
  • Cross-functional collaboration and strong execution
  • CRM discipline, forecasting and data-driven management
  • Technological curiosity, autonomy and an entrepreneurial mindset

Horizon is an equal opportunity employer. We promote diversity, multiculturalism, and inclusion.

title: Account Manager Performance Marketing (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Als Account Manager Performance Marketing (m/w/d) bei SPCTR. übernimmst du Verantwortung für eigene Kundenaccounts und wirst zu dem festen Ansprechpartner, dem unsere Kunden vertrauen. Wir arbeiten als verlängerte Online-Marketing-Abteilung, von wachsenden Start-ups bis zu namhaften größeren Unternehmen.

Deine Rolle sitzt genau an der Schnittstelle: Du führst deine Kunden souverän durch Jour Fixes und Quarterly Business Reviews und arbeitest gleichzeitig operativ in den Accounts, wenn Performance-Kampagnen auf Google, Meta, TikTok und Snapchat umgesetzt und optimiert werden. SEO und GEO gewinnen dabei zunehmend an Bedeutung, genauso wie der Einsatz von KI und Automatisierung im Alltag. Bei uns arbeitet das ganze Team mit Claude.

Was wir am meisten schätzen, lässt sich schwer in eine Anforderungsliste fassen: Proaktivität. Menschen, die Probleme früh benennen und mit einem Lösungsvorschlag um die Ecke kommen. Wenn du dich darin wiedererkennst und unternehmerisch denkst, passt du zu uns.

Aufgaben

  • Du betreust eigene Kundenaccounts eigenverantwortlich und bist der feste Ansprechpartner für Strategie, Umsetzung und Ergebnisse.
  • Du führst Jour Fixes und Quarterly Business Reviews selbstständig, auch bei größeren Kunden mit mehreren Entscheidern und festen Entscheidungswegen.
  • Du setzt Performance-Kampagnen auf Google, Meta, TikTok und Snapchat operativ um und optimierst sie kontinuierlich entlang klarer KPIs.
  • Du denkst die Accounts ganzheitlich und bringst SEO- und GEO-Themen mit ins Spiel, wenn sie zu den Zielen des Kunden passen.
  • Du erstellst Analysen, Reportings und Dashboards und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen für Kunden und Team ab.
  • Du nutzt KI-Tools und Automatisierungen aktiv im Tagesgeschäft, bei uns vor allem Claude, für Analysen, Reportings, Recherchen und operative Prozesse.
  • Du erkennst wiederkehrende Aufgaben und manuelle Workflows und denkst sie proaktiv in Richtung Automatisierung weiter.
  • Du benennst Probleme früh, transparent und mit einem Lösungsvorschlag im Gepäck.
  • Du behältst Markt, neue Plattform-Features sowie Entwicklungen rund um KI, Search und GEO im Blick und bringst Relevantes ins Team ein.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Performance, Content und Design zusammen, in flachen Hierarchien mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch.

Qualifikation

  • Du bringst 1 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Online oder Performance Marketing mit, idealerweise im Agenturumfeld oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit direktem Kundenkontakt.
  • Du hast ein Studium im Bereich BWL, Marketing, Kommunikation oder Vergleichbares abgeschlossen, eine passende Ausbildung gemacht oder dir dein Können in der Praxis erarbeitet.
  • Du bist kommunikationsstark und trittst gegenüber Kunden klar, souverän und professionell auf, auch wenn mehrere Entscheider und festgelegte Prozesse im Spiel sind.
  • Du kennst dich praktisch mit Google Ads und Meta Ads aus. Erfahrung mit Looker Studio, Google Analytics und Google Tag Manager ist ein Plus.
  • Du hast idealerweise ein Grundverständnis von SEO und GEO, gerne auch mehr, und richtig Lust, dich in diese Themen weiter einzuarbeiten.
  • Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit KI-Tools wie zum Beispiel Claude oder ChatGPT und siehst darin einen echten Hebel für produktiveres Arbeiten.
  • Du hast Drive: Du willst dich und das Unternehmen aktiv nach vorne entwickeln und übernimmst Verantwortung, ohne dass man dich darum bitten muss.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, verlässlich und priorisiert, und verlierst auch bei mehreren Projekten parallel nicht den Überblick.
  • Du kommst mit modernen Tools gut zurecht. Wir arbeiten mit awork sowie Microsoft 365 und Teams.
  • Du bist Teamplayer, schaust über den eigenen Tellerrand und unterstützt dein Kollegium, wenn es eng wird.

Benefits

  • Ein offenes und engagiertes Team, das von den Gründern selbst geführt wird und einen starken Zusammenhalt pflegt. Auch nach der Arbeit.
  • Echte Account-Verantwortung von Anfang an, mit Kunden, bei denen du deine Wirkung siehst.
  • Ein Umfeld, in dem KI und Automatisierung ausdrücklich gewünscht sind und neue Tools und Ideen ausprobiert statt ausgebremst werden.
  • GEO und KI-Sichtbarkeit als Zukunftsthema, das du mit uns gemeinsam aufbaust.
  • Viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, vollständig remote zu arbeiten.
  • Work from anywhere: Arbeite von dort, wo du am besten arbeiten kannst, plus die Möglichkeit, in unserem Büro in Köln zu arbeiten (optional auch Hamburg).
  • Spannende Start-ups und namhafte größere Kunden, an denen du fachlich schnell wächst.
  • Datengetriebenes Arbeiten, ehrliche Kommunikation und moderne Marketingprozesse.

Klingt das nach der richtigen Herausforderung für dich? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Eigenschaften wie Drive und Lernfähigkeit zeigen sich selten im Kennenlerncall, sondern erst in der Zusammenarbeit. Deshalb halten wir den Prozess schlank und ehrlich: Wenn es von beiden Seiten passt, merken wir das schnell.

Wenn du Kunden souverän führen willst, Performance Marketing operativ stark umsetzt und Lust hast, SEO, GEO und KI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen mit uns weiterzudenken, bist du bei uns genau richtig. Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil des Teams bei SPCTR.

title: Accounts Payable Accountant
descriptionHtml:
Master the flow of our finances. Keep numbers sharp – so every part of our business runs without a hitch.

As our Accounts Payable Accountant, you own our financial obligations to suppliers and service providers from start to finish. You work side-by-side with our Finance crew, internal teams, and external vendors – making sure every invoice and payment moves smoothly. Reporting to the Head of Accounting, you keep our books balanced and ensure our partners trust how we operate. Your daily work gives Robin Radar the solid foundation needed to build world-class radar technology.

What you'll do

  • Invoice processing and vendor onboarding: Set up new vendors in our ERP system and review incoming goods and services. Verify and process supplier invoices with precision under our P2P guidelines. Ensure full documentation and approvals are in place before payment.

  • Payment execution and expense handling: Prepare and submit electronic transfers strictly on schedule. Review and process colleague expense reports against company policies. Guarantee timely reimbursements so everyone gets paid accurately.

  • Reconciliations and records management: Perform daily bank reconciliations to match company books with actual balances. Carry out regular account reconciliations, investigating and fixing discrepancies promptly. Maintain clean, audit-ready records in full compliance with WKR legislation.

  • Vendor relations and compliance: Build positive partnerships with external suppliers by resolving payment questions quickly. Enforce P2P policies and accounting principles across our organization. Propose practical improvements to enhance our internal controls and day-to-day efficiency.

  • Systems testing and team support: Train new colleagues on our ERP purchase tools to keep processes compliant. Test upcoming changes to the Purchasing module and share ideas to refine the software. Review Accounts Payable postings in our reporting tool to keep numbers accurate.

What you bring

  • Over 4 years of experience in Accounts Payable or other related accounting roles within a Finance team;

  • Good understanding of accounting, tax and financial reporting principles and practices and regulations;

  • Fluency in both English and Dutch is required;

  • Excellent knowledge of MS Office and familiarity with ERP systems (i.e. SAP or equivalent, Odoo);

  • Strong attention to detail, analytical acumen and organizational skills;

  • Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment;

  • Good communication and collaboration skills and ability to communicate well across cultures and backgrounds.

What we offer

  • Working for a Great Place to Work® certified company;

  • Comprehensive pension plan;

  • Commuting allowance;

  • 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days);

  • Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications;

  • High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role;

  • An international team of 30+ nationalities, full of high performance colleagues you can exchange experiences with and learn from. As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks!

Robin Radar is a technology leader in tracking and classifying small objects. Our radars and software help prevent bird strikes in aviation, reduce the impact of wind farms on wildlife, and protect critical infrastructure from drone threats. Our work shows up at airports, wind farms, military sites and nature reserves around the world.

We're one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands, with a crew of bright minds across 30+ nationalities. Growth doesn't mean we lose the plot – eyes on the skies, feet on the ground. Our values keep us grounded: WE TRUST. WE OWN IT. WE AIM HIGH.

Want to work on next-level radar tech, solve real problems, and never have to pretend your job has meaning? You'll fit right in – we're saving you a seat.

title: Accounts Payable Specialist
descriptionHtml:
At i3D.net, we provide world-class global coverage with one of the most interconnected networks in the world. Our solutions focus on low latency, zero packet loss, and unmatched scalability, enabling seamless experiences for millions of users worldwide. With dedicated support, bespoke solutions, and cutting-edge technology, we deliver reliable, cost-efficient infrastructure that empowers game developers and businesses to scale effortlessly. Partnering with major names like Nvidia, DuckDuckGo, and Ubisoft, we are shaping the future of gaming and network technology.

Bij i3D.net bouwen we aan de toekomst van gaming en netwerktechnologie. Met een van de meest verbonden netwerken ter wereld bieden we internationale infrastructuuroplossingen voor miljoenen gebruikers. We combineren minimale vertraging, betrouwbare verbindingen en schaalbaarheid met persoonlijke ondersteuning en maatwerk. Zo helpen we gameontwikkelaars en bedrijven zoals NVIDIA, DuckDuckGo en Ubisoft om wereldwijd te groeien.

Ons Finance-team zorgt ervoor dat onze groeiende internationale organisatie ook financieel op rolletjes loopt. Daarom zoeken we een nauwkeurige, betrokken en proactieve Financieel Administratief Medewerker met een focus op Accounts Payable.

Jouw rol

Samen met je collega’s verzorg je de dagelijkse financiële administratie, met jouw focus op het crediteurenproces. Je zorgt dat inkoopfacturen correct worden verwerkt, tijdig worden goedgekeurd en volgens afspraak worden betaald.

Je bent een zichtbaar en toegankelijk aanspreekpunt binnen de organisatie. Je zoekt actief contact met collega’s, bewaakt de voortgang van factuurgoedkeuringen en volgt openstaande acties proactief op. Bij afwijkingen zoek je uit wat er speelt en werk je samen met leveranciers en collega’s aan een oplossing.

Daarnaast onderhoud je de workflows en autorisatieschema’s in 4cee, het factuurverwerkingssysteem. Daarmee help je het factuurverwerkingsproces efficiënt en overzichtelijk te houden.

Je maakt deel uit van een Finance-team van acht collega’s en rapporteert aan de Finance Manager.

Wat je gaat doen

  • Controleren en boeken van inkoopfacturen op de juiste grootboekrekening en kostenplaats, met toepassing van de juiste btw-code.

  • Controleren of facturen aansluiten op contractuele afspraken en, waar van toepassing, inkooporders.

  • Bewaken van de voortgang van factuurgoedkeuringen en proactief opvolgen van openstaande acties bij collega’s.

  • Uitzoeken en oplossen van afwijkende, geblokkeerde of onvolledige facturen.

  • Onderhouden van workflows en autorisatieschema’s in 4cee, in afstemming met de verantwoordelijke collega’s.

  • Voorbereiden van betaalvoorstellen en verwerken van betalingen volgens de interne autorisatieprocedure.

  • Verwerken van bankmutaties die betrekking hebben op leveranciersbetalingen.

  • Bijhouden en controleren van leveranciersgegevens volgens de afgesproken procedures.

  • Onderhouden van leverancierscontact over facturen, betalingen en openstaande vragen.

  • Controleren en afstemmen van openstaande crediteurenposten.

  • Ondersteunen bij de maand- en jaarafsluiting, onder meer door ontbrekende facturen en nog te verwerken kosten te signaleren.

  • Zorgen voor een volledige en controleerbare digitale administratie.

  • Signaleren van knelpunten en meedenken over verbeteringen in de financiële processen en systemen.

Hoe succes in het eerste jaar eruitziet

Je kent onze financiële processen en systemen en voert je dagelijkse werkzaamheden zelfstandig uit. Facturen worden correct verwerkt en tijdig ter goedkeuring en betaling aangeboden. Je houdt overzicht over openstaande posten en acties en schakelt tijdig wanneer de voortgang dreigt vast te lopen.

Collega’s weten je te vinden en jij weet wie je moet benaderen om zaken verder te brengen. De workflows en autorisatieschema’s in 4cee zijn actueel en je hebt bijgedragen aan een efficiënter factuurverwerkingsproces.

Tijdens de maand- en jaarafsluiting lever je de benodigde informatie tijdig en zorgvuldig aan.

Wie jij bent

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en gestructureerd en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werk. Je stelt prioriteiten, houdt overzicht en wacht niet af wanneer iets blijft liggen. Je zoekt actief de samenwerking op en spreekt collega’s op een prettige, duidelijke manier aan op openstaande acties.

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig, leert graag en denkt mee over hoe processen beter kunnen. Een internationale technische omgeving spreekt je aan en je vindt het leuk om vanuit Finance bij te dragen aan een organisatie in de wereld van gaming, infrastructuur en hosting.

  • Je hebt een afgeronde mbo-opleiding in een financiële richting en minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare financiële administratieve functie, bij voorkeur binnen de crediteurenadministratie.

  • Ervaring met verschillende btw-codes en het correct toepassen daarvan bij de verwerking van inkoopfacturen.

  • Praktische kennis van Excel en affiniteit met financiële systemen en digitale factuurverwerking.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels voor contact met collega’s en internationale leveranciers.

  • Beschikbaarheid van minimaal 24 uur per week, met ten minste twee vaste dagen op kantoor in Rotterdam.

  • Ervaring met NetSuite en 4cee is een pré.

Waarom werken bij i3D.net?

  • Maak het verschil:

  • Draag bij aan een solide financiële basis voor een internationaal bedrijf met een jarenlange staat van dienst.

  • Hybride werken

  • Profiteer van flexibel hybride werken, een thuiswerkbudget en hoogwaardige hulpmiddelen.

  • Ruimte om te groeien

  • Ontwikkel je verder met een vergoeding voor opleidingen, loopbaanbegeleiding en mogelijkheden om je kennis en vaardigheden uit te breiden.

  • Aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • Een marktconform salaris, een jaarlijkse bonus, 25 vakantiedagen naast de officiële feestdagen, een reiskostenvergoeding en een premievrije pensioenregeling.

  • Blijf in beweging

  • Maak gratis gebruik van onze eigen fitnessruimte in Rotterdam.

  • Gratis games

  • Krijg toegang tot de gamebibliotheek van Ubisoft

title: AI Developer (LLM Products) - Remote
descriptionHtml:
Welcome to dexter health!

At dexter health, we build AI-powered software for care teams. Our mission is to reduce administrative workload in healthcare so caregivers can spend more time with patients.

We are looking for a high-agency AI Developer to help us build new AI features faster and improve the quality, reliability, and speed of existing AI workflows.

This is a hands-on engineering role. Not research. Not prompt-only. You will turn ambiguous product ideas into working, production-ready AI features.

The role is mostly focused on shipping AI product features, with some AI systems and infrastructure work where needed.

You will work closely with product and engineering, but we expect you to take real ownership. You should be comfortable moving fast, making technical decisions under ambiguity, and using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar every day.

Tasks

As our AI Engineer, you will:

  • Build new AI-powered product features from idea to production

  • Improve existing AI workflows for quality, reliability, latency, and user value

  • Design and implement LLM-based workflows, structured outputs, validation logic, and fallback behavior

  • Build evaluation loops, tests, and quality checks for AI-generated outputs

  • Integrate AI capabilities into existing product and backend systems

  • Work with commercial and open-source LLMs without being tied to one specific provider

  • Support self-hosted model workflows where they make sense for quality, speed, cost, or control

  • Debug AI feature failures across inputs, outputs, data, backend logic, and user flows

  • Use AI development tools as a core part of your daily workflow

  • Ship quickly while keeping production quality high

Requirements

We care less about formal seniority and more about speed, intelligence, ownership, and product impact. We like people who operate with founder-like urgency: they figure things out, make progress under ambiguity, and care about outcomes more than titles.

Must-have

  • Strong software engineering skills, especially in Python or a comparable backend language

  • Experience building AI-powered product features or LLM-based workflows

  • Ability to turn ambiguous product ideas into working software quickly

  • Strong understanding of how to design, test, validate, and improve AI outputs

  • Experience integrating AI workflows into production systems

  • Strong debugging instincts across application logic, data, model outputs, and user-facing behavior

  • Experience with evaluation, testing, validation, or quality checks for AI-generated outputs

  • Serious experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar as part of your daily workflow

  • High intelligence, fast learning speed, bias to action, and ownership mindset

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, fast decisions, and a high-trust startup environment

  • Clear written and spoken English

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with frontend or fullstack product development

  • Experience with self-hosted LLMs, model serving, inference optimization, or similar systems

  • Experience with open-source LLMs and related deployment workflows

  • Experience improving latency, cost, quality, or reliability of AI systems

  • Experience with healthcare software, healthcare data, or regulated environments

  • Experience working with structured data extraction, documentation automation, voice workflows, or workflow automation

  • German language skills

  • Knowledge of nursing homes or elderly care workflows

This role is probably not for you if

  • You are mainly looking for an ML research role

  • You are a prompt engineer without strong coding skills

  • You need detailed specifications before making progress

  • You prefer slow, highly structured corporate environments

  • You are mainly looking for management, not hands-on building

  • You want to use AI tools only occasionally instead of as part of your daily workflow

  • You optimize for perfect process over fast, reliable execution

Benefits

  • Remote work

  • Fair compensation based on skills, experience, and location

  • Ownership of important backend systems

  • Work on software used in real healthcare workflows

  • Modern AI-native development workflow

  • Room to grow with the company

Why?

Caregivers spend too much time on documentation, coordination, and administrative work. We build technology that reduces this burden.

AI is core to our product. But useful AI features do not come from demos alone. They need strong engineering, fast iteration, evaluation, production thinking, and deep ownership of the user outcome.

If you want to build AI product features that ship, improve real workflows, use AI tools every day, and take ownership in a fast-moving team, we would like to hear from you.

title: AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Engineer based in Germany.

We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to build and deploy production-grade AI systems that address complex challenges across heavy industries, including utilities, manufacturing, logistics, and energy. You will play a key role in developing a next-generation industrial operating system, taking innovative products from concept to production. The role combines agentic AI, multimodal machine learning, industrial data integration, and full-stack engineering. You will work with real-world data from sensors, machines, and operational systems to deliver intelligent solutions that improve efficiency, reliability, and decision-making. This is a high-ownership opportunity in a fast-moving, zero-to-one product environment. You will help establish the foundations of an ambitious platform designed to transform industrial operations.


Accountabilities

You will design, build, and ship the core AI capabilities of an industrial intelligence platform, connecting advanced models with operational data, enterprise systems, and practical decision-making tools.

  • Develop and deploy agentic AI systems, including orchestration, tool use, state management, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

  • Build agent runtimes and orchestration frameworks supporting specialized agents for vision quality, predictive maintenance, and operations planning.

  • Design context assembly systems using industrial ontologies and memory, including tool dispatch, approval gates, tracing, and cost controls.

  • Develop multimodal data pipelines combining video processing, computer vision, and structured operational data.

  • Implement computer vision capabilities such as object detection, segmentation, and action recognition, using technologies such as YOLO and OpenCV.

  • Process industrial sensor data, including RTSP video, time-series telemetry, vibration, thermal data, and PLC/OPC-UA streams.

  • Build signal-processing and sensor-correlation workflows, including FFT feature extraction and cross-sensor analysis.

  • Design and contribute to industrial ontologies and knowledge graphs representing plants, assets, sensors, work orders, materials, and maintenance histories.

  • Develop memory systems for trace storage, playbooks, asset templates, and reusable failure-pattern libraries.

  • Build operational interfaces such as dashboards, evidence-based alerting workflows, replanning tools, and audit trails.

  • Develop integration connectors for ERP, CMMS, WMS, industrial historians, and PLC systems, ensuring data normalization and consistent schema mapping.

  • Deliver end-to-end solutions spanning data ingestion, model serving, backend services, and frontend interfaces.

  • Ensure production systems meet demanding requirements for reliability, latency, scalability, cost efficiency, and operational usability.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is an autonomous, hands-on AI engineer with experience taking complex systems from initial development to production, particularly in environments involving physical-world data and industrial operations.

    • At least 3 years of experience building and shipping production AI systems; 5+ years preferred.

    • Proven experience developing agentic AI products and production systems, including orchestration, tool integration, state management, and human oversight.

    • Experience as an early-stage engineer at a venture-backed startup, contributing to products and systems from zero to one.

    • Strong background in AI and machine learning applied to physical-world systems.

    • Experience working with large-scale industrial data, such as video streams, IoT devices, sensor telemetry, vibration, thermal data, or PLC/OPC-UA systems.

    • Hands-on experience building multimodal AI pipelines that combine computer vision with structured operational data.

    • Understanding of data ingestion, normalization, temporal alignment, data quality, and ground-truth challenges in real-world environments.

    • Experience with industrial ontologies, knowledge graphs, or structured context systems based on asset hierarchies and operational processes.

    • Experience integrating AI systems with enterprise and industrial platforms such as ERP, CMMS, WMS, historians, or PLC systems.

    • Strong software engineering skills across backend and frontend development, including Python and TypeScript.

    • Experience with production-oriented technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React Native, and OpenCV.

    • A practical understanding of system reliability, failure modes, latency, cost management, and human interaction.

    • Ability to work autonomously, take ownership, and deliver in a fast-paced, high-intensity environment.

    • Strong motivation to solve complex industrial challenges through hands-on engineering and applied AI.

      • Benefits

      • Opportunity to help build a category-defining industrial operating system with the potential to shape manufacturing plants and industrial facilities over the next 10–20 years.

      • Exceptional employee equity package, with an equity pool described as twice the industry standard and an estimated value of more than $200,000 from day one.

      • Opportunity to work alongside an experienced team with backgrounds in enterprise technology, industrial robotics, autonomous driving, and academic research.

      • Exposure to complex, real-world industrial challenges and large volumes of underutilized sensor data.

      • Direct impact on operational efficiency, predictive maintenance, industrial reliability, and decision-making across major industries.

      • Opportunity to contribute to a zero-to-one product in an ambitious, innovation-driven environment.

title: AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
View our much better version of this job spec on our careers page: https://juro.notion.site/aie

***

THE KEY BITS

  • Location: We can currently only accept applications from candidates that are located and have long-term working rights in the UK.

  • Flexibility: We have office hubs in London and Boston, as well as no-office hubs in several European countries. We operate a choice-first work approach that lets you work fully remotely from Day One even if you’re near an office hub.

  • Salary: We benchmarked £115,000 + equity at IC4 level in our progression framework for someone based in the UK. What you’ve done in the last ~2 years is far more important to us than how long you’ve been an engineer — so if you think you meet the requirements but are worried you’re not “senior” enough, we strongly encourage you to still apply. If you like the look of the role but the salary doesn’t match what you’re looking for, let us know in your application.

  • Interviews: 3 stages totalling around 3 hours over 2-3 weeks.

  • Start date: As soon as you can start.

  • Reporting to: Pavel Nekrasov, Director of Engineering and lead of the Agentic team at Juro

  • More info: The FAQ below, juro.com/careers, our handbook or ask ----- anything.

HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER

Juro has big ambitions: to make it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts. And we'll need help doing it.

Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.

Our Agentic team was the first team at Juro to go fully AI-native, and it's been the role model for our other product teams as Juro evolved into an AI company.

As the Agentic team, we build the AI foundations the rest of engineering ships on — starting with Operator, the agent that works across contracts inside Juro.

We want Operator to do a lot more. That takes more and better tools, solid evals, and a harness that keeps up with a stack that’s still rapidly evolving. And more great people to do it.

What you're here to do

Give Operator the tools it needs to act across Juro and make sure what it does is measurably good. In your first months, success looks like this:

  • You've shipped new tools that connect Operator to the Juro app, from first idea to production.

  • What you ship has evals around it, supported by the Quality Assurance team, so we can tell whether a new model, prompt or library version makes things better or worse.

  • You own parts of the agent harness (planning, tool use, context) without the team becoming a. bottleneck.

  • You review a lot of agent-written code and decide quickly what's safe to merge and what will break three cycles later.

We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub.

WHO WE LOOK FOR

Research shows that while men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, women and those in traditionally under-represented groups tend to apply only if they check all boxes. So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

To succeed here:

Every Juror finds their balance across our four core Principles — we hire, develop and celebrate people who live them every day.

Curious how you’d fit? Try our personality quiz to see how you map against our principles.

On top of that, you have been part of a journey where:

  • You’re a programmer first, and you now build with AI and LLMs. You’ve written production TypeScript/Node.js and MongoDB for users. Agents write most of the code today, but you can still tell when an agent’s output shouldn’t go through.

  • You’ve built agentic systems yourself, including the tools that let agents act on APIs and integrations. You can explain the parts of an agent (planning, tools, context, the loop around them) because you’ve built them.

  • You’ve written and run evals and think about quality in probabilities.

  • You’ve shipped something people can use: a product, an open-source project or a tool. (We’ll ask you for a link or description in our application form.)

  • Bonus: you’ve used our AI stack before. It changes often, so understanding why things break matters more than knowing the tools already.

Day to day, you’ll work with Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, Redis and pgvector on AWS, plus Bedrock, LiteLLM and Mastra for the AI layer.

These requirements can come from a job, a side project or open source. The field is about two years old, so we care about what you've built, not how many years you've been doing it.

This job likely isn’t for you if:

  • You need a polished setup before you can ship. We'd rather ship a small, good version this week than a perfect one in two weeks, by which time the stack has moved on.

  • You want a stable roadmap. Priorities here can change week to week.

  • You want to rebuild things whenever you'd have done them differently. We disagree a lot and openly, but once a call is made, we commit and move.

  • You've only ever worked inside one opinionated framework and never looked under the hood.

  • You'd rather build product UI. Most of this work is foundations other engineers build on.

OUR MISSION

Juro exists to help the world agree faster by making it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts.

The load on legal teams is increasing as business teams move faster with the help of AI. The only way out is to deploy AI within the legal team so that (a) routine contract work can be executed autonomously and (b) lawyers’ time is reserved for problem solving.

It’s like having an extra team member that is always on and takes on heavy lifting. Just like an in-house lawyer, Juro:

  • is present for, and trusted by, business teams

  • owns contracts from first draft to signature and beyond

  • builds judgement from every contract it works on

…all within guardrails controlled by the legal team.

GOT MORE QUESTIONS?

Check if they're answered on:

  • Our extended job description for this role: https://juro.notion.site/aie

  • Our company handbook: https://juro.notion.site/handbook

  • Our careers page: https://juro.notion.site

There, you'll find answers on topics such as career progression, inclusion & belonging, the interview process, benefits and more. Or reach ----- for anything.

title: AI R&D Engineer – Model Training  (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

Team Culture

At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose.

We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. We often mob-program, which keeps us aligned and means we always learn from each other.

About the Role

As an AI R&D Engineer in Model Training (f/m/d), you will join our model training team in Heidelberg or Berlin. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg. The model training team is building and improving our model training pipeline, which has been used to train Kolibri.

  • You will work across our full stack. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. Other weeks, you will be enabling large-scale code execution for reinforcement learning. And at other times, you might dig deep into our evaluation codebase to lift inference throughput on evals.

  • No two days are the same. Things move fast, and your ability to focus and prioritize is what lets you unblock the team day-to-day while designing the high-quality tooling and infrastructure that speeds us up long-term.

  • We're still building out our training pipeline and infrastructure. Some pieces exist, some do not, and you will have real influence on what gets built and how. Your work directly shapes how quickly we can experiment and improve our models.

  • Identifying issues and taking initiative is what drives our day-to-day work.

  • Working mode, design decisions, priorities are all done in your team together with your team mates.
    The strongest teams often use highly collaborative techniques, like mob or pair programming.

  • Due to the highly collaborative nature of our work you are expected to be on-site at least two days a week. If you are in Berlin, you should expect to travel around every second month for a few days to Heidelberg.

  • We are specifically looking to strengthen the Software Engineering in the teams which are research heavy. Major points include improving the maintainability of our code through tests and design & architecture changes.

Requirements

  • At its core, you need to be able to dive into a codebase, change the behavior as necessary, and after the change the code should be better tested and easier to understand than before.

  • As such we look for candidates for an understanding of how to design for low coupling and high cohesion paired with the ability to incrementally refactor.

  • Experience with the following technologies is likely to be helpful:

    • Test Driven Development (TDD)

    • Trunk based development

    • Continuous integration

    • Domain Driven Design

Nice-to-haves

  • Most of our code is in Python, there is also the occasional Rust codebase.

  • Large parts of our training pipeline are built on top of Kubernetes.

  • We do not hire for skills in a particular technology or language, but rather ability to learn and mindset, yet experience with these technologies is a plus.

Language: English fluency required. French or German is a plus.

Responsibilities

As part of the Venture Lead team, you will be responsible for driving our venture creation process on the opportunity areas that you own:

  • Opportunity research: build conviction on priority areas where Marble should create new companies, based on deep technical and market analysis.

  • Talent sourcing: identify talent with high founder potential and relevant domain expertise and hire them as Founders in Residence to build with Marble.

  • Building: work with Founders to develop venture ideas, systematically de-risk them, and turn them into new companies with team, funding and a roadmap to seed. You'll ensure robust diligence to support progress / stop decisions.

Alongside these, you will take on supporting work and special projects based on priorities and your profile, such as: external content creation, events, founder resources development, portfolio support, ecosystem relations, etc.

Requirements

This role is ideal for an engineer or physicist who can build, reason from first principles, with enough technical foundations to navigate various hardware domains where electrons handle power, information, or both:

  • Technical expertise in one of two fields: device/compute or power/grid. You hold a PhD in either Applied Physics, Engineering Physics, Electrical Engineering or related, ideally with applied experience in startups or industry.

  • Experience building hardware that had to work. It can be a device you made, a product you had to test in a real-world environment, etc.

  • Commercial orientation. Beyond tech alone, you enjoy thinking about product, customers, economics, deployment, manufacturing or supply chains.

  • First principles reasoning. You can break down a problem into its core constituents to understand what needs to be true for things to work.

  • Clear communicator. You can articulate complex ideas and defend a conviction with sharp memos and engaging presentations.

  • Talent intuition. You know a great founder when you meet them, and if you want to work with them, you know how to persuade them.

  • Makes things happen. Team player who moves fast, with high standards for excellence, and high ownership on projects from start to finish.

We would love to hear from you if this sounds like you:

  • You have prior experience working with early-stage startups, deep tech commercialisation, applied R&D, or industrial tech development.

  • You are AI native. You can combine frontier tools and human judgment to maximise productivity and leverage in your work.

  • You are relentlessly curious. You stay current in your own field, you enjoy learning about new domains, and you learn very fast.

  • You have a superpower. For example: technical mastery in a field, the ability to see patterns where others cannot, truly original ideas, high EQ and energy level, strong network in a relevant domain, extraordinary writing skills, etc.

  • You are playing to win. You know that venture is competitive and follows a power law, and the challenge motivates you.

  • You are a pragmatic optimist with a driving motivation to solve the hardest problems in electrification, clean energy and intelligence.

Your ability to learn on the job matters more than ticking every box.

What We Offer

  • Full-time (CDI) contract, Associate level*

  • €60-70k gross annual base salary + 10% target bonus + stock options

  • Office in Paris. Occasional remote days are possible

  • Health insurance (Alan), meal and mobility vouchers (Swile)

  • Exposure to our network of top founders, investors, and advisors

  • Working with the brightest, most driven individuals you'll meet

  • Rapid learning curve and personal development

  • Enhanced parental support

What is hard to capture just with the above is the unique opportunity this role offers to join Marble in the early days of our journey, and shape the future of what we hope will become a top institution in climate and hard tech in Europe and beyond.

(*) We're opportunistically open to more experienced candidates who could potentially join at the Senior Associate level.

We believe that a diverse group of minds creates an unfair team advantage when building high impact companies. Hence, we actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds, genders and perspective to apply.

Studies have shown that under-represented candidates are less likely to apply unless they feel they meet every single qualification. If you are excited about the opportunity but your experience does not align perfectly - please apply anyway!

title: Associate Relationship Manager - Midlands
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Our vision is to reimagine Relationship Banking for established SMEs, through the very best people, products and digital tools. Allica’s Relationship Management team was formed in 2022 and continues to grow at pace, providing established SME customers with expert human relationships alongside modern banking technology.

The team supports customers with lending, current accounts, savings, asset finance and working capital facilities, while building deep local relationships with SME customers, trusted professional advisers and business communities.

The Associate Relationship Manager role is a newly created position that is a key step in our ambition to build the best Relationship team to support our SME clients. The successful candidate will manage a portfolio of clients and be expected to deliver across a range of commercial, customer service and risk objectives whilst also providing support to the wider relationship team as part of their development.

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to develop their skills and progress a career as an SME Relationship Manager.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Manage a portfolio of SME customers delivering outstanding customer service, building genuine and trusting relationships and develop a deep understanding of your clients’ businesses and their ambitions.

  • Deliver against a range of commercial targets including lending and new customer / deposit acquisition, as well as identifying and meeting a range of client needs through the provision of Allica products and services.

  • Build a trusted external network with SME advisers and the wider business community. Leverage this network to generate new business opportunities for the bank, in addition to signposting your clients to external support and advice as appropriate.

  • Ensure that Risk is managed effectively on your portfolio, with all required risk activities completed on time and to a high standard. Use customer data and internal Allica systems to identify signs of client stress and take proactive action to tackle early.

  • Work closely with a Senior Relationship Manager, contributing to building a bespoke personal development plan which will include supporting them and the wider team as part of your learning.

  • Take an active role in new business campaigns, including attending events, following up on leads, supporting prospect engagement and undertaking some cold calling where appropriate.

  • Support event organisation and follow-up activity, helping the team build strong local relationships with SME customers, prospects, accountants, solicitors and other trusted professional advisers.

  • Maintain accurate CRM records, strong follow-up discipline and good control over customer, prospect and portfolio activity.

  • Build strong, collaborative and productive relationships with your team and wider internal stakeholders to ensure customer needs are meet efficiently and any issues resolved quickly.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Some B2B sales, account management and/or SME banking experience, with a clear interest in building a career in SME relationship banking and a passion for supporting SMEs to be more successful.

  • Some experience of commercial lending and understanding / analysing financial accounts would be of benefit.

  • Curious, proactive and keen to learn, with the motivation to develop lending, sales, risk management and portfolio management capability through formal training and on-the-job coaching.

  • Confident engaging with customers, prospects and SME business advisers (including in person, via video call and by phone) asking great questions, following up consistently and building professional relationships.

  • Good organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage customer information and requests, portfolio tasks and follow-up actions accurately and at pace.

  • Practical understanding of customer service, sales activity and account management disciplines, ideally gained in a B2B, financial services or relationship-led environment.

  • Confident using systems, CRM tools and data to manage activity, track progress and support strong customer and risk outcomes.

  • Experience using AI tools in a business environment would also be of benefit.

  • An energetic, resilient, hands-on approach, with the confidence to get into the detail, solve problems and take ownership of outcomes.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to build credibility with customers, prospects, advisers, colleagues and stakeholders.

  • Strong alignment to Allica’s values, with the judgement, integrity and energy to lead by example and help contribute to the next phase of the Direct Relationship Management channel.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.
