  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs is scaling fast – new enterprise customers, new products, new markets. The Billing Operations Specialist is the person who makes sure every deal that closes is reflected correctly in our systems.

This is an operational ownership role, sitting at the intersection of Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Engineering – responsible for the full billing lifecycle of our enterprise accounts, from provisioning a new customer on day one to cleanly closing out a churned account. You'll resolve discrepancies before customers notice them, catch configuration drift before it becomes a revenue problem, and build the processes that make billing feel invisible to everyone else. You'll also work on projects and programs that evolve the sophistication of our billing processes and our tooling, and help with things like pricing migrations and other critical efforts.

The ideal person is someone who is obsessive about accuracy and automation, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and energized (not frustrated) by the complexity of managing billing at scale across thousands of accounts.

Provisioning

  • Translate closed-won deals from Salesforce into correctly configured subscriptions in our billing platforms, such as Stripe – pricing plan, billing interval, contract start date, trial periods, discounts

  • Own the reconciliation between executed order forms and what's been requested for provisioning; work with Sales and Legal to resolve any gaps

  • Partner with Engineering to identify automation opportunities and build guardrails that make provisioning faster and more accurate over time

Subscription & account management

  • Process mid-cycle changes and manage renewal mechanics – upgrades, downgrades, seat changes, plan switches, and so on.

  • Handle offboarding cleanly: close subscriptions, issue final invoices or credits, ensure no residual billing

  • Resolve invoice discrepancies raised by customers or flagged by the Customer Success team – incorrect amounts, missing credits, misapplied discounts

Revenue integrity

  • Run periodic audits of active subscriptions to verify billing matches contracted terms

  • Identify and remediate ghost subscriptions, duplicate customers, and orphaned invoices

  • Support month-end and quarter-end close by reconciling billing platforms with Finance's records

  • Surface pricing or configuration anomalies to relevant teams.

Requirements

Must-have

  • 2-5 years in billing operations, revenue operations, finance operations or a similar role supporting B2B or enterprise customers (adjust the range for level)

  • Hands-on experience with a subscription billing platform, ideally Stripe Billing or similar (Chargebee, Zuora, Recurly), including subscriptions, invoices, credits, coupons and billing intervals

  • Experience turning closed-won deals and order forms into correct billing configurations (pricing plan, start date, trial, discounts)

  • Strong attention to detail and a record of catching discrepancies before customers do

  • Can read a contract or order form and spot gaps against what was requested for provisioning

  • Experience reconciling billing data to finance records, including supporting month-end or quarter-end close

  • Comfort working with Salesforce (or another CRM) as the source of truth for deals

  • Clear written communication and ability to work across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal and Engineering

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and with managing a high volume of accounts without losing track

Strong plus

  • Experience with usage-based or hybrid pricing

  • Familiarity with SQL, spreadsheets at scale (pivots, lookups), or BI tools, for audits and reconciliation

  • Experience building automation or scripts, or partnering with Engineering on guardrails (APIs, webhooks, no-code tools)

  • Experience running subscription audits, such as finding ghost subscriptions, duplicate customers and orphaned invoices

  • Experience with pricing migrations or billing-system migrations

  • Exposure to ASC 606 or revenue recognition basics

  • Experience with a quote-to-cash stack (CPQ, contract management, ERP such as NetSuite)

  • Experience at a high-growth SaaS or AI company

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States or Europe.

  • Concevoir les créations de nos campagnes marketing : publicités, réseaux sociaux, emails, lancements produits et communications clients.

  • Rendre accessibles des sujets complexes (gestion des dépenses, finance, conformité, IA) grâce à des illustrations, infographies, schémas et vidéos.

  • Créer nos supports commerciaux et institutionnels : présentations, brochures, fiches produits, témoignages clients, documents corporate.

  • Piloter le design et les évolutions courantes de notre site web (cohérence visuelle, parcours, landing pages, intégration de contenus), en lien avec l'agence qui gère la partie technique, et documenter composants et process.

  • Mener tes projets du brief à la livraison, dans le respect des délais et des contraintes de production digitale et print.


Ce qu'on va attendre de toi :

  • Tu as environ 5 ans d'expérience en tant que graphiste dans un environnement B2B SaaS ou tech, en entreprise ou en agence auprès de clients B2B SaaS.

  • Tu as conçu des campagnes multicanales et tu connais les contraintes du digital comme du print.

  • Tu as une expérience pratique d'un CMS (création de pages, intégration de contenus, responsive) et une bonne compréhension des principes UX/UI, d'accessibilité et de conversion.

  • Tu utilises les outils de création assistée par l'IA avec pertinence, en gardant un regard exigeant sur la qualité, l'originalité et les droits d'utilisation.

  • Tu es créatif(ve), force de proposition, autonome et rigoureux(se), et tu as l'œil pour repérer la moindre erreur.

  • Tu sais mener plusieurs projets de front et défendre tes choix créatifs auprès des équipes.

  • Tu parles anglais couramment pour échanger avec nos équipes européennes.

C'est un plus si :

  • Tu as une expérience en fintech ou dans les services financiers.

  • Tu pratiques le motion design, notamment sur After Effects.

  • Tu sais faire du montage vidéo (réseaux sociaux, témoignages clients, lancements) : un format encore peu développé chez nous, que tu pourras faire grandir.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Une entreprise rentable, en pleine croissance, avec une dimension européenne.

  • Des projets variés qui laissent une large place à la créativité : on t'encourage à proposer, donner ton avis et challenger l'existant, en toute autonomie.

  • Un poste à fort impact : tes créations porteront l'évolution de notre identité et feront de notre site une vraie vitrine, génératrice de demandes de démo.

title: Broker Development Manager
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

THE ROLE 

Our brokers play a crucial role in making this a reality. We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. You’ll use AI day to day, from researching brokers to preparing for meetings, so more of your time goes on the conversations that win business. We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate Broker Development Manager to accelerate our distribution through brokers. In this role, you’ll maximise existing broker relationships and build strong, strategic, growth partnerships as part of our fast-paced distribution team right at the heart of Flock’s mission.

WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE:

Be a part of building something truly game changing in the fleet market. You’ll manage a panel of key strategic brokers with significant growth opportunities. You’ll engage them on the market-leading benefits of Flock’s connected fleet proposition, and how together, we can reduce risk, improve costs and save lives. You’ll also have real freedom in how you use AI to work, whether that’s getting under the skin of a broker’s book before a meeting or spotting growth opportunities across your panel.

A LITTLE MORE ON WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

  • Act as a primary face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners, driving mutual growth and long-term success.

  • Deliver high volumes of broker submissions, directly supporting Flock’s ambitious growth targets.

  • Build, grow and develop our broker panel, onboarding new partners at pace and maximising their commercial potential.

  • Proactively engage brokers, finding new and creative ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors.

  • Develop and execute clear, data-driven account growth strategies to drive sustained performance.

  • Achieve strong conversion and retention by supporting day-to-day trading activity and helping brokers (and Flock) win and retain business.

  • Work closely with internal teams, collaborating with brilliant Flockers across the business to deliver shared growth objectives.

  • Maintain strong broker advocacy by being visible, responsive and passionate about Flock’s product, proposition and mission.

  • Use AI in your day-to-day work, from broker research and meeting prep to analysing your pipeline, so your time goes on relationships rather than admin.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK:

ESSENTIAL

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in managing broker relationships within the insurance sector, possessing a reputable standing in the industry.

  • Energy and innovation in abundance - the ability to work fast, spot opportunity and solve problems. 

  • A proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, driving business growth, and closely collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve collective objectives.

  • An existing network of broker contacts that will enable a rapid integration and immediate impact within Flock’s business development realm.

  • Exceptional understanding of the commercial broker marketplace, competitor carriers, broker business models, and processes.

  • Ability to deliver a consultative sales process, aligning Flock’s value proposition with brokers’ current and future business needs.

  • Comfortable using AI in your daily work, from research and meeting prep to account analysis, and curious about where else it could help you win business.

PREFERABLE

  • Experience building networks of brokers in a Commercial Motor Fleet setting. 

  • Have a broker distribution background with an active panel of brokers in the commercial insurance market. 

  • Can embrace new technologies and products, with experience of successfully distributing these to brokers.

WHAT WE OFFER (in addition to a competitive salary)

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖 

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

ONE LAST THING..

Authenticity is important to us. We value the unique qualities and experiences you bring. So if you apply, just be your genuine self. It’s who we want!

descriptionHtml:
Who Are We ?

🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless.

Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.

At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.

Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.

We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy.

💼 About This Role

We are looking for a Business Product Owner to join our team and act as a mini-CEO for one of our key markets, taking full ownership of its performance and growth. You will play a crucial role in establishing and maintaining our products' market leadership, driving product expansion, and enhancing operational efficiency.

  • You understand our product, customers, and operational landscape; how value is created, delivered, and scaled and start identifying opportunities for improvement.

  • You establish strong working relationships with the Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success teams.

By 3 months

  • You analyse product workflows and cost structures to improve efficiency and reduce time-to-market without sacrificing product quality.

  • You coordinate cross-functional initiatives with Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to ensure efficient and well-executed go-lives.

  • You become the main point of contact for our customers and engage directly with them, turning feedback into clear, actionable insights.

By 6 months

  • You proactively drive product and operational improvements that measurably impact efficiency, cost, and customer satisfaction.

  • You influence roadmap decisions through market research, competitive analysis, and customer data.

  • You streamline customer support and success processes to improve response times and long-term customer health.

  • You’re trusted as a key partner across teams – shaping how we scale, not just what we build.

🚀 What You Need to Be Successful:

  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field.

  • You bring 3+ years of professional experience in customer success, account management, or similar roles within a B2B environment, ideally in SaaS.

  • You are fluent in English. Proficiency in additional languages is a plus.

  • With the strong background in client-facing roles you bring, you know how to engage stakeholders at every level, bridging the gap between technical execution and executive leadership.

  • You put the customer first, anticipate their needs, and focus on delivering solutions that improve satisfaction and the overall experience.

  • You are based in Munich and able to work from the office 3 days per week.

💡It’s a Plus If You Have

  • Previous experience in the logistics industry.

  • Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment.

🌟 How We Set You Up to Be Successful

We don’t just define what success looks like – we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us.

  • Onboarding sessions with your hiring manager & COO, Ksenia, to understand your role, goals, and priorities.

  • Onboarding sessions with our COO, Ksenia and CEO, Felix, to learn about CONROO’s vision, strategy, and business.

  • HR onboarding, with our People Partner, Hind, covering our values, tools, policies, and processes.

  • Product onboarding session with our Product Owner, Özgür.

  • A buddy system to support you during your first 2 months.

  • Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured.

  • We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly.

👥 About Our Team

We’re a team of around 30 curious minds working from our offices in Munich and Nuremberg – and remotely across Germany. We value ownership and a mindset driven by continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work – and have fun in the process together along the way.

🤝 Why Us

💫 A mission that matters: Be part of a company that’s working on something meaningful and a purpose you can stand behind.

🏝️ Workation: Switch up your usual scenery and spend up to 30 days working remotely from a different location.

🎉 CONROO Time Off: Some moments deserve more than a celebration! Enjoy extra days off for special milestones like your birthday, wedding, or welcoming a new family member.

🎟️ Employee discounts: Use our employee discount portal to access attractive deals from top brands across tech, travel, fashion, home, and more – online and in-store.

🌍 International team: With 10 nationalities across a team of around 30 people, you’ll be part of a naturally diverse environment where different perspectives come together.

🧠 Hungry for knowledge? Our monthly S.H.A.R.E sessions teach you something new every month and give you the stage to share your passion & expertise too. If you want to go further, we’re happy to support you with a course, workshop, or other training opportunities.

Our Recruitment Process - simple, quick, and human.

title: Central Relationship Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Allica exists for the half a million or so established SMEs with typically 5 to 100 employees. These SMEs are a crucial pillar of the UK’s prosperity - representing more than a quarter of all turnover and jobs - yet are increasingly neglected by traditional high street banks.

Since early 2021 Allica Bank has been building its direct SME relationship proposition too. Our vision is to reimagine Local Relationship Banking for established SMEs, through the very best people and digital tools.

Our Central Relationship Managers (Central RMs) will initially be focussed on assisting SMEs with turnover up to £1m supporting clients business ambitions through the provision of day-to-day banking facilities including business current accounts and savings as well as commercial mortgages and asset finance. Over time, we’re building a wider SME banking product to offer working capital solutions, and you’ll represent Allica across all these products too.

Role Description

Supporting a portfolio of centrally managed customers, ensuring they are well served with strong customer satisfaction, ensuring good credit risk management of your portfolio and growing the portfolio via your own business development activities and working with Allica’s marketing team and their lead generation capabilities.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Successfully relationship managing a centralised portfolio of local SMEs, providing secured SME lending including commercial mortgages and asset finance, alongside current accounts and savings, widening over time in line with our offering.

  • Through ongoing proactive client engagement and forward-looking conversations to unlock opportunities to support businesses with their plans and ambitions.

  • Credit risk monitoring for your portfolio including spotting early warning signs and fulfilling additional credit requests.

  • Originating SME lending opportunities from initial enquiry through to completion, including writing credit papers in line with Allica’s credit policy and appetite.

  • Delivering the business plan for your portfolio, and actively managing your objectives and personal development plans. Capable of horizon risk scanning, interpreting local markets and delivering action plans.

  • You’ll be able to evidence an ability to work expertly with customers, colleagues and advisors to structure new lending proposals and write credit applications.

  • Making your colleagues proud that you represent Allica, by ensuring excellent service for SME customers, prospects and advisors. You are a trusted partner for customers, building deep, multi-layered relationships.

  • Working closely and collaboratively with all areas of Allica to ensure a seamless and professional service is always provided.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • A deep passion for serving SMEs.

  • Self-starter organised and committed to succeeding in a flexible environment.

  • Highly capable relationship manager, with a track record of building high-value, trust based and long-lasting referral relationships, and the ability to develop good levels of new business on the back of these.

  • Good credit skills, including the ability to analyse and review financial accounts and associated information.

  • You will need to have a strong understanding of SME banking, which must include a strong background in commercial mortgages.

  • You will be able to demonstrate a history of exemplary level of service, and of maximising the value with prospects and customers.

  • You will have excellent interpersonal and communication skills together with evidence of strong career progression and/or outperformance.

  • You’ll be able to evidence an ability to work expertly with customers, colleagues and advisors to structure new lending proposals and write credit applications.

  • You’ll have a proven track record in providing excellent customer service, and in generating new income opportunities whilst effectively managing credit risk.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Chief of Staff - Operations
descriptionHtml:
Über Ralph

Ralph baut das Operating System für Wohnimmobilien. Der Markt ist riesig, und er läuft noch größtenteils auf Aktenordnern, Outlook und USB-Sticks. Wir sind der erste AI Property Manager, der auf einem eigenen Operating System läuft, und betreiben Gebäude damit End-to-End. Ralph OS automatisiert Zahlungen, Buchhaltung, Compliance und Kommunikation. AI-Agenten bereiten die Arbeit vor, und unser Team gibt sie frei. Die Hausverwaltung ist unser Einstieg. Das Ziel ist die neue Infrastruktur für die ganze Kategorie, mit Fintech, Versicherung und Finanzierung auf derselben Plattform. Heute verwalten wir über 10.000 Wohneinheiten und wachsen schnell, organisch und durch Zukäufe. Verantwortung bekommst du bei uns früh, und was du baust, nutzen wir direkt im Alltag.

Warum das wichtig ist

Aufgaben

  • Integration & Transformation: Du arbeitest eng mit dem VP Operations daran, neu erworbene Unternehmen sauber zu integrieren und operativ auf Ralph-Standard zu bringen.

  • Escalation Management: Du springst bei komplexen operativen Themen ein, strukturierst Sachverhalte und übersetzt sie in konkrete nächste Schritte.

  • Fixer: Dir ist kein Problem zu groß oder zu klein – du übernimmst Ownership und bleibst dran, bis das Problem kein Problem mehr ist.

Qualifikation

  • Entrepreneurial Spirit: Du willst verstehen, wie man ein Unternehmen operativ besser macht, und hast keine Berührungsängste, selbst hands-on einzusteigen.

  • Change Mindset: Du verstehst, dass gute Prozesse nicht nur gebaut, sondern erklärt, eingeführt und im Alltag verankert werden müssen.

  • Analytische Schärfe: Du liebst Daten und komplexe Zusammenhänge, kannst sie aber in einfache, umsetzbare Prozesse übersetzen.

  • Execution Power: Du hast einen extremen Drang zum Machen. Wenn du eine Mauer siehst, suchst du nicht nach dem Grund, sondern nach dem Weg darüber hinweg.

  • Kommunikation: Du bist rhetorisch stark, kannst auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen souverän auftreten und sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau.

Benefits

  • Sparring: Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem VP Operations zusammen und bekommst tiefen Einblick in zentrale Management-, Integrations- und Transformationsfragen. Hoher Exposure zum Rest des Executive Leadership Teams.

  • Impact: Deine Arbeit beeinflusst direkt unseren Unternehmenserfolg: keine Bullshit-Aufgaben, sondern echte Verantwortung an den wichtigsten Hebeln des Unternehmens.

  • Lernkurve: Du lernst eine riesige, bislang stark analoge Industrie von innen kennen und arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Operations, Product, Tech und Management.

title: Cloud Solution Architect
descriptionHtml:
Cloud Solution Architect - Data & AI

Location: UK (Hybrid)
Practice: Data & AI

About HSO

HSO is a Business Transformation Partner with deep industry expertise and global reach. As one of Microsoft's leading partners, we help organisations unlock the full potential of Microsoft Dynamics 365, Azure, Data and AI technologies to deliver meaningful business outcomes.

With operations across Europe, North America and Asia, HSO combines industry knowledge, technical excellence and a people-first culture to help customers modernise their businesses, transform operations and embrace innovation with confidence.

As demand for Data & AI solutions continues to accelerate, we're expanding our Data & AI practice and looking for experienced Cloud Solution Architects to help shape the next generation of customer transformation programmes.

The Role

As a Cloud Solution Architect - Data & AI, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping and qualifying customer opportunities across the Microsoft cloud ecosystem.

This is a highly visible role that sits at the intersection of sales, enterprise architecture and delivery, combining technical leadership with commercial thinking. You'll work closely with customers, Microsoft and internal stakeholders to understand business challenges, identify opportunities, design compelling solutions and create clear pathways from initial discovery through to successful delivery.

You'll help organisations transform the way they use data, analytics and artificial intelligence, translating business ambition into practical, costed and deliverable solutions.

Success in this role requires more than technical expertise. You'll need strong consulting and stakeholder management skills, the confidence to challenge assumptions, and the commercial awareness to ensure opportunities are both valuable for clients and aligned with HSO's delivery capability.

What You'll Be Doing

Opportunity Qualification & Solution Shaping

  • Lead Data & AI opportunity qualification alongside Account Managers, Business Development teams and Enterprise Architects.
  • Facilitate customer discovery workshops, architecture assessments and strategic discussions.
  • Understand customer business drivers, challenges and desired outcomes.
  • Help customers define realistic transformation roadmaps aligned to business priorities.
  • Qualify opportunities using structured sales and consulting methodologies, including MEDDIC/MEDDICC approaches.

Solution Architecture & Advisory

  • Design end-to-end Data & AI solutions using Microsoft technologies and best practices.
  • Shape modern analytics, AI and data platform architectures that are commercially viable and technically deliverable.
  • Provide architectural leadership across data platform modernisation, analytics, AI and automation initiatives.
  • Ensure alignment with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Well-Architected principles.
  • Communicate architectural trade-offs and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Commercial Leadership

  • Translate customer requirements into proposals, statements of work, delivery plans and business cases.
  • Produce solution estimates, cost models and phased implementation approaches.
  • Support customers in understanding ROI, value realisation and investment considerations.
  • Challenge unclear scope and identify delivery, cost and commercial risks early in the sales cycle.
  • Work closely with delivery teams to validate assumptions before commitments are made.

Growth & Go-to-Market

  • Contribute to the evolution of HSO's Data & AI propositions and repeatable offerings.
  • Develop demonstrations, accelerators, sales collateral and industry-specific solution narratives.
  • Support RFPs, bid responses, executive presentations and proof-of-concept engagements.
  • Collaborate with Microsoft stakeholders to drive pipeline growth and co-sell opportunities.
  • Keep up to date with emerging Microsoft technologies and industry trends across Data & AI.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate combines strong technical capability with exceptional commercial awareness.

You'll be equally comfortable discussing board-level business outcomes with executive stakeholders as you are diving into architecture decisions with technical teams.

Commercial & Consulting Experience

You'll have:

  • Proven experience in a Solution Architecture, Pre-Sales, Consulting or Technical Advisory role.
  • Experience working within a Microsoft partner, consultancy or enterprise technology environment.
  • Strong commercial acumen and experience creating proposals, business cases and Statements of Work.

title: Commercial Director
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

The Opportunity

This is one of the highest-leverage commercial roles in the business. As Commercial Director, you'll own the entire sales system at Relay — strategy, structure, process, and performance across all four of our segments: Pitstop/Field Sales, Enterprise, Large Parcel, and SME Parcel. You'll set the standards that let each segment lead build well, and you'll be personally accountable for the sum of the results.

Beyond the day-to-day, this role has a genuine builder's brief: creating the infrastructure and team capabilities that take Relay international over the next few years. If you want to shape how a fast-growing carrier goes to market at scale — and leave a lasting mark on how that machine works — this is the role.

What You'll Own

Sales strategy and structure

  • Design the shape of Relay's sales organisation across all four segments — how they relate, where they overlap, how resource is prioritised

  • Define the sales motion for each segment: who it sells to, how, and through which channel

  • Keep strategy current as the business and market evolve

Data and performance management

  • Set the metrics that matter across pipeline, conversion, quota attainment, and productivity

  • Build or oversee the dashboards that surface them

  • Use data to make decisions on resourcing, territory design, and where to invest or pull back — instinct complements data here, it doesn't replace it

Process, structure, and scalability

  • Own the sales playbook, forecasting cadence, deal review process, CRM hygiene standards, and comp and quota-setting principles

  • Upskill and coach the existing team on pitch, process, and performance

  • Build infrastructure that scales for the next three years, not just today's headcount

Team leadership and org design

  • Lead the four segment sales leads (Pitstop/Field, Enterprise, Large Parcel, SME Parcel) and any central sales ops or enablement partners

  • Decide what's centralised across functions versus what each segment lead owns locally

  • Hire, develop, and coach those leads so each can build out their patch well

Global and remote team leadership

  • Lead teams remotely across time zones and geographies as Relay expands into the Americas and Europe

  • Proven capability to do this is a requirement — it can't be learned on the job here

Exec partnership and GTM planning

  • Partner with the CCO and other function leads on revenue planning, headcount decisions, and commercial trade-offs

  • Translate company strategy into a sequenced sales roadmap and GTM direction

  • Push back clearly when targets or timelines aren't realistic

Who Will Thrive in This Role

  • Multi-motion sales leader. You've led more than one kind of sales motion — for example, high-volume SMB or transactional sales alongside enterprise or mid-market relationship-led sales. You're comfortable setting standards and managing performance across both. You've carried a number yourself and led others doing the same. This isn't a role for a single-lane specialist.

  • Data-driven and structured operator. You define the metrics that matter, build or oversee the dashboards, and use data to make resourcing and process calls — not gut feel alone. You have a track record of introducing or significantly upgrading forecasting discipline, CRM hygiene, territory design, and comp structures in ways that improved consistency and scalability. You think in systems across a multi-year horizon, not just the next quarter.

  • Global and remote team builder. You've led sales teams across multiple geographies or time zones, ideally including the US and Europe. You're comfortable setting standards, culture, and expectations remotely. Having helped take a company into a new country is a bonus; the core requirement is proven capability.

  • People leader and org designer. You've led sales managers or leaders — not just individual contributors — and operated at least one layer removed from the front line. You have a track record of hiring and developing leaders beneath you, and making clear calls about what to centralise versus what to delegate.

  • Exec partner. You've partnered directly with a CEO, founder, or C-suite on revenue planning and commercial trade-offs. You can push back on unrealistic targets while maintaining trust, and you can translate company strategy into an actionable, sequenced sales roadmap.

  • Builder, not just operator. You've introduced new process, data infrastructure, or org structure in a previous role — not only operated within a system someone else built. This role is not about being a super-IC closer or a sector-pedigree hire; logistics experience is welcome but not a requirement or a filter.

Compensation, Benefits & Workplace

  • Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay’s success.

  • Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you’d need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it.

  • 25 days of holidays

  • Enhanced parental leave.

  • Hardware of your choice.

  • Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more).

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Company Operations Lead
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs moves fast - by design. We run lean, we bias toward action, and we trust our people to figure things out. That's how we've built world-leading AI products in three years with a fraction of the headcount of our peers. But speed at 200 people and speed at 1,000+ people are different challenges, and the systems, habits, and connective tissue that let a company move fast without breaking things don't build themselves.

As our Company Operations Lead, you'll own the infrastructure that lets ElevenLabs keep its velocity as it scales. Not by adding process for process's sake - but by building the right systems, in the right places, at the right time, so that the rest of the company can focus on what they do best. You'll establish the operating layer that keeps a 50-country, hybrid organization coherent; drive the strategic planning cadence that keeps leadership aligned; and deploy a lean team of strategic generalists against the company's most urgent cross-functional challenges.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Operating Cadence: Running the planning and alignment cycles that keep the company pointed in the right direction. This includes OKR planning, workforce, and headcount planning.

  • Operating System: Building and maintaining the infrastructure layer that lets the company move faster. Systems of record, org taxonomy and governance, and the knowledge management systems that ensure information flow effectively across our remote-first team.

  • AI Enablement & Agentification: Ensuring every team at ElevenLabs has the tools, access, and knowledge to work effectively with AI. You'll own the internal AI enablement framework - managing tool access and rollout, identifying where agents and automation can accelerate how functions operate, and building the learning opportunities and champions programmes that drive deep adoption. You'll work closely with Security, IT, and the Automations team to ensure what gets built is built right.

  • Operations Centre of Excellence: Defining what great operations looks like at ElevenLabs and embedding it across the company. You'll set the blueprint that makes operational excellence repeatable and deploy the team as embedded operators inside other functions, standing up best practices, up-skilling teams, and handing off cleanly once the work is done.

Requirements

We do not require formal experience, certifications, or degrees. We do require:

  • Proven experience building and leading a Strategy & Operations or BizOps function at a high-growth technology company - ideally through a meaningful scaling inflection (Series B–D trajectory or equivalent).

  • Track record of standing up functions and systems from scratch and handing them off, rather than owning a permanent queue.

  • Structured problem-solving background - strategy consulting, a BizOps or Chief of Staff seat with genuine strategic scope, or an operator role that required both systems-building and executive influence.

  • Strong AI and tooling fluency - you should be pushing the organisation on what's possible with AI enablement, not chasing it.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management: you can partner with founders and Leads and earn trust quickly in a flat, high-velocity environment.

Bonus:

  • Experience inside a company that scaled through a 200 → 2,000+ person inflection.

  • Background that spans both consulting and operator roles - you've done the thinking and the building.

  • Familiarity with knowledge management, AI agentification, or internal tooling as an operational discipline.

Location

This role is remote. London or New York preferred.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

descriptionHtml:
About Ledger

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

The team

The Consolidation team, part of Finance (Accounting & Consolidation), prepares the Group’s IFRS consolidated financial statements across multiple international legal entities. The team is moving its consolidation EPM tool from SAP BFC (ViaReport C&R) to Amelkis EPM, with a go-live targeted for Q1 2027, while preparing the 2026 annual closing. The intern supports both work streams and reports to the Consolidation Director.

What you’ll be doing:

Annual consolidation closing (2026)

  • Support the preparation of the Group’s IFRS consolidated financial statements across multiple legal entities

  • Assist with intercompany reconciliation and eliminations

  • Process consolidation adjustments and review reporting packages submitted by subsidiaries

  • Liaise with subsidiary finance teams to collect, control and consolidate reporting packages

  • Support ad hoc analyses requested during the annual audit

EPM tool migration (SAP BFC to Amelkis EPM)

  • Contribute to data migration, configuration and testing workshops for the new Amelkis consolidation/EPM tool

  • Participate in the “double run” phase to ensure data accuracy between the legacy and new systems

title: Consultant Senior AI Advisory - CDI Paris - Theodo Data & AI
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Créée en 2016, Theodo Data & AI est l'entité Data et IA de Theodo. Notre ambition est d'accompagner nos clients dans la conception et le déploiement de leur stratégie data ainsi que la recherche et le développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle à l’état de l’art. L'entreprise est en pleine croissance : chaque année, Theodo Data & AI enregistre une croissance de plus de 30 % de son chiffre d'affaires, ouvrant ainsi de nouvelles opportunités passionnantes pour les Theodoers !
Ton équipe : Tu rejoins l’activité AI Advisory que Theodo est en train de lancer. Le rôle de ton équipe : aider les directions générales à passer de l’expérimentation IA à un impact business massif, en réconciliant vision stratégique et réalité technologique. Ton objectif en tant que Consultant Senior / Manager AI Advisory est de contribuer, piloter et (selon ton niveau) vendre des missions de conseil AI & Data, avec un niveau d’exigence “cabinet d’excellence” et une obsession pour la mise en production. Tes missions : Piloter le delivery de missions de conseil IA : cadrage de cas d’usage, analyse de valeur, audits (SI / data / plateformes), production de livrables structurants (schéma directeur, business case, roadmap IA). Être l’interlocuteur de confiance côté client : gérer la relation au quotidien, embarquer les parties prenantes (DG, C-level, DSI, Directeur Data/IA…), challenger les idées et sécuriser l’adoption (culture, gouvernance, éthique). Structurer l’exécution vers l’impact : transformer un besoin flou en plan d’action clair (Audit → MVP → Scale), prioriser et piloter les chantiers avec une logique ROI (EBITDA, churn, productivité, etc.). Contribuer au build de l’activité (selon le niveau) : concevoir des offres et méthodologies AI Advisory, formaliser des frameworks, capitaliser sur les retours mission. Développer le business (selon le niveau) : identifier des opportunités de rebond, porter l’avant-vente, rédiger les propositions commerciales et assurer le foisonnement. Leadership & coaching (niveau Manager) : encadrer et faire grandir des consultants sur les missions, challenger leurs travaux, garantir la qualité globale et la satisfaction des décideurs. Tes perspectives d’évolutions : Chez Theodo, tu participes à la construction d’une nouvelle activité : tu n’arrives pas dans une structure figée. Selon tes appétences, tu pourras évoluer vers des rôles de Lead / Principal AI Advisor, Practice Lead, ou piloter des programmes de transformation IA à grande échelle, avec une forte exposition sur des enjeux stratégiques et commerciaux. Profil recherché : Tu as 2 à 5 ans d’expérience (Consultant Senior) ou 5 à 8 ans (Manager), idéalement en cabinet de conseil ou boutique reconnue Data/IA (Big 4, Capgemini Invent, Accenture… ou Artefact, Eleven, AI Builders…). Tu as une expérience impérative sur des comptes SBF120 / CAC40 ou des scale-ups avec une forte complexité organisationnelle (missions de transformation > 6 mois). Tu es tech-fluent : pas besoin d’être codeur, mais tu comprends l’architecture SI/data, tu sais distinguer mode vs innovation de rupture, et tu testes les outils (LLMs, agents…) pour en connaître les limites réelles. Tu as une vraie posture de trusted advisor : écoute active, intelligence situationnelle, fiabilité, capacité à créer de la confiance avec des décideurs. Tu maîtrises la synthèse top-down : tu sais captiver un COMEX en 3 slides, tout en pouvant descendre dans le détail technique quand nécessaire. Tu as une forte rigueur analytique et une culture ROI : tu sais chiffrer l’impact financier et piloter l’exécution avec obsession du résultat. Process de recrutement : Sourcing / pré-sélection si pertinent Premier entretien avec le responsable AI Advisory (Yannick) Étude de cas Éventuellement deuxième entretien expert ou managérial Entretien VP (Clément)Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo Data & IA ? title: Corporate Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’ collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Learn more at superhuman.com.

The Opportunity

Superhuman is on a mission to build the fastest, most delightful productivity experiences powered by AI. As we scale rapidly, our internal technology operations must evolve to match our ambition.

We’re looking for a Security Engineer to join our Corporate Technology team. Our commitment to user trust is unwavering, and this new team member will play a crucial role in protecting Superhuman’s corporate environment and the infrastructure that millions of users depend on. Working closely with the Corporate Infrastructure team, you will harden and secure the systems our employees rely on every day, Identity and Access Management, Endpoint Management, SaaS platforms, and Networking, while ensuring that security enables speed rather than slowing it down.

This is an opportunity to build and maintain critical security programs, including Insider Risk, Threat and Vulnerability Management, and Third-Party Risk. You’ll leverage AI to build smarter security controls and processes, and help define how AI itself is secured across our corporate infrastructure. Your work will empower employees to move fast while maintaining a high bar for corporate security.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and maintain corporate security controls that enable employees to move fast with confidence, making the secure path the easiest path.

  • Develop security standards, guidelines, and policies in collaboration with the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team.

  • Leverage AI to build and scale security controls, automate security processes, and accelerate threat detection and response across our corporate infrastructure.

  • Define and implement AI security standards for the corporate environment, ensuring employees can safely adopt AI-powered tools and workflows.

  • Perform risk assessments and security assurance on systems that support Superhuman’s business operations: IdP, operating systems, desktop applications, SaaS solutions, and network infrastructure (ZTNA, CASB, VPN).

  • Lead the design and execution of a corporate Zero Trust architecture, working across identity, endpoint, and network security.

  • Drive the remediation of security vulnerabilities identified through assessments.

  • Evaluate and implement cutting-edge enterprise security technology to continuously strengthen our security posture.

Qualifications

  • Has 6+ years of experience working on a Security team in corporate security, enterprise security, or a related domain for a SaaS company.

  • Expert-level understanding and experience in at least two corporate security domains: Identity and Access Management, Endpoint Management, SaaS platforms, and Networking.

  • Strong experience with data protection technologies (DSPM, discovery, masking, access controls, DLP, backup).

  • Strong experience with assessing the configuration of common SaaS applications (SSPM), such as Salesforce, Workday, and Coupa.

  • Strong experience with both macOS and Windows endpoint security.

  • Familiarity with AI security principles and practical knowledge of how to secure AI adoption in a corporate environment.

  • Demonstrated experience using AI to build security controls, automate security processes, or scale security operations.

  • Ability to assess risk in ambiguous situations and make balanced security decisions that consider both offensive and defensive perspectives.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and manage up effectively.

  • A mindset that security should enable speed, experience designing controls that protect without creating unnecessary friction.

  • Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments.

Compensation and Benefits

We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

Benefits

Häufige Fragen zum Loom-Video im Bewerbungsprozess

Wenn du dich bei uns bewirbst möchten wir ein Loom Video von dir erhalten. 🙏🏻

Warum wollt ihr ein Video statt eines Anschreibens? Weil wir in der Content-Branche arbeiten und uns ein kurzes Video in zwei Minuten mehr über dich sagt als jedes Anschreiben.

Was ist Loom und brauche ich einen Account? Loom ist ein kostenloses Tool, mit dem du dich selbst und/oder deinen Bildschirm aufnimmst und per Link teilst. Die kostenlose Version reicht völlig. Du kannst auch jedes andere Tool nutzen (z. B. Handyvideo über Google Drive) Hauptsache, wir können den Link öffnen.

Wie lang sollte das Video sein? 2–4 Minuten. Kürzer ist besser als länger – wenn du es knapp auf den Punkt bringst, ist das schon ein Pluspunkt.

Was soll ich im Video sagen? Stell dich kurz vor, erzähl, warum du zu RealStudio willst, und zeig uns ein Projekt, einen Kunden oder ein Ergebnis, auf das du stolz bist. Gerne mit geteiltem Bildschirm, z. B. Kampagnen, Reportings oder Content, an dem du beteiligt warst.

Muss das Video professionell aussehen? Nein. Kein Schnitt, keine Musik, kein Skript nötig. Wir bewerten nicht die Videoqualität, sondern dich. Ein ruhiger Ort und guter Ton reichen.

Auf Deutsch oder Englisch? Bitte auf Deutsch, da unsere Kunden überwiegend aus dem DACH-Raum kommen.

Wer sieht mein Video? Nur die Personen, die bei uns am Bewerbungsprozess beteiligt sind. Wir teilen es nicht weiter und löschen es nach Abschluss des Verfahrens.

Wie geht es nach dem Video weiter? Wir melden uns innerhalb von max 2 Werktagen bei dir. Wenn es passt, folgt ein Kennenlern-Call und danach ein Probetag, an dem du an einer realistischen Aufgabe mit uns arbeitest.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

You will ensure the consistent achievement of key performance indicators (KPIs), use data and insight to foster continuous improvement, and champion initiatives that streamline processes and improve customer experiences. descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Renewals are the core of a SaaS company's revenue. You own renewal targets for Samsara's Digital Mid-Market segment: setting customers up for success while maximising financial results. On every deal that means minimising attrition, locking in the best terms, spotting growth opportunities, feeding insights back to the business and closing 36-month renewals.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
  • You enjoy working at high velocity: 
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will: 

  • Own 60+ renewals per quarter from end-to-end and exceed sales targets
  • Follow a structured scenario-based forecasting methodology 
  • Engage with customers to identify and mitigate renewal risk and drive platform adoption at scale
  • Work cross-functionally with sales teams to solve problems and ensure a successful, smooth renewal
  • Contribute to an exceptional team environment that motivates the team to perform at its best
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Business fluency in French (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years of full-cycle closing sales experience, ideally with mid-sized businesses in a high-transaction environment.
  • A record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • Empathy for customers and teammates, and strong organisation.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

Du übernimmst von Anfang an viel Verantwortung und eigene Kundenaccounts und arbeitest direkt mit den beiden Gründern und unserem Customer-Success-Team zusammen. Du lernst unsere Kunden, Coaches und Programme kennen und wirst schnell zur festen Ansprechperson für Deine Accounts.

title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Diese Rolle passt perfekt zu Dir, wenn Du:

  • du Energie von Gesprächen bekommst und gerne im Austausch bist
  • selbst anpackst: egal ob Anruf, Follow-up oder spontane Rückfrage
  • Lust hast, Teil eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens zu sein
  • 1-2 Jahre Erfahrung im Account Management oder Kundenkontakt mitbringst
  • erste Erfahrung mit CRM Systemen und digitalen Abläufen hast

Diese Rolle passt gar nicht, wenn Du:

  • auf detaillierte Anweisungen wartest, bevor du einen Schritt machst
  • Kundengespräche als lästige Pflicht siehst
  • du dich an wiederkehrenden Aufgaben und optimierten Prozessen störst

Was wir machen

Fired Up bietet Weiterbildungen und Coaching für Menschen in der Karriereorientierung – gefördert über Bildungsgutschein und AVGS, kostenlos für unsere Teilnehmenden. Wir sind AZAV-zertifiziert und begleiten jährlich über 1.300 Menschen durch unsere Programme. Unser kleines, engagiertes Team in Berlin wächst und du kannst ein Teil davon sein. Die Arbeitswelt verändert sich gerade stark durch KI und wir haben einen Impact, Menschen Zugänge zur neuen Arbeitswelt zu schaffen.

Dein Job (konkret, nicht in Buzzwords)

Intro Calls mit unseren Clients führen

Dein Kernstück: Du führst täglich zehn bis zwölf kurze Erstgespräche (je 15 Minuten) mit Menschen, die gerade in einer beruflichen Umbruchphase sind. Du informierst sie über unsere Angebote, nimmst dir kurz Zeit für sie – und schickst danach eine knappe Follow-up-Mail. Klingt simpel, hat aber echten Einfluss auf Menschen in einer verletzlichen Phase.

Was du brauchst: Kommunikationsstärke, Empathie, aktives Zuhören, gutes Zeitgefühl, fließendes Deutsch und Englisch

Matching mit unseren Programmen

Du informierst welche Programme wir anbieten und schaust welche am besten passt.

Was du brauchst: Sorgfalt, Systemverständnis (Hubspot), Kollaborationsbereitschaft

Follow Up Aufgaben

Du bleibst an den Menschen dran, rufst an um zu sehen ob das Programm beantragt wurde.

Was du brauchst: Grid, Drive, Energie

Was du mitbringst

Must-haves:

  • Freundliche, empathische Kommunikation – du machst Menschen das Ankommen leicht
  • 1-2 Jahre Erfahrung im Kundenservice
  • Fließend Deutsch und Englisch, mündlich und schriftlich
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise – du weißt, was als nächstes zu tun ist

Nice-to-haves:

  • Kontakt mit Weiterbildung, EdTech und/oder Coaching
  • Vertrautheit mit CRM-Systemen, idealerweise Hubspot

Dealbreaker:

  • Für dich steht Strategie im Vordergrund
  • Empathie ist nicht deine Stärke
  • Schnelligkeit in Arbeitsprozessen schreckt dich ab

Was wir bieten

Kultur:

  • Kein BS: Wir reden miteinander, nicht übereinander
  • Impact: Deine Arbeit verändert das Leben von Menschen, die einen Neustart brauchen
  • Team Support: Großer Support mit deinen Team Mitgliedern

Strukturell:

  • 28 Urlaubstage
  • Strukturiertes Onboarding in den ersten drei Monaten – du wirst nicht ins kalte Wasser geschmissen

Es ist eine Rolle für jemanden, der wirklich zuhören kann, der Struktur liebt und der Lust hat, in einem wachsenden Berliner Startup echten Impact zu haben.

Wenn das nach dir klingt: Wir freuen uns auf dich.

descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Le rôle

En tant que Customer Success Manager Key Accounts (CSM KA), tu accompagnes un portefeuille de cabinets partenaires grands comptes (7 à 10 comptes, Top 150) qui déploient Pennylane auprès de leurs équipes et de leurs clients. Ton objectif : maximiser l’adoption, la satisfaction et la rétention, tout en structurant une gouvernance adaptée à des organisations multi-bureaux.

Tes responsabilités

  • Piloter la relation au quotidien avec les décisionnaires et équipes projet du cabinet.

  • Définir et exécuter des plans d’adoption (collaborateurs + clients) fondés sur la donnée.

  • Anticiper les risques (satisfaction, déploiement, adoption) et mettre en place des plans de remédiation.

  • Contribuer à l’inscription et à l’usage de la PA Pennylane pour centraliser les flux.

Ce que tu vas faire concrètement

1) Stratégie d’embarquement clients (TPE/PME)

  • Conseiller les cabinets sur la communication, l’activation et la formation des clients.

  • Aider à intégrer les enjeux de facture électronique dans le plan d’embarquement.

  • Suivre l’exécution post-déploiement et proposer des actions correctives.

2) Adoption et usage côté collaborateurs

  • Mesurer l’usage et identifier les leviers d’amélioration.

  • Mettre en place des plans d’action et en piloter l’exécution.

3) Satisfaction & rétention

  • Maintenir une relation de confiance, cadrer les attentes et délivrer de la valeur.

  • Déployer des plans d’action stratégiques (annuels / semestriels) avec les partenaires.

Indicateurs de réussite

  • CSAT sur ton portefeuille.

  • Progression de l’adoption (collaborateurs et clients), suivie en COPIL.

  • Qualité de la gouvernance et autonomie des relais locaux.

  • Réduction des risques et amélioration de la rétention.

  

Profil recherché

 

  • Expérience de 5 ans minimum :

    • en Customer Success SaaS avec de bonnes bases comptables (ou motivé(e) à monter en compétences à ce sujet

    • ou en finance / audit avec gestion de relation clients (dimension commerciale)

  • Excellente relation client : capacité à rassurer, structurer, et prendre de la hauteur.

  • Assertivité : recommandations claires, diplomatie et capacité à convaincre.

  • Pilotage de portefeuille (santé client), plans d’action ad hoc.

  • Analyse de données : tirer des insights et prioriser.

  • Gestion de projet : coordination multi-interlocuteurs, rigueur et autonomie.

  

Process de recrutement

 

  • Premier entretien avec Florent Mirigay - Senior Business Recruiter (45 min)

  • Deuxième entretien avec Alexandra Ser, Team lead de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (45min)

  • Etude de cas (préparée en amont) avec Alexandra et une personne de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (1H)

title: Data Analist E-commerce
descriptionHtml:
Als Data Analist e-commerce ben jij dé analytics expert die data omzet in waardevolle commerciële inzichten. Je zorgt ervoor dat het E-commerce team kan sturen op betrouwbare inzichten en helpt collega's om betere beslissingen te nemen over onze website, app, assortiment, content en commerciële prestaties. Kortom: je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid in een uitdagende rol.

Je bouwt mee aan de analytics-omgeving van My Jewellery en deze geef jij zelf mede vorm. Je bouwt niet direct wat er gevraagd wordt. Je daagt je collega’s uit en vormt gezamenlijk een plan welke inzichten nodig zijn en hoe jij die inzichten het beste kan bouwen en delen met je collega’s. Dit kan bijvoorbeeld een analyse zijn, een dashboard, een rekenmodel of een automatische e-mail feed met verbeter suggesties. Zo bouw je mee aan een My Jewellery dat stuurt op de juiste inzichten en leg je de basis voor de verdere groei van ons merk.

Daarnaast duik je in commerciële vraagstukken. Je onderzoekt waarom conversie verandert, welke productcategorieën het beste presteren, waar bezoekers afhaken in de funnel en welke experimenten daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan omzet en marge. Je denkt actief mee over verbeterkansen, daagt aannames uit en vertaalt analyses naar concrete acties met aantoonbare business impact.

In deze rol werk je intensief samen met collega's van E-commerce, CRO, Product, IT, Finance en Marketing & Customer Analytics. Samen bouwen jullie aan een data gedreven organisatie waarin analyses niet alleen inzicht geven, maar vooral leiden tot betere commerciële keuzes.

Jouw taken

  • Je ontwikkelt een betrouwbare analyticsomgeving en je zorgt voor eenduidige definities voor commerciële KPI's zoals conversie, omzet, marge en returns;

  • Je bouwt datamodellen en dashboards voor website-, app-, funnel- en productperformance;

  • Je analyseert conversie, funnelprestaties, productcategorieën en commerciële kansen en vertaalt deze naar concrete adviezen;

  • Je bouwt AI coding oplossingen om je eigen werk efficiënter en effectiever te maken;

  • Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van data, onderzoekt verschillen tussen databronnen en zorgt voor betrouwbare inzichten;

  • Je werkt als businesspartner samen met E-commerce, CRO, Product, IT, Finance en Marketing om datagedreven besluitvorming verder te ontwikkelen.


  • Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring binnen e-commerce, digital of product analytics;

  • Je hebt goede SQL-vaardigheden en kunt zelfstandig datamodellen, analyses en dashboards ontwikkelen;

  • Je weet commerciële vraagstukken te vertalen naar bruikbare inzichten en durft stakeholders kritisch te adviseren;

  • Je hebt kennis van statistiek en experimentanalyse en begrijpt hoe je conversie en commerciële KPI's meet en verbetert;

  • Ervaring met A/B testen, conversie optimalisatie en product analytics is een sterke pré;

  • Ervaring met dbt, Python of web- en app-tracking is een pré;

  • Je woont in Nederland.

Over My Jewellery

My Jewellery is een van de snelst groeiende merken en e-commerce bedrijven van Nederland met internationale bekendheid. We ontwikkelen collecties en campagnes die het leven van vrouwen een beetje mooier maken. Met meer dan 1.000 collega's bouwen we elke dag aan een merk vol ambitie en creativiteit. Onze cultuur? Persoonlijk, betrokken en sprankelend. Jij mag hier helemaal jezelf zijn en krijgt de ruimte om te groeien, te leren en impact te maken. Ondanks onze sterke, internationale groei blijven de lijnen kort, de structuur plat en het saamhorigheidsgevoel op hoog niveau. Als team proberen we iedere dag het verschil te maken!

What you work on depends on the crew you join, something that is decided once you start your internship, but your six months will mix:

  • Answering real business or product questions: framing the problem, digging into the data and turning what you find into a recommendation your crew acts on.

  • Growing with the Data community: joining our main rituals (retros, insights sharing sessions, on-call shifts), and later helping us recruit the next generation of Data Associates

You won’t be alone: from day one, you will benefit from a senior Alaner from the Data team to work with at the office and a coach from the Data team as well.

Please note that for this internship, you need to:
