title: Data Center Long-Term Capacity Partnerships
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral Cloud builds and operates the infrastructure that powers Mistral's AI. The Data Centers team signs long-term leases for data center capacity developed by third-party operators, sources the GPUs that fill those halls, and runs the workloads that train and serve Mistral's models. Today the team is around 40 people, mainly based in Paris with some remote members, and operates roughly 200 MW of existing capacity across France. Key partners include Éclairion in France and EcoDC in Sweden, which is currently delivering Mistral's first Swedish data center.

The team sits at the center of an ambitious roadmap: Mistral has publicly committed to securing one gigawatt of data center capacity globally by 2030. With 200 MW already online, roughly 800 MW remain to be secured over the next five years.

The Role

Mistral's cheapest and best-tailored capacity is the capacity planned furthest ahead. This hire builds the partnerships that make that possible: long-term relationships with infrastructure funds, data center developers, and landowners who acquire sites, secure grid connections, and construct bespoke facilities on Mistral's behalf, three to four years before the first GPU is installed.

You will define the collaboration principles that govern this ecosystem. You will structure partnerships where third parties carry development risk and Mistral locks in capacity designed to its technical specifications. The role is part strategist, part negotiator, part ecosystem builder.

What You Will Do

  • Negotiate long-term capacity partnerships with infrastructure funds, data center companies, and landowners across Europe

  • Define collaboration principles and contractual frameworks that allow third parties to develop data centers on Mistral's behalf

  • Structure bespoke data center designs so that power, cooling, and layout are tailored to Mistral's technical needs

  • Build a pipeline of development sites: land acquisition, grid connection, and construction timelines planned three to four years out

  • Align partnership strategy with Mistral's science and infrastructure roadmaps

What We're Looking For

  • You have built infrastructure partnerships. You have negotiated long-term capacity or development agreements with data center operators, infrastructure funds, or similar counterparties.

  • You think in multi-year horizons. You have planned capacity three to five years ahead and understand how early commitment reduces cost and improves design control.

  • You can define frameworks, not just close deals. You have created collaboration models that align third-party incentives with your own technical and commercial requirements.

  • You operate across European markets. You have worked across multiple jurisdictions and understand the regulatory and permitting landscape for data center development.

What We Offer

Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

title: Deep Learning Engineer
descriptionHtml:

As our Deep Learning Engineer, you develop, optimize, and deploy neural networks that enhance real-time radar performance. You work side-by-side with AI, Software Engineering, Hardware, and Product Management colleagues – translating abstract radar signal modalities into models that spot small airborne objects in noisy environments. You report to the Team Lead AI, and your models directly safeguard critical sites around the globe.

What you'll do

  • Model design and architecture: Design, train, and optimize deep learning models for detection, segmentation, and classification. Tailor neural networks to process abstract, non-natural 3D, 4D, and 5D radar imagery.

  • Data engineering and automation: Prepare, preprocess, and augment large-scale radar datasets for training pipelines. Implement automated labeling strategies to streamline data preparation at scale.

  • Edge optimization and deployment: Optimize trained neural networks for high-performance inference on edge computing hardware. Collaborate with Software Developers and Radar Specialists to integrate models seamlessly into production systems.

  • Research and field validation: Evaluate emerging deep learning techniques to continuously lift our radar capabilities. Test model robustness under diverse field conditions and document design choices clearly.

What you bring

  • MSc in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field

  • 2-4 years of experience in Deep Learning, specifically within Computer Vision

  • Strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience using PyTorch

  • Practical experience with edge deployment and model optimization tools like TensorRT or ONNX

  • Familiarity with non-natural signal modalities such as radar, sonar, LiDAR, or medical imaging

  • Fluent English, both written and spoken

  • A proactive mindset and strong problem-solving skills in a collaborative environment

What we offer

  • Working for a Great Place to Work® certified company;

  • Comprehensive pension plan;

Robin Radar is a defence technology leader in detecting, tracking and classifying drones and other small airborne objects. Our radars and software protect military sites, borders and critical infrastructure from drone threats, and also help prevent bird strikes in aviation and reduce the impact of wind farms on wildlife. Our work shows up at defence and security sites, airports and wind farms around the world.

We're one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands, with a crew of bright minds across 30+ nationalities. Growth doesn't mean we lose the plot – eyes on the skies, feet on the ground. Our values keep us grounded: WE TRUST. WE OWN IT. WE AIM HIGH.

  • Own the Writer Design System (WDS) as your primary domain — agentify and maintain it, ensuring it's optimized for both humans and AI agents building with it

  • Solid instincts for animation principles including easing curves, choreography, anticipation, follow-through, interruptibility, and perceived performance

  • Fluency in Figma at expert level — auto-layout, variants, variables, and code connect — and proficiency with design engineering technologies like framer-motion, gsap, and lottie for web-based animation

title: Digital Marketing & Performance Manager 100%
descriptionHtml:
Du bist ein Profi in Google Ads und hast über mehrere Jahre Kampagnen mit substanziellen Budgets geplant, aufgebaut und optimiert – idealerweise in einer Agentur für verschiedene Kunden und Branchen. Du weisst, wie man aus jedem Werbefranken das Maximum herausholt, Zielgruppen präzise erreicht und Kampagnen messbar auf Leads und Umsatz ausrichtet.

In dieser Position übernimmst du die Verantwortung für unser gesamtes Paid Advertising: Google Ads als Kernkanal, ergänzt durch Microsoft Ads (Bing) und Social Ads auf Meta, LinkedIn und weiteren Plattformen. Du entwickelst alle Kanäle strategisch und operativ weiter. Ergänzend bringst du dich in SEO und GEO ein, damit unser Unternehmen sowohl in klassischen Suchmaschinen als auch in KI-basierten Antwortsystemen sichtbar bleibt.

Aufgaben

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

Schwerpunkt Paid Ads – Google, Microsoft & Social (rund 70 %)

  • Strategische und operative Gesamtverantwortung für unsere Google-Ads-Konten
  • Kampagnenstruktur, Keyword-Strategie, Anzeigentexte, Gebotsstrategien und Budgetsteuerung
  • Sauberes Conversion-Tracking mit Google Tag Manager, GA4 und Enhanced Conversions als Basis aller Optimierungen
  • Laufende Optimierung von CPA, ROAS und Conversion-Rate
  • Aufbau und Optimierung von Landingpages im Zusammenspiel mit den Kampagnen
  • A/B-Tests von Anzeigen, Zielgruppen und Landingpages
  • Aufbau, Skalierung und Optimierung unserer Microsoft-Ads-Kampagnen (Bing) als Ergänzung zu Google Search
  • Planung, Umsetzung und Optimierung von Social Ads auf Meta (Facebook, Instagram), LinkedIn und je nach Zielgruppe TikTok
  • Entwicklung von Kreativkonzepten, Anzeigenformaten und Zielgruppenstrategien für Social Ads in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team
  • Kanalübergreifende Budgetverteilung und Attribution über Google, Microsoft und Social hinweg
  • Aussagekräftige Reportings mit konkreten Handlungsempfehlungen an die Geschäftsleitung

Qualifikation

Must-have

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Performance-Marketing mit klarem Schwerpunkt Google Ads
  • Agenturerfahrung mit Betreuung mehrerer Kunden und Branchen ist ein klarer Vorteil
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Google Ads, Google Tag Manager und GA4
  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit Gebotsstrategien, Zielgruppen, Conversion-Tracking und Budgetsteuerung
  • Praxiserfahrung mit Microsoft Ads (Bing) inkl. Import und Anpassung von Google-Kampagnen
  • Praxiserfahrung mit Social Ads, insbesondere Meta Ads und LinkedIn Ads
  • Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denken und sicherer Umgang mit Kennzahlen und Budgets
  • Hohe Eigeninitiative und selbstständige, hands-on Arbeitsweise
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (stilsicher in Anzeigentexten) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

Was dich auszeichnet

Google Ads ist dein Handwerk. Du kennst die Plattform in der Tiefe, hinterfragst Googles Automatisierungsempfehlungen kritisch und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten statt Bauchgefühl. Microsoft Ads und Social Ads beherrschst du ebenso sicher und weisst, welcher Kanal für welches Ziel den besten Return liefert. Gleichzeitig denkst du über den einzelnen Kanal hinaus und verstehst, wie Paid Ads, SEO und GEO zusammenspielen. Du arbeitest strukturiert und lösungsorientiert, vor allem aber bist du ein Macher, der Kampagnen selbst aufsetzt, testet und optimiert.

Benefits

Wir bieten

  • Eine verantwortungsvolle 100-%-Position am Standort Wil SG
  • Volle Verantwortung für unser Paid-Advertising-Budget und viel Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld an der Schnittstelle von Marketing, Technologie und künstlicher Intelligenz
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und hohe Eigenverantwortung
  • Abwechslungsreiche Projekte mit direktem Einfluss auf Wachstum und Umsatz
  • Ein motiviertes und engagiertes Team
  • Raum für eigene Ideen und innovative Marketingansätze
  • Langfristige Perspektiven und persönliche Weiterentwicklung

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt?

Du willst deine Google-Ads-Expertise in einem Unternehmen mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen einbringen und direkten Einfluss auf Wachstum und Umsatz haben? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung, gerne mit Beispielen von Kampagnen, die du verantwortet hast.

title: Digital Product Manager - Price Management (ContextIQ)
descriptionHtml:
Notre équipe Digital Procurement & Pricing recherche un·e Digital Product Manager - Price Management (ContextIQ) (f/m/d) en CDI basé·e à Lille (Upline).

Au sein de l'écosystème digital de Decathlon, notre équipe conçoit des solutions d'aide à la décision pour les équipes Procurement à l'échelle mondiale. En synergie avec le Purchase COE (Center of Excellence), nous développons des produits comme ContextIQ, PYC et Datacost afin d'éclairer la stratégie d'achat par la donnée. Nous recherchons un·e Product Manager passionné·e par la valeur métier, la simplicité d'usage et les produits data pour piloter l'évolution de ContextIQ.

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

En tant que Digital Product Manager sur ContextIQ, ta mission est de transformer les besoins complexes des acheteurs et acheteuses en une expérience produit fluide et un backlog clair et priorisé :

  • Vision et stratégie produit : Définir la feuille de route (roadmap), la vision produit et les indicateurs clés de succès (KPIs, adoption, valeur business délivrée).

  • Product Discovery & Prototypage : Explorer les besoins des équipes achats, concevoir et tester des parcours utilisateurs et des prototypes interactifs.

  • Delivery & Priorisation : Rédiger des spécifications fonctionnelles claires, prioriser le backlog selon la valeur apportée et accompagner les équipes d'ingénierie dans les cycles de delivery.

  • Écosystème & Gouvernance Data : Collaborer avec les équipes techniques pour assurer l'intégration continue de ContextIQ avec les autres plateformes de pricing (PYC, Datacost), veiller à la gouvernance de la donnée et préparer l'intégration de solutions IA (AI-ready).

  • Accompagnement & Adoption : Mesurer l'impact des fonctionnalités déployées, animer les retours d'expérience et favoriser l'adoption auprès des communautés d'acheteurs.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Expérience confirmée en Digital Product Management, de la phase de discovery jusqu'au delivery continu.

  • Capacité d'animation, d'écoute active et de facilitation avec des parties prenantes transverses (business, data, ingénierie).

  • Solide maîtrise des méthodes de priorisation par la valeur, de la formalisation des besoins et de la gestion de backlog.

  • Pratique des tests utilisateurs et du prototypage rapide (maîtrise d'outils type Figma appréciée).

  • Appétence ou expérience avérée dans le domaine des achats (Procurement), du price management ou de l'analyse de données.

  • Sensibilité aux enjeux d'intégration technique (API, flux de données) et à la gouvernance de la donnée.

  • Communication claire, esprit d'analyse et aisance dans un environnement collaboratif et évolutif.

STACK TECHNIQUE & ÉCOSYSTÈME

  • Outils Product & Discovery : Figma, Jira, Confluence, analytics & user testing tools.

  • Data & Architecture : Notions solides en API REST, intégration de données, data governance et pipelines d'alimentation pour modèles IA.

  • Écosystème métier : Outils de Procurement & Price Management (ContextIQ, PYC, Datacost).

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Organisation de travail hybride ;

  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;

  • Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;

  • Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;

  • Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.

descriptionHtml:

But what truly sets us apart? We believe our people are at the heart of everything we do. If you're curious about how we work, what we value and how you might grow with us, explore our Culture Hub & Career Opportunities.

You will own the end-to-end commercial lifecycle from identifying market opportunities and designing scalable partnership models to sourcing, negotiating, launching, and growing high-impact partnerships that generate sustainable revenue, expand our member base, and strengthen our market presence.

As the leader of this function, you will build and lead a high-performing team while working cross-functionally with Product, Growth, CRM, Brand, Finance, Legal, and Operations to launch and scale strategic partnerships. Together, you will create seamless partner experiences and establish this channel as a core driver of Urban Sports Club's long-term growth.

What you will need to succeed

title: Director, Fan Services
descriptionHtml:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.

At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Director, Fan Services leads the Fan Services customer service organization across first and second line teams, owning the departmental budget, headcount planning, and vendor/BPO relationships in partnership with global teams. This role works across internal Fanatics International stakeholders to prioritize activity for the benefit of partners and fans, delivering feedback to the SLT on progress and future opportunities while bringing extensive experience of best-in-class processes, tools, and performance management. The Director, Fan Services delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.

HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT

Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.

Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

Cross-Functional Leadership:

  • Liaise with fulfillment operations, logistics, merchandising, marketing, business analytics, Partnerships, and technology teams to gather information, provide key insights, and resolve issues across the organization.
  • Coordinate resources, remove barriers, and work cross-functionally with external partners including marketplace operations, drop ship vendors, and MTO/3PL partners to ensure seamless operations.
  • Lead and present Fan Services operational data on daily, weekly, and monthly business review calls to senior and executive leadership, proactively communicating core KPIs and delivering strategies to overcome operational challenges.

People Leadership:

  • Manage staffing, workflows, and performance seamlessly for on-premises, hybrid, and remote employees, maximizing team performance through training, motivation, project management, and incentive programs.
  • Develop succession plans and talent pipelines for managers, supervisors, and team leaders to build organizational depth and resilience.
  • Deploy policies, procedures, and service level standards across the customer service organization in partnership with global teams to ensure consistent, high-quality execution.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

  • Own the voice of the fan by serving as the subject matter expert for customer sentiment and feedback, strategizing messaging that adapts to fan needs and enhances the Fanatics brand globally.
  • Consistently analyze and leverage data to drive targets and process improvements across key metrics including Net Promoter Score, Customer Satisfaction/Customer Delight, First Contact Resolution, Appeasement per Contact, and Contacts per Order.
  • Identify and reduce contact drivers through innovative solutions while ensuring adherence to all appropriate regulatory and compliance frameworks, including PCI/PII and GDPR.
  • Develop and manage BPO and vendor partner relationships — including performance, cost, and contract oversight — to ensure fans receive best-in-class service across every channel.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

  • Apply strong technical proficiency across customer experience technologies including contact experience platforms, e-commerce front-end/back-end tools, order management systems, content management systems, and AI/Machine Learning-powered conversation analytics systems to drive continuous improvement.
  • Leverage omni-channel operational expertise to identify gaps, design scalable solutions, and enhance the end-to-end fan service experience across all touchpoints.
  • Bring innovative approaches to first and second line contact management, improving resolution rates and reducing friction across own and 3PL operations.
  • Identify opportunities to integrate emerging technologies and data-driven tools to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and elevate fan outcomes.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

  • Own the strategic roadmap, budget, and resource planning for the Fan Services customer service organization, aligning headcount, technology, and vendor/BPO investment to business goals.
  • Drive performance management across the team with a disciplined focus on financial targets and third-party SLAs, ensuring accountability at every level of the organization.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, demonstrating the ability to manage competing priorities with urgency and composure while delivering results at scale.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently in writing, speaking, and digital formats to senior-level and C-level audiences, translating operational complexity into strategic insight.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY

We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:

  • Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
  • Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
  • Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
  • Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of customer operations experience, including deep expertise in first and second line contact management and managing own and 3PL operations.
  • 7+ years of people leadership experience, including demonstrated success leading leaders and managers across on-premises, hybrid, and remote environments.
  • Experience and understanding of omni-channel operations and the e-commerce space.
  • Advanced communication skills in writing, speaking, and digital formats, with the ability to deliver comfortably to senior-level and C-level audiences.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office suite, including foundational experience with Excel and pivot tables; knowledgeable user of CRM technologies, Conversation-Analytics Software, Contact Center Technologies, Customer Review Tools, and order management tools such as EDI, DAX, and Cloud Reporting.
  • Proven track record of owning departmental budgets, headcount planning, and BPO/vendor relationships including performance, cost, and contract oversight.
  • Multi-lingual candidates are encouraged to apply; Spanish, French, and German are preferred.

Education:

Bachelor's degree in business, communications, management, or a related field.

WORK LOCATION

On-site: Your work location will be onsite in Stakehill.

At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.

ABOUT US
Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

ABOUT THE TEAM
Fanatics Commerce is a leading designer, manufacturer, and seller of licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods. It operates a vertically-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally – as well as its flagship site, www.fanatics.com.

Fanatics Commerce has a broad range of online, sports venue, and vertical apparel partnerships worldwide, including comprehensive partnerships with leading leagues, teams, colleges, and sports organizations across the world—including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Formula 1, and Australian Football League (AFL); the Dallas Cowboys, Golden State Warriors, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea FC, and Tokyo Giants; the University of Notre Dame, University of Alabama, and University of Texas; the International Olympic Committee (IOC), England Rugby, and the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA).

· Build Championship Teams

title: Director, Operational Readiness
descriptionHtml:
About Nscale

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About the Role

We're hiring a Director, Operational Readiness to build and lead Nscale's portfolio-level readiness capability, ensuring every new site, capacity expansion, and major infrastructure deployment is truly ready for production.

Reporting to the Sr. Director, Technical Program Management, you'll set up the readiness framework, gates, scorecards, and transition model that bring our infrastructure into steady-state operations. You'll work across Development, Construction, Commissioning, Technical Program Management, Network, Compute, Security, Procurement, Legal, vendors, and Operations to surface dependencies early, manage exceptions, and align readiness with customer and operational milestones.

Operational Readiness doesn't replace program delivery, technical acceptance, or on-site Operations. It connects them. You'll provide the common model and portfolio-level assurance that leadership relies on to make confident go-live decisions, and you'll lead a growing team of Sr. Project Managers and Technical Writers who carry out readiness across our sites and regions.

What You'll be Doing

Readiness Operating Model & Portfolio Integration
• Build and lead Nscale's Operational Readiness capability and team, establishing and continuously improving the readiness lifecycle, gates, standards, governance, and escalation framework
• Define minimum readiness requirements across people, process, technology, tooling, documentation, training, vendor support, monitoring, ownership, and risk
• Establish clear readiness interfaces with Development, Construction, Commissioning, Technical Program Management, Network, Compute, Security, Procurement, Legal, vendors, and Operations
• Build integrated readiness plans that connect milestones, gates, dependencies, evidence, ownership, and decisions, and drive cross-functional gaps to clear ownership and resolution
• Maintain forward visibility into upcoming sites, expansions, and infrastructure programs so readiness work starts early

Readiness Assurance & Transition
• Own the portfolio readiness scorecard as the single source for readiness reporting to executive leadership, covering status, material risks, dependencies, exceptions, and required decisions
• Govern the readiness gate process into steady-state Operations and issue formal gate recommendations for site go-live approval
• Make sure material readiness exceptions are resolved, deferred, or explicitly accepted by the appropriate functional or executive authority
• Keep a clear line between readiness assurance and the technical acceptance authority held by Commissioning, Engineering, and Operations
• Run early-life reviews on newly transitioned infrastructure and turn findings into stronger readiness standards and deployment practices

Standards & Documentation
• Make sure readiness documentation, evidence, standards, and transition artifacts are complete, consistent, and reusable
• Use existing systems and governance wherever possible to avoid unnecessary process overhead
• Partner with on-site Operations to confirm readiness evidence for SOPs, MOPs, EOPs, and runbooks ahead of handoff

Team Leadership
• Build and lead a high-performing team of Sr. Project Managers and Technical Writers that scales with Nscale's deployment portfolio
• Create clear accountability, common methods, and consistent execution across regional and deployment readiness work
• Coach the team to work at both strategic and tactical levels in a fast-moving environment

About You
• 12+ years of progressive experience in data center infrastructure, mission-critical operations, technical program management, operational readiness, infrastructure operations, service delivery, reliability, or related large-scale technology environments
• Proven experience building or scaling readiness frameworks, operating models, transition processes, or cross-functional delivery capabilities
• Experience leading teams across multiple concurrent infrastructure initiatives and integrating dependencies across Engineering, Facilities, Operations, vendors, and program teams
• Strong understanding of how physical infrastructure, technology platforms, and steady-state operations connect, from planning and construction through commissioning, transition, and production
• Excellent executive communication, with the ability to translate technical and operational conditions into clear risks, decisions, and actions
• Ability to influence across organizational boundaries without direct authority
• Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels in a rapidly scaling environment

Nice to Have
• Experience with AI, HPC, GPU infrastructure, hyperscale data centers, or high-density infrastructure
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field (equivalent professional experience will be considered)
• Relevant certifications in data center infrastructure, technical program management, IT service management, reliability, or operations

Why this role matters

As Nscale grows, more sites, technologies, vendors, and teams have to come together before infrastructure can enter production. Operational needs like staffing, tooling, documentation, monitoring, training, and vendor support must be identified early enough to develop alongside technical delivery.

This role makes that happen. You'll give leadership a clear, data-backed view of readiness across the portfolio, catch dependencies before they affect milestones, and make sure risks are explicitly owned rather than quietly passed on to Operations. The result is cleaner handoffs, fewer late blockers, and readiness that scales with Nscale's deployment pace.

What We Can Offer You

At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core.

Highly competitive US compensation package (base + bonus + equity), with performance reviews every 12 months. 🚀

Join one of the fastest-growing AI infrastructure companies — your chance to directly shape how global AI capacity is planned and deployed. ✨

Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions. Grow by leading critical cross-functional initiatives and shaping capital strategy — always with our full support.

Human-First Flexibility: We treat you as humans first. 🫶🏽 Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments.

We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

descriptionHtml:

With its eight public Grandes Écoles and two affiliated Graduate Schools, it is the leading public institute dedicated to engineers and managers. Together, we imagine and build a sustainable future by educating the leaders who will shape tomorrow’s transitions.

🎯 What we expect from you

As a Postdoctoral Researcher or Research Engineer, you will perform research and innovation activities in the field of soft electronics and optical sensing for artificial skin applications. Within the Centre of Microelectronics and the Flexible Electronics Department (FEL), you will contribute to the development of stretchable optical waveguides and their integration into artificial skin demonstrators.

The flexible electronics department develops technological and scientific knowledge in the field of soft electronics. The department has a strong knowledge in the field of material and interface electrical and mechanical characterization. The activities of the department are regrouped in the 660m2-area platform. This technological platform regroups facilities and technological equipment for R&D activities in Micropackaging, micro and nano-electronics, in a clean room of 220m² 1000-class and 400m² 10000-class.

Stretchable electronics can also be combined with optical systems such as waveguides. These devices will be developed to create artificial skin with pressure and temperature sensing capabilities.

Within this project, the work will focus on the fabrication and characterization of stretchable optical waveguides, as well as on fabrication and integration techniques for optical components (LEDs / photodiodes). A related publication is “Transparent, Optical, Pressure-Sensitive Artificial Skin for Large-Area Stretchable Electronics” (https://doi.org/10.1002/adma.201200523).

The main activities will include:

· Fabrication and characterization of elastomer waveguides for pressure and temperature sensing applications.

· Integration of optically pressure- or temperature-sensitive materials into the elastomer waveguides.

· Characterization and validation of complete sensing devices.

The fabrication processes and experimental setups are already available. However, good knowledge of Python is important for operating and further developing the test benches. Hands-on laboratory work is essential and will be partly performed in our clean room facility.

The expected outcome is the demonstration of radically new soft optical sensing devices with features and functions that cannot be achieved with conventional electronic approaches. This work is part of a European project involving multiple partners across Europe, including ETH Zurich (ETHZ), the University of Oxford, Johannes Kepler University Linz, EMPA…

title: Engineering Internship - Deep Learning for Infrared Thermography Antenna Measurements
descriptionHtml:
THE POSITION

ANYFIELDS measures antennas by infrared thermography: a thermosensitive film heated by the radiated field is imaged by an infrared camera, giving a 2D map of the electric field, nonintrusive and very close to the antenna. Two limits remain: the maps are noisy (dynamic range of 25 to 30 dB at best, 35 to 40 dB needed to retrieve side lobes and cross-polarization), and they are blurred by the response of the detector (film and optics), whose resolution is not explained by the theory.

This internship develops physics-driven neural networks, trained without any clean reference, to restore the maps, and compares them rigorously with the conventional methods already implemented.

Missions :

  • Benchmark synthetic and measured datasets, reproduction of the conventional methods (wavelet denoising, drift removal, deconvolution, slanted edge).

  • Estimate PSF of the detector: neural network constrained by the film heat diffusion and the optics, estimated from a few measurements; explain the gap between the theoretical (about 1 mm) and measured (4 to 8 mm) resolution. Compare with conventional methods.

  • Implement Denoising by self-supervised deep denoising of the maps, quantified gain in dB towards 35 to 40 dB, ranking of the limiting factors of the setup.

  • Validate by test whether the imaging resolves the individual elements of array antennas in the Ku and Ka bands, before and after improvement. Report on the retained methods.

You will work at the crossroads of electromagnetics, imaging and deep learning, with the engineers of the Innovation team.

Location: Toulouse (city centre)

Start: As soon as possible

Duration: 6 months

Profile

  • Bac+5 - Engineering school / Master in applied mathematics, signal and image processing, machine learning and/or electromagnetics

  • Programming skills (preferably Python), experience with a deep learning framework

  • Knowledge of inverse problems or infrared cameras is a plus

  • Team spirit, proactive attitude and good communication skills in an interdisciplinary team

En tant qu’Engineering Manager, ton rôle est de manager jusqu’à 4 tech leads, soit de chapeauter la réussite de 4 projets, en binôme avec un(e) Group Project Manager. Tes futures missions : Le besoin actuel porte sur des missions “grands-comptes” avec des produits et architectures complexes, développées par plusieurs squads de Theodo : - Manager & faire progresser les Tech Leads : tu accompagnes 1 à 4 Tech Leads dans leur montée en compétence et leur épanouissement. - Assurer le delivery technique : tu garantis la qualité du code (3S : stabilité, sécurité, vitesse), la tenue des jalons et la robustesse de l’architecture. - Contribuer au développement business : tu participes aux discussions stratégiques avec nos clients (DSI, sponsors…), tu aides à identifier des opportunités et tu es acteur de l’avant-vente avec nos sales. Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples : - iDealwine® : leader mondial des enchères de vins en ligne a engagé la migration de son site e-commerce monolithique vers une architecture composable pour gagner en évolutivité, en sécurité et en maîtrise technologique. Après 2 mois de cadrage, les équipes Theodo ont piloté une approche design-to-cost permettant de modulariser la plateforme et de migrer 20 ans d’historique en 14 mois, dans le respect du budget et du planning. - Sevetys : refonte complète d’une web app métier avec deux volets stratégiques : un outil de prise de rendez-vous pour les propriétaires d’animaux et un back-office dédié aux vétérinaires. Deux équipes produit ont piloté la reconstruction des plateformes de bout en bout, rejointes en fin de projet par une équipe data pour structurer et valoriser les données. Principal défi : une mise en production coordonnée à grande échelle, impliquant de nombreuses cliniques vétérinaires, sans interruption d’activité. Tes perspectives d’évolutions : Perspectives d’évolution moyen terme (1 - 2 ans) : - Manageriale : VP Tech ou Group Manager - Technique : Architecte senior - Business/Influence : Thought Leader (animer une communauté tech) ou Intrapreneur (porter une nouvelle offre) Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. Profil recherché : - 7 à 14 ans d’expérience professionnelle, avec une expérience confirmée en management d’équipes tech et en environnement ESN / conseil. - Basé(e) en région parisienne, avec une préférence pour une présence majoritaire au bureau, attendue pour un rôle stratégique et managérial. Hard skills - Solide expertise technologique (Java / Spring Boot et/ou Angular) permettant d’être crédible et légitime auprès des équipes, sans être attendu·e sur le code au quotidien. - Capacité à concevoir des architectures évolutives et à arbitrer des choix techniques dans des contextes grands comptes complexes. - Expérience significative en management d’équipes techniques, avec la capacité à débloquer des Tech - Leads sur des problématiques techniques complexes. - Capacité d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes complexes, avec un impact transverse dans l’organisation. - Intérêt pour l’IA générative et son usage dans la conception et le développement de produits digitaux. Soft skills - Leadership affirmé et posture pédagogique pour embarquer, inspirer et faire progresser des équipes exigeantes. - Orientation marquée business et création de valeur : chez Theodo, nous ne faisons pas de la tech pour la tech. - Aisance relationnelle et communicationnelle, avec la capacité d’adresser tous niveaux d’interlocuteurs, y compris C-level, et de mener des conversations exigeantes. Le process de recrutement : - Call de qualification (30 min) avec un membre de l’équipe recrutement - Cultural fit (1h) avec le même recruteur - Test technique de refactoring (à la maison + débrief 1h) - Entretien modélisation (1h) - Simulation vente d’architecture à un DSI (1h) - Final avec un dirigeant - Prise de référencePourquoi rejoindre Theodo Cloud ? L'environnement : 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 Prime d’intéressement indexée sur la croissance de Theodo 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - UK Public Sector
descriptionHtml:
SLSQ427R384

At Databricks, we help public institutions use data and AI to improve services, increase productivity, and get more value from public data and technology investment. That means putting trusted, relevant insight closer to the people making operational, policy and service decisions, and building services that can evolve as missions, technology and delivery models change, rather than becoming tomorrow's legacy.

Databricks is looking for an Account Executive to own and grow some of our most strategic Public Sector customers in the UK government delivering against their core missions. You will inherit an established portfolio of strategic government accounts, with a clear mandate to protect and expand that base while building new relationships across departments and agencies we do not yet serve.

This is a succession role: you will step into relationships and momentum that already exist, building trust quickly with current stakeholders while developing your own view of where Data and AI can help solve the sector's most important challenges. You will translate national and departmental priorities into measurable customer outcomes and sustainable growth.

Working closely with government stakeholders, internal teams, cloud providers, and strategic partners, you will deepen consumption in existing accounts and extend Databricks' footprint.

The Pressures Shaping This Work

Government's hardest missions increasingly require insight across institutional boundaries, without requiring those institutions, their accountability, or their data to be centralised. The opportunity isn't one giant government data system; it's enabling institutions to connect, govern and use data and insight across boundaries while retaining control of their own data, responsibilities and decisions. You'll be selling into that reality.

The Impact You Will Have

  • Take ownership of an existing portfolio of strategic government accounts, maintaining continuity with current stakeholders and expanding usage of the Databricks Intelligence Platform.
  • Build and execute a go-to-market plan for the territory, prioritising the departments, agencies, use cases, and partners most likely to create sustainable growth.
  • Identify and pursue net-new opportunities across departments and agencies not yet engaged with Databricks, building pipeline alongside your existing portfolio.
  • Develop a clear view of national and departmental priorities and translate them into compelling Data and AI value propositions, executive conversations, business cases, and qualified opportunities.
  • Use data and evidence to continuously refine your territory strategy, testing assumptions about where demand exists and which use cases resonate, and changing course when the evidence tells you to.
  • Map and engage the full range of buying centres within each account, building champions, guiding opportunities forward, and compressing decision cycles.
  • Run a consumption-led sales motion, using demand plans to prioritise the highest-value use cases in each account and grow usage over time rather than closing one-off deals.
  • Manage a portfolio that spans quick wins and longer, complex public-sector sales cycles simultaneously.
  • Build and defend a strong renewal and expansion motion within existing accounts as a foundation for new growth.
  • Orchestrate cross-functional and partner resources, including professional services, training, systems integrators, and hyperscaler co-sell teams, to maximise account impact.
  • Represent Databricks credibly with senior government stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor who puts customer outcomes first.

What We Look For

  • A strong track record of quota attainment or over-achievement selling into public-sector accounts.
  • Demonstrated ability to build a territory-level go-to-market strategy from first principles, reasoning from the fundamentals of how the sector works rather than importing a playbook from somewhere else.
  • Experience managing an existing account portfolio through a transition, building trust quickly with inherited relationships while also prospecting for new ones.
  • Working knowledge of UK Government structures, national and departmental priorities, procurement frameworks, and how public-sector technology decisions are funded, approved, and implemented.
  • Sales experience in cloud software, data platforms, open-source technology, Data and AI, or a related enterprise technology market.
  • Experience selling usage-based or consumption-based models and co-selling with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Comfort running both land-and-expand motions in existing accounts and greenfield business development across new departments and agencies.
  • Experience co-developing business cases and building relationships with senior civil-service stakeholders.
  • Experience using structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC or Value Selling, with disciplined and accurate forecasting.
  • A willingness to challenge assumptions, your own and others', and use evidence to make better decisions rather than relying on intuition alone.
  • Eligibility for security clearance; existing clearance is an advantage.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Marketing Team

Marketing at Pelico is a growth function, not a support function. We work hand-in-hand with Sales and BDRs to create qualified pipeline with the largest industrial companies in the world. Our audience is senior: COOs, VPs of Operations, supply chain, and manufacturing leaders at enterprise accounts.

Events are one of our strongest levers for reaching them: trade shows, executive dinners, roundtables, webinars, and Pelico-hosted events in Europe and the US—occasionally co-hosted with partners and industry bodies, which means co-building the format, splitting the cost, and sharing the audience. We measure ourselves on meetings and pipeline, not on badge scans.

Your Mission

You'll own Pelico's event growth engine end-to-end, turning field events into a measurable, efficient source of qualified pipeline and customer engagement.

  • Decide what we do and what we stop: You own the portfolio—which events we commit to, which we drop, and which formats get more budget next year. This is the heart of the role.

  • Own the event portfolio from strategy and prioritization through delivery, follow-up, and post-event review: That covers trade shows, webinars, executive dinners, roundtables, as well as Pelico-hosted, customer, and partner events.

  • Tie every event to a commercial outcome: For each event, you'll define the target accounts and audiences, the meeting and pipeline goals, and the metrics that matter.

  • Run delivery and budget with discipline: You'll set clear timelines, owners, and vendor plans, keeping spend under control across many activities at once.

  • Get Sales and BDRs committed: No event goes ahead without Sales ownership, a prospecting plan, pre-booked meetings, and a named follow-up owner.

  • Make results visible: You'll set up reliable lead capture and HubSpot tracking so leads, meetings, opportunities, and costs can be tracked for every event.

  • Turn events into content: Speaker and customer interviews, event films, social coverage, and approvals with appearing customers—coordinated with team members who produce it.

  • Expect travel: Up to 3 trips per quarter, including on-site setup days.

Your Impact

  • Field events become a measurable contributor to pipeline, meetings, and MQLs.

  • Budget moves toward the formats that work—scaling efficient levers like webinars and challenging underperforming formats before investing in them again.

  • A repeatable event playbook (targeting, execution, lead capture, follow-up, and post-event review) is published and used across Marketing, Sales, and BDRs.

  • Pelico is seen as the premier enterprise B2B player in its category: executives want to attend Pelico events and return for the next one.

What We're Looking For

This is a hands-on ownership role. You set the strategy, run the execution yourself, and answer for the results.

You'll need:

  • Proven experience owning a multi-format B2B SaaS/tech event portfolio end-to-end: strategy, delivery, follow-up, and review.

  • A commercial mindset. You choose events for named audiences and business goals, not for prestige or attendance, and you can explain your go/no-go trade-offs.

  • Strong budget and ROI discipline, with hands-on use of metrics like cost per MQL and cost per meeting.

  • Experience aligning Sales and BDR teams on event goals, ownership, and follow-up.

  • Experience co-building events with partners: agreeing on the format, splitting costs, and keeping both brands served.

  • Solid CRM habits. HubSpot is a strong plus: lead capture, tracking, and reporting from first contact to opportunity.

  • Excellent organization across many events running in parallel with partners, vendors, and internal teams.

  • AI-native ways of working: practical AI workflows for targeting, research, or reporting, with clear human judgment on top.

  • Fluent English. For the Paris role, professional French is also required.

Nice to have:

  • Background in aviation, aerospace, manufacturing, or supply chain.

  • Experience with executive- and enterprise-level events (C-level dinners, roundtables).

  • Managerial experience.

Why Pelico

We're building something genuinely hard and genuinely important. Here's what that comes with:

  • Meaningful equity — you're building this with us, so you'll own a piece of it

  • Competitive salary benchmarked to your market

  • Flexible, hybrid work model — we care about output, not face time

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Learning & development budget — we invest in people who invest in themselves

  • Opportunity to work with some of the world's most complex and fascinating manufacturing operations

  • A team that takes the work seriously without taking themselves too seriously

Pelico is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

title: Finance Working Student (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Description

We are looking for a diligent performer, because clean books are the foundation of everything that follows. Join the CEO Office at QuantumDiamonds (QD) and become the backbone of our finance organisation. You will own your processes end-to-end and run them independently, from invoice intake to payment and the handover to our tax advisors. As a Working Student in Finance, you will keep our books clean, our invoices and expenses on track and our records audit-ready, handling day-to-day accounting with a strong focus on invoice processing, expense handling and bookkeeping. At the same time, you will help us improve and automate our finance processes as we scale from a fast-growing deep-tech company to industrial production.

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

  

What will you do

  • Process incoming supplier invoices end to end: capture, check, match against purchase orders, and assign the correct accounts and cost centers in Odoo

  • Track open invoices and prepare payment runs

  • Align with suppliers and external partners on payments, open items and payment terms

  • Process employee expense claims and reimbursements, ensuring receipts and approvals are complete

  • Prepare and maintain clean records for the DATEV export to our tax advisors

  • Align with our tax advisors on bookkeeping questions and account management

  • Support monthly bookkeeping and closing activities, including reconciliations and follow ups on missing bills

  • Maintain supplier master data and keep our digital document archive organized

  • Support grant reimbursement tracking by collecting and organizing supporting documentation

  • Identify repetitive manual steps and help improve and automate our invoice and expense workflows

 

What is expected of you

  • You are enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field

  • You are detail oriented, reliable, and enjoy working accurately with numbers and documents

  • You are confident in Excel, experience with DATEV, Odoo, or another ERP system is a plus

  • Basic knowledge of German bookkeeping (e.g. SKR03/SKR04, VAT treatment of invoices) is a plus

  • You take ownership: you run your processes independently and follow tasks through to completion

  • You are available for 15 to 20 hours per week and can work from our Munich office

  • Fluent German and English is required

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 20 vacation days (based on a 5-Day week) plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

title: Financial Controller
descriptionHtml:
What is Flagstone?

Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work.

Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.

 

A feel for our culture:

To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.

That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.

We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.

 

Does this sound like you?

You’re a qualified accountant who enjoys being close to the numbers and close to the business. You’ve run month-end, the balance sheet, and financial controls end to end, and you know what good controls look like in both complex and fast-growing environments. You stay calm under pressure, explain finance simply to people outside it, and you’re always looking for smarter, more automated ways of working.

 

What you'll do

You’ll run Flagstone’s day-to-day core finance operations, making sure our numbers are accurate, controlled, and on time. Reporting to the Finance Director, you’ll own the month-end close, the balance sheet, and day-to-day financial control, while our FP&A team owns planning and forecasting. As the Finance Director’s right hand, you’ll run the detail so they can focus on supporting the CFO, the Board, and commercial decisions. It’s a hands-on role that will grow in scope and complexity as Flagstone scales.

This will include:

  • Running the month-end close end to end and delivering accurate, timely management accounts

  • Keeping a clean, fully supported balance sheet, with reconciliations, accruals, prepayments, and journals in order

  • Making sure direct-to-consumer and business revenue is recorded accurately, with commercial terms in contracts correctly reflected in revenue and cash

  • Managing daily cash and liquidity monitoring, so the Finance Director always has a clear view of our position

  • Owning financial controls that fit our scale and regulatory environment, including our obligations as an Authorised Payment Institution

  • Preparing for the annual statutory audit, and delivering VAT returns, tax compliance, Companies House filings, and HMRC reporting

  • Making sure monthly payroll and benefits are processed accurately, supported by clear standard operating procedures

  • Working closely with teams across the business, including Product and Engineering on software capitalisation, Compliance, People, Legal, Sales, Data, and Transaction Operations

  • Deputising for the Finance Director and supporting the team during peak periods

  • Using automation and AI to shorten the close, reduce manual work, and help build a technology-enabled finance function

  

What you'll bring

  • ACA or ACCA qualified, with solid post-qualified experience running month-end, balance sheet, and financial controls

  • Strong technical accounting knowledge and the pace to deliver to tight deadlines

  • Experience in a complex environment with good controls discipline, as well as in a smaller, fast-growing business

  • Experience with a modern cloud ERP system, with Workday Financials a significant advantage

  • A sharp eye for detail and good commercial awareness, spotting when numbers and contracts differ and following it through

  • Strong organisation, with the ability to manage competing priorities and adjust quickly

  • Clear, direct communication that builds trusted relationships across teams, and the ability to explain financial information simply to non-finance colleagues

  • An empathetic, approachable style, helping other teams get things right rather than just flagging what’s wrong

  • Resilience through month-end, audit, and shifting priorities, and the confidence to challenge constructively, including at senior level

  • Ownership of outcomes, sound judgement on when to act and when to escalate, and a drive to keep finding better ways of working

  • Direct-to-consumer experience is helpful but not essential

     

How we reward you:

At Flagstone, the benefits extend beyond false gifts like “fruit and snacks”. Instead, we invest in your health, wealth, and professional development. Here’s a selection of our benefits:

  • Hybrid working - Spend at least 1 day a week with your team in our collaborative London office

  • Competitive bonus scheme - designed to reward and recognise high performance

  • Flexible benefits budget - a pot to fund meaningful benefits for you, whether it's hormone or fertility testing, cancer screening, neuro-diversity coaching or something that matters for you.

  • A range of salary sacrifice options to help you make tax efficient savings on electric cars, nursery schemes, home and tech goods.

  • Working Abroad - Flagstone employees can work remotely from an approved list of locations for up to 90 days a year

  • Mental wellbeing support – Access therapy and mental health sessions through Spill

  • Learning and development – £1,000 personal development budget to help you grow in your role.

  • Private health care - Enjoy all the benefits AXA has to offer, including reduced gym memberships and medical history disregarded

  • Medical cash plan - To help you with the costs of dental and optical expenses

  • Life insurance and Income Protection- four times your annual salary for peace of mind

  • Matched pension contributions up to 5%

  • 25 days holiday - plus bank holidays, well-being days and volunteering days

  • Enhanced Parental Leave – enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption pay.

     

All are welcome.

At Flagstone, we’re assembling a diverse team that defies our industry’s norms. Think this role could suit you? We encourage you to apply, no matter your background.

Exchanging ideas with others is part of what we enjoy about this work. In October 2026, Philipp Göllner spoke at the Enterprise AI Summit in Charlotte about how our team built a Chief of Staff agent. We plan to represent XALT again at the summit in Portland in May 2027. title: Forward Deployed Engineer - EMEA
descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to turn n8n’s most strategic enterprise deployments into production-ready success stories by embedding on-site, solving real customer problems, and building reusable automation patterns that shape our product.

To do so, you’ll work directly with customers, Deployment Strategists, and Product to make every engagement high-impact, scalable, and repeatable:

Drive high-impact enterprise deployments

Embed on-site with enterprise customers for focused 5-day deployment engagements, arriving with a hypothesis and leaving with production workflows in place.

Partner closely with Deployment Strategists to align technical execution with customer priorities, stakeholder needs, and adoption goals.

Build trust with technical and non-technical stakeholders by turning complex customer environments into clear, actionable solutions.

Build production-grade automation solutions

Design and build workflows, integrations, and custom nodes tailored to each customer’s environment and scalable beyond the initial use case.

Extend existing n8n nodes or add missing functionality where needed to unlock high-value enterprise use cases.

Translate ambiguous business problems into concrete automation designs that prioritize real customer value over technical complexity.

Work across industries and tech stacks, getting productive quickly in new environments.

Bridge customer needs with Product and Engineering

Identify when a bespoke customer requirement should become a reusable node improvement, product feature, or platform capability.

Create a clear feedback loop with Product and Engineering by documenting technical gaps, customer context, implementation learnings, and prioritization signals.

Contribute reusable learnings, workflows, custom nodes, and integration patterns to an internal playbook library.

Turn customer learnings into product and playbooks

Identify when a bespoke customer requirement should become a core product feature and document it clearly for Product.

Contribute reusable learnings, workflows, and patterns to an internal playbook library.

Help ensure every engagement makes the next one faster, stronger, and more productized.

Keep engagements focused and scalable

Deliver time-boxed customer engagements with clear outcomes, rather than open-ended professional services work.

Build solutions that customers can own and operate themselves.

Know when to build, when to simplify, and when to push back to avoid unnecessary complexity.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

🧑‍💻 Strong engineering background: You have solid full-stack or backend engineering experience and have built integrations, APIs, or automation pipelines in production environments.

🧩 Integration-building expertise: You can create custom nodes, extend existing integrations, and work confidently with APIs, authentication patterns, data models, and event-driven systems.

🔧 Product-minded technical execution: You can distinguish between a one-off customer workaround, a reusable node improvement, and a product feature worth escalating.

🤝 Customer-facing confidence: You’re comfortable working directly in customer environments and can build trust with engineers, operators, and non-technical stakeholders.

🗺️ Solution design skills: You can take a messy operational problem and turn it into a clean, practical technical design.

⚖️ Strong technical judgment: You know when to build, when to push back, and how to avoid gold-plating solutions that should stay simple.

✈️ Willingness to travel: You’re open to travelling roughly 30-50% of the time for on-site engagements, primarily across Europe.

⚡ Speed to productive: You can quickly understand new industries, tech stacks, and customer environments without needing everything to be neatly defined.

Nice-to-haves

🔁 Workflow automation experience: You have familiarity with n8n or similar workflow automation tools.

🏢 Enterprise deployment experience: You’ve worked with strategic enterprise accounts in complex technical environments.

🧱 Node or connector development: You’ve built custom nodes, connectors, plugins, SDKs, or reusable integration frameworks.

🚀 Forward deployed experience: You’ve worked in a forward deployed, solutions engineering, or similar role at a product-led technical organization.

📣 Product feedback experience: You’ve helped turn customer learnings into clear product feedback, roadmap input, or engineering specifications.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll be the founding Forward Deployed Engineer, helping define how we turn our largest enterprise deployments into long-term, referenceable success stories. Your work won’t sit in a demo environment — you’ll build production workflows with real users, influence our product roadmap, and create the playbooks that shape how this function scales.

You’ll join one of Europe’s fastest-growing startups at a moment of huge momentum, working with a remote-first team that values autonomy, speed, experimentation, and direct customer impact.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:
