title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer, Internship
descriptionHtml:
Le poste

Les Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSE) travaillent directement avec les clients afin de comprendre rapidement leurs problèmes les plus importants et ainsi concevoir et implémenter des solutions qui vont utiliser leurs données afin de résoudre ces problématiques. Nos clients s’appuient sur les plateformes de Palantir pour certaines de leurs opérations les plus critiques, et les projets débutent souvent par une question ouverte, par exemple : « Comment évaluer le risque d’incendie de forêt et, par conséquent, comment optimiser le réseau électrique ? » ou « Comment évaluer rapidement notre chaîne d’approvisionnement alimentaire et l’adapter afin d’apporter à temps une aide vitale ? » En tant que FDSE, vous appliquez votre capacité à résoudre les problèmes, votre créativité et vos compétences techniques pour aider les organisations à exploiter au mieux leurs données et avoir ainsi un impact réel sur le monde. Vous avez l’opportunité d’obtenir des informations rares et de contribuer à certaines des industries et institutions les plus importantes au monde.

Responsabilités principales

En tant que stagiaire chez FDSE, vos responsabilités s’apparentent à celles que l’on trouve dans une petite start-up, tout en bénéficiant des ressources, de la stabilité et de l’accompagnement d’une entreprise technologique bien établie. Vous travaillerez en petites équipes avec une supervision minimale et serez responsable de l’exécution de bout en bout de projets à enjeux élevés. Votre journée peut consister à discuter de l’architecture avec d’autres ingénieurs, à gérer des données à grande échelle, à coder une application web personnalisée, à discuter avec l’équipe dirigeante du client ou à établir une stratégie pour votre équipe.

Les stagiaires FDSE sont traités exactement comme des ingénieurs à temps plein, et bénéficient d’une grande liberté et d’une grande autonomie dans leur travail. Ils assument la responsabilité des projets et des résultats réels sur lesquels nos clients comptent.

Nos principes:
  • Impact : nous gérons des projets significatifs et enthousiasmants qui rendent le monde meilleur.
  • Responsabilité : nous menons nos projets du début à la fin, en surmontant tous les obstacles que nous pourrions rencontrer. Nous nous faisons mutuellement confiance afin de gérer efficacement le temps et les priorités et donner aux individus l’espace nécessaire pour réfléchir par eux-mêmes.
  • Collaboration : nous travaillons en interne avec des personnes d’horizons variés, tels que d’autres FDSE, des équipes Produits et des Deployment Strategists. Nous travaillons également en externe avec nos clients, souvent sur site, afin de comprendre et de répondre à leurs problèmes.
  • Développement : nous pensons que l’apprentissage par l’expérience est l’une des meilleures écoles et nous nous encourageons nous-mêmes tout comme nos pairs à rechercher de nouveaux défis et de nouvelles opportunités de croissance, ainsi qu’à trouver de nouvelles façons d’innover et de partager les connaissances.
Le profil recherché
  • Propension et intérêt à se déplacer sur les sites client en fonction des besoins. Capacité de passer 25 à 50 % du temps en déplacement de préférence, mais les exigences peuvent varier selon l’équipe et l’emplacement.
  • Capacité démontrée à apprendre continuellement, à travailler de manière autonome et à prendre des décisions avec un minimum de direction.
  • Capacité à collaborer avec des équipes de personnes techniques et non techniques, et à être à l’aise pour travailler dans un environnement en évolution constante avec des objectifs dynamiques et des itérations avec les utilisateurs.
  • Volonté de résoudre de façon créative les problèmes techniques liés aux structures de données, aux systèmes de stockage, à l’infrastructure cloud, aux frameworks front-end et à d’autres outils techniques.
  • Intérêt à travailler avec des données à grande échelle et à les utiliser pour résoudre des problèmes opérationnels importants.
Les exigences
  • Expérience en ingénierie, de préférence dans des domaines tels que l’informatique, les mathématiques, le Software Engineering, la physique et la science des données.
  • Maîtrise de langages de programmation tels que Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript ou similaire.
  • Vous devez prévoir d’obtenir votre diplôme en 2027. Il doit s’agir de votre dernier stage avant d’obtenir votre diplôme.
Pour postuler, veuillez soumettre ce qui suit :
  • Un CV à jour
  • Des réponses réfléchies à nos questions de candidature
Date limite de l’offre

Afin de renforcer la transparence de notre processus de recrutement, nous aimerions vous faire part de nos attentes concernant la date limite de l’offre. En postulant à ce poste, vous vous engagez à confirmer votre décision dans les deux semaines suivant la réception de votre offre écrite.

La vie chez Palantir

Nous tenons à ce que chaque Palantirien(ne) atteigne son meilleur potentiel, c’est pourquoi nous célébrons les forces, les compétences et les intérêts des individus, de votre premier entretien à votre croissance à long terme, plutôt que de nous appuyer sur les échelles de carrière traditionnelles. L’attention portée aux besoins de notre communauté nous permet d’optimiser nos possibilités de croissance et contribue à garantir de nombreuses voies de réussite chez Palantir. Promouvoir la santé et le bien-être dans tous les domaines de la vie des Palantiriens n’est que l’une des façons dont nous investissons dans notre communauté. Apprenez-en davantage sur la vie chez Palantir et notez que nos offres peuvent varier selon les régions.

Conformément aux valeurs et à la culture de Palantir, nous estimons que les employés sont « meilleurs ensemble » et que le travail en présentiel permet d’obtenir des résultats plus créatifs. En conséquence, nous encourageons les employés à travailler depuis nos bureaux pour favoriser la connectivité et l’innovation. De nombreuses équipes proposent des options hybrides (télétravail un jour ou deux par semaine), ce qui permet à nos employés de trouver le bon compromis pour leur productivité personnelle. En fonction des besoins de l’entreprise, il existe quelques postes qui permettent de travailler « à distance » de manière exceptionnelle. Si vous postulez à l’un de ces postes, vous devez travailler depuis la ville et/ou le pays dans lequel vous êtes employé(e). Si le poste précise « sur site », vous devez travailler depuis un bureau.

Si vous souhaitez donner aux organisations les plus importantes au monde les moyens d’agir, votre place est ici. Palantir valorise l’excellence, d’où qu’elle vienne. Nous nous engageons à rendre le processus de candidature et d’embauche accessible à tous et offrirons des aménagements raisonnables aux personnes vivant en situation de handicap. Si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement pour le processus de candidature ou d’embauche, veuillez et nous indiquer comment nous pouvons vous aider.

Attention : il ne vous sera jamais demandé d’envoyer un paiement ou de partager des données financières pour participer à notre processus d’entretien. Si vous pensez avoir été contacté par un escroc, nous vous conseillons de cesser toute communication avec la personne et d’envisager de la signaler aux autorités compétentes, telles que l’Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3) du FBI aux États-Unis.

A World-Changing Company

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role

Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) work directly with customers to quickly understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions to use data against them. Our customers rely on Palantir’s platforms for some of their most critical operations, and projects often start with an open-ended question like, "How do we evaluate wildfire risk and optimise a power grid as a result" or "How do we quickly assess our food supply chain and modify it to deliver life saving assistance on time?" As an FDSE, you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organisations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the world’s most important industries and institutions.

Core Responsibilities

As an FDSE Intern, your responsibilities look similar to those at a small startup, with the resources, stability and mentorship of an established tech company. You’ll work in small teams with minimal supervision and own end-to-end execution of high stakes projects. Your day might span discussing architecture with fellow engineers, wrangling massive-scale data, coding a custom web app, speaking with customer executives, or establishing strategy for your team.

FDSE Interns are treated just like full time engineers, with significant freedom and ownership over their work. Interns take responsibility for real world projects and outcomes that our customers rely on.

Our Principles:

  • Impact: We address meaningful and exciting projects that change the world for the better.

  • Ownership: We see projects through from beginning to end, working through any obstacles we may encounter. We trust each other to effectively handle time and priorities and give people the space to think for themselves.

  • Collaboration: We work internally with people from a variety of backgrounds — such as other FDSEs, product teams, and Deployment Strategists. We also work externally with our customers, often on site, to understand and tackle their problems.

  • Growth: We believe experiential learning is one of the best teachers and encourage ourselves and our peers to seek new challenges and opportunities for growth, as well as find new ways to innovate and share knowledge.

What We Value

  • Willingness and interest to travel as needed to client sites. Ability to travel 25-50% preferred, but requirements vary by team and location.

  • Ability to continuously learn, work independently, and make decisions with minimal direction.

  • Ability to collaborate in teams of technical and non-technical individuals, and comfortable working in a constantly evolving environment with dynamic objectives and iteration with users.

  • An eagerness to creatively solve technical problems with data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks, and other technical tools.

  • Interest in working with and using large scale data to solve valuable business problems.

What We Require

  • Engineering background, preferred in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, and Data Science.

  • Proficiency with one or more programming languages, such as Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar.

  • Must be planning on graduating in 2027. This should be your final internship before graduating.

To apply, please submit the following:

  • An updated resume / CV

  • Thoughtful responses to our application questions

Offer Deadline

In an effort to build more transparency into our recruitment process, we’d like to share our offer deadline expectations. By applying to this position, you commit to confirming your decision within two weeks of receiving your written offer.

Life at Palantir

We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.

In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.

If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please and let us know how we can help.

Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3) .

title: Founder Talent Acquisition
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Hexa is a venture studio. Since 2011, we've built more than 60 companies, including 3 unicorns. Every year, our startup studio, Hexa Start, creates 12 companies from scratch, and our accelerator, Hexa Sprint, funds several dozen more. Each Start company begins with a CEO and a CTO we recruit ourselves: finding them is our core business.

That's where you come in. 👀

The role

Our partners bring the ideas. What turns an idea into a real company is the people who build it, so finding the right founders is Hexa's core business. That's your job: convincing aspiring founders to join us, walking them through a life-changing decision, and putting them in front of the right partner at the right time.

Our marketing team builds and nurtures the reservoir of future founders. You turn it into a pipeline for each open role (say, a CTO for a cybersecurity project with experience in LLM-built attacks), run the search with the partner leading the project, assess, and close. Laure, your peer, does the same for each company's first employees.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll need the business sense to read an idea and know what kind of founder it calls for, and a sharp eye for entrepreneurial profiles: you can tell a true entrepreneur from a strong manager, even when both look great on paper.

What you'll actually do

  • Source, hands-on: inbound comes first, but you roll up your sleeves and reach out to everyone who looks on track to start something, before anyone else does,

  • Build a pipeline for every open founder role within two weeks, from your own sourcing, the marketing reservoir and our scoring agents,

  • Own the founder scorecard with the partners and fine-tune it every quarter against real hiring outcomes,

  • Interview, assess and close demanding, sometimes hesitant candidates, alongside partners and our CTO,

  • Tell marketing and community what each search is missing, down to the event it needs,

  • Act as product owner of our recruiting stack (Ashby, sourcing tools, AI agents), and call in agencies when a search runs short.

What we're looking for

  • 2 to 7 years in recruiting or talent acquisition, close to founders: fast-growing startup, VC fund, accelerator, studio, or founder and executive search

  • You know what makes a strong founder, and you have examples rather than generalities

  • A track record of closing senior or founder-level candidates, with numbers to back it

  • You build trust fast, and you can challenge a candidate without putting them off

  • You're as comfortable testing an agent or optimizing a workflow as building a relationship

  • You have the standing to disagree with a partner, and the judgment to know when not to

  • You are fluent in English and French

Our recruitment process

  • First call with Laure, Talent Partner

  • Introduction call with our CEO, to deepdive on the role

  • Case study on a live search: pipeline, gaps and your plan for the next two weeks

  • Interviews with two partners

  • References with hiring managers and candidates you've placed

What's in it for you:

  • Package: €62K to €68K gross/year (base salary of €52K–€57K + 20% annual profit sharing)

  • Opportunity to invest in all Hexa portfolio startups at a (very) preferential rate

  • Swile meal card

  • 8 to 12 RTT days per year

  • Flexible remote work policy (up to 2 days/week)

  • Mobility budget: €500/year for green transportation (bike, metro, electric scooter)

  • Health insurance with 50% coverage for you and your family

  • 1% Holiday bonus

  • MacBook laptop

title: Founding Customer Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

The Role

We are hiring a Founding Customer Success Lead/Manager for the UK market.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to build a market and a function, not simply manage a book of business or an expansion. You will work with some of our most strategic customers, helping them move from initial experimentation to broad, measurable adoption of AI across their organizations.

You will own the full customer journey, from executive alignment and implementation through long-term adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion. You will build trusted relationships with C-level and VP-level leaders, help customers navigate the organizational change that comes with adopting AI, and turn successful customer outcomes into a repeatable Customer Success motion from our London HQ.

As our first senior Customer Success leader based at the London HQ, you will help define how Dust serves customers from the office. You will create playbooks, establish operating rhythms, shape our approach to executive engagement, and feed what you learn back into the wider Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Deployment teams.

Dust is an AI-native company, and that changes what Customer Success can look like. You will help customers understand how AI can reshape their work while using AI to make your own practice more effective, scalable, and precise.

This role is suited to someone who combines executive presence with a strong builder's mindset. You should be comfortable operating without a finished playbook, making decisions with incomplete information, and taking responsibility for outcomes from beginning to end.

What you will do

  • Own a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers, building durable relationships across executive, business, technical, and operational stakeholders.

  • Establish trusted-advisor relationships with C-level and VP-level leaders, helping them define their AI strategy and turn that strategy into meaningful business outcomes.

  • Lead complex customer journeys from kickoff through adoption, renewal, and expansion. You will coordinate the right people at the right time and make sure progress does not stall between teams.

  • Drive measurable value realization by helping customers identify, quantify, and communicate outcomes such as time saved, costs reduced, faster execution, and improved decision-making.

  • Lead executive business reviews and other strategic customer conversations, connecting product usage to business impact and creating a clear path to the next stage of adoption.

  • Support customers through enterprise-wide change management, including rollout planning, governance, internal enablement, use-case discovery, and the transition from individual experimentation to organization-wide adoption.

  • Identify and develop expansion opportunities across teams, functions, and geographies. You will partner closely with Sales to turn strong adoption and customer outcomes into sustainable account growth.

  • Orchestrate internal resources across Customer Success, AI Deployment Strategy, Forward-Deployed Engineering, Product, and Sales to deliver a cohesive customer experience.

  • Build the foundations of Dust's Customer Success motion from the London HQ, including account planning, executive engagement, adoption frameworks, value reviews, customer education, and feedback loops.

  • Represent the voice of customers inside Dust by turning customer needs, use cases, and patterns into clear product feedback, strategic insight, and better ways of working.

  • Contribute to the broader Customer Success team by sharing what works, raising the bar for strategic account management, and helping shape how a GenAI-native CS organization operates.

What we are looking for

  • You have 8+ years of experience in Customer Success, account management, consulting, solutions, or a related customer-facing role, with a strong track record of owning and growing strategic enterprise accounts.

  • You have worked with complex organizations where adoption requires sustained executive alignment, cross-functional coordination, and thoughtful change management over multiple quarters.

  • You have successfully managed senior customer relationships, including the ability to influence C-level and VP-level stakeholders and communicate credibly with business and technical audiences.

  • You have a track record of driving measurable customer outcomes, renewals, and expansion. You can move comfortably between strategic conversations and the operational details needed to make progress.

  • You have built or improved Customer Success processes, playbooks, or operating models. You know how to create structure where little exists and how to turn individual success into a repeatable motion.

  • You understand how technically sophisticated products are adopted inside large organizations. Experience with AI, developer tools, data platforms, enterprise software, or another emerging technology category is highly valuable.

  • You are fluent in AI concepts and are genuinely curious about how agents, language models, and automation will change the way companies operate. You do not need to be an engineer, but you should be able to engage confidently with technical teams and build practical AI fluency with customers.

  • You communicate with clarity and conviction in English, both in writing and in executive settings. French is helpful because you will work closely with our Paris-based teams, but it is not essential.

  • You have strong judgment, initiative, and ownership. You make sound decisions under ambiguity, follow through on commitments, and take responsibility for the outcome rather than waiting for perfect instructions.

  • You are comfortable being both strategic and hands-on. You can lead an executive business review in the morning, rethink an onboarding process in the afternoon, and write the first version of a playbook when the team needs one.

  • You are generous with context, direct in your communication, and committed to working as part of a team. You make the people around you better.

What success looks like

In your first six months, you will have:

  • Built strong relationships with the key executives, champions, and decision-makers across your customer portfolio.

  • Created clear account plans and adoption strategies for each strategic customer.

  • Established a repeatable approach to executive engagement, value realization, and expansion planning from the London HQ.

  • Helped customers move from isolated AI experiments to repeatable, high-value workflows used across teams.

  • Identified the most important customer and market patterns and turned them into actionable feedback for Dust's Product and Go-to-Market teams.

  • Created the first building blocks of a scalable Customer Success playbook.

Over time, you will help make Dust indispensable to some of the most ambitious companies and define what exceptional Customer Success looks like for an AI operating system.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

Compensation: £100K – £155K • Offers Equity

title: Founding Sales
descriptionHtml:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. In reality, hundred of thousands of operators acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on, with tools that have barely changed in decades and spending hours a day on email. Nexcade is building the agentic operating system for those people, transforming the way people communicate and optimise the $1T spend on logistics every year.

Our agents are live in production with leading global Freight Forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are rapidly expanding the platform to touch every part of the logistics lifecycle.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality from top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

How we work

  • Everybody builds, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents. You will not be asked to write software, but you will run your prospecting, preparation, follow-up and business-case analysis on agents rather than by hand.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

The role

We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding, and as a founding sales leader you will partner with Dan, our CEO, to win deals now and to put in place the process, tooling and playbooks that make the next ones predictable.

What you’ll do

  • Drive Full-Cycle Sales: Partner directly with our CEO to craft and execute a detailed go-to-market plan that hits aggressive growth targets. Manage the entire sales process from initial outreach through contract signature. Qualify leads, run discovery, deliver compelling demos, navigate technical and commercial objections, and close deals. Own the number.

  • Build the Pipeline Machine: Instrument a multi-channel demand generation engine including events strategy, AI BDR outreach, targeted ABM campaigns, and creative outbound. You'll leverage emerging sales tools and AI to punch above our weight.

  • Master the Product Story: Own our sales demo and product positioning strategy. Work closely with Deployment Strategists to ensure demos resonate with different personas and value props. You should be able to run a killer demo yourself.

  • Navigate Complex Sales: Sell into freight forwarding operations, IT, and executive buyers. Handle technical conversations, security reviews, and integration discussions. Know when to bring in technical resources and when to close solo.

  • Manage Commercial Relationships: Own the customer relationship post-sale through onboarding and expansion. Work with the Deployment team on smooth handoffs. Identify upsell and expansion opportunities.

  • Build Sales Foundations for Scale: Establish our sales tech stack (CRM, engagement tools, analytics). Create repeatable playbooks, sales collateral, and battlecards. Document what works. Build the foundation that enables the first 10 sales hires.

What we look for

  • Proven Sales Closer: Deeply motivated by winning deals and hitting numbers, with a track record of hitting quota in B2B SaaS or logistics tech. You've closed complex deals with multiple stakeholders and long sales cycles, and you know your conversion rates, pipeline velocity and deal cycle times because you instrument what you do.

  • 0-to-1 Builder: You've sold at an early-stage company where nobody handed you a playbook, so you wrote one. You can zoom out to shape GTM strategy with the CEO, then zoom in to write the cold email and prep the demo, and you're comfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration.

  • Logistics Domain Knowledge: Prior experience selling into freight forwarding, logistics or supply chain is highly valuable. If you don't have it, you've shown you can become a domain expert quickly and speak credibly with industry buyers.

  • Technical Fluency: Comfortable discussing AI, automation, APIs and integrations with technical buyers. You can hold your own on system architecture, security and data flows without needing engineering on every call.

  • Founding Team Mentality: Willing to do what it takes to win, whether that's working a trade show floor, building a custom demo environment or getting a contract over the line yourself. You thrive in the chaos of early-stage startups.

Why join

As the first commercial hire you will shape how Nexcade sells, who it sells to and what the product becomes, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will sell directly to the businesses that will run on what we build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it. The sales playbook and stack, the demand engine, the partner channel and the expansion motion from one module to the next are not built yet, and would be yours.

title: Frontend Engineering Lead
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a Frontend Lead Engineer to own the front end at Omnea.

Our design system is growing fast, our front-end architecture is becoming more complex, and right now ownership of these things is distributed. You'd be the person who takes this to the next level.

You'll work across every product team. You'll own the design system, own the front-end architecture, and set the standard for how we build interfaces. We're a tight-knit group of ambitious builders who hold the bar high. It took over 10,000 interviews to hire our first 50 Omneans. Over the next year, our engineering team will double in size, our enterprise customer base will grow from ~180 to 300+, and revenue will triple. The front end has to scale with it.

This is a craft role with real leverage. Almost every engineer at Omnea ships front end. What you build determines how well they do it.

Procurement is a harder interface problem than it sounds. Approval workflows that branch and re-route, dense tables people live in all day, intake forms that adapt to what someone is buying. Getting this right is the difference between software people tolerate and software people actually like using.

What Can You Expect On Our Engineering Team?

  • Join a Skilled Team. Become part of one of Europe's fastest-growing software companies, working alongside experienced full-stack product engineers and product designers from top technology businesses and startups.

  • Own the Design System. You'll own our design system outright: components, patterns, tokens, documentation, and adoption. You'll partner closely with Design to turn intent into reusable, high-quality primitives.

  • Own the Front-End Architecture. Deployment strategy, performance, build tooling, and the conventions everyone else follows. You'll set the direction rather than inherit it, working alongside the engineers and designers closest to each surface rather than owning it in isolation.

  • Leverage Across Every Team. You'll work with all of our engineering teams on their most front-end-heavy projects. The work you do multiplies across the whole org.

  • A Real Design Partnership. Every cross-functional team at Omnea has a dedicated Product Manager and Product Designer. You'll be the connective tissue between design intent and what actually ships, and the person designers come to when they want to know what's possible.

  • Work with Modern Technology. TypeScript everywhere, React and Next.js on the front end, and Meticulous for automated visual regression testing, so you can refactor the design system without fear. Behind it sits Postgres and AWS serverless infrastructure (Lambda, DynamoDB, and EventBridge), managed through Pulumi and deployed via GitHub Actions, with Datadog for observability.

  • AI-Native Development. AI is core to how we build. Engineers use Claude Code and agentic workflows every day to write, review, and ship code faster, and our product is itself built on AI agents that automate complex procurement workflows.

  • Continuous Delivery. We deploy small, incremental changes to production multiple times per day, enabling rapid iteration and fast customer feedback loops.

  • Collaboration and Autonomy. We operate as a high-trust team where individuals are expected to take ownership while collaborating closely to solve difficult problems.

  • Customers at the Center. We regularly engage directly with customers to understand their problems, gather feedback, and ensure we're building products that create genuine value.


About You

  • You're deep in React. You've built complex, production React applications and you understand the framework properly, not just the API surface. Rendering behaviour, state, performance, and where things break at scale.

  • You've owned front-end infrastructure. Rendering strategies, build tooling, bundle performance, and the architectural decisions underneath a large application.

  • You've built or owned a design system. Not just consumed one. You've made the calls on component APIs, driven adoption across teams, and dealt with the messy reality of migration and versioning.

  • You have taste. You care how things look and feel, you notice when something is only 90% right, and you can hold a genuine conversation with designers rather than just implementing tickets.

  • You know CSS deeply. Layout, styling architecture, and building interfaces that hold up across breakpoints, themes, and edge cases. You treat accessibility and motion as part of the craft rather than a checklist at the end.

  • You're a strong engineer first. Your depth and your interest sit in the front end, and that's the point of this role. But you're fluent in TypeScript generally and comfortable working beyond the browser when a problem calls for it.

  • You're motivated by impact. You care about what your work actually achieves, not just how it's built. You thrive with the autonomy to make meaningful decisions and take real ownership of outcomes.

  • You're a team builder. You're excited by maximising team performance, whether that means learning from others or taking the time to explain, give feedback, and level up those around you.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. This role is new. Its shape will be partly yours to define, and you're happy tackling problems without a predefined solution, backed by an experienced team.


Nice-to-Haves

  • You've worked at design-led companies or somewhere with a genuinely high bar for interface quality.

  • You've performed exceptionally at something else, be it academics, sport, or work. You've gone above and beyond the norm.

  • You love engineering. It's more than a job. You've contributed to open source or worked on side projects just because you enjoy it.


Interview Process

Before applying, we strongly encourage you to spend a few minutes in our R&D Candidate Hub. It covers our engineering culture, ways of working, interview process, tech environment, and what it's like to build at Omnea.

>> R&D Candidate Hub: https://omnea.notion.site/R-D-Candidate-Hub-2f688cce658780f1b942c81cd3a032d4

While this is a front-end specialist role, we expect a core level understanding of TypeScript beyond the browser, so you should be comfortable writing general TypeScript in an exercise that will feel more full-stack than front-end. We assess this as part of our pair programming stage, which is the same standard exercise we run for every engineer. Beyond that baseline, we're looking for genuine depth in React, front-end architecture, and design systems.

The process varies slightly by level but generally includes:

  1. Initial screening call with our Talent team (30 mins, remote)

  2. AI Product Eng Challenge, language-agnostic (1 hour, remote)

  3. Onsite interviews at our Victoria office (~3 hours)

    • Engineering Culture interview with an Engineering Manager or Team Lead (45 mins)

    • FE System Design interview with a Senior Engineer (60 mins)

    • Engineering Leadership interview with our CTO (45 mins)

    • Office tour (15 mins)

We'll asses level throughout and align interview stages accordingly.

We're proud to support visa sponsorship for candidates who need it.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

title: Genesis-World: Core Physics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
What we're building

Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future.

Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI. One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available (paper). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact (paper) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise.

Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright.

This is at the core of Genesis AI's strategy. Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200+ hours), while correlating with on-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute.

The role

You push the physics of Genesis-World forward. The mandate is clear: ship production-ready simulation capabilities that matter for the company's internal needs. Research applied end-to-end, from algorithm to merged, tested, documented code that real robot-learning pipelines depend on. Occasional groundbreaking research happens, notably through academic collaborations. But the core of the job is making the engine measurably better along five axes:

  • Speed. Algorithms that are not only faster but also smart enough to spend compute only where it matters across both time and space: larger stable timesteps, selective fidelity (adaptive across scales or simply hand-set), structure-aware solvers.

  • Completeness. No physics off limits: water, human animation, air flow, gravel, tendons, even body organs. Whatever the next use-case needs, the engine grows to cover it.

  • Fidelity. More realistic models: contact, friction, deformation, energy, actuation, materials…

  • Versatility. Extensible multi-physics without compromise on realism: all solvers in the scene coupled together at once, two-way and constraint-based. Write your own solver and it joins the scene like a native one, growing into an open solver ecosystem.

  • Scalability. From workstation to factory scale, and one day, city scale: thousands of interacting entities, batched across environments, without losing physical soundness.

Our ambition is to establish Genesis-World as the go-to simulator for physical AI, from companies and research labs to individuals.

The problems waiting for you

  • Every fidelity for every physics. The same physics at every point of the speed-accuracy spectrum, from heavily batched training with XPBD or VBD to final validation with IPC. Same scene, same API, pick your tradeoff.

  • Invent physics level-of-detail (LOD). Rendering has had LOD for decades, physics is still waiting. Simulate at full fidelity what agents interact with and see, coarsely what they do not.

  • Heterogeneous environments. Every parallel world can hold a completely different model: different bodies, joints, and collision geometries.

  • Adaptive timesteps per island. Error-based control with Runge-Kutta Dopri5, and Time-of-Impact stepping during collision detection, as done in Jiminy.

  • Couple everything, exactly. Efficient and accurate two-way constraint-based coupling between heterogeneous grey-box solvers, using state-of-the-art methods like ADMM. Owning every solver in the stack is what makes it possible.

  • More scalable constraint solvers. Push rigid constraint solving beyond its current scalability ceiling (reference).

  • Unify contact resolution. Hydro-elastic compliance, unilateral constraints, and sequential impulses in the same framework, ideally under one generic formulation.

  • Closed kinematic loops without constraints. Handle loops intrinsically for numerical stability and speed, in the spirit of Kamino.

Day to day: you write your physics in plain Python and Quadrants makes it fast on every backend. And you validate it the hard way: analytical closed forms, other engines, real-world data.

Who you are

You are a physicist and an engineer at once. You judge a method by whether it holds up in production at real scale, and you do not stop until it does. No blind spots: you relentlessly hunt down even the defect that looks insignificant, because it never is.

  • A strong background in physics-based simulation, preferably related to robotics: RBD, FEM, MPM, SPH, IPC, XPBD, VBD, ABD, plus constrained optimization and numerical integration of stiff systems.

  • A track record of shipping simulation code that others rely on, in an engine, in industry, or in a research codebase used beyond its authors.

  • Solid HPC programming (CPU and/or GPU), and an instinct for what makes a numerical method fast in practice, beyond complexity classes.

  • Rigor in validation: analytical closed forms, cross-engine consistency, real-world data.

Bonus points: publications in simulation, graphics, or robotics venues (SIGGRAPH, ICRA, IROS, CoRL, RSS). Contributions to an open-source physics engine.

Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

You’ll grow a portfolio of our most important automotive OEM and supplier accounts in EMEA, working hand in hand with our Business Development leaders. Our deals are large, technical and multi-year. These deals are built on a foundation of understanding multiple technical and business stakeholders, from individual engineers, to leadership and C-suite. You will need to spend time understanding what an engineering team is battling, what the program manager is worried about, how to gain support and buy in from procurement and purchasing teams, and what the CTO is trying to achieve at a strategic level, then pull these threads together to build a successful deal. You'll work hand in hand with solution engineering and business development teams to shape, build and close deals. Internally, you’ll coordinate engineering, product, legal and finance to deliver on what we commit.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

  • Own critical client relationships and expand reach into key accounts including major OEM and Tier 1 relationships.

  • Drive strategic alignment and executive engagement across R&D, procurement and other relevant teams

  • Grow current footprint across Applied Intuition's solutions and land multi year commercial deals, including securing renewal risks

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Bachelor's degree

  • 5-10 years of experience automotive software / platform / semiconductor sales into Automotive OEMs

  • Track record of securing large scale, multi year software deals

  • Strong knowledge of a complex software sales process, including ability to map stakeholders, leverage key contacts and drive progress through legal, following up and maintaining CRM hygiene

Nice to have:

  • Technical fluency around Software Defined Vehicle technical topics, ADAS/AD, ADAS validation, SIL/HIL toolchains

  • Ability to have a technical conversation without the presence of a solution engineer

  • Strong network inside at least one or more major European Automotive OEMs

  • Masters in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or comparable Engineering subject

  • MBA

Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

Applied Intuition pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum intended target base salary for new hire salaries for the position. The actual base salary offered to a successful candidate will additionally be influenced by a variety of factors including experience, credentials & certifications, educational attainment, skill level requirements, interview performance, and the level and scope of the position.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Applied Intuition is an equal opportunity employer and federal contractor or subcontractor. These regulations require that covered prime contractors and subcontractors take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status or disability. title: Go-To-Market Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Growth at Private Equity Insights

Are you excited about solving real, hard problems? Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. You will learn to write copy that makes elite investors act, map the entire market of investors, decide who to target, and deploy AI to outperform a teams of 20+ people.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career, apply.

Why Private Equity Insights

Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 5 media companies and exited 1.

What we offer you

  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way
  • Unlimited growth potential. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our conferences

Your Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will vary; however, some of them will be to:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value to the client.

What we expect from you

You possess an unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency. You have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what you do. You take ownership of everything you do, are proactive and follow through on commitments. Moreover, you’re humble and you share our passion for building and executing new businesses. Furthermore, we expect that you:

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Role is full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week.

Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year.

The start date is flexible.

title: Graduate Partnership Executive
descriptionHtml:
About us

Fospha is the measurement system enterprise retail and ecommerce brands run their business on. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what's actually working — across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop — down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on. Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, Lululemon and many more use Fospha up to 25 times a day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform - and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin.

The Graduate Opportunity at Fospha

Joining Fospha’s graduate programme means stepping into a fast-paced environment where you’ll gain real responsibility and exposure from day one. In Partnerships, graduates work directly with some of the world’s biggest digital platforms - like TikTok, Meta, and Snapchat - playing a key role in strengthening relationships, enabling joint initiatives, and driving partner success.

  • Hands-on exposure to our Partnerships: Working directly with the platforms such as Tiktok, Meta and Snap, you will build commercial acumen, develop strategic communication skills, and gain a deep understanding of how the digital advertising ecosystem works.
  • Cross-Functional Exposure: With support, cross-functional collaboration, and the opportunity to make a visible impact early on, it’s the ideal launchpad for ambitious graduates looking to break into the world of ad tech and strategic partnerships.
  • Comprehensive Training: In addition to the extensive on-the-job learning opportunities, you'll receive a broad and blended in-person training curriculum covering essential topics such as Business Storytelling, Relationship Building, Market Research & Product and Financial Management.

The Role:

As a Partnerships Executive, you'll join a high-impact team focused on enabling, scaling, and deepening Fospha’s relationships with the platforms that power digital marketing.

This is a graduate-level role designed to develop future leaders. You’ll be hands-on with major ad platforms, supporting both strategic execution and day-to-day coordination. You’ll also work closely with internal teams - especially Marketing, Product and our Customer Teams - to make sure our partners have what they need to help customers grow.

Key responsibilities:

  • Supporting our partner managers in coordinating with Google, Meta, TikTok, Snap and others
  • Preparing decks, talking points and training sessions to enable partner sales teams
  • Tracking and reporting on partner performance and engagement
  • Liaising across internal teams to keep initiatives moving and aligned
  • Owning communications or enablement efforts for specific territories or smaller partners
  • Researching and initiating contact with emerging or long-tail partners
  • In addition to your core responsibilities, we expect you to be excited by the opportunity Gen AI brings and find new ways of working utilising our Gen Ai hub!

What are we looking for?

We hire for potential – you don’t need a technical degree or marketing background. You should apply if you:

  • Are an excellent communicator – written, verbal, and visual
  • Are highly organised and detail-oriented
  • Are curious about how marketing, measurement and partnerships work
  • Can handle multiple workstreams and work well under light-touch supervision
  • Thrive in fast-moving, high-growth environments
  • Want to make a real commercial impact from day one

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience with TikTok Ads, Meta, or other digital marketing tools
  • Familiarity with platforms like Notion, HubSpot, Google Sheets
  • Any internship or part-time experience in partnerships, sales, marketing or client-facing roles
  • Like shopping and are a customer of retail brands

Our Values and Principles

You will be able to demonstrate examples of our core principles:

  • Seek inclusion & diversity: We create an environment where everyone feels welcome, and people are encouraged to speak and be heard
  • Work Hard, Work Well, Work Together: We take responsibility for making things happen, independently and together; we help colleagues in need and close loops, making sure our work is complete and has lasting impact
  • Grow: We are proactive, curious and unafraid of failure
  • Customer at the heart: We care about the customer, feel their pain and love building product that solves their biggest problems
  • Candour with caring: We deliver candid feedback with kindness and receive it with gratitude

What we can offer you

  • A workplace pension, through Royal London, with Fospha matching your contributions up to 3%
  • A £1,000/year flexible benefits allowance to put towards private medical insurance, dental cover, a health cash plan, gym membership, extra holiday, or a pension top-up - whatever suits you!
  • Access to Wellhub, giving you one membership across gyms, boutique studios, and wellbeing apps
  • 25 days' annual leave plus 8 UK bank holidays, an extra day off for your birthday! and more holiday the longer you stay (26 days after 3 years, 27 after 6)
  • Life assurance worth 4x your annual salary, from day one
  • Cycle to Work scheme, plus discounts on everyday spending through our benefits portal — Apple, Tesco, IKEA, M&S, Deliveroo, cinema tickets and more
  • Quarterly one-to-one sessions with a financial adviser, plus access to payroll-deducted loans through Salary Finance
  • Paid volunteering days each year
  • Regular socials, free weekly snacks, and Lunch & Learn events at our Scale Space office, plus access to the wider Blenheim Chalcot community
  • Opportunities to travel — including to our India and North America offices

The Process

  • 15-minute screening call with a member of the Talent Team
  • 30-minute Hiring Manager interview
  • Task and Panel interview
  • Final Exec interview

Top tip: Make sure to thoroughly research Fospha and tell us why you would be a great fit for the role!

title: Growth Lead - Performance Marketing
descriptionHtml:
About Plasma

Plasma is building the primary account for global money.

Money used to belong to a country. Increasingly, it belongs to a person or business moving through many countries. People and businesses now earn, spend, save, hire and invest across borders. Traditional banks cannot serve this new world.

Our first product, Plasma One, is a global money account: a place to receive, hold, send funds in seconds, earn yield and spend with a card in the local economy.

Underneath is the Plasma network, built from first principles for stablecoin payments. Stablecoins make dollars faster, cheaper and more reliable to move.

The opportunity is to become where all global money lands first: where income arrives, balances grow, payments move, businesses operate, and new financial products are built.


The Team & Our Story

We are a global team of founders, operators and engineers, obsessed with building the best products. We work at the cutting edge of financial innovation, using stablecoins to create tools for consumers and businesses.

We operate with trust, clarity, and ambition: own your craft, move with urgency, contribute beyond your lane, back your teammates, debate rigorously, and keep raising the bar for what great means.

The role

  • You inherit a live product with real spend, and you own the paid engine that scales it across Plasma One and Plasma Business. Channels, budget, creative and measurement all sit with you.

  • Own the cost of acquisition of valuable users and managing our paid advertising motion end to end.

  • Deploy many variations of ads, platforms and angles to test high performing creative and formats driving users into both custom funnels and direct to app while measuring downstream events.

  • Take us beyond our crypto-native audience. Find the audiences, messages and formats on Meta, Google, TikTok and YouTube that bring in people who fund and keep spending, then scale the ones that work.

  • Run the campaigns yourself. You build them, launch them, read the results and decide where tomorrow's budget goes. New creative, new audiences and new angles every week, with a clear read on what worked and why.

  • Look past the click. Work with product and design on landing pages, onboarding, lifecycle and referrals so a new sign-up becomes a funded account and a regular user.

  • Build the paid function. The tracking, reporting and playbooks you set up become what the team runs on, and as channels prove out you help hire the specialists who scale them.

The Bar

  • Regional market expertise. You know how to work on an acquisition strategy that differs between countries and markets

  • Deep, hands-on experience running paid acquisition at a consumer app or fintech, especially paid social and search, with real budgets and real accountability for the outcome.

  • Understand how to navigate Meta AEM, Google optimization, Apple search ads, Snapchat and other platforms, configure Appsflyer, our data warehouse and creative to achieve exceptional results.

  • A track record of structured creative testing and confident budget allocation across channels.

  • Strong measurement skills. You know attribution, incrementality and cohort analysis, and where each one can mislead you.

  • Range across the funnel. You have improved landing pages, onboarding, lifecycle or referrals, working closely with product and design.

  • Proof, not claims. Show us what you personally tested, what improved, and what it did to acquisition cost, activation and retention. Vague answers will not get through.

  • Resourceful. You find a way to get the answer or the result, with or without a big team behind you. Based in London or ready to relocate.

Nice to have

  • You were an early growth hire at a global consumer fintech

  • You know your way around mobile measurement partners such as AppsFlyer or Adjust, and the ad policies that come with financial products.

  • You are curious about stablecoins and new payment rails. Prior crypto experience is not required.

What's in it for you

  • Above-market salary for the level of the role, with token compensation.

  • A beautiful London HQ with gym access and daily food, for those who thrive in an office environment. Visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're joining from abroad.

  • Premium health insurance for you and your family, fully covered by Plasma.

  • Monthly wellness budget, whether that's the gym, therapy, sauna, or massage.

  • All the tools and tech you need to operate at your best.

  • Real ownership and responsibility from day one, with your work shipping to hundreds of thousands of people, moving millions of dollars every day.

Data Protection & Privacy
We are committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. Any personal information you provide during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable local data protection laws.

Compensation: £100K – £150K • + Tokens

title: Hardware Design Senior Manager
descriptionHtml:
Hardware Design Senior Manager 

Bristol, UK

About the job

Lead the engineers behind the power, timing and control circuits that make Graphcore’s AI compute hardware work.

Your team’s schematics, component choices and electrical constraints will give PCB layout engineers complete inputs for implementing each design. You’ll help test and manufacturing teams understand expected behaviour, resolve circuit issues and take hardware through to production.

You’ll line-manage engineers, coach their development and agree achievable commitments, matching the work to available capacity. You’ll coordinate reviews and investigations, ensure corrective actions reach closure and plan ahead for tools, licences and compute resources.

Grow your leadership across the hardware lifecycle, drawing on specialist expertise rather than becoming the technical authority for every circuit. Build a more autonomous team whose methods and shared knowledge improve how Graphcore develops its next generation of hardware.

The team and culture

You’ll connect Hardware Design with SI/PI, PCB layout, mechanical, thermal, systems and firmware engineers across locations. Programme management owns the integrated plan; you’ll flag competing priorities early and bring practical options for resolving them.

Technical owners help agree operating conditions, margins and acceptance criteria. You’ll encourage engineers to challenge assumptions, using evidence and specialist advice to resolve difficult trade-offs.

What we’re looking for

  • People leadership that develops engineers, delegates effectively and addresses difficult performance issues, with readiness for formal line management.
  • Experience coordinating engineering delivery with programme management, including estimates, work allocation, dependencies and capacity, with sound judgement under schedule pressure.
  • Communication that builds relationships across disciplines and locations, resolves competing expectations and secures decisions by explaining risks and trade-offs.
  • A strong hardware engineering background spanning circuit and schematic development, board implementation, verification and production transition. An engineering degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Understanding of power supplies, sequencing, reset, clocks, digital interfaces and SI/PI constraints, with judgement about when specialist input is needed.
  • Experience organising technical reviews, maintaining traceable design records and ensuring investigations and corrective actions reach a clear conclusion.

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.

Benefits

· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success

· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.
We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.

Sponsorship

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.

Join the Team at Graphcore

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.

title: Head of Brand/Content H/F
descriptionHtml:
Make Sense, aujourd'hui c'est +23 000 abonnés sur LinkedIn, 8 000 sur YouTube et un positionnement différenciant sur le marché des agences marketing.

L'objectif est de faire de Make Sense et de ses dirigeants une référence visible, désirable et incontournable sur le marché, en transformant l'agence en véritable « "media company" autour d'un point de vue fort et de preuves clients massives.

Le Head of Brand est l'architecte et l'orchestrateur de la brand (corporate + personal brands des founders), pas juste un "content manager". Il s'assure que chaque contenu, chaque touchpoint, chaque cas client renforce le positionnement Make Sense.

Vos missions

Mission principale

À 12 mois, construire et piloter un système de brand et de contenu qui :

- positionne Make Sense comme la référence des agences d'acquisition payante pour e-commerçants ambitieux,

- installe les dirigeants comme figures d'autorité sur le sujet,

- génère une demande inbound qualifiée et récurrente,

- crée de la préférence de marque et de la confiance avant même le premier call.

Cette mission s'inscrit dans un objectif à plus long terme (24-36 mois) : faire de Make Sense l'agence de performance marketing de référence en France.

Reporting & périmètre

Reporte à Maxence CEO / Founder.

Collabore étroitement avec : Senior Strategist, Sales, équipe externe (montage, graphisme).

Make Sense est une agence pilotée par son fondateur : Maxence reste le décisionnaire final sur les grands choix de marque et de positionnement. Le rôle du Head of Brand est de nourrir sa réflexion, de la challenger avec des arguments solides, et de transformer ses convictions en système de marque et de contenu qui tourne. Autonomie totale attendu sur l'exécution et la mise en place.

Objectifs & livrables

À 15 jours :

- Connaître sur le bout des doigts les offres de l'agence.

- Être capable de positionner Make Sense au sein de son environnement concurrentiel et de son marché.

À 1 mois :

- Une routine de contenus mise en place et qui commence à se roder.

- Une première capacité d'analyse des impacts (vues, engagement, retours) pour ajuster la stratégie.

À 3 mois :

- Une proposition structurée, construite pour atteindre les objectifs à 12 mois, avec une feuille de route priorisée et des premiers arbitrages.

- Un calendrier éditorial structuré à 90 jours, mis à jour en rolling.

À 12 mois :

- Une machine de contenu corporate + founder-led qui tourne et une cadence tenue sur l'année avec la capacité à scaler la production sans brûler les founders.

- Des process de production et de distribution documentés, et une équipe média externe qui exécute sans friction avec un Minimum Viable Squad brand/media structuré (pool de freelances ou éventuels internes) dont les rôles sont clairs.

- Une croissance claire des indicateurs brand : vues, reach qualifié, abonnés sur les bons canaux, trafic direct / branded search.

- Une croissance du volume de leads inbound qualifiés issus des contenus.

- Des feedbacks marché tangibles sur les calls de vente (« je vous suis depuis X mois », « j'ai vu telle étude de cas »).

Activités clés au quotidien

- Traduire les objectifs business en roadmap brand & contenu.

- Réaliser et faire valider les créas et contenus (idées, scripts, tournages, montages, posts).

- Travailler main dans la main avec les founders pour extraire les idées, les frameworks, les prises de position.

- Prioriser les sujets et campagnes qui créent le plus de levier business et brand.

- Suivre les chiffres brand & inbound, ajuster les stratégies et formats.

- Garantir la cohérence : chaque output doit ressembler à « Make Sense », pas à n'importe quelle agence.

Vos compétences

Profil recherché

Expérience

- 5 à 8 ans d'expérience en brand / content / media, idéalement en agence (RP, social, growth, création) plutôt qu'en grand groupe pour être à l'aise dans une structure où tout va vite et où les rôles ne sont pas cloisonnés.

- Expérience significative en BtoB, ou en environnement mixte BtoB/BtoC avec une vraie culture business.

- Idéalement, une expérience de personal branding ou d'accompagnement de dirigeants sur leur prise de parole (LinkedIn, contenu, storytelling).

- A déjà construit ou contribué à un programme de contenu structuré (pas seulement géré des réseaux sociaux au fil de l'eau).

- A déjà structuré et managé une petite équipe interne ou de freelances

Mindset

- Stratégique et tactique : voit la brand comme un levier business.

- À l'aise avec des dirigeants très visibles, capable de les challenger sans jamais lisser ou aseptiser leur discours.

- Orienté résultats.

Compétences « hard »

- Excellente compréhension du branding B2B / agence / service premium.

- Solide culture contenu (YouTube, LinkedIn, podcasts, storytelling, formats qui convertissent en confiance).

- Capacité à bâtir et piloter un système de production de contenus.

- Bon niveau en copywriting.

- Capacité à briefer et diriger des créatifs (vidéo, design, etc.).

- À l'aise avec les chiffres : sait définir et suivre les bons KPIs.

Culture fit

- Parle le langage business : comprend MRR, marge, LTV, CPA, etc.

- Communique clairement, sait dire non aux idées qui diluent la brand.

- Relie systématiquement ses choix créatifs et éditoriaux à des objectifs business (pas de contenu pour le contenu, pas de branding pour l'esthétique).

- Capable de travailler dans un environnement exigeant, avec des décisions qui se prennent vite et un fondateur impliqué.

Avantages
