title: Head of Operations
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

The Role

The Head of Operations reports to Sauraj (Co-CEO, GTM and Operations) and take ownership of operational excellence company-wide. As Finance, Legal, People, IT and InfoSec, and Compliance grow into their own functions, this person partners with each lead on the operational side of their work and holds the whole together as one system. They lead the operations team and grow it into one fit for a company many times our current size.

  • Builds the operating engine for growth and scale. Owns how the company runs operationally and designs the processes that hold up as headcount, revenue, and complexity grow fast. Everything breaks at each new stage of growth; this person sees it coming and rebuilds ahead of the curve so operations never becomes the ceiling on how fast we can move.

  • Drives operational excellence across every function. Accountable for the operational side of finance, people, legal, and the wider back office, with IT, InfoSec, and compliance covered through the relevant leads. You will set the standard and makes sure nothing important falls between functions.

  • Brings order to ambiguity. Takes the most complex, cross-functional problems and drives them to resolution bringing all the right stakeholder to the table, motivating and inspiring them to come together and deliver the project for everyone’s benefit.

  • Is a decision partner. Frames trade-offs, surfaces risk early, and turns decisions into action, so the leadership team works from reliable data and sound judgment.

  • Builds and inspires the operations team. Hires, develops, and leads an operations team people want to be part of, and sets a standard of execution that raises the bar for everyone who works with them.

Who we're looking for

Essential:

  • High-growth experience above all. Has operated inside a company through rapid scaling, seen what breaks at each stage, and built the processes and structures that scaled through it. This is the most important thing we are looking for.

  • Global operating experience. Has run operations across multiple countries and regions, comfortable holding a company together across time zones and jurisdictions, not just in a single market.

  • Broad operations ownership. Has driven operational excellence across two or more of finance, people, legal, and business operations as a senior generalist, partnering with specialist leads rather than owning their decisions.

  • A leader operators want to follow. Builds and develops strong teams and is the kind of person other excellent operators want to come and work with.

A big plus:

  • Experience in the data, developer tools, or AI market, and comfort working credibly with a technical, research-led team

  • Has built an operations function that grew with a company from startup into real scale

What makes someone thrive here:

  • Energized by building the systems that unlock the next stage of growth, not by maintaining the status quo

  • Radical ownership: runs at the most difficult problems and resolves them rather than passing them up

  • Practical and pragmatic: builds processes that scale without bloat, using as much structure as the moment needs

  • Calm and decisive under ambiguity and competing priorities, and sets that standard for the team

Location

Ideally this person will be located at one of our hubs in New York or Berlin. In exceptional circumstances, we will be able to consider remote/hybrid applications.

Life at Prior Labs

You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.

Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.

Our Commitments

The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are.

title: Head of Technical Support
descriptionHtml:
📍 London (Hybrid — 2 days onsite)

🕒 Permanent | Start ASAP

 

We’re Making Travel Effortless. Join Us.

Travel is essential, whether it’s visiting family, starting a new adventure, or taking a career defining trip. Yet today, over 4 billion airline passengers rely on tech that hasn't changed in decades.

At Duffel, we’re rebuilding the infrastructure underpinning the global travel industry. Backed by top-tier investors (Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures, and Kima Ventures) and born out of Y Combinator (S18), we’re simplifying complex systems to build the future of travel

About the role

As Head of Technical Support, you’ll lead our team of Technical Support Engineers and take responsibility for the quality, effectiveness and development of the function.

You’ll build a team that combines strong technical investigation with clear, thoughtful customer communication. You’ll coach engineers, establish effective ways of working and ensure customers receive dependable support as their integrations grow in complexity and scale.

You’ll stay close to the work: reviewing investigations, helping with significant escalations and understanding where our products or processes create friction. Your impact will come from strengthening the whole team’s ability to resolve problems and turning what we learn from support into lasting improvements.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, Partner Engineering, Partner Management and Travel Operations. Technical Support owns day-to-day API questions, troubleshooting and the customer support response to technical incidents. Partner Engineers own strategic technical relationships and solution architecture; Implementation Managers own implementation programmes.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and develop the team. Set clear expectations, provide regular coaching and feedback, support career development and address performance issues constructively. Hire and onboard engineers as the team grows.

  • Own support quality. Establish standards for technical investigation, written communication, case ownership and follow-through. Ensure customers understand what is happening, what comes next and who is responsible.

  • Build a dependable support operation. Improve triage, prioritisation, queue management, handovers and escalation paths. Plan staffing and coverage around customer needs and agreed service commitments, with a sustainable workload for the team.

  • Strengthen technical capability. Help engineers investigate API behaviour, interpret logs and request traces, reproduce integration issues and distinguish customer configuration problems from platform or supplier issues.

  • Lead significant customer escalations. Coordinate the support response, establish customer impact and keep communication clear through to resolution. Work with Engineering on diagnosis and recovery, involving Partner Engineering where an issue creates a wider strategic risk.

  • Make collaboration effective. Give Engineering actionable escalation reports with evidence, reproduction steps and impact. Work with Travel Operations on booking and supplier issues, and with implementation teams to ensure new integrations enter support with the context the team needs.

  • Improve the product through support. Identify recurring problems and turn them into clear recommendations for Product and Engineering. Track whether fixes, documentation and product changes actually reduce customer friction.

  • Make support easier to deliver. Develop troubleshooting guides, internal knowledge, customer documentation and useful tooling. Apply automation and AI where they improve accuracy, speed and access to help.

  • Use evidence to guide decisions. Monitor response and resolution performance, ageing work, reopened cases, customer feedback and team capacity. Use that information to prioritise improvements and make clear recommendations about investment.

What we’re looking for

  • Experience managing and developing a technical support or support engineering team serving business customers.

  • A track record of improving both customer outcomes and how a support function operates.

  • Strong technical understanding of APIs, HTTP, authentication, webhooks and integrations, with enough practical depth to guide investigations and earn the trust of engineers.

  • Comfort working with logs, SQL and scripts to investigate problems or improve support workflows.

  • Experience handling consequential customer escalations, including situations where the cause or resolution is initially uncertain.

  • Ability to explain technical issues to developers, business stakeholders and senior leaders.

  • Sound judgement about urgency, customer impact and competing priorities.

  • Evidence of effective hiring, coaching, performance management and delegation.

  • The ability to influence Product, Engineering and commercial teams through clear reasoning and useful evidence.

  • Comfort building and improving a function in a growing company, while remaining involved in its day-to-day work.

Experience that would be useful

  • Supporting an API platform, developer product or infrastructure business.

  • Working with enterprise customers running important production integrations.

  • Leading support across different time zones.

  • Improving support tooling, knowledge management, self-service or automation.

  • Experience in travel technology, payments or another industry with complex external dependencies.

You don’t need to have worked in travel or held this exact title. We’re interested in the teams you’ve developed, the problems you’ve solved and the judgement you bring.

What success looks like

During your first six months:

  • Engineers have clear expectations, regular coaching and practical development plans.

  • Customer issues have clear ownership, appropriate prioritisation and dependable communication.

We zijn een ambitieus team waarin we houden van hard werken, maar waar ook ruimte is voor een geintje of een goed gesprek. Tijdens jouw stage draai je volledig mee in het voorbijkomend HR werk en helpen wij je graag in het ontwikkelen van je competenties en de mogelijke schoolopdrachten. Je kunt hierbij denken aan:

  • Assisteren bij gegevensinvoer en HR assistenten taken in AFAS

  • Organiseren en bijhouden van personeelsdossier

  • Vragen van collega’s verwerken

  • Ondersteunen bij het organiseren van de onboardingdag

  • Meelopen met HR-professionals

  • Ondersteunen bij diverse HR projecten

Wie zijn wij?

Wij zijn Priva! Priva is een familiebedrijf, gevestigd in het Westland. Het is de missie van Priva om een ​​optimale omgeving te creëren waarin zowel planten als mensen kunnen werken, groeien en zich ontwikkelen. Wij bieden wereldwijde oplossingen voor de tuinbouw, gebouwautomatisering en alles daartussenin. Wij zijn toonaangevend in de ontwikkeling en productie van technologie voor het optimaliseren van omgevingsomstandigheden en processen.

Onze ambitie is om bekend te staan ​​als de toonaangevende technologie- en dienstverlener voor duurzame stedelijke delta's. We zijn er trots op dat onze oplossingen resulteren in een lager verbruik van natuurlijke hulpbronnen, zoals energie en water. Om onze missie en ambitie waar te maken, zijn we op zoek naar toegewijde collega's. We zijn er trots op dat we met ruim 500 collega's, in 16 internationale vestigingen verdeeld over 12 landen samen met meer dan 400 internationale installatiepartners werken aan het leveren van onze duurzame oplossingen en diensten in meer dan 100 landen.


Wie ben jij?

Wij zijn opzoek naar een enthousiaste derde- of vierdejaars stagiair die graag ervaring op wilt doen in HR. Bij voorkeur volg je de HBO-opleiding Human Resource Management, maar ook studenten van andere opleidingen waarbij HR een onderdeel is zijn welkom. Je bent proactief, nauwkeurig, communicatief vaardig en betrokken bij het team en je collega’s binnen Priva. Ook vind je het geen probleem om met internationale collega’s in het Engels te communiceren zowel schriftelijk als mondeling. Voor deze stage verwachten we dat je 24 tot 40 uur per week beschikbaar bent.

Wat je krijgt

title: IAM Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
As an IAM Software Engineer, you’ll focus on Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions. Your work combines technical analysis, platform configuration, low-code implementation, integration, testing, and troubleshooting, with custom coding where needed. You’ll work closely with engineers, architects, consultants, and customer teams to deliver secure, reliable solutions. 

You’ll join an engineering delivery team of around 8–12 people, working across customer assignments in two-week sprints, often with a specific sprint focus. Our ‘you build it, you run it’ approach combines implementation, ongoing improvement, and troubleshooting after delivery, supported by senior engineers in your own and neighbouring teams doing similar work. 

What you’ll do as an IAM Software Engineer 

  • Design and deliver IGA solutions that help customers govern access, using standard platform capabilities, low-code tools, and integration standards, with C#, SQL, and APIs where needed. 
  • Translate customer needs into technical designs and engineering tasks, working with architects, security engineers, and customer stakeholders to meet security, compliance, scalability, and maintainability requirements. 
  • Troubleshoot complex IAM issues, identify root causes, and implement lasting improvements that reduce recurrence and security risk. 
  • Improve automation and delivery practices, using PowerShell and CI/CD where appropriate to make implementation and ongoing changes more reliable. 
  • Share knowledge and support junior engineers through mentoring, design sessions, and reviews of configurations, integrations, and code. 

The impact you’ll have 

Your engineering work will help leading organizations manage access confidently, protect sensitive data, and comply with evolving regulations. By building reliable IAM solutions and improving delivery practices, you’ll contribute to technical strategy and help the team deliver more effectively—strengthening client security and trust in the digital landscape. 

What we can offer you 

Autonomy in your work and support for your career development. 

  • Permanent, full-time contract (40 hours per week) 
  • Flexible, hybrid working: typically two days per week on location—one at a client site and one at our Waardenburg office. 
  • Work outside normal hours is rare (currently fewer than five occasions per year) and always discussed in advance. 
  • Typically, 5–15 learning days per year for your development, including certifications and events. Training and associated costs are agreed individually rather than through a fixed training budget. 
  • 30 days of annual leave: 25 flexible days and 5 fixed company days. 
  • Variable team bonus and annual profit distribution 
  • Mobility budget or company lease car 
  • Private pension scheme 
  • Home office setup budget and monthly remote work allowance 
  • Regular team and company social events 

What you’ll bring to the team 

Core experience and skills 

  • 3–6 years in software or platform engineering, including at least one year designing and implementing IGA solutions such as Omada Identity or Microsoft Entra ID Governance. 
  • Experience in solution design, configuration, API integration, testing, and deployment, using Git and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps). 
  • Practical C# and SQL experience to troubleshoot and extend IAM solutions where needed. 
  • Strong analytical, design, and problem-solving skills, with a deep understanding of software security and the ability to turn security and compliance requirements into practical solutions. 
  • A relevant bachelor’s degree (e.g., computer science or information security), or equivalent experience. 

How you work 

  • Strong collaboration, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with a structured, proactive approach and the ability to drive work independently. 

Practical requirements 

  • English at C1 and Dutch at B2 or higher, written and spoken. 
  • Client-site travel is within the Netherlands, with current major clients in the Randstad. You’re able and willing to travel to those sites and our Waardenburg office; no driver’s license is required. 
  • Currently residing in the Netherlands and eligible to work here. 

Nice to have 

  • Azure experience. 
  • AI-assisted tools for analysis, configuration, testing, documentation, or coding. 
  • Relevant certifications, e.g., Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Omada Certified Engineer, or CISSP. 

About SITS | Traxion 

SITS | Traxion specializes in Identity & Access Management, with 24 years of consulting experience and a team of 120 specialists. We work with organizations across sectors, including Schiphol Group, dsm-firmenich, Gemeente Rotterdam, Belastingdienst, E.ON, and Ayvens. 

As part of the European IT security group SITS, we combine international collaboration with a flat organizational structure and a respectful, collaborative culture.

title: Ingénieur(e) développement logiciel - Backend  - Sécurité - Login (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Ingénieur(e) développement logiciel - Backend  - Sécurité - Login (f/m/d)      

L’équipe Login est le pilier de l’écosystème Decathlon. Composée de profils passionnés et multiculturels, notre équipe d'une dizaine de personnes construit une solution d’authentification sécurisée et haute performance pour plus de 80 pays. Notre ambition ? Offrir une expérience membre fluide via un point d’entrée unique et hautement sécurisé. Notre défi actuel est de taille : mener une migration d'architecture d'envergure internationale depuis notre système Spring Security 5 vers Spring Security 7. Rejoins une équipe de passionné·es au cœur des enjeux globaux de Decathlon !TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

La mission principale est d’accompagner la création de nouvelles fonctionnalités et l’amélioration de l’application, le tout tournant autour d’une organisation s’appuyant sur un écosystème agile afin de délivrer rapidement et fréquemment le plus de valeur possible à nos produits.

Contexte DevSecOps : you build it, you run it, you enjoy it !

  • Security by Design

Standard OAuth 2.1 / OIDC : Contribuer à l'implémentation de ces protocoles pour garantir des accès sécurisés à nos services.

Sécurisation du Code : Appliquer les principes de sécurité dès la conception (OWASP, protection contre les injections, gestion sécurisée du cycle de vie des sessions).

Veille Sécurité : Identifier et corriger proactivement les failles potentielles au sein de l'écosystème Java/Spring.

Administration Cloudflare : Gérer, configurer et optimiser notre infrastructure Cloudflare (WAF, protection DDoS, DNS, CDN, Gestion des Bots). 

Audit et Monitoring : Mettre en place la surveillance des menaces, analyser les logs de sécurité et réagir aux incidents (SOC/SIEM).

  • Développement & Delivery

Production : Assurer le delivery sur les briques core du CIAM (moteurs d'authentification, gestion des jetons, intégrations protocolaires).

Patterns Avancés : Implémenter des solutions résilientes basées sur Kafka (Patterns CDC & Outbox) pour garantir la cohérence des données sans compromettre la performance.

Qualité Intégrée : Garantir la stabilité via des tests automatisés rigoureux (Playwright, Gatling) dès la phase de développement.

  •  Pilotage par la Donnée : Tracking & A/B Testing

Expérimentation : Mettre en œuvre des stratégies d'A/B testing via Statsig pour valider les évolutions du tunnel d'authentification de manière granulaire.

Tracking Comportemental : Intégrer et maintenir un tracking précis via Amplitude pour analyser les parcours utilisateurs et identifier les points de friction.

Performance Produit : Collaborer avec les équipes Produit pour traduire les besoins business en implémentations techniques mesurables et scalables.

  • Architecture, Scale & Observabilité

Conception Système : Modéliser les flux complexes via le C4 Model pour assurer une vision claire des interactions entre services.

Infrastructure & Ops : Déployer et opérer tes services sur Kubernetes (Helm), avec une maîtrise totale de l'observabilité via Datadog.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • +7 ans en Java dans des environnements distribués à fort trafic.
  • Compétence sécurité : 
    • Standard OAuth 2.1 / OIDC
    • Expérience sur Keycloak ou équivalent
    • Sécurisation du Code (OWASP, injections, sessions sécurisées)
  • Spring & Spring Security : Connaissance des mécanismes internes (Filters, Authentication Providers, etc.).
  • Event-Driven Architecture : Expérience sur Kafka, CDC et utilisation du pattern Outbox.
  • Data & Growth : Expérience sur des outils de tracking (Amplitude) et de Feature Flagging / A/B testing (Statsig).
  • Cloud & Tools : Kubernetes, Helm, Datadog.
  • Testing : Playwright (E2E) et Gatling/Blazemeter (Load testing).
  • Langue : Anglais technique (documentation impérative).

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

Organisation de travail hybride ;

Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;

Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;

Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;

Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

title: Internship - Programming & Automation
descriptionHtml:
WE CANNOT PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP

Details

Preferred starting date: ASAP

Weekly availability: Full-time (5 days/week)

Period: 6 months

Location: Aerospace Innovation Hub, Delft, the Netherlands

About the company

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced onboard UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers who are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members come from different backgrounds such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics, and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub on the TU Delft campus in the Faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low-TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.

The project

Sensor calibration is a manual job today, and it does not scale to the number of sensor units we intend to ship. We are building automated test and calibration infrastructure to fix that, starting with a cell built around a UFactory UF850 robotic arm on a linear rail.

We already have the arm and the calibration software. What we do not have is the physical cell around it, or the software that drives it. This first project is split into two internships that run side by side:

• Robot programming and automation — this position

• Mechanical design and integration — separate posting

The two interns will work closely together. Neither half of this project is any good on its own. This calibration cell is the first thing we are building on this front, not the last, so there is a good chance the right person carries on to other robotics and automation projects once it is running.

Your role

If you are the kind of person who is not satisfied until an automated system actually works reliably, not just once, this internship is designed for you.

We are looking for a Robot Programming & Automation Intern to help build the software behind our robotic test and automation infrastructure. Your first project is turning a robotic arm on a linear rail into a system that reliably captures good calibration data — but the skills involved are the same ones we’ll lean on for whatever we automate next: getting a robot to move well, knowing whether the data it’s collecting is any good, and building something solid enough to run unattended.

Getting that right is the substance of this internship, on this project and on whatever comes after it.

What you’ll do

• Build the robot control layer: drive the arm through its SDK, coordinate the linear rail, and plan safe motion inside a cell that also has a target, cables, and an operator in it.

• Design pose generation that’s actually informed by the calibration problem, including getting proper coverage across a multi-camera rig rather than just one lens at a time.

• Get the timing and synchronisation right between the robot, the cameras, and the captured data — this is where automated rigs usually go wrong.

• Gate data quality at capture time, and retry within the run rather than finding out later that a dataset is unusable.

• Close the loop with our existing calibration pipeline: feed it data, read back its results, and use that to decide what to capture next and when a run is done.

• Package captures with the metadata needed to make a calibration reproducible, and make the whole thing robust to failures mid-run.

• Build a simple operator-facing workflow: mount the rig, pick a profile, press go.

• Work closely with the mechanical intern — your requirements shape their fixture design, and their measurements shape your motion limits.

Who you are

• You are enrolled in a relevant study program (Robotics, Computer Science, Computational Science and Engineering, Mechatronics, Aerospace, Electrical Engineering, or similar).

• You are strong in Python. C++ is a plus.

• You are comfortable with 3D geometry: rigid transforms, rotation representations, coordinate frames, and keeping your conventions straight when it is 6pm and nothing lines up.

• You are interested in robot programming specifically — motion, reachability, collisions, repeatability — and not only in the vision maths around it.

• You understand enough about how camera calibration works to reason about what makes a dataset good or useless. You do not need to be able to write the solver.

• You have worked with real sensors and real robots, and you have learned that they lie about timing.

• You care about reliability. An automated process that works four times out of five is not automated.

• You write code that another engineer can pick up and extend.

• You are comfortable taking responsibility for software that moves physical hardware.

• You are independent, curious, organized, and resourceful.

• Linux does not scare you, and neither does a robot that moves the moment your code says move.

We care much more about what you have built and made work than about grades.

Nice to have

These are strong pluses, but not strict requirements:

• ROS 2, MoveIt 2, tf2, and motion planning in practice

• Experience with industrial or collaborative arm SDKs (UFactory / xArm, UR, Franka), or motion control more generally

• Hands-on camera calibration experience: OpenCV, Kalibr, ChArUco or AprilTag targets, hand-eye calibration

• Multi-camera rigs, and the specific pain of calibrating cameras with little or no overlapping field of view

• Machine vision cameras: triggering and synchronisation, GenICam, exposure control, rolling versus global shutter

• Coverage or observability reasoning: understanding why some poses inform a parameter and others do not

• Simulation environments (Gazebo, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo)

• Docker, CI, and the habit of writing tests before you need them

• Experience turning a research script into something an operator can actually use

Please include

When applying, please include links, repositories, or writeups that show us you build things that work. For example:

• GitHub repositories, with a note on which parts you actually wrote

• robot arm or robot motion projects

• camera calibration, multi-view geometry, SLAM, or structure-from-motion work

• data capture pipelines, test automation, or anything that had to run unattended

• computer vision projects

• simulation work

• a short writeup of something that broke and how you found the cause

• anything that demonstrates hands-on technical ownership

If you have ever chased a calibration error you couldn’t explain, eventually traced it to a timestamp, and fixed it properly, you’ll probably fit right in.

Requirements

• Enrolled in a relevant study program (Robotics, Computer Science, CSE, Mechatronics, Aerospace, Electrical Engineering, or similar)

• Strong programming skills, Python at minimum

• Comfortable working in Linux

• Strong interest in robotics, automation, computer vision, or perception

• English proficiency

• Organized and proactive working style

What we offer

• 1000 euro monthly compensation

• 10 vacation days during the internship period

• Flexible working hours and the option to work from home 2 days per week where practical

• A direct and significant influence on highly innovative products

• The opportunity to work close to the hardware and the product, with fast iteration and tight feedback loops

• Full ownership of a self-contained system that the rest of the company will depend on

• A team environment where practical experimentation, learning, and ownership are expected

The application procedure

• If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us some information about yourself. This can be a resume, website, portfolio, or any other source that gives us a clear impression of your background, technical skills, and hands-on experience.

• We will get back to you ASAP. If we think you could be a fit for the position, we will invite you for an informal introduction so we can get to know you, and equally important, you can get to know us. After this, a more technically focused interview may follow.

• If at that point we believe you are the person we are looking for, we will discuss the specifics such as starting date and internship period.

Welcome to the team!

title: IT Ops
descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

As Dust's first full time IT Ops hire in Paris, you'll own the infrastructure that keeps a fast-growing team running: from devices and access management to the systems and security practices that scale with us. This is a foundational role at a company where AI is woven into every workflow, giving you a front-row seat to how the future of work is actually being built. You'll work directly with the team and have real impact from day one.

What you'll do

Own Device & Endpoint Management

  • Provision, configure, and manage all employee hardware (Mac and Linux) across the Paris team

  • Maintain MDM tooling and ensure all devices meet security and compliance standards

  • Build and document onboarding/offboarding hardware workflows

Manage Identity & Access

  • Own IAM across SSO, Google Workspace, and third-party SaaS tools

  • Ensure access controls are current, auditable, and correctly scoped

  • Partner with the team to implement least-privilege access policies

Keep the Office Running

  • Manage AV, networking, and physical infrastructure at the Paris office

  • Be the first point of contact for IT issues — resolving quickly and building self-serve resources to reduce recurring requests

  • Coordinate with vendors and manage hardware inventory

Drive Security & Compliance

  • Support internal security reviews, audits, and compliance initiatives

  • Identify risks proactively and propose practical mitigations

  • Maintain IT documentation that stays accurate and useful

Build IT Systems That Scale

  • Automate repetitive processes and reduce manual IT overhead

  • Evaluate and implement new tools as the team grows

  • Contribute to IT roadmap planning alongside the Ops and Engineering teams

Requirements

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions. Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

Aptitude

  • Hands-on experience managing macOS and Linux endpoints in a SaaS or tech environment

  • Strong working knowledge of MDM solutions (Jamf, Kandji, or equivalent), SSO, and identity management platforms

  • Solid understanding of network fundamentals: routing, VPNs, DNS, and office connectivity

  • Comfortable working in security-conscious environments with an understanding of access control best practices

  • Able to document systems and processes clearly enough that others can operate them independently

Attitude

  • Shows up as a team multiplier — resolves issues without drama and leaves things better than they found them

  • Communicates proactively: flags problems early and follows through without needing to be chased

  • Takes user experience seriously — treats every colleague as a customer of IT

  • Gives and receives direct feedback without friction

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where the priorities can shift

Agency

  • Proactively identifies IT risks and improvements before they become problems

  • Owns issues end-to-end: from diagnosis through resolution, without dropping the thread

  • Builds processes and automation that reduce recurring manual work for the team

  • Makes reasonable calls under ambiguity rather than escalating everything upward

  • Continuously looks for ways to use AI tools to improve how IT operations run at Dust

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

title: IT Support Specialist L2 (f/m/x)
descriptionHtml:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

Are you ready for solutions that are more than just a promise and bring real quality of life to thousands of households every day? What you create at Enpal will deliver clean electricity tomorrow and bring about lasting change in how we use energy.

 

We are looking for a hands-on IT Support Specialist to join our IT team in Berlin.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, takes ownership of their work, and thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly.

You will be responsible for providing reliable IT support, managing incidents and service requests, supporting device lifecycle operations, and ensuring a smooth employee experience.

 

We are looking for someone who can work independently, communicate confidently with stakeholders, and balance urgent requests with structured service delivery.

 

What you'll do:

  • Own and resolve L1/L2 technical support requests end-to-end, ensuring timely resolution and adherence to SLAs.

  • Provide hands-on walk-in and remote IT support across multiple locations.

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, connectivity and application issues across Windows, MacOS, iOS and Android devices.

  • Manage, prioritize and document tickets in Jira Service Management or similar ITSM platforms.

  • Investigate recurring incidents, identify potential root causes and collaborate with relevant teams on resolution.

  • Escalate complex issues appropriately while maintaining ownership and tracking progress.

  • Manage competing priorities in a high-volume support environment while maintaining service quality.

  • Configure, deploy and maintain laptops, mobile devices and peripherals using Microsoft Intune and other endpoint management tools.

  • Maintain accurate IT asset records, including device assignments, returns, replacements and inventory.

  • Support hardware lifecycle activities, including provisioning, repairs and secure disposal, in line with IT security policies.

  • Support employee onboarding and offboarding, including device preparation, access provisioning, equipment handovers and returns.

  • Assist with large onboarding waves, ensuring timely preparation, tracking and delivery of devices.

  • Troubleshoot Microsoft Teams Rooms, conferencing equipment and related AV systems.

  • Provide technical support for Microsoft 365, Teams and other workplace collaboration tools.

  • Identify opportunities to improve support processes, reduce recurring issues and enhance the employee experience.

  • Create and maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting guides and knowledge base articles.

  • Collaborate with distributed IT teams to ensure consistent service delivery across locations.

  • Communicate proactively with employees and stakeholders, setting realistic expectations and providing timely updates.

  • Follow established IT processes, security standards and escalation procedures.

 

What you'll bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on IT support experience in a corporate or enterprise environment.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows and macOS environments.

  • Practical experience supporting Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and enterprise applications.

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Intune or similar endpoint management tools.

  • Experience with ITSM platforms such as Jira Service Management.

  • Understanding of ITIL principles, incident management, request fulfilment and SLA-driven support.

  • Experience with hardware provisioning, device troubleshooting and IT asset management.

  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks and manage competing requests.

  • Strong communication and customer service skills, including handling challenging situations professionally.

  • A proactive, accountable and solution-oriented approach.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting large-scale onboarding and offboarding operations.

  • Familiarity with Snipe-IT or similar IT asset management systems.

  • Experience troubleshooting Microsoft Teams Rooms and audiovisual equipment.

  • Basic networking knowledge, including VPN, DNS, DHCP and connectivity troubleshooting.

  • Basic scripting knowledge using PowerShell or Bash.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Defender and endpoint security concepts.

  • Experience working with distributed or international IT teams.

  • Awareness of ISO 27001, GDPR and IT security best practices.

     

Are you interested even if you don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential—regardless of whether your experience meets every single requirement. ☀️

 

What we offer:

  • Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition.

  • The sun shines all over the world - At Enpal, you'll work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities.

  • The ideal setup for your focus - We are convinced that excellent results are achieved when the conditions are right. That's why we rely on a hybrid working concept that gives you the freedom to always work in the way that best suits your tasks. Do you need new inspiration on an international level? With Workflex, we offer you the opportunity to relocate abroad for up to 30 days a year, depending on your responsibilities.

  • Grown-up business & startup spirit - In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain, you'll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and table tennis to stocked beverage fridges and barista coffee.

  • Your kick-start at Enpal - Onboarding day with a welcome bag, buddy program, and a team that really supports you.

  • Stay up to date & help shape the future - Transparent all-hands meetings, short decision-making processes, and an open feedback culture - without mistakes, there is no progress.

  • The energy transition can only be achieved together - At Enpal, you can expect legendary team spirit and unforgettable team events.

  • Your extra boost - 29 vacation days + one additional day off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve, discounted membership at Wellhub, and corporate benefits. Everything you need to help you achieve a good work-life balance.

  • Investing in your future – We don’t just think sustainably when it comes to energy, but also when it comes to you. Take advantage of our company pension scheme to build a solid foundation for your future, step by step.

  • Make your home smart – Sustainability starts at your doorstep. As part of our team, you’ll benefit from a permanent 25% discount on the entire Bosch Smart Home product range – for an even more efficient and connected home.

     

At Enpal, we are proud of the diversity of our team. No decisions are made on the basis of skin colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age, either during recruitment or employment. Dragon & Gries ist Deutschlands größte Personalberatung im Bereich Konzernsteuern. Wir bringen Steuerexpert/innen und Führungskräfte aus den Bereichen Steuern, Zoll und Payroll mit attraktiven Arbeitgebern aus Industrie und Beratung zusammen. Unsere Mandanten unterstützen wir bei der gezielten Identifikation, Ansprache und Gewinnung hoch qualifizierter Fach- und Führungskräfte – mit dem Ziel, Kandidaten und Unternehmen langfristig erfolgreich zusammenzubringen.

Deine Aufgaben im Innendienst

Du unterstützt unser Team am Standort Aachen aktiv bei der Kandidatenansprache, der Neukundengewinnung und der Bearbeitung laufender Rekrutierungsprojekte.

  • Du übernimmst die telefonische Erstansprache von Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten aus dem Steuerrecht.

  • Du sprichst gezielt Unternehmen an, die aktuell Mitarbeitende im Steuerbereich suchen, und stellst den Kontakt zu potenziellen Neukunden her.

  • Du unterstützt unsere Personalberaterinnen und Personalberater bei der Bearbeitung laufender Rekrutierungsprojekte.

  • Du pflegst Kandidaten- und Unternehmensdaten in unseren Systemen und hältst Informationen auf dem aktuellen Stand.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Beratungsteam zusammen und unterstützt dabei, passende Kandidaten und Unternehmen zusammenzubringen.

Das bringst du mit

Für diese Position im Umfang von 40 Stunden pro Woche suchen wir eine kommunikative und engagierte Persönlichkeit, die gerne mit Menschen arbeitet und Spaß an vertrieblichen Aufgaben hat. Auch wenn du nicht jede einzelne Anforderung erfüllst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

  • Du telefonierst gerne und gehst offen auf neue Menschen zu.

  • Du hast Interesse an Recruiting, Personalberatung und Vertrieb.

  • Du arbeitest dich gerne in neue Themen und insbesondere in den Bereich Steuerrecht ein (Vorkenntnisse nicht erforderlich).

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch im Kontakt mit Kandidaten und Unternehmen.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und gerne im Team.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Wir bieten dir ein unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis in einem wachsenden Team mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice inklusive entsprechender Ausstattung. Du erhältst eine intensive Einarbeitung und arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Personalberaterinnen und Personalberatern zusammen.

Für deine tägliche Arbeit stellen wir dir Firmenhandy und Firmenlaptop zur Verfügung. Kostenlose Parkplätze, regelmäßige Teamevents und Firmenfeiern sowie kostenlose Getränke und Snacks gehören bei uns ebenfalls dazu. Darüber hinaus bieten wir 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr, Angebote zur beruflichen Weiterbildung sowie verschiedene zusätzliche Benefits. Auch Haustiere sind bei uns im Büro willkommen.

Deine ersten Monate bei Dragon & Gries

In den ersten Wochen lernst du unser Team, unsere Arbeitsweise und den Markt für Steuerexpert/innen kennen. Du wirst Schritt für Schritt in die Kandidatenrecherche, die telefonische Ansprache und unsere Vertriebsprozesse eingearbeitet.

Nach kurzer Zeit übernimmst du erste eigene Kandidatenkontakte und unterstützt unsere Personalberater bei konkreten Suchmandaten. Mit zunehmender Erfahrung sprichst du außerdem gezielt Unternehmen an, die im Steuerbereich neue Mitarbeitende suchen, und übernimmst mehr Verantwortung im Recruiting- und Vertriebsprozess.

Deine Perspektive bei Dragon & Gries

Wenn du dich fachlich und vertrieblich weiterentwickeln möchtest, bieten wir dir die Möglichkeit, perspektivisch als Personalberater/in eigene Rekrutierungsmandate und Kunden zu betreuen. title: Lead AI Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Worum es geht

MAIA ist eine KI-Plattform für Unternehmen. Mit MAIA durchsuchen Teams ihre internen Daten und verankern Agenten tief in ihren Prozessen. Wir begleiten Unternehmen dabei, KI nicht nur in einzelnen Abteilungen, sondern im ganzen Unternehmen einzusetzen.

Technisch heißt das: Wir bauen eine GenAI-Anwendung mit eigenen Agentensystemen, RAG-Pipelines und agentenbasierten Workflows, binden externe Systeme unserer Kunden an und analysieren ihre Daten. Wir nutzen die besten verfügbaren Modelle, betrieben in der EU, und machen sie verlässlich für anspruchsvolle Arbeit mit großen, komplexen Datenmengen.

Zahlreiche Industrieunternehmen arbeiten seit Jahren intensiv mit MAIA. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Finanzierungsrunde 2026 bringen wir MAIA jetzt in die Breite. Entwickelt wird MAIA seit 2021 in Leipzig.

Was du bei uns machst

Als Lead AI Engineer führst du unser Engineering-Team in Leipzig, entwickelst rund drei Viertel deiner Zeit selbst mit und arbeitest eng mit unserem CTO zusammen.

Deine Schwerpunkte:

  • Selbst entwickeln. Du übernimmst anspruchsvolle Features und Architekturthemen in unseren Agenten-, RAG- und Workflow-Systemen und schreibst Pläne, an denen sich andere orientieren.

  • Technische Richtung. Du triffst wichtige Designentscheidungen mit, priorisierst gemeinsam mit dem CTO die technische Roadmap und treibst die technische Vision von MAIA voran.

  • Das Team anführen. Du koordinierst die Arbeit im Team und bist Sparringspartner für alle Engineers, in Designdiskussionen, Reviews und Feedback. Du führst technische Interviews und entscheidest mit, wen wir einstellen.

  • Besser werden, gemeinsam. Mit dem Team verbesserst du laufend, wie wir entwickeln, gerade im agentischen Arbeiten: von Plänen und Reviews über Evals bis zu Releases.

  • Am Puls der Technik. Du verfolgst neue Entwicklungen bei LLMs, Retrieval, Agenten und darüber hinaus, bewertest sie nüchtern und bringst ins Produkt, was trägt.

Was wir suchen

  • Ein herausragender AI Engineer. Du hast LLM-Systeme gebaut und in Produktion betrieben. RAG, Embeddings, Vektorsuche, Tool Calling und Agenten kennst du aus der Praxis, auch die Stellen, an denen sie scheitern. Neue Modelle und Techniken probierst du aus eigenem Antrieb aus und trennst dabei Substanz von Hype.

  • Starke Architektur. Du hast Backend-Systeme gebaut, ausgeliefert und über längere Zeit in Produktion betrieben. Du triffst Designentscheidungen, die auch in einem Jahr noch tragen, und erkennst schwache Architektur auch dann, wenn ein Coding Agent sie geschrieben hat.

  • Sehr gut in mindestens einer unserer Sprachen. TypeScript, Python oder Go, am besten eine der statisch typisierten. Alle drei musst du nicht mitbringen. In die anderen arbeitest du dich ein.

  • Technische Führung. Du hast ein Team als Tech Lead, Lead Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle fachlich geführt. Wie die Rolle hieß, ist zweitrangig. Du gibst Verantwortung ab und freust dich, wenn das Team ohne dich gute Entscheidungen trifft. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du gern selbst weiter, denn diese Rolle ist keine reine Managementrolle.

  • Messen statt vermuten. Du weißt, wie man Systeme testet und evaluiert, die auf dieselbe Frage nicht immer gleich antworten. Du baust die einfachste Lösung, die das Problem löst. Weitere Retrieval-Stufen, Prompt-Ketten oder Abstraktionen kommen erst dazu, wenn Messungen sie rechtfertigen.

  • Agentisch arbeiten. Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Alltag. Du hast eine klare Meinung dazu, wie ein Team mit ihnen schnell bleibt, ohne an Qualität zu verlieren.

  • Sicherheit mitdenken. Unsere Kunden vertrauen uns ihr internes Wissen an. Mandantentrennung, Zugriffsrechte und sichere Entwicklung sind für dich selbstverständlich.

  • Klar kommunizieren. Du sprichst Probleme früh an, argumentierst mit Belegen und erklärst technische Entscheidungen verständlich, im Team ebenso wie gegenüber Produktmanagement, Customer Success und Vertrieb. Du sprichst sehr sicher Deutsch und ebenso Englisch.

Arbeiten bei MAIA

Uns verbindet ein gemeinsames Ziel: ein richtig gutes Produkt zu bauen. Jede und jeder übernimmt Verantwortung für das eigene Thema. Wir haben Spaß an der Arbeit und sind stolz auf das, was unsere Kunden mit MAIA erreichen. Die Wege sind kurz, und Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Im Engineering-Team hinterfragen wir kritisch, wie wir entwickeln, und verbessern unsere Prozesse laufend, gerade in der agentischen Entwicklung.

Wir arbeiten gern zusammen in unserem Büro, zentral zwischen Innenstadt und Zoo, und kochen fast jeden Tag gemeinsam. An mindestens drei Tagen pro Woche sind wir vor Ort, an den übrigen arbeitest du, wo du möchtest. Wann dein Tag beginnt, legst du selbst fest.

  • Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen und Coding Agents

  • Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, auch zu Führungsthemen

  • Zugang zu einer Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft

Vergütung

Das Jahresbruttogehalt liegt bei 90.000 bis 100.000 €. Wo du in dieser Spanne liegst, besprechen wir spätestens nach dem Interview zu Technik und Führung. Dazu kommt eine virtuelle Beteiligung über unser VSOP.

Bewerbung und nächste Schritte

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte uns in ein paar eigenen Sätzen eine Frage: Warum willst du MAIA mitgestalten?

Wir arbeiten jeden Tag mit KI. Für diese Antwort zählt aber deine eigene Perspektive. Schreib sie deshalb bitte selbst, gern kurz und ohne Feinschliff.

Passt es, folgen ein 30-minütiges Kennenlernen, ein 90-minütiges Interview zu Technik und Führung und ein Abschlussgespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Nach jedem Schritt hörst du in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Werktagen von uns. Unser Ziel ist eine Entscheidung in rund drei Wochen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Learning Design & Training Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Location: Bracknell, UK (hybrid, 2 days per week in office) | Type: Full-time, 37.5 hour

Reports to: Head of Portfolio

The role in brief

Most learning designers build courses. In this role, you will own them.

As our Instructional Design & Training Products Manager, you will take a portfolio of professional training products from first idea to finished, quality-assured release, and keep them at their best for as long as they are in use. The training you build is used by aviation (civil and defence) professionals whose decisions keep people safe, so getting it right matters.

You will work alongside some of the most respected subject matter experts in aviation safety, helping them turn deep technical knowledge into learning that is clear, engaging and works in the classroom, online and in blended formats. You will have real influence over how we design, develop and quality-assure our training, including how we use AI to do it better.

If you have a background in learning design or training product development, a sharp eye for quality, and want to see your work make a visible difference, we would like to hear from you.

Why this role matters

This role owns the full lifecycle of a defined segment of our training and consulting portfolio. You will be the bridge between our subject matter experts and the wider business – sales, marketing and delivery – making sure every product is high-quality, ISO-compliant and commercially sound.

Just as importantly, you will help make our portfolio more scalable, so that great products no longer depend on SMEs doing all of the development themselves.

What you will do

  • Own the product lifecycle: take a defined set of training and consulting products through design, development, QA, release and maintenance, delivering against timelines, budgets, quality standards and commercial goals.

  • Identify learning needs: use training needs and gap analysis, customer insight and delivery feedback to shape new products and refresh and improve existing ones.

  • Lead learning design with SMEs: turn expert knowledge into clear learning objectives, specifications, storyboards and design documentation.

  • Shape new products: work with Business Development and SMEs to define market needs, build the case for new products and position them for sale.

  • Create high-quality materials: presentations, workbooks, facilitator guides, lesson plans, marketing collateral and digital content.

  • Champion quality: run QA, proofreading, brand, IP and publication checks before anything is released.

  • Keep products current: manage version control, maintenance cycles and product KPIs.

  • Improve the learner experience: raise the standard of design and usability across classroom, virtual and blended formats.

  • Work smarter with AI: use AI tools to speed up development and reduce SME drafting time.


What you will bring

  • At least 2 years’ experience in training product development, instructional or learning design, or L&D content development.

  • A track record of designing professional training materials for classroom, virtual or blended delivery.

  • A solid grounding in learning design principles (for example ADDIE) and in training needs and gap analysis.

  • A strong eye for quality and detail – you notice what others miss, from a weak learning objective to an inconsistent heading.

  • Strong project management skills, and the ability to juggle several products, deadlines and stakeholders at once.

  • Confidence working with subject matter experts: asking the right questions, challenging constructively, and turning expertise into effective learning.

  • Advanced skills in PowerPoint, Word, Excel and Adobe Acrobat.

  • Excellent written English, to publication standard.

Nice to have

  • Experience in aviation, defence or another safety-critical or regulated industry.

  • E-learning or blended learning development experience.

  • A recognised L&D or instructional design qualification.

  • An understanding of IP and contract frameworks.

  • Experience using AI in content development.

What success looks like

  • 90% or more of product milestones delivered on time.

  • 100% of releases meet QA, brand and IP standards.

  • A 40% reduction in SME effort on repeatable development tasks.

  • Fewer maintenance requests and releases each year.

  • AI used effectively across the development process.

  • Positive feedback from stakeholders and learners on usability and quality.

Join Baines Simmons

Baines Simmons builds the competence behind aerospace and defence safety. For 25 years we have delivered expert, approachable training and consulting to civil and military aviation organisations worldwide: more than 750 organisations served, over 200,000 professionals trained, and 40 or more regulatory authorities advised.

We work as one with our clients, sharing serious know-how, rigour and expertise. Across every sector, and alongside global regulators, we help organisations continuously improve safety, airworthiness and compliance. We go beyond helping them comply with regulations; we empower them to excel in operational and safety performance.

We look for curiosity, passion, leadership and impact. Our people do not just advise on safety. They change how clients manage it. If you want your work to make a measurable difference to aviation safety, we would like to hear from you.

One organisation, four brands

Baines Simmons is one of four TrustFlight brands. TrustFlight is the Aerospace Safety Intelligence Platform, building the technology that helps aviation operate safely and stay compliant. Redline Assured Security delivers government-standard aviation security, and Kenyon International delivers crisis management and response. Each brand keeps its own name, heritage and team. Together we share one platform, one set of values and one purpose: closing the gaps between disconnected tools and providers, because those gaps are where risk accumulates. Working at Baines Simmons means your expertise connects to all four.

Why people stay

We believe people do their best work when they have the freedom to do their job without too many rules and barriers getting in the way. Our culture is built on empowerment and trust: we hire good people and expect them to make the right calls for the customer, company, and themselves. Transforming an industry means our people have to keep learning. We earn our clients' confidence by being honest and dependable with each other, and that includes caring about the important things in life outside of work.

Our offices in the UK, Canada, the US and Jersey are where teams meet to collaborate and plan. People who deliver earn more say in how their career develops, from the path they take to the flexibility they need.

If you want to make a real difference to safety, this is the place to be.

How we work with AI

TrustFlight is an AI-first organisation, and we provide AI training where it is appropriate for your role. In this role that means using AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Copilot and Gamma) to draft and structure content, accelerate documentation and reports, and support knowledge management, while critically reviewing and refining every AI-generated output for accuracy, clarity and professional quality. You will design and apply AI-enabled workflows that make product development faster and more consistent, look for new places to integrate AI into our processes, and share what works with the team. You will complete our AI fluency onboarding within your first 30 days and spend four hours a month experimenting with AI tools and building your skills.

Where and how you will work

  • Working hours: 37.5 hours per week, core hours 09:00–17:00

  • Work pattern: Hybrid, 2 days per week in our Bracknell office

  • Travel: Occasional travel as required

  • On-call or shift work: None

  • Screening or clearance: Criminal record check required

What we offer

  • Competitive salary of £38,000 to £44,000

  • Generous holiday allowance

  • Company pension contribution

  • Healthcare cover for everyone, including dental and optical

  • Support for personal career development

  • Flexible working arranged with your manager

Ready to apply?

Send us your CV. We would also love a short cover letter telling us about a training product you designed and are proud of: what the need was, how you approached it, and what difference it made.

title: MAIT Additive Manufacturing Technician
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


We are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refuelled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.


We want you as a talented MAIT Additive Manufacturing Technician to help us in our mission by contributing significantly to Additive Manufacturing (AM) technology, development and in-house production for our Vehicles Nyx Earth and Nyx Moon.


The ideal candidate will play a key role as an Additive Manufacturing Technician, overseeing the daily execution of our 3D printing production. This versatile position focuses on the practical lifecycle of AM components, from machine setup and operation to intricate post-processing and finishing. The ideal candidate will ensure strict adherence to quality protocols and maintain meticulous documentation to guarantee that all parts comply with high industry standards and NASA regulations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Set up and operate metal AM (laser powder bed fusion) systems, including powder loading, calibration and part removal.

  • Monitor build and machine status, identify anomalies and escalate issues as required.

  • Maintain traceability and build documentation throughout production runs.

  • Maintain a clean and organized work area; ensure equipment and tools are well maintained and calibrated.

  • Assist with machine maintenance and troubleshooting.

  • Perform post-processing tasks such as support removal, bead blasting, surface finishing and cleaning.

  • Coordinate with service providers for heat treatment, HIP or precision machining as required.

  • Ensure cleanliness and quality of parts prior to inspection.

  • Careful preparation of manufacturing protocols, parts release certificates and traceability records in accordance with aerospace or industrial standards.

  • Visual inspection of cleaned parts for surface defects or damage prior to handover to quality assurance.


Qualifications:

  • 2 years of relevant hands-on experience in additive manufacturing or aerospace production.

  • Comfortable working with metal powders, inert gas systems, and precision tools.

  • Familiarity with additive manufacturing standards, including NASA or aerospace industry standards, is highly desirable.

  • Strong attention to detail, problem solving skills and ability to follow technical procedures.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, customer-focused manufacturing environment.

  • English language skills (spoken and written) are required for day-to-day communication, technical documentation and customer interaction


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with CAD and/or build preparation software (e.g., 3Dxpert, Magics, Netfabb).

  • Experience operating metal additive manufacturing machines such as laser powder bed fusion or directed energy deposition printers.

  • Hands-on experience with propulsion or aerospace components (combustion chambers, injectors, nozzles).

  • Familiarity with aerospace and spaceflight quality standards (e.g., AS9100, NASA-STD, ECSS).

  • Knowledge and or experience working with industrial robots.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

descriptionHtml:

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

BUILD AND DEVELOP A HIGH-PERFORMING EMEA TEAM

DRIVE OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE

SHAPE THE CUSTOMER JOURNEY WITH CROSS-FUNCTIONAL PARTNERS

REQUIREMENTS
