title: Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering
descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

À propos du rôle

Anthropic construit l’équipe Applied AI pour aider les organisations les plus ambitieuses du monde à adopter Claude de manière transformatrice, sûre et durable. Nos Forward Deployed Engineers s’intègrent directement auprès de clients stratégiques pour déployer des applications d’IA en production qui résolvent de véritables problèmes métier. À mesure que cette pratique se développe, nous avons besoin d’une personne leader pour construire et développer cette équipe.

En tant que premier Forward Deployed Manager en Europe du Sud, vous piloterez l’équipe qui se situe à la frontière du déploiement d’IA en entreprise. Vous recruterez et développerez une équipe performante de Forward Deployed Engineers, fixerez le standard technique et opérationnel pour les engagements clients, et construirez les playbooks qui transforment les succès ponctuels en modèles reproductibles. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les Engagement Managers qui gèrent la logistique de livraison et les relations avec les parties prenantes, tout en veillant à ce que votre équipe livre du code de qualité, se développe techniquement, et représente Anthropic au plus haut niveau dans les environnements clients.

Ce rôle est un rôle de meneur-contributeur avec une forte orientation leadership. Vous resterez assez impliqué dans le travail technique pour examiner les architectures, déboguer les problèmes en production, et vous associer à votre équipe quand cela compte — mais votre impact principal viendra des personnes que vous recruterez, des standards que vous fixerez, et de la culture que vous créerez. Vous collaborerez de manière transversale avec les équipes Ventes, Produit et Ingénierie pour façonner la manière dont Anthropic sert ses clients les plus stratégiques, et les insights de terrain de votre équipe influenceront directement la direction produit.

Ce rôle nécessite quelqu’un qui s’épanouit dans l’ambiguïté et qui est énergisé par la création à partir de zéro. Vous définirez ce que l’excellence ressemble pour la gestion d’une équipe FDE chez Anthropic — il n’existe pas de playbook existant à suivre.

Responsabilités

  • Recruter, développer et fidéliser une équipe de classe mondiale de Forward Deployed Engineers. Fixer un haut standard pour le talent technique et l’instinct client.
  • Mener des entretiens individuels réguliers, fournir du mentorat technique, et investir dans la progression de carrière de chaque membre de l’équipe. Créer un environnement où les Forward Deployed Engineers accomplissent leur meilleur travail.
  • Staffier et superviser les engagements clients dans le portefeuille de votre équipe, en prenant des décisions d’allocation des ressources qui équilibrent les besoins clients, le développement de l’équipe, et les priorités métier.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes de compte et les Engagement Managers pendant le processus de pré-vente pour qualifier les engagements, définir le périmètre du travail, et informer les demandes de travail.
  • Examiner les architectures techniques et le code produit par vos Forward Deployed Engineers, en veillant à ce que l’équipe livre des solutions production de haute qualité qui résolvent de véritables problèmes clients.
  • Rester assez impliqué pour diriger des sessions de découverte technique, prototyper des solutions, et déboguer des problèmes complexes aux côtés de votre équipe quand cela est nécessaire.
  • Construire des playbooks reproductibles, des dépôts de démarrage, des modèles d’intégration, et une base de connaissances interne qui capture ce que votre équipe apprend sur le terrain.
  • Définir les OKRs de l’équipe liés aux résultats de succès client et aux objectifs d’adoption produit. Créer des cadences opérationnelles — standups, rétros, revues d’engagement — qui maintiennent l’équipe alignée.
  • Collaborer avec Produit et Ingénierie pour traduire les insights de terrain en améliorations produit. Servir comme voix du client dans la planification interne.
  • Voyager sur les sites des clients selon les besoins (25-50%), particulièrement lors des lancements d’engagement et pour les comptes prioritaires de votre équipe.

Vous pourriez être un bon fit si vous avez

  • 10+ ans d’expérience en ingénierie logicielle, architecture de solutions, ou dans un rôle technique orienté client comme l’ingénierie forward deployed ou le conseil.
  • 2+ ans d’expérience en gestion de personnes au sein d’une organisation de services/post-vente/FDE avec un palmarès de recrutement, développement et fidélisation d’ingénieurs performants.
  • De l’expérience dans la construction d’organisations de zéro à un, pas seulement l’héritage d’une organisation existante.
  • De l’expérience de travail direct avec des clients d’entreprise sur des mises en œuvre techniques, y compris l’aisance à naviguer dans les dynamiques organisationnelles complexes.
  • Une présence de cadre avec la capacité à naviguer fluidement entre les conversations stratégiques avec les parties prenantes senior et les sessions de débogage pratiques avec les ingénieurs.
  • Des compétences fortes en communication écrite et verbale. Vous pouvez traduire la complexité technique en narratifs clairs pour des audiences diverses.
  • Un enthousiasme sincère pour la construction de quelque chose de nouveau et la définition de l’excellence pour une équipe qui n’existe pas encore.

Pourquoi ce rôle compte

Vous serez une personne leader fondatrice d’une équipe qui définit comment les entreprises adoptent et déploient l’IA. Votre travail influencera directement la direction produit d’Anthropic, créera des modèles réutilisables pour la base clients plus large, et établira Anthropic comme le partenaire de confiance pour la transformation de l’IA — tout en promouvant le développement responsable des systèmes d’IA de pointe.

About the role

Anthropic is building the Applied AI team to help the world's most ambitious organizations adopt Claude in ways that are transformative, safe, and lasting. Our Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with strategic customers to ship production AI applications that solve real business problems. As this practice grows, we need a founding leader to build and scale it.


As the first FDE Manager in Southern Europe, you'll own the team that sits at the frontier of enterprise AI deployment. You'll hire and develop a high-performing team of FDEs, set the technical and operational bar for customer engagements, and build the playbooks that turn one-off successes into repeatable patterns. You'll work hand-in-hand with Engagement Managers who own delivery logistics and stakeholder management, while you ensure your team is shipping quality code, growing technically, and representing Anthropic at the highest level in customer environments.

This is a player-coach role with a strong bias toward leadership. You'll stay close enough to the technical work to review architectures, debug production issues, and pair with your team when it matters — but your primary impact will come from the people you hire, the standards you set, and the culture you create. You'll partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Engineering to shape how Anthropic serves its most strategic customers, and your team's field insights will directly influence product direction.

This role requires someone who thrives in ambiguity and is energized by building from zero to one. You'll be defining what good looks like for FDE management at Anthropic — there is no existing playbook to follow.

Responsibilities

  • Hire, develop, and retain a world-class team of Forward Deployed Engineers. Set a high bar for technical talent and customer instincts.

  • Conduct regular 1:1s, provide technical mentorship, and invest in the career growth of each team member. Create an environment where FDEs do the best work of their careers.

  • Staff and oversee customer engagements across your team's portfolio, making resource allocation decisions that balance customer needs, team development, and business priorities.

  • Collaborate with account teams and Engagement Managers during the pre-sales process to qualify engagements, scope work, and inform statements of work.

  • Review technical architectures and code produced by your FDEs, ensuring the team ships high-quality, production-ready solutions that solve real customer problems.

  • Stay hands-on enough to lead technical discovery sessions, prototype solutions, and debug complex issues alongside your team when needed.

  • Build repeatable playbooks, starter repositories, integration templates, and an internal knowledge base that captures what your team learns in the field.

  • Define team OKRs that tie to customer success outcomes and product adoption goals. Create operational cadences — standups, retros, engagement reviews — that keep the team aligned.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to translate field insights into product improvements. Serve as the voice of the customer in internal planning.

  • Travel to customer sites as needed (25-50%), particularly during engagement kickoffs and for your team's highest-priority accounts.

You may be a good fit if you have

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, or a technical customer-facing role such as forward deployed engineering or consulting.

  • 2+ years of people management experience within a services/post-sales/FDE organization with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.

  • Experience building organizations from 0->1, not just inheriting an existing one.

  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers on technical implementations, including comfort navigating complex organizational dynamics.

  • Executive presence with the ability to move fluidly between strategic conversations with senior stakeholders and hands-on debugging sessions with engineers.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. You can translate technical complexity into clear narratives for diverse audiences.

  • Genuine excitement about building something new and defining what great looks like for a team that doesn't yet exist.

Why this role matters

You'll be a founding leader of a team that defines how enterprises adopt and scale AI. Your work will directly influence Anthropic's product direction, create reusable patterns for the broader customer base, and establish Anthropic as the trusted partner for AI transformation — all while advancing the responsible development of frontier AI systems.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:€235.000—€295.000 EUR

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Manager, GTM Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

At Checkout.com, we create marketing that moves people to choose our products, builds a brand where great marketers want to work, and fuels the growth of our business.

We’re looking for a GTM Engineer to join Marketing and help transform how we work internally. You’ll design and build AI-assisted workflows, agents and integrations that reduce manual effort, improve how information moves across the team and give marketers more time to focus on high-value work.

Marketing Operations Team owns our marketing technology and tools, and the automation that supports go-to-market execution across our channels. This role works alongside Marketing Operations, with a different starting focus: improving the internal processes, workflows and systems that help Marketing plan and deliver its work. The aim is to 10x our impact.

This is a hands-on technical role in a marketing team. You’ll spend around 70% of your time building: understanding how work gets done, finding where it is manual or breaking down, and shipping practical solutions. You’ll partner closely with Marketing Operations to make sure what you build fits our existing tools and standards.

You’ll work across Marketing, in close partnerships across Marketing Operations, Commercial AI Transformation and the AI Centre of Excellence. You’ll bring a clear technical point of view on what is scalable and reliable, while making sure the systems you build are useful to the people who need them.

How You’ll Make an Impact

Find the problems worth solving

Work with teams across Marketing to understand their processes and the work behind their requests. Map workflows, identify manual effort, duplicated work, missing context and avoidable errors, then prioritise opportunities based on their potential value. You’ll use your creativity and judgement rather than simply build to a ticket.

Build AI-assisted workflows and integrations

Create and ship agents, automations, skills and integrations that make internal marketing work easier. You might use Claude Enterprise, Copilot Studio, Clay, MCP connectors, coding agents or other tools across our marketing stack. Work with Marketing Operations when a solution involves our marketing technology or channel tools.

Make internal marketing work more efficient

Build workflows that help teams do the work behind marketing more efficiently, from briefing, research and insight gathering to planning, content development and hand-offs. Connect information and tools so people spend less time on repetitive coordination and more time on work that needs their expertise. Partner with Marketing Operations where workflows touch marketing technology or channel execution.

Build systems people can rely on

Design beyond the individual task. Consider the data, context, tools, users, hand-offs, controls and feedback loops a workflow needs to work well. Identify where information is missing, where an agent needs better direction or where teams need support to use and improve the system.

Help marketers build with AI

Work alongside marketers to show what is possible and help them use AI with confidence. Create reusable patterns, skills, playbooks and guardrails so teams can solve more problems themselves and repeat good practice.

Test, learn and improve

Prototype and test workflows, learn from how people use them, and improve or retire them based on the results. Identify design, security, privacy, brand and scale risks early, and follow our AI governance and review processes.

Keep up with the tools

Stay curious about new models, coding tools, connectors and agent patterns. Be able to explain which tools are right for a particular job and why, whether you’re comparing Claude, ChatGPT, coding agents or emerging platforms.

What We’re Looking For

You build things

You’ve made working automations, prototypes, integrations, agents, internal tools or products, and enjoy taking a messy problem through to something people can use. Your job title matters less than what you’ve built and the value it creates.

You use AI hands-on

You use LLMs to get work done, not just to talk about what they could do. You’re comfortable prototyping with AI coding tools, testing different approaches, debugging and improving the result. You can show us something you’ve built with Claude, Codex, ChatGPT or another LLM platform, at work or in your own time.

You have sound technical judgement

You can reason about systems, APIs, data flows, permissions and failure modes. You understand the difference between a promising demo and a dependable workflow. You don’t need a traditional software engineering background, but you do need to be comfortable working directly with technical tools and making sensible implementation choices.

You understand marketing and GTM

You understand how demand generation, growth, customer marketing, marketing operations, sales and revenue processes connect. You’re familiar with concepts such as campaign briefs, segmentation, ABM, lead scoring, MQLs, MQAs, pipeline, attribution and lifecycle stages. You’re interested in the business outcomes behind the work.

You’ve worked across marketing or RevOps tools

You’ve built or supported workflows across platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Asana, Clay or similar tools. You can think across a stack rather than optimise one tool in isolation, and you’re comfortable with connectors, APIs, webhooks or MCP-style integrations.

You know how to design useful workflows and agents

You can give a workflow the context it needs, choose the right tools, define hand-offs, involve people at the right points and make outputs easy to review. You understand that an agent’s performance depends on its data and operating environment as well as the model.

You prioritise for value

You can judge which problems are worth solving, which should remain manual and where a simpler answer will work better. You balance speed, quality, risk, maintainability and commercial impact, and can make a clear case for what to build next.

You measure and improve your work

You’re comfortable defining success measures, tracking usage and output, and deciding what to improve, stop or scale. You care about measurable gains in productivity, quality, speed or business impact.

You think in systems

You look for the process behind the immediate pain point. When a spreadsheet is difficult to use, for example, you’re curious about the data, decisions and hand-offs that created it, and what would make the process work better. You can hold the bigger picture while working through the details needed to ship.

You communicate clearly and bring people with you

You can explain technical ideas to marketers, commercial leaders, Product, Engineering, Security, IT and Operations in a way that helps them make decisions. You listen well, communicate simply and influence through your work and judgement.

You’re curious and self-starting

You’re comfortable with ambiguity and motivated to learn. You’ve taught yourself new tools, built something outside your formal remit or pursued a technical interest in your own time. A personal project, prototype, automation, community contribution or other example could show us how you learn.

You use AI responsibly

You understand that marketing systems need to be accurate, secure, explainable and aligned with our brand and company standards. You know when people need to review an output, when data should not be used and when an experiment is not ready to scale.

You might come from marketing technology, marketing operations, growth engineering, RevOps, automation engineering, product, full-stack engineering or another technical role close to commercial teams. What matters most is your curiosity about marketing, your judgement about what is worth improving and your ability to build practical solutions.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

title: Marketing Intern
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

Most people have no idea what benefits they actually have. And most of the teams running those benefits spend their week managing them in spreadsheets. Both of those are problems AI can help solve.

Ben is the agentic benefits platform for global enterprise. One system across every market, with AI doing the checking and the chasing so the people can do the deciding. We're seven years in, we built it from scratch, and there's a lot left to solve.

Your Mission

As Ben's Marketing Intern, you'll turn marketing strategy into the things people actually see. The direction is set — the positioning, the argument, who we're talking to. Your job is to make the work that carries it: the posts, the pages, the campaign assets, the video clips.

You'll sit with the marketing team for twelve months and learn from how great marketing actually gets made. You’ll get to experience the whole process: from the argument to the thing that ships: the report, the posts, the pages, the ad variants, the clips, the event stand. At a bigger company you'd get one of those. Here you get all of it, and quick, direct feedback from experts who care how it's done.

What You'll Be Working On

  • Content production and reuse: taking a report, a podcast episode or an article and building the posts, emails, pages and sales assets that carry it

  • Social: owning the company page calendar, and making it easier for our execs and the wider team to post

  • Website and SEO housekeeping: on-page fixes, metadata, internal linking, blog uploads, and the audit items that never reach the top of anyone's list

  • Event and campaign creative build: turning a concept into the invites, stand copy, follow-ups and post-event content.

  • Video and podcast support: clips, captions, show notes, distribution

  • Paid and campaign build alongside our demand gen lead: social ad variants and audiences, HubSpot landing pages, forms, emails and lists, and tracking.

You'll Love This Role If You...

  • Have built something of your own. A social account with a following, a YouTube series, a newsletter, a side project. Growing an audience from nothing teaches you how content moves people, and that's most of what we do

  • Can take a brief and improve it. Not follow it to the letter, not rewrite it from scratch. Interpret, then make something

  • Are comfortable with new tools, including AI. You'd rather work out how something functions than wait to be shown

  • Care who's reading. You want to know who's on the other end of the thing you're making. Everything else is teachable

No marketing degree and no marketing experience required. What you've made matters more than where you learned to make it.

Why Join Us?

Most internships hand you a spreadsheet and a coffee order. This one hands you the LinkedIn account.

You'll be one of a small marketing team, reporting to our Content Lead, working on the launches and campaigns that the rest of the year hangs off. You'll get the whole experience, from strategy to content shipped, because you'll be the one shipping it. You'll get direct feedback, quickly, from people who care about the craft.

title: Marketing Manager (DACH)
descriptionHtml:

Finance teams at fast-growing, multi-entity companies are outgrowing their single-entity ledgers and facing a familiar crossroads: bolt on more tools, or go full corporate ERP. Neither option is good. The Frankenstack breaks. The ERP weighs you down with implementation fees and consultants. There has to be a better, more AI native way.

There is. It's Light.

Light is building an AI-native financial platform for modern companies. Fast to implement, intuitive to use, and designed to get smarter over time. We call it organic software.

Companies like Legora, Lovable, and Fuse Energy already run on Light. Following our $30M Series A last year, we're building the team that will make Light the default finance platform for the next generation of businesses.

  

Why DACH, why now.

To win Europe, you have to win DACH. We know this. That's why we're making our first dedicated hire for the region and treating it as a must-win market. You won't be a satellite of a global team running templated playbooks. You'll be a builder. The person who decides what Light looks and feels like in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

  

What you'll be doing.

  • Building Light's presence in DACH from the ground up, shaping our GTM strategy, and becoming one of the defining faces of the region. If you'd rather set the direction than follow it, this is your gig.

  • Owning the full DACH events calendar. Finhack hackathons, third-party sponsorships, roundtables. From concept to follow-up, you run it.

  • Managing the regional budget, knowing where to spend and where to hold back.

  • Working with our brand team on everything from regional messaging and localisation to experiential campaigns that cut through in a market full of noise.

  • Bringing on-the-ground market data back to your VP Marketing and Growth Lead to sharpen paid activity, targeting, and messaging across the region.

  • Driving regional pipeline, working across events, campaigns, and community to build a consistent flow of qualified opportunities for the sales team.

  • Partnering with RevOps to keep pipeline clean, prospects moving, and nothing falling through the cracks between marketing and sales.

  • Enabling the sales team with the collateral, messaging, and market context they need to win in DACH.

  • Building community, not just pipeline. You'll build relationships with press, analysts, and partners, but the bigger goal is an ecosystem of likeminded changemakers around a product that's transforming the finance function.

  

What we think you'll need.*

  • Meaningful experience in field or regional marketing at a B2B SaaS company, ideally one that was building out international presence from a non-DACH HQ.

  • Native-level German fluency. You can write the copy, run the room, and build the relationships.

  • A real track record running field marketing and events from start to finish..

  • The ability to work across Sales, RevOps, and brand without losing momentum or creating friction. You know how to get things done in a cross-functional team.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI tooling, not just comfort with it. We're an AI-native company and use AI across everything we build and do. Just as Light helps finance teams do their best work, we expect our people to use AI to do theirs.

  • To be based in London, with frequent travel.

*But really, what do we know? If the crux of the role sounds right but you don't tick every box, reach out anyway and make your case.

  

The good stuff.

🏢 In-office culture, with a high talent-density team.
💸 Competitive salary.

🚀 The chance to shape a category from the inside, not just market around it.
🌍 Regular travel to Copenhagen, London, New York, and wherever the action is.
🥳 Company off-sites twice a year. The last one was in Italy.

title: Medior AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Van slimme AI-modellen naar oplossingen die écht werken.

Een AI-model bouwen is één ding. Zorgen dat het betrouwbaar draait, gekoppeld is aan echte data en waarde toevoegt bij een klant: daar wordt het interessant.

Bij adesso werk je aan AI-oplossingen die verder gaan dan experimenten, van machine learning en MLOps tot generatieve AI, LLM's en agents. Je bouwt, implementeert en verbetert oplossingen die organisaties echt gebruiken.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Medior AI Engineer werk je samen met senior AI Engineers en Forward Deployed Engineers aan klantprojecten. Je pakt zelfstandig onderdelen op en groeit in architectuur en end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid.

  • AI ontwikkelen: je bouwt ML-modellen, LLM-toepassingen en agentic workflows.

  • Van idee naar productie: je bouwt data- en ML-pipelines, automatiseert deployments en zorgt voor monitoring en betrouwbaarheid.

  • Slim integreren: je koppelt AI aan bestaande systemen, API's en cloud- en dataplatformen.

  • Meedenken met de klant: je vertaalt vraagstukken naar praktische, schaalbare oplossingen.

  • Kennis delen: je legt herbruikbare patronen vast en deelt wat je leert met je collega's.

Projecten die verder gaan dan het model

We richten ons op retail en e-commerce, finance en utilities. Denk aan:

  • Prognoses waar planners op durven te sturen, van retailassortiment tot netbelasting.

  • Intelligente documentverwerking, zoals KYC-dossiers of inspectierapporten, met herleidbare bronnen.

  • Agents die werk voorbereiden in klantenservice en backoffice, met evals en guardrails.

  • Computer vision, zoals in de fitnessbranche, waar we onveilige situaties in onbemande 24/7-locaties herkennen.

De uitdaging zit niet alleen in het model, maar ook in betrouwbaarheid, integratie en de werking in de praktijk. Je kiest steeds de techniek die bij het probleem past.


Wat breng je mee?

  • Ervaring met het ontwikkelen en in productie brengen van ML- of GenAI-oplossingen.

  • Goede kennis van Python, SQL en machine learning.

  • Ervaring met MLOps en/of LLM's, RAG en AI-agents.

  • Kennis van minimaal één cloudplatform (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric.

  • Je werkt met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren.

  • Je denkt vanuit de klantvraag en legt technische keuzes helder uit.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Wat dit níet is

  • Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je.

  • Geen notebook-kerkhof. Een model is pas af als het in productie draait en gebruikt wordt.

  • Geen GenAI omdat het kan. Soms is een klassiek model beter, soms een LLM; jij kiest wat past.

  • Geen werk op afroep. Je denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee, niet pas als het ontwerp al vastligt.

Het team

Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. Jij gaat als AI Engineer de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak.

Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen.

Heb je diepe kennis van finance, retail of utilities en wil je dichter op de klant zitten? Kijk dan ook naar onze FDE-vacatures. Twijfel je? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen welke rol het best past.

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk

We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen:

  • Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent.

  • AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken.

Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit richting architectuur en end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid.

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Zullen we kennismaken?

Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

title: Model Risk Officer
descriptionHtml:
Build with us

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

Credit, IRRBB and capital models sit at the heart of how a bank measures its own risk. Mollie already uses models in day to day processes, but nobody challenges them independently from a second line perspective yet. As Model Risk Officer, you'll help build the second line model risk function that gives Mollie, and its regulator, confidence that models can be trusted before they're used.

This is a true 0 to 1 role. Mollie isn't a bank today, so there's no model risk framework, validation methodology or model inventory to inherit. You'll design the policy, validation approach and governance from scratch, starting with the credit, IRRBB and capital models already in design for our future capital and liquidity planning. Your work feeds into our licence application and, once authorised, into how we manage model risk every day.

You'll also work with our Machine Learning team and the Domains already deploying models, so you can shape how we manage model risk today, not just in a banking future. Your challenge and sign off will be visible to senior leadership, audit and, eventually, our regulator. As Mollie grows and matures its model risk management, your scope grows from building the framework to running an ongoing model risk cycle.

What you'll ship

  • Build and own Mollie's model risk management framework and policy, including model risk appetite, validation standards and the model risk lifecycle.

  • Set up and maintain the model inventory for credit, IRRBB and capital models, with materiality and risk tiering for each.

  • Coordinate independent second line validation and challenge before models are used, including credit risk and ECL, IRRBB, and Pillar 1 and Pillar 2 capital models.

  • Design the ongoing monitoring and re-validation cycle with the Machine Learning team, covering performance testing, limitation tracking and re-validation triggers.

  • Partner with model owners in Credit Risk and Treasury ALM, and coordinate within the second line Risk function, so model risk challenge is built into the wider risk and capital frameworks.

  • Coordinate clear, well documented validation reports and model risk information that stand up to scrutiny from DNB/ECB, external auditors and internal audit.

What you'll bring

  • Around 5 to 7 years of experience in model risk management or model validation within a bank, preferably across at least one of credit, IRRBB and capital models.

  • Solid working knowledge of ECB model risk expectations and how model validation should be structured and evidenced.

  • Comfort building a model risk framework and validation approach from the ground up. You're excited to write the first playbook.

  • Strong quantitative skills to critically assess model methodology, assumptions and performance, and the discipline to document your findings so others, including a regulator, can follow them.

  • The ability to explain model limitations and validation findings to model owners and senior stakeholders, and the confidence to hold your ground under challenge.

  • Genuine curiosity about how AI can speed up the parts of model validation that don't need a human, so more of your time goes toward judgement and challenge.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

AI at Mollie

title: Network Architect / Network Specialist (On‑Prem, Global)
descriptionHtml:
Position Overview

Agile Robots SE is seeking a Network Architect / Network Specialist to define and operate our global on‑premise network across multiple geographies and regional offices. You will lead the design and lifecycle of our campus, branch, and data‑center networks—including high‑performance NVIDIA InfiniBand fabrics that power AI/HPC workloads—while ensuring our controls meet TISAX expectations and internal ISMS requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1) Global Architecture & Standards (On‑Prem Only)

  • Design and document end‑to‑end on‑prem architectures (core/distribution/access/WLAN; DC leaf‑spine).
  • Establish and maintain global standards: IP addressing & IPAM (NetBox), routing policy, QoS, naming, security baselines, and change control (HLD/LLD, MOP/SOP, rollback).
  • Define network zoning & segmentation (VLAN/VRF; optional EVPN/VXLAN where justified) across Officeand DMZ networks with clear trust boundaries.

2) Routing, Switching, WLAN & Regional Sites

  • Engineer BGP/OSPF for WAN & DC; deliver redundancy/failover across carriers and sites.
  • Own Aruba campus/branch switching and WLAN (coverage, capacity planning, RF hygiene, roaming, WPA2/3‑Enterprise).
  • Plan and execute site builds/moves/expansions (circuits, last‑mile, demarc, handoffs, cutovers) with measurable downtime windows.

3) Security, Remote Access & Identity

  • Lead FortiGate policy architecture (zones, NAT, segmentation, IDS/IPS) and FortiGate VPN (IPsec/SSL) for site‑to‑site and remote access, including HA and posture checks.
  • Implement 802.1X NAC (e.g., Aruba ClearPass) with RADIUS/Active Directory integration; enforce device posture and guest segmentation.
  • Operate DMZ patterns (reverse proxying, jump hosts, constrained admin planes) and align with TISAX/ISMSrequirements.

4) High‑Performance Networking for AI/HPC

  • Design, deploy, and maintain NVIDIA InfiniBand fabrics (topology, cabling/optics, partitioning), including subnet managers (UFM/opensm), congestion control, and path optimization.
  • Coordinate with compute/storage teams (e.g., DGX/HPC clusters) on throughput, latency, and scale; plan upgrades and fabric expansions.

5) Reliability, Observability & Automation

  • Deliver high availability (fast convergence, dual‑homing, link aggregation/MLAG/VLT) and tested DR/failover.
  • Implement proactive monitoring/alerting (e.g., Zabbix), telemetry/SNMP, and capacity trends; maintain RCAs and SLOs.
  • Centralize logging with rsyslog and FortiAnalyzer; enforce retention and integrity for audits.
  • Use NetBox, Ansible/Python, and Git‑based workflows for configuration management, drift control, and repeatable changes.

6) Compliance, Risk & Vendor Management (TISAX Focus)

  • Map network controls to TISAX expectations (ISMS governance, secure remote access, logging, supplier access, data protection).
  • Partner with ISMS owner/CISO on risk assessments, controls testing, and evidence preparation for audits (policies, diagrams, logs, change records).
  • Manage carriers and vendors (Fortinet, Aruba, Dell; integrators); lead RFPs, SLAs, and lifecycle planning.
  • Mentor regional IT; act as L3 escalation for incidents and major changes.

Core Technologies @ Agile Robots SE

  • Security & Remote Access: FortiGate NGFW, FortiGate VPN (IPsec/SSL), FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer.
  • Campus/Branch & WLAN: Aruba CX/AOS switching, controllers/APs, ClearPass (802.1X), AirWave (on‑prem mgmt).
  • Data Center & Fabric: Dell PowerSwitch (OS10), VLT/MLAG; NVIDIA InfiniBand (UFM/opensm).
  • Foundational Services: VLAN/VRF, BGP/OSPF, QoS; DHCP/DNS, Active Directory, RADIUS; NetBox(IPAM/DCIM).
  • Observability & Automation: Zabbix, rsyslog (retention policy), NetFlow/sFlow; Ansible/Python, Git.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years in enterprise on‑prem networking across multi‑site/multi‑region environments.
  • Deep hands‑on with FortiGate, Aruba (switching/WLAN), Dell data‑center switching, and NVIDIA InfiniBand basics.
  • Strong routing/switching (BGP, OSPF, VLAN, VRF), segmentation, and DMZ design; HA and fast convergence patterns.
  • Proven delivery of secure remote access, 802.1X NAC, and logging/monitoring at scale (rsyslog, analyzers, NMS).
  • Experience aligning network controls to ISMS/TISAX (policy ↔ design ↔ evidence).
  • Excellent documentation (HLD/LLD, diagrams) and stakeholder communication.

Preferred

  • Certifications: Fortinet NSE (4/5/7+), Aruba (ACMA/ACMP/ACSP/ACDX), CCNP/CCIE, Dell networking, and/or NVIDIA networking.
  • ClearPass NAC depth, FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer, Aruba AirWave; EVPN/VXLAN familiarity.
  • Exposure to RADIUS/AD integration and FreeRADIUS stack.
  • Familiarity with Zabbix tuning, syslog retention strategies, and ITSM/change tooling.
  • Experience segmenting AI/HPC clusters and integrating with storage/compute pipelines.

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. 

Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio, together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.

Find out more at: https://www.agile-robots.com/en/

title: OT Security Engineer (Physical Security Systems)
descriptionHtml:
Does contributing to the smooth operations of a leading EU Agency appeal to you? Then this could be your next opportunity!

About the Agency

Our client, eu-LISA, is the European Union Agency responsible for operating large-scale IT systems that help keep Europe safe and support cooperation in areas like security, migration, and justice. Civitta, in cooperation with Talenta, provides temporary agency workers to eu-LISA.

We are looking for

OT Security Engineer (Physical Security Systems) supporting the Protective Security Sector within the Security Unit. The position is based in Strasbourg, France.

About the Job


In this role, you will protect the network and infrastructure behind the Agency’s physical security systems, such as access control, CCTV, intrusion detection and security management platforms. You will be a hands-on technical practitioner who assesses, hardens and improves this environment, working closely with the Physical Security Systems Administrators, ICT colleagues and external service providers.


You will
  • Carry out regular security assessments of servers, workstations, network devices and administration interfaces supporting physical security systems
  • Identify vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, excessive privileges and possible attack vectors
  • Maintain vulnerability registers, track remediation and verify that corrective actions are effective
  • Implement corrective measures directly or coordinate them with technical stakeholders, and escalate unresolved risks
  • Develop and maintain security baselines and hardening standards, and check compliance with them
  • Support secure authentication, privileged access management and secure administration practices
  • Assess LAN, VLAN and network segmentation, and the security impact of integrations and third-party connections
  • Recommend and implement improvements to network segregation, access restrictions and resilience
  • Contribute security expertise to infrastructure upgrades and the deployment of new security capabilities
  • Produce technical reports and regular reporting on the security posture of the physical security infrastructure
  • Monitor security advisories and threat developments, and contribute to the continuous improvement of security standards

    • Requirements
  • A university degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Network Engineering, Information Systems or a related field
  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in network security, infrastructure security, cybersecurity or technical security assessment
  • Proven hands-on experience in performing security assessments, analysing network and system configurations and hardening systems yourself (the role is not limited to governance, policy or audit coordination)
  • Sound knowledge of TCP/IP, switching, LAN/VLAN architectures, network segmentation, OS security, patch management and privileged access management
  • A valid Personnel Security Clearance at EU CONFIDENTIAL level or higher, or an equivalent national clearance recognised by an EU Member State
  • Good command of written and spoken English and French (minimum B2 in both)
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, Security+, GIAC or CCNP Security, and experience with access control, CCTV or intrusion detection systems, are a strong advantage

    • Benefits

    WE OFFER an opportunity to work in a prestigious EU Agency within a multicultural environment, with a gross hourly rate of EUR 35.74.

    Become part of a multicultural work environment and submit your CV in English and Europass format by 4 November 2026.

title: Partner Account Manager, Cabinet Intégrateurs (en télétravail depuis Bordeaux) (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 350 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !



Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez nous ?

Les intégrateurs historiques disposent souvent d’une expertise métier reconnue, d’équipes commerciales et de conseil, ainsi que d’un parc de clients à accompagner. Ils peuvent contribuer fortement à la croissance de Pennylane, à la fois par la vente de nouvelles solutions et par le développement de leur parc existant.

Pour transformer ce potentiel en résultats, il faut installer une dynamique commerciale durable : aligner les dirigeants et les équipes terrain, faire émerger des opportunités, améliorer la maîtrise du produit et faciliter la collaboration avec les équipes Pennylane. Tu aideras les partenaires à passer d’une relation de distribution ou de prescription à une collaboration active, structurée et créatrice de valeur.

 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

Tu piloteras le développement d’un portefeuille de partenaires intégrateurs, de la stratégie de compte jusqu’à l’exécution des plans d’action :

  1. Développer les comptes partenaires, en alignant les dirigeants, responsables commerciaux et équipes opérationnelles autour d’objectifs communs.

  2. Accélérer le business Resell et Cosell, en animant les opportunités, en améliorant leur qualité et en aidant les partenaires à faire progresser leurs cycles de vente.

  3. Faire monter les équipes partenaires en compétence, grâce à des démonstrations, des formations et un accompagnement commercial concret.

  4. Créer une dynamique de croissance sur le parc existant, en identifiant les opportunités de déploiement, de migration et d’équipement des clients des intégrateurs.

  5. Faire rayonner les apprentissages du terrain, en partageant les résultats, les besoins partenaires et les leviers qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe Partnerships et les autres équipes internes.

 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

1. Construire et déployer les plans de croissance des partenaires

  • Comprendre le modèle économique, l’organisation, les priorités et le potentiel de chaque intégrateur.

  • Construire avec les dirigeants et responsables commerciaux des plans de compte ambitieux, assortis d’objectifs et d’étapes concrètes.

  • Identifier les leviers de croissance adaptés à chaque partenaire : développement du parc, nouveaux projets, campagnes ciblées, événements ou actions conjointes.

  • Mobiliser les sponsors et les équipes terrain pour ancrer le partenariat dans les pratiques commerciales et opérationnelles.

  • Prioriser ton temps et les ressources internes en fonction du potentiel et de l’impact attendu.

2. Animer le business Resell et Cosell

  • Créer et entretenir une relation de confiance avec les décideurs, les équipes commerciales et les consultants du partenaire.

  • Suivre le pipeline Resell et Cosell, assurer la qualité des opportunités et rendre le forecast fiable.

  • Aider le partenaire à qualifier les besoins, structurer les opportunités et mobiliser les bons interlocuteurs Pennylane.

  • Coordonner les actions avec les Account Executives et clarifier les rôles sur les cycles de vente partagés.

  • Détecter les risques, débloquer les situations et accélérer les opportunités pertinentes jusqu’à leur conclusion.

3. Développer le parc et les opportunités chez les clients des intégrateurs

  • Identifier avec le partenaire les segments de clients et les cas d’usage prioritaires.

  • Construire des plans d’action pour équiper ou faire migrer les clients du parc lorsqu’une opportunité pertinente existe.

  • Aider le partenaire à organiser la prospection, la qualification et le suivi des projets issus de son réseau.

  • Participer à des rendez-vous clients, démonstrations ou événements lorsque cela peut accélérer le business ou renforcer la relation.

  • Suivre l’impact des actions engagées et capitaliser sur les approches qui produisent des résultats.

4. Former et rendre les équipes partenaires plus autonomes

  • Maîtriser la proposition de valeur et les principaux cas d’usage de Pennylane afin de réaliser des démonstrations convaincantes.

  • Former les équipes commerciales du partenaire à présenter la valeur de la solution, au-delà des seules fonctionnalités.

  • Aider les consultants et équipes opérationnelles à comprendre les conditions d’un déploiement réussi et à orienter les clients vers les bons interlocuteurs.

  • Préparer les partenaires à leurs rendez-vous, événements clients et temps forts commerciaux.

  • Adapter ton accompagnement aux profils et au niveau de maturité des équipes du partenaire.

5. Être présent sur le terrain et faire vivre la relation

  • Assurer une présence physique régulière auprès des partenaires prioritaires, notamment lors de revues d’activité, de rendez-vous dirigeants et d’actions commerciales.

  • Préparer et animer des revues de partenariat qui débouchent sur des décisions, des responsables et des prochaines étapes claires.

  • Entretenir un réseau de contacts au-delà de l’interlocuteur principal afin de sécuriser la continuité du partenariat.

  • Identifier tôt les signaux de risque, les irritants et les sujets nécessitant un arbitrage.

  • Représenter Pennylane auprès des partenaires avec exigence, réactivité et transparence.

6. Collaborer en interne et contribuer à la stratégie Partnerships

  • Coordonner les plans partenaires avec les équipes AE, Marketing, Ops, Produit et les équipes d’accompagnement concernées.

  • Faire remonter des retours terrain précis sur les besoins des intégrateurs, les objections, les évolutions de marché et les opportunités commerciales.

  • Proposer des initiatives marketing, commerciales ou produit pour accélérer la croissance des partenaires.

  • Partager les bonnes pratiques et les succès avec l’équipe afin de contribuer à la performance collective.

  • Maintenir des informations fiables dans le CRM et respecter les processus de vente et de suivi partenaires.

     

Profil recherché :

Compétences incontournables :

  • Tu as une expérience confirmée en vente indirecte B2B, gestion de comptes partenaires ou développement de réseaux de revendeurs et d’intégrateurs;

  • Tu as idéalement au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans un environnement logiciel ou SaaS B2B ; une expérience plus senior sera appréciée pour gérer des partenaires stratégiques et des cycles complexes;

  • Tu sais élaborer et piloter des plans de croissance avec des interlocuteurs de niveau direction et des équipes opérationnelles;

  • Tu as une approche commerciale orientée résultats, sais piloter un pipeline et transformer les analyses en actions concrètes;

  • Tu es à l’aise dans les rendez-vous terrain, les négociations, les présentations et les démonstrations produit;

  • Tu sais engager plusieurs parties prenantes chez un partenaire et construire une relation de confiance dans la durée;

  • Tu es proactif, créatif et résilient : tu sais prendre des initiatives et maintenir une dynamique même lorsque les résultats prennent du temps;

  • Tu es rigoureux dans le suivi des opportunités, le forecast et l’utilisation du CRM;

  • Tu apprécies le travail en équipe et sais collaborer avec des fonctions commerciales, marketing, produit et opérations;

  • Tu maîtrises le français et peux participer à des échanges professionnels en anglais.

     

Atouts appréciés

  • Une connaissance des solutions de comptabilité, finance, gestion, ERP ou logiciels de gestion pour les PME;

  • Une expérience auprès d’intégrateurs, de revendeurs, de VAR ou d’éditeurs logiciels B2B.

  • Une bonne compréhension des écosystèmes de distribution logicielle et des enjeux de déploiement chez les clients;

  • Une expérience de gestion de grands comptes partenaires, de plans de migration de parc ou de cycles Resell et Cosell.

     

Ce que nous recherchons surtout :

Au-delà de ton expérience, nous recherchons une personne qui :

  • Sait créer rapidement de la confiance et de la crédibilité auprès de dirigeants et d’équipes terrain;

  • Aime être au contact des partenaires et transforme cette proximité en actions commerciales mesurables;

  • Sait conjuguer vision stratégique du compte et exécution opérationnelle au quotidien;

  • Est à la fois autonome, coachable et généreuse dans le partage de ses apprentissages avec l’équipe;

  • A envie de contribuer à la croissance d’un réseau historique tout en faisant évoluer ses pratiques.

 

Process de recrutement :

  1. Screening Talent Acquisition — 45 min : motivation, expérience en partenariats logiciels, connaissance de l’écosystème et disponibilité pour les déplacements.

  2. Entretien Hiring Manager — 45 min : réalisations concrètes, gestion de portefeuille, activation et développement de partenaires, approche terrain et collaboration.

  3. Étude de cas — environ 1 h : analyse d’un portefeuille d’intégrateurs, proposition d’un plan de croissance, priorisation du pipeline Resell/Cosell et présentation d’une approche de démonstration ou d’enablement.

  4. Entretien final — environ 45 min : vision du canal, contribution stratégique, collaboration transverse et adéquation avec les ambitions de Pennylane.

 

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

title: Partner Development Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

This Role

The Solution Partner Ecosystem is the second biggest growth lever at Dust, yet Europe's agency and consultant market is still almost entirely untapped.

As Partner Development Manager (EU) at Dust, you will build a volume engine to boost partner-led revenue. Your job is to find the right partners across Europe, recruit them, and get them to their first win fast, and then transform into a repeatable motion. Working directly with our global partnerships team, you'll own the outreach motion, the onboarding, and the early relationship with every new partner you bring in, primarily digital transformation agencies and AI consultants.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can build a relationship from a cold message, run a disciplined process, and never lose the human touch that makes partners want to show up. You will be part of a growing partnerships team of 6 people, with partner managers distributed by location and a global partner operations and a solutions engineer.

Key Responsibilities

Hunt and recruit partners across Europe

  • Map the agency and consultant landscape across key European markets and identify highest-leverage entry points

  • Build and run an outbound motion to engage high-potential agencies and AI consultants: cold outreach, events, referrals, and everything in between

  • Develop targeted messaging tailored to different partner profiles, geographies, and languages

  • Qualify and prioritise your pipeline based on partner fit, client base relevance, and activation potential

Qualify partners and shape their Dust proposition

  • Run discovery conversations with prospective partners to assess their client base, AI readiness, and commercial fit before investing further

  • Help partners articulate how Dust fits into their service offering, whether that's a new AI practice, an add-on to existing engagements, or a standalone product recommendation

  • Make the call on which partners are worth advancing and move quickly on the ones that aren't

Onboard and enable new partners to go to market

  • Run structured onboarding for every new partner: product training, sales methodology, and deployment fundamentals

  • Own product training sessions with new partners and make sure they can demo, pitch and deploy Dust independently before going live

  • Get partners to first deal fast and track time-to-activation as a core success metric

Manage your partner portfolio and drive performance

  • Own quarterly business reviews with active partners: pipeline, escalations, and partnership trajectory

  • Keep the account management layer efficient and systematic to handle a high volume of partners

Support partners through live deals

  • Coach partners through sales cycles where Dust expertise is needed on the call

  • Build shared accountability for revenue outcomes between Dust and the partner network

Requirements

  • 5+ years of partnership management or business development experience in B2B SaaS, with proven track record of driving revenue through partner channels

  • Outbound-first mindset with a proven ability to recruit cold partners into active pipeline contributors, without relying on warm intros or an established brand to open doors

  • Relationship building expertise with ability to establish trust and drive action with consulting firms and system integrators

  • Strong enablement instincts — you can translate a technically complex product into a partner-ready sales motion and get partners to first deal without hand-holding

  • Excellent communication skills in English and French, nice to have a third European language

  • Entrepreneurial background or mindset: you've built something from scratch before, whether a territory, a partner channel, or a program, and you can show the impact

  • Self-starter mentality comfortable with ambiguity and can easily iterate on a built playbook

  • Nice to have: Existing network of agencies or consultants across Europe is a strong plus; we're looking for someone who brings complementary reach, not just experience in the category

What Makes This Role Unique

  • Direct revenue impact: You'll be directly involved in signing partners, closing deals and driving measurable business results

  • AI-native partner operations: Build and shape the partner operations in a AI-native team

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with sales, partnerships, and product teams

  • High-growth environment: Join at a pivotal moment as we scale from €1M to €40+M ARR

  • Innovation opportunity: Help define how AI companies should approach partnership development

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.
