title: Senior Compliance Director – UK
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

BJAK is Southeast Asia’s largest digital insurance platform, expanding financial access through automation, data, and digital scale. As we grow across markets, we are committed to building a platform that is safe, compliant, and trusted.

We are hiring a Senior Compliance Director – UK to lead regulatory strategy, risk governance, and compliance operations for our UK market entry and expansion alongside the CEO. This role is expected to hold the SMF16 (Compliance Oversight) Senior Management Function once approved, and will act as our primary point of contact with the FCA.

This is a build role: you'll be creating frameworks, policies, and controls from scratch rather than inheriting an existing function.

 

Why This Role Matters

The Senior Compliance Director – UK will:

  • Design and enforce compliance frameworks that enable safe scaling of digital financial services.

  • Ensure BJAK operates in accordance with UK regulatory standards, especially FCA requirements.

  • Protect consumers through transparent, fair, and ethical practices.

  • Establish BJAK as a trusted partner with regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders.

  • Build compliance capability and culture across the company.

 

What You Will Do

Regulatory Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and maintain compliance frameworks aligned with UK regulatory requirements.

  • Lead regulatory readiness for market entry, licensing, and ongoing supervision.

  • Serve as the primary contact with the FCA and relevant UK bodies.

  • Interpret regulatory changes and guide business strategy accordingly.

 

Risk Governance & Compliance Operations

  • Build policies and controls covering AML, KYC, data privacy, consumer duty, distribution, and claims-related compliance.

  • Conduct risk assessments and implement remediation plans for identified gaps.

  • Establish monitoring, testing, and reporting processes for ongoing compliance.

  • Ensure internal audits, compliance reviews, and control testing are operationalised.

 

Consumer Protection & Business Integrity

  • Embed fairness, transparency, and responsible selling throughout the organisation.

  • Oversee product compliance, marketing reviews, pricing governance, and distribution oversight.

  • Implement complaint handling frameworks aligned with regulatory standards.

 

Cross-Functional Support & Training

  • Partner with product, operations, legal, marketing, and commercial teams to ensure compliant execution.

  • Provide guidance on regulatory implications of new products, partnerships, or distribution models.

  • Deliver training to ensure teams understand and execute compliance responsibilities.

 

You Will Thrive in This Role If You

  • See compliance as a strategic enabler, not a blocker.

  • Operate with high integrity, sound judgment, and strong attention to detail.

title: Senior Consultant (m/w/d) Data Governance

title: Senior Counsel, Privacy & AI Compliance (EU)
descriptionHtml:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.   We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

What You’ll Do:

The Legal and Government Affairs team at CoreWeave is highly collaborative and partners closely with teams across the company to navigate complex legal landscapes while enabling innovation and growth. The team is pragmatic, solutions-oriented, and deeply engaged in strategic decision-making, with a strong emphasis on building trusted relationships across the organization.

As Senior Counsel, Privacy & AI Compliance (EU), you will serve as a key legal advisor on European privacy, data protection, and artificial intelligence requirements. If you thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex problems, and are eager to make a significant impact, CoreWeave is the place for you.

About the role:

Reporting to the Senior Director & Lead Managing Counsel, Privacy, Regulatory & Compliance, you will independently advise on complex regional matters, help operationalize evolving legal requirements, and partner closely with Privacy, Product, Engineering, Security, Commercial Legal, Government Affairs, and business teams across Europe. You will play a central role in scaling practical, risk-based privacy and AI compliance frameworks for CoreWeave’s cloud infrastructure, products, and European operations.

In this Role You Will:

  • Advise on EU and UK privacy, data protection, and AI laws and regulatory developments, including the GDPR, UK GDPR, ePrivacy requirements, the EU AI Act, the EU Data Act, and related national implementing laws and guidance.
  • Translate complex legal requirements into clear, practical, and scalable guidance for Product, Engineering, Security, Commercial, Marketing, HR, Procurement, and operational teams across Europe.
  • Lead or support privacy and AI assessments for new and evolving products, features, data uses, vendors, and business initiatives, including DPIAs, legitimate-interest assessments, transfer impact assessments, AI risk and classification analyses, and documented compliance decisions.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to embed privacy by design and default, responsible AI, data minimization, transparency, security, retention, and governance requirements into product architecture and development processes.
  • •  Advise on international data transfers, data localization and residency requirements, cross-border access, and related contractual and operational mechanisms, including EU Standard Contractual Clauses and the UK International Data Transfer Addendum or Agreement.
  • Support implementation of CoreWeave’s AI compliance framework in Europe, including role and use-case classification, risk management, transparency, recordkeeping, human oversight, technical documentation, contractual allocation of responsibilities, and governance for internal and customer-facing AI uses.
  • Provide regional guidance on data subject rights, records of processing, privacy notices, consent and cookies, retention and deletion, data sharing, direct marketing, and other core privacy program requirements.
  • Advise on European product launches, market entry, strategic partnerships, customer and vendor arrangements, and commercial terms involving privacy, data use, AI, and regulatory responsibility.
  • Support cybersecurity and privacy incident response in Europe, including assessment of regulator and data subject notification obligations, engagement with relevant stakeholders, and documentation of defensible legal decisions.
  • Lead or support responses to inquiries, audits, consultations, and investigations involving European data protection authorities, AI regulators, and other governmental bodies; coordinate with local counsel and drive follow-up and remediation.
  • Develop and maintain regional policies, procedures, playbooks, training, control mappings, and evidence of compliance, and monitor emerging legal and enforcement trends to inform business strategy and program priorities.

Who You Are:

  • 4+ years of relevant legal experience, including substantial experience advising on European privacy and data protection matters; a mix of law firm, regulatory, and in-house experience is preferred.
  • Qualified to practice law in an EU member state or the United Kingdom and in good standing with the applicable professional body.
  • Strong working knowledge of the GDPR and UK GDPR, including controller and processor obligations, privacy-by-design requirements, data subject rights, international transfers, DPIAs, security and breach notification, and regulator engagement.
  • Meaningful experience with AI governance or emerging AI regulation, including the ability to interpret and operationalize the EU AI Act for technology, cloud, infrastructure, or enterprise use cases.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex regional matters, identify material risk, present practical options, and make clear, defensible recommendations in ambiguous situations.
  • Experience building or operationalizing privacy and AI compliance programs through policies, assessments, controls, training, governance processes, monitoring, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Technical fluency and the ability to understand data flows, cloud architecture, product functionality, AI systems, and security practices and translate them into actionable legal guidance.
  • Excellent drafting and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex legal requirements clearly and influence technical, commercial, and business stakeholders across jurisdictions.
  • Proven ability to build trusted cross-functional relationships, manage multiple priorities, and work effectively in a fast-paced, rapidly scaling global environment.

Preferred: 

  • Experience advising a high-growth cloud, AI, SaaS, data center, infrastructure, or other technology company.
  • Experience engaging with European data protection authorities, AI regulators, standards bodies, industry groups, or external counsel on novel technology issues.
  • Experience advising on cross-border data transfers, cloud service provider obligations, enterprise AI governance, and the allocation of regulatory responsibilities between providers and customers.
  • Familiarity with recognized privacy, security, and AI governance frameworks or standards, such as ISO/IEC 27701, ISO/IEC 42001.

Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.

  • You remain calm under pressure and can make sound, defensible decisions when facts are still developing.
  • You’re curious about technology and enjoy working closely with security and engineering teams to understand how systems operate.
  • You communicate complex legal risk clearly and concisely, with a practical focus on protecting customers and enabling the business.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast!  We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values: 

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!  

The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:

  • Family-level Medical Insurance
  • Family-level Dental Insurance 
  • Generous Pension Contribution 
  • Life Assurance at 4x Salary 
  • Critical Illness Cover

Benefits may vary by location. 

Equal Opportunity 

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

Recruitment Agencies

CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms & Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.

Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.

Export Control Compliance

This position requires access to export controlled information.  To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency.  CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.

title: Senior Data Analyst, Financial Health
descriptionHtml:
📍Cardiff, London or Remote (UK)  | 💰 £76,000 to £95,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits | Data Team, Borrowing 

About our Financial Health Team:

We are scaling up our Data and Credit team to support the rapid growth and evolution of our portfolio. We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Financial Health squad who are focused on supporting customers in financial difficulty. 

As a Senior Data Analyst, you’ll be working in collaboration with Product, Data Science and Analytical Engineering peers on data-driven insights and initiatives. We’re looking for an experienced Senior Data Analyst with hands-on experience who can bring fresh thinking and new ways to inspire the team and our customers.

What you’ll be working on:

As a Senior Data Analyst you will partner with Product Managers, Engineers, and Data Scientists in an agile product environment. You’ll champion the use of data and bring ideas to life through a rigorous analytical approach. Your work will focus on improving the support we offer to customers in financial difficulty, ensure our operational processes are well controlled and we meet regulatory requirements.

At Monzo we believe there’s a better way to do banking - we care deeply about our customers, are innovative and execute quickly. 

Our mission is to revolutionise the way people manage their finances by putting them in control and promoting their financial wellbeing. Our Borrowing business is growing rapidly (both on our existing products, and with the planned launch of new products). We aim to create a genuine feel-good factor when it comes to personal credit, and are looking for driven, analytical and creative individuals to help us achieve this goal. 

Your day-to-day:

  • Generate insights that can drive the direction of our Financial Health strategy through proactive analysis
  • Bring data-driven rigour to our approach to product development and build a strategic understanding of the business while structuring complex projects to bring them to life
  • Work and advise on Financial Health’s global expansion strategy
  • Develop and maintain Looker dashboards, reports and metrics that assess business and customer outcomes within Financial Health
  • Ensure accurate reporting to third parties and regulators
  • Build and maintain controls to ensure our business processes are running as intended 
  • Lead projects to improve the accuracy, efficiency and accessibility of our data

Locations & flexible working 

Our main tech hub is in London, but our data teams are based all over the UK — from Brighton to the Western Isles.

We love meeting in person, but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you’re nearby. You’ll do your best work where you feel most comfortable.

We value flexibility, connection, and wellbeing. You’ll have the freedom to work in a way that fits your life, whether that’s school drop-offs, avoiding rush hour, or making time for what matters most.

Work the way that works for you at Monzo! 💼

Our technology stack:

OurData team's mission is to Enable Monzo to Make Better Decisions, Faster

At the core of this mission sits our data platform. We're great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. Our engineers collect analytics events from their microservices, and upload these into our Data stack for analysis. We optimise for simplicity and re-usability – all our data lives in one place and is made available via our data warehouse in Google BigQuery.

We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies (note we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all them):

  • Google Cloud Platform for all of our analytics infrastructure
  • dbt andBigQuery SQL for our data modelling and warehousing
  • Python for data science
  • Go to write our application code
  • AWS for most of our backend infrastructure

You should apply if:

  • What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!
  • You are passionate about using data to improve and inform business decisions
  • You’re motivated by solving challenging problems, and communicating and collaborating closely with subject matter experts on those solutions
  • You’re excited by the opportunity to work autonomously to impact the future of a fast growing, ever evolving business
  • You’re as comfortable getting hands-on as taking a step back and thinking strategically
  • You are experienced with using a variety of Data Analysis tools. You know when to pick the right tool, and can help others do the same
  • You have a solid grounding in SQL 
  • Experience in Financial Health is a plus, but not required.

We're on the look out for L40 Senior Data Analysts at the moment, you can read more in our Data Progression Framework

The Interview Process:

title: Senior Detection and Response Engineer - UK
descriptionHtml:
Senior Detection and Response Engineer (Cheltenham, UK)

Location: Cheltenham, UK

Team: Product & Engineering

Employment Type: Full-Time, Remote

About VulnCheck

Exploitation prevention is only as strong as the intelligence driving those efforts, and most of the industry is still running on intelligence that lacks exploit context. VulnCheck, The exploit intelligence company, delivers structured exploit intelligence on what is actively weaponized in the wild, purpose-built for the data lakes, ETL pipelines, automation, and AI and LLM workflows your infrastructure already runs on, raising the capability of everything it powers.

About the Role

Our Target and Canary Intelligence products provide unique visibility into vulnerable assets on the internet, attacker infrastructure, and attacks that leverage vulnerabilities for initial access. Target Intelligence maintains a continuously updated view of internet-facing systems — the services and versions they run, and their exposure to vulnerabilities. Canary Intelligence deploys intentionally vulnerable systems across the internet and captures real exploitation attempts as they happen.

We are looking for an experienced detection and response engineer to help scale the durable detections behind these products. These detections generate world-class, vulnerability-centric threat intelligence our customers rely on to defend themselves against exploitation activity on the internet.

You'll have wide latitude to shape how VulnCheck stays ahead of an accelerating volume of vulnerabilities - the tooling, the workflows, and the standards for detection engineering at scale. Although this is a 100% remote role, candidates must be located in or around Cheltenham, United Kingdom.

What You'll Do

  • Design and direct AI-assisted, agentic detection workflows that scale coverage to an accelerating volume of vulnerabilities, with you on the loop for quality
  • Author and ship network signatures and detections against internet-scale scan and probe data to identify services, versions, and whether hosts are vulnerable.
  • Build detections against Canary telemetry that separate real exploitation signal from internet noise, and synthesize that signal into threat intelligence customers can act on
  • Drive feedback loops into our probing and collection capabilities - identifying what data we should collect, what we shouldn't, and where coverage gaps exist
  • Continuously evaluate detection quality, measuring and tuning false positive and false negative rates
  • Respond rapidly when high-impact vulnerabilities drop - analyze, build coverage, ship
  • Work alongside our vulnerability researchers and threat hunters to connect detection engineering with exploit intelligence

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience building and shipping durable detections over network and host data
  • Experience scaling detection development and continuous evaluation processes using AI and agentic workflows with humans on the loop
  • A track record of researching, engineering, and validating durable detections across network and host telemetry, with a disciplined approach to false positives and false negatives
  • Expertise in device fingerprinting and protocol analysis. You understand the nuances of how services manifest on the wire, and how these signals stack to passively uncover what is running behind an open port on an internet address
  • Knowledge of attacker command-and-control techniques, covert channels, and exploitation artifacts — and how to identify them through network traffic analysis
  • A background in host-based analysis and DFIR. You know what telemetry is worth collecting from sensors to identify exploitation activity and attacker behaviors, and how to synthesize it into high-quality, actionable threat intelligence
  • Strong programming or scripting ability — you can codify detection logic so it is performant and integrates cleanly with VulnCheck’s engineering system
  • Familiarity with CVE, NVD, KEV, or exploit intelligence datasets
  • A response mindset — when a new vulnerability drops, you're the first to dig in, analyze it, and ship detection coverage

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing and tuning detections in Suricata, Snort, Zeek, or similar, and writing Nuclei templates or other scanner signatures
  • Published detection research, signatures, or open-source detection content
  • Experience with streaming systems or real-time data processing
  • Background in high-growth or startup environments

What We Offer

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted, and valued. VulnCheck offers benefits designed to meet a wide range of needs and lifestyles, tailored to your country of employment:

  • Generous, flexible time off
  • Retirement/pension plan contributions (e.g., 401k with match in the US; local pension schemes elsewhere)
  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage
  • Generous paid parental leave
  • Remote-friendly environment with flexibility
  • Support for home office costs (phone & internet)

Specific benefit details vary by country and are confirmed during the offer process.

Why Join Us

Built on over two decades of cybersecurity experience, our team of experts understands the intricacies of vulnerabilities, their exploitation in the wild, and how to leverage this data to build more effective cybersecurity products that produce better outcomes for organizations.

VulnCheck gives organizations a tactical advantage by providing best-in-class exploit & vulnerability intelligence information. We have a sense of duty to protect the critical infrastructure we rely on including medical devices, power grids and telecommunication networks. We were founded in 2021 in Lexington, Massachusetts.

VulnCheck has a transparent, collaborative, and supportive culture — we are looking for people who have a growth mindset, are curious and innovative. Our team is smart, but humble, hardworking, and supportive.

title: Senior Director, Enterprise Risk Management
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the team

The Global Risk team at Airwallex plays a critical role in enabling the company’s growth by building a strong, scalable, and globally consistent approach to risk management. The team works across the business to define risk appetite, develop frameworks and policies, support strategic decision-making, and provide oversight of key risks as Airwallex expands across products, markets, and regulatory environments. You’ll be part of a highly collaborative group that partners closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Commercial, Financial Crime Compliance, Regulatory Compliance, and Legal teams to help Airwallex grow responsibly and with confidence. This is a team where you’ll tackle complex, high-impact challenges, shape how risk is managed at a global fintech, and help build the foundations for long-term scale.

What you'll do

As Senior Director, Enterprise Risk Management, you will shape and scale Airwallex’s enterprise risk management capability across the US and EMEA, helping ensure risk management is a strategic enabler of growth rather than a check-the-box exercise. You will translate Board-approved risk appetite into practical decision-making, strengthen governance and reporting, guide major product and organization changes, and help the company stay resilient as it grows across markets, products, and regulatory environments. You will work closely with the Chief Regulatory and Compliance Officer and senior leaders across the business to turn complex risk signals into clear action, while building a strong and practical risk culture across the organization.

This role is based in the US or EMEA.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the evolution of Airwallex’s enterprise risk architecture, including risk appetite, taxonomy, governance standards, escalation protocols, and enterprise-wide oversight, ensuring the framework remains aligned with business strategy and global growth priorities.

  • Translate complex risk data, issues, and trends into clear, decision-useful reporting for the C-suite, Board committees, and external stakeholders, and act as a trusted independent advisor who can challenge initiatives that exceed approved risk appetite or outpace control maturity.

  • Oversee risk-informed change governance for new products, new markets, major systems changes, and structural changes, ensuring governance supports business velocity while maintaining effective control standards and clear accountability for remediation of material issues.

  • Own and continue to strengthen the enterprise crisis management framework, including escalation triggers, governance, and executive response mechanisms, while improving preparedness for severe but plausible events across operational, regulatory, technology, and business domains.

  • Drive a unified, risk-aware culture across the organisation by championing consistent adoption of enterprise risk standards, reinforcing first line ownership, and promoting risk management as a shared responsibility and competitive advantage.

  • Build and lead a high-performing global second line team, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Commercial, Compliance, Legal, Treasury, Finance, and regional leadership to support Airwallex’s next phase of scale with more data-driven and technology-enabled risk oversight.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Law, STEM, or another relevant quantitative field.

  • 10 to 15+ years of experience in risk management, operational risk, enterprise risk, compliance, controls, or audit within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or another highly regulated environment.

  • At least 5+ years leading enterprise risk management, operational risk, or governance programmes in a complex, matrixed, multi-jurisdiction organisation.

  • Proven experience designing, building, or scaling second line of defense frameworks, including risk appetite statements, risk taxonomies, governance processes, and escalation mechanisms.

  • Strong familiarity with the regulatory environment relevant to electronic money institutions and payments firms, including practical exposure to regulators such as the FCA, DNB, Bank of Lithuania, MAS, and FinCEN.

  • Demonstrated experience preparing risk papers and communicating effectively with senior executives, Board or committee audiences, regulators, or auditors, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Experience defining crisis or incident governance frameworks and leading or supporting executive-level response to material operational, regulatory, or business events.

  • A high-ownership, pragmatic approach, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities and significant cross-functional collaboration.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Advanced degree such as an MBA, Master’s in Risk Management, or JD.

  • Professional certification such as FRM, PRM, CRMA, CAMS, or CFE.

  • Deep fintech and payments experience, including exposure to cross-border payments, merchant acquiring, card scheme environments, local payment methods, or multi-entity regulated groups.

  • Experience managing risk approvals and governance in a high-velocity product and engineering environment, where new features, products, markets, or operating models are launched frequently.

  • Strong data literacy and comfort using dashboards, metrics, and technology-enabled tools to support risk oversight and reporting.

  • A clear bias toward automation, AI, and scalable tooling to improve issue management, reporting, and second line efficiency, paired with the judgment to balance innovation, business agility, and control effectiveness.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Senior Embedded Performance Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to hardware, moving across the stack, and solving the kinds of problems where milliseconds, bandwidth, startup time, and system efficiency matter.

You will work across the AuterionOS ecosystem on topics such as:

  • Embedded Linux performance and system tuning
  • Low-latency video streaming and media pipelines
  • C/C++, Python, and Bash-based platform development
  • Hardware integration, system profiling, and end-to-end optimization

  • Work within the Apps & Simulation team and collaborate with other development teams to build high-performance products for autonomous systems.
  • Design, optimize, and maintain performance-critical components within AuterionOS, Auterion’s custom embedded Linux distribution.
  • Improve end-to-end system behavior across compute, networking, video, and hardware interfaces, with a strong focus on latency, throughput, reliability, and resource efficiency.
  • Analyze and optimize demanding workloads such as real-time telemetry, video streaming, media processing, and communication between distributed system components.
  • Investigate system bottlenecks across the full stack, from kernel and OS behavior to application-level code and tooling.

title: Senior Embedded Rust Firmware Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Our firmware team is growing, and we are looking for a senior engineer to take the lead on core parts of it. You'll own major parts of the embedded Rust firmware at the heart of the BMS, deliver features end to end on your own and help shape how the firmware is built. Together with Stefan, our CTO, and our embedded Rust engineer, you'll take on architecture decisions and code reviews and help take us from a tested prototype to a fully certified product. The technology is proven, the funding is secured, and the foundations you set now will define how every future Anori BMS works.

Start date: from January 1, 2027

What You'll Do

  • Own, design, implement and ship firmware features for the BMS, from requirement to verified release

  • Extend our middleware and independent modules into one real-time system: their control and data flow, scheduling and how they stay predictable under load

  • Mentor other engineers on the team, lead code reviews and raise the bar for code quality across the team

  • Set and evolve the engineering practices that keep the firmware trustworthy: testing, CI/CD, HiL, coverage and end-to-end requirements traceability

  • Debug and trace on real hardware across ARM and RISC-V cores, down to interrupt priorities, the memory map and timing of individual functions

What You Bring

Must have

  • Several years of production Rust on embedded targets (no_std), including features you designed and shipped yourself

  • Experience making, documenting and defending architecture trade-offs for embedded systems

  • A quality mindset: hands-on test experience, CI and coverage as everyday tools, and code reviews with constructive feedback.

  • Critical, analytical, systematic thinking: you reason from first principles, make your assumptions explicit and challenge existing paradigms

Strongly preferred

  • Deep embedded experience incl. async Rust on embedded targets, down to the executor: futures, wakers, pinning

  • Architecture of multicore and multi-controller systems: the partition of work, data and timing across cores and controllers

  • Hands-on debugging and tracing on ARM and RISC-V

  • Knowledge of various communication protocols and stacks: CAN, LIN, BLE, LTE modems

  • Basic hardware skills: reading schematics, working with an oscilloscope, board bring-up, debugging

Nice to have

  • Formal methods for embedded software: model checking, or a proof of a scheduling or memory property

  • A background in safety-critical (IEC 61508, ISO 26262, …) and battery systems

  • Comfortable implementing numerical algorithms (filtering, state estimation) on constrained hardware

  • Experience mentoring other engineers

You might be a fit if

  • You want to be an active part in accelerating the energy transition in Europe

You also want to become an Anori? We cannot wait to meet you. Go and click the apply button. Don’t be shy, we are nice.

title: Senior Executive Assistant (PSA-3)
descriptionHtml:
United Nations University (UNU)

The United Nations University (UNU) is a global think tank and postgraduate teaching organization within the United Nations System. UNU engages in policy-relevant research, capacity development, and knowledge dissemination in furtherance of the purposes and principles of the United Nations. The work of UNU contributes to solving pressing global problems that are the concern of the United Nations and its Member States. 

For the past five decades, UNU has been a source of impartial research on sustainability, human security, and economic development. With hundreds of researchers working at institutes in 12 countries, UNU's expertise spans the full breadth of the 17 Sustainable Development Goals, generating policy-relevant knowledge to effect positive global change. UNU collaborates closely with other UN entities and leading research institutions across the globe. For more information, please visit http://unu.edu.

The United Nations University Vice-Rectorate in Europe (UNU-VIE), established in 2007 in Bonn, Germany, is one of two UNU Vice-Rectorates and the only one located in Europe. It supports the institutional development of UNU, facilitates collaboration across UNU and the UN, as well as fosters strategic partnerships - particularly with the Global South - and shares knowledge and expertise through the development of joint activities and projects. In addition, UNU-VIE conducts frontier research reinforcing existing UNU programming and supporting the implementation of key UN priorities. More information about UNU-VIE can be found here: https://unu.edu/vie.

.

Responsibilities

1.  Manage appointments and mission travel for the Vice-Rector/Director of UNU-EHS and Deputy Director, if required

3.    Support logistical arrangements for institutional meetings and events

  • Support the identification of possible venues on and off campus for the respective events;

  • Manage the booking of UNU Bonn’s conference and meeting rooms and respond to participant requests.

4.     Provide support with general office administration

  • Update and maintain an overview of all institutional contacts;

  • Procure office supplies for the Office of the Vice-Rector/Director;

5.     Perform other duties as assigned by supervisor

Key Performance Indicators

  • Timely and accurate coordination of calendars, appointments and official travel arrangements;

  • Timely response to internal and external enquiries, including an appropriate choice of language to the respective audience;

  • Accurate, clear and timely preparation of correspondence/written documents, such as letters, briefing notes, meeting minutes, ppt presentations and others;

  • Effective assistance with logistical arrangements for meetings and institutional events;

  • Timely updating, completeness and accuracy of institutional archives and the contact database, including records of key partners, key stakeholders and other relevant institutional contacts;

Competencies

Values:

  • Integrity - Act ethically, demonstrating the standards of conduct of the United Nations and taking prompt action in case of witnessing unprofessional or unethical behaviour, or any other breach of UN standards;

  • Humility - Demonstrate self-awareness and willingness to learn from others;

  • Humanity - Act according to the purposes of the United Nations: peace, dignity and equality on a healthy planet.

Behaviours:

  • Analyse and Plan - Seek out and use data from a wide range of sources to understand problems, inform decision-making, propose evidence-based solutions and plan action;

  • Deliver Results with Positive Impact - Hold oneself and others accountable for delivering results and making a positive difference to the people and causes that the United Nations serves;

  • Learn and Develop - Pursue own learning and development and contribute to the learning and development of others;

title: Senior Financial Crime Analyst
descriptionHtml:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | £59,500 - £80,500 + Benefits ✨| ℹ️ 12 Month Fixed-Term Contract

Our Financial Crime team ⭐

Our Financial Crime Collective helps keep Monzo and our customers safe by building effective, proportionate controls that protect against financial crime while delivering great customer outcomes.

We’re looking for a Senior Financial Crime Analyst to join our Actions Squad. You’ll be a subject matter expert across key financial crime controls, taking ownership of complex problems and helping us continuously improve how our controls operate across both Monzo Bank Limited (MBL) and Monzo Bank Europe (MBEU).

This is a role with plenty of ownership and cross-functional exposure. You’ll work closely with teams across Financial Crime, Operations, Product and Engineering, using data and your financial crime expertise to identify risks, strengthen controls and shape longer-term improvements.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

  • Owning our global risk controls for Exit & Defunds, Law Enforcement and Acceptable Use Standard, with end-to-end oversight of BAU performance across MBL and MBEU.
  • Developing and improving control documentation and standards, balancing financial crime risk, operational efficiency and customer experience.
  • Using data and trend analysis to monitor control effectiveness, identify emerging threats and spot opportunities to strengthen our controls.
  • Making sure we have appropriate financial crime control coverage as Monzo launches new products and expands into new areas.
  • Identifying and prioritising material risks, escalating these clearly to leadership alongside practical, evidence-based recommendations.
  • Owning the investigation and remediation of incidents within your control areas and partnering with other Control Owners to resolve high-impact issues.
  • Acting as a domain expert for your areas, providing technical guidance, sharing knowledge and helping build capability across the wider Financial Crime Collective.
  • Leading cross-functional initiatives across Product, Operations and Engineering, building shared understanding and influencing teams towards compliant and customer-focused solutions.
  • Taking on Nominated Approver and Financial Crime Floater responsibilities.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You have strong financial crime and regulatory compliance expertise and are comfortable acting as a subject matter expert within your domain.
  • You’re confident using data to understand control performance, identify weaknesses and make evidence-based recommendations — experience with tools such as Looker would be useful.
  • You’re comfortable independently assessing and prioritising complex financial crime risks, making proportionate decisions and escalating material issues when needed.
  • You communicate clearly and can adapt your approach for different audiences, from operational and technical teams through to senior leaders.
  • You’re great at working cross-functionally and can build strong relationships across teams such as Product, Operations and Engineering to influence outcomes without relying on formal authority.
  • You’re comfortable managing a complex portfolio and competing priorities, while maintaining a high bar for quality and proactively identifying opportunities to improve how we work.


🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £59,500 - £80,500

ℹ️ Please note this will be a 12 month fixed-term-contract

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. 

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.


🌈 The application journey has 3 steps...

  • 20 min call with the recruiter
  • Intro call with the Hiring Manager
  • 2 hours of technical and behavioural interviews

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! 

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. 

#LI-OS1 #LI-REMOTE

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

title: (Senior) Frontend Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Looking for a new adventure? You’ve come to the right place.

We're an Amsterdam-based team of 90+ (and counting) with 25+ nationalities amongst us! A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. And we have something important in common (other than our very well-worn passports): We want to change the way people travel.

And that's exactly what we're doing, with the travel app to plan, track, and relive trips in a smart and beautiful way.

Polarsteps has over 20 million users already, but, for us, this is just the beginning. We have big plans for the future, and so we need even more talented and enthusiastic people to help us on our journey.

Want to know more about us? Here you go.

Your expedition: Frontend Engineering at Polarsteps

We’re a small team, doing big things.

If you haven't seen our app yet, go ahead and check it out; you'll see that we care (a lot) about providing a seamless, top-quality user experience for every one of our travelers. And it is this that has got us ratings of 4.8 and 4.7 on the app stores (where we’ve been featured multiple times). But it doesn’t stop there: not only did Google create this awesome video about us, but we’ve been mentioned in two of Apple’s WWDC keynote speeches!

We’ve got an impressive past, but we’re even more excited for the future, and the impact you can make from day one is huge, with everything you ship affecting more than 23 million users. Even with that in mind, we believe in truly giving our team members the freedom they need to craft to perfection while encouraging a practical mindset to avoid under- or over-engineering mishaps.

We are seeing enthusiastic and accelerated growth of the travel industry, and with that comes both opportunities and growing pains. So, if you enjoy creating thoughtful user experiences, obsessing over performance and polish, and solving the challenges that come with building a product used by millions, you're in for a lot of fun with us.

Your itinerary

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day.

You will:

  • Work on all things at the forefront of our beautiful and complex web app, and create new features that will impact millions of users.

  • Help our Product team by creating prototypes and sharing your knowledge.

  • Build fun internal tools like our teleporter.

  • Take part in daily interactions with product managers, designers, other engineers, and the rest of our team, we believe in a deeply collaborative environment.

  • Proactively improve the resiliency, maintainability, and scalability of our platform, addressing technical debt when needed or, even better, preventing it when it makes sense.

The equipment in your backpack

What we’re hoping you’ll bring with you.

✅ 5-7+ years of a strong frontend background. We work with React and Typescript and would love it if you are familiar with them, or a similar technology.

✅ A pragmatic approach to solving the problem at hand. You shouldn’t be scared of tackling big challenges in automated testing, optimizing performance or developing new features.

✅ You use AI tools daily to move faster, but never to skip understanding. You can explain, defend and debug every line you ship, whether you wrote it or an AI did.

✅ A history of working on intuitive and beautiful front-end solutions

✅ Experience working in an Agile team environment.

✅ A keen eye on User Experience

Bonus points for Tanstack, Playwright, Python, Node.js ✨

1st class extras

Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet.

  • Salary range: Between EUR 68.000 - 80.000 (medior level) and EUR 84.000 and 99.000 gross per year incl 8% holiday allowance (based on 40 hours/week). Where you land in the range depends on your experience and skills, to be evaluated during the interview process.

  • Equity: You'll be able to participate in our Polarsteps SAR Plan.

  • A yearly free flight or train to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here.

  • A shiny new MacBook to work your magic on.

  • Hybrid working. Split your time between the office and your home, as you see fit.

  • An extensive home office set-up, everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk.

  • 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you).

  • Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you, but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar.

  • The option to switch up your zoom background by working from another country for up to 8 weeks a year.

  • A personal development budget for that curious mind of yours!

  • A pension plan to help you save for those around-the-world retirement trips.

  • Delicious daily office lunches.

  • Awesome monthly parties, as well as team trips away.

  • A lively office in downtown Amsterdam, with travel costs reimbursed.

  • Free Polarsteps Travel Books to contain all your far-flung adventures.

At Polarsteps, we believe the best products are built by people as diverse as the travelers using our apps! That's why we specifically encourage people underrepresented in the tech industry to apply for a role with us. Because we believe that diversity, be it age, race, sexual orientation, physical ability, ethnicity, or gender identity, makes both the world and the workplace better.

descriptionHtml:

HappyOps entwickelt moderne Softwarelösungen für mittelständische Industrieunternehmen in Europa. Qualifikation

  • Du denkst pragmatisch, lernst schnell und hast Freude daran, komplexe technische Herausforderungen gemeinsam mit Kunden und dem Team zu lösen.

  • Du kannst technische Entscheidungen fundiert begründen, bringst eigene Ideen ein und bist gleichzeitig offen für neue Perspektiven und konstruktives Feedback.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, hast einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch und behältst auch in dynamischen Projekten den Überblick.

  • Du hast Freude an der engen Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden sowie mit unserem Gründungsteam und möchtest die technische Zukunft von HappyOps aktiv mitgestalten.

Benefits

title: Senior GTM Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Strava

Strava is the app for active people. With over 200 million athletes in more than 185 countries, it’s more than tracking workouts—it’s where people make progress together, from new habits to new personal bests. No matter your sport or how you track it, Strava’s got you covered. Find your crew, crush your goals, and make every effort count. Start your journey with Strava today.

Our mission is simple: to motivate people to live their best active lives. We believe in the power of movement to connect and drive people forward.

About the Role

The Strava for Business team partners with the world's leading brands and agencies to inspire active communities and connect with athletes in meaningful ways. Our sponsorship solutions offer an innovative alternative to traditional advertising — rooted in motivation, community, and real-world impact.

We're growing fast and quote-to-cash rigor is the foundation of that growth. Today, the individual stages of our commercial process have clear owners across Sales, Creative Solutions, Partner Marketing Science, Legal, Product and Finance. The gap is in how those stages work together end to end.

This role sits within GTM Strategy & Operations, reporting into the Global Lead of the function.

This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role. You'll work at the intersection of all teams that are involved in our quote-to-cash process. This is a role for someone who excels in taking complex go-to-market problems, redesign the underlying process and drive change across teams, systems and ways of working.

We follow a flexible hybrid model that translates to more than half of your time on-site in our London, UK office — three days per week.

What You'll Do

• Own and improve quote-to-cash. Map the end-to-end commercial journey, identify bottlenecks and redesign processes so deals move cleanly from opportunity through delivery and revenue recognition.

• Lead cross-functional quote-to-cash transformation. Work across Sales, Partner Marketing Science, Creative solutions, Legal, Finance, IT and Product to solve problems that sit between functions and drive improvements through to completion.

• Integrate new products and capabilities. Make sure new propositions can be quoted, contracted, delivered, reported, invoiced and recognised cleanly before they scale.

• Improve business systems and handoffs. Design better workflows across the commercial stack, including HubSpot, Ironclad, delivery tooling, billing and revenue systems. Ensure data, ownership and approvals move cleanly between them.

• Build operational visibility. Establish the KPIs, reporting and escalation mechanisms needed to understand where the commercial engine is working - and where it is not.

• Own the transformation roadmap. Help make the operating model real by ensuring global design is informed by regional and XFN teams needs and can be deployed effectively.

What You’ll Bring to the Team

• Minimum 5+ years of relevant experience in quote-to-cash, revenue productivity, commercial learning, go-to-market enablement, strategy and operations, product operations, program management or a closely related field.

• Experience leading complex cross-functional programmes with multiple teams, systems and senior stakeholders.

• A proactive mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity, drive and execute initiatives, and deliver results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

• Comfort operating in a builder environment — you're not inheriting a playbook; you're helping create it. You thrive with autonomy, move quickly through ambiguity, and are energised by building from zero.

• Ability to map complex processes, identify root causes and design simpler, scalable operating models.

• Strong communication, stakeholder management, and storytelling skills, with comfort presenting recommendations and direction to stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines.

• A detail-oriented, methodical, and process-driven mentality that is focused on both accuracy and efficiency.

• Demonstrated ability to operate at the intersection of Sales, Product, Legal, Finance, and regional teams, with strong influence in a matrixed environment.

Ideally, You'll Also Bring

• Experience in adtech, media, advertising platforms or digital partnerships, with an understanding of the operational complexity behind deal delivery, measurement, creative operations, contracting and revenue recognition.

• Familiarity with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot), Asana, Ironclad.

What Success Looks Like

• The end-to-end commercial process is documented and ownership is clear.

• The biggest quote-to-cash bottlenecks have been identified and materially removed.

• Critical handoffs between teams and systems are more reliable and measurable.

• New products can enter the commercial process without bespoke workarounds.

• Leadership has a clear view of operational health and where intervention is needed.

• GTM operations are built ahead of the business's growth rather than catching up with it.

For information on benefits, please click here.

Why Join Us?

Movement brings us together. At Strava, we’re building the world’s largest community of active people, helping them stay motivated and achieve their goals.

Our global team is passionate about making movement fun, meaningful, and accessible to everyone. Whether you’re shaping the technology, growing our community, or driving innovation, your work at Strava makes an impact.

When you join Strava, you’re not just joining a company—you’re joining a movement. If you’re ready to bring your energy, ideas, and drive, let’s build something incredible together.

Strava builds software that makes the best part of our athletes’ days even better. Just as we’re deeply committed to unlocking their potential, we’re dedicated to providing a world-class, inclusive workplace where our employees can grow and thrive, too. We’re backed by Sequoia Capital, TCV, Madrone Partners and Jackson Square Ventures, and we’re expanding in order to exceed the needs of our growing community of global athletes. Our culture reflects our community. We are continuously striving to hire and engage teammates from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives because we know we are a stronger team together.

descriptionHtml:
Support Analyst, London

Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) operates a global portfolio of lifestyle brands focused on creating places and experiences that bring people together. The company designs, develops, and operates hospitality-driven destinations to host gatherings of all kinds, ranging from small corporate meetings to immersive brand activations and beyond. We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team.

We are looking for a Support Analyst to join our Corporate Technology team in London. You will support a range of systems across the breadth of our ecosystem. You will be the first point of contact for our employees when technology gets in the way of their work, covering everything from laptops and login issues to first-line support for the business systems our teams rely on every day.

This is a hands-on, people-facing role. Our hospitality and workplace experience is award winning, and the technology behind it has to be just as dependable. You will resolve the majority of issues yourself, escalate cleanly and quickly when you cannot, and help us spot the patterns worth solutioning.

You will work alongside IT, Network, Software, and Infrastructure engineers, and you will have real visibility into how a global technology organisation is run.

This role is based out of our beautiful and brand new London office at 200 Aldersgate St (5 days a week on site).

Please note: candidates must currently reside in the UK and be able to work in the UK without sponsorship.

What You’ll Do:

  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues across macOS and Windows endpoints, Google Workspace, Salesforce, Okta, Active Directory, and other Convene business systems.
  • Provide first-line (L1) support for business applications: access and permissions questions, basic configuration, data corrections, and triage of functional issues before they reach system owners.
  • Triage, prioritise, and manage tickets in our service desk, keeping requesters informed at every stage.
  • Coordinate escalations to L2 and L3 support, engineering, vendors, and other functions across the business, tracking dependencies through to resolution rather than handing them off.
  • Meet individual and team KPIs for response time, resolution time, and customer satisfaction.
  • Execute technical onboarding for new starters and offboarding for leavers, including account provisioning, device build and assignment, and access reviews.
  • Handle sensitive identity changes with care and accuracy, for example legal name changes across ADP, Okta, and downstream systems.
  • Follow defined protocols for urgent deactivations and security incidents to protect company and client data.
  • Maintain device compliance, patching, and configuration through our MDM platform.
  • Support badge and physical access platforms alongside our Security and Workplace teams.
  • Contribute to root cause analysis for recurring and high-impact incidents, and capture the detail the team needs to automate repetitive work.
  • Write and maintain knowledge base articles and runbooks in Confluence so employees can self-serve and colleagues can pick up where you left off.
  • Explore new tools and approaches, and tell us when you have found something better.

What We Look For: 

  • 3+ years in a technical support, help desk, or IT operations role.
  • Strong hands-on troubleshooting across macOS and Windows.
  • Working knowledge of Okta (or a comparable IdP), Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and Active Directory.
  • Experience supporting SaaS business applications such as Salesforce, including user administration and access management.
  • Experience with a ticketing platform (Jira Service Management or similar) and a documentation tool such as Confluence.
  • Clear, patient written and verbal communication with non-technical colleagues at every level, including senior stakeholders and clients.
  • Sound judgement about when to solve, when to ask, and when to escalate.

What's nice to have: 

  • Endpoint protection platforms (Sophos Central or equivalent) and MDM/UEM tooling (Omnissa Workspace ONE, Intune, Jamf).
  • Basic scripting or automation (PowerShell, Bash, Python) or experience with no-code automation in Jira or Okta Workflows.
  • Experience in hospitality, events, professional services, or another environment where the client is in the room.
  • Relevant certifications (CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, Okta Certified Professional, Microsoft 365 Fundamentals).

Community and Impact

Convene is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and we believe that diverse teams are the best teams. title: Senior Infrastructure Manager
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Manager who is, first and foremost, a people leader.

In this role, your primary responsibility is the health, performance, and career growth of your engineering team. While you must possess a solid technical background to understand the challenges your team faces, your day-to-day focus will not be hands-on technical work. Instead, you will use your experience to remove blockers, guide decision-making, and ensure your engineers have the environment they need to succeed.

The Team You Will Lead

You will lead the Infrastructure Solutions team within the wider Technical Operations department. Your engineers are responsible for building the environment, delivering projects as requested by Engineering and Product, and ensuring we remain available, scalable, and secure. They are not responsible for the BAU function of the platforms that is managed by another team within Technical Operations. The Infrastructure Solutions team takes a concept or idea and makes that into a reality within the boundaries and constraints of our platforms.

You will be managing a team of engineers who individually possess experience in:

  • On-Premise Linux systems, Container solutions, Debian packaging, Ansible, data streaming and queuing technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
  • Advanced database management knowledge (MySQL, Postgres) in replicated environments.
  • Physical Network management, with an on-prem estate that is Juniper focused.
  • Cloud environments: GCP and AWS
  • Platform engineer focused on building, maintaining and supporting an Internal Developer Platform (CI/CD)

The Operational Reality

It is important to be transparent about the environment you are joining. We operate at high velocity with a broad and complex technology estate. However, we are a lean team, not a giant corporation with endless resources.

  • Context Switching is the Norm
    • You will rarely have the luxury of focusing on a single task for weeks at a time. You will be required to shift focus multiple times a week, and sometimes multiple times a day, as business priorities evolve.
  • Agility over Silos
    • Because we are a lean team, we wear many hats. You must be comfortable pivoting from a strategic discussion to an operational challenge without losing momentum.
  • Focus Management
    • Success in this role requires the ability to maintain high standards while navigating a workload that changes dynamically. This is not a role for those who prefer a slow, singular focus; it is for those who thrive on variety, pace, and solving complex problems in real-time.
