title: Software Engineer II - Code Context
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Software Engineer

Location: London, UK

Join Code Context, a team helping to shape the future of AI-powered work at Deliveroo, DoorDash, and Wolt. You'll solve challenging technical problems and build tools that help employees work smarter, move faster, and deliver better outcomes across a global business serving millions of customers, riders, and partners.

Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll join an engineering-led team focused on a fundamental challenge in AI-assisted software development: giving coding agents the right context to work effectively. As a Software Engineer on the Code Context team, you’ll build developer tooling and infrastructure that connects AI agents with the knowledge, systems, and workflows they need. Your work will help every employee across Deliveroo, DoorDash, and Wolt make better use of AI in their day-to-day work.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Build Developer Tooling: Design, build, and maintain the infrastructure and tooling that make relevant context accessible to AI coding agents across complex codebases and workflows.
  • Own Technical Projects: Independently take technical projects from design through delivery and adoption, evaluating approaches, making sound technical decisions, and measuring their impact. Contribute to the team's technical direction in a fast-moving AI landscape.
  • Build for Reliability & Scale: Ensure the systems behind our developer tooling remain reliable, performant, and secure as adoption grows. Use observability, feedback, and real-world usage to identify issues and continuously improve the developer experience.
  • Collaborate & Influence: Work closely with engineering teams and stakeholders across Deliveroo, DoorDash, and Wolt to understand their challenges, identify opportunities, and drive adoption of AI-powered tooling.
  • Support Peers & Grow: Share technical knowledge, provide constructive feedback, help unblock colleagues, and contribute to engineering interviews and hiring as the team grows.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine – Query Engine
descriptionHtml:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.

In this role, you'll own the query engine that searches hundreds of billions of claims across a variety of retrieval backends, from a distributed graph database to vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial indexes.

This is greenfield work with a massive scope. No off-the-shelf system answers precise questions over hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims at agent speed, so you'll make foundational decisions, from storage layout and indexing across engines to the query language and the planner that routes work between them, that every query depends on.

What you'll do

  • Own storage and indexing across backends: data layout, partitioning and indexes for graph, vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval, with bulk snapshot builds and live ingest that never take the system down.

  • Decide how best to search: cost-based planning from cardinality estimates that chooses, for each question, which backends to use, in what order and how to join their results, executed as traversals, retrievals, filters and aggregations in one plan.

  • Make it fast at scale: serve thousands of queries per second, profiling and cutting p50/p99 latency, memory and cost per query under high concurrent load, from on-disk layout to network fan-out.

  • Keep answers consistent while the data converges: the graph is fed by live updates and bulk snapshots at once and is eventually consistent by design, so you'll own what a query may see while it converges: consistent snapshot promotion, ordered application of live updates and stable pagination across versions.

  • Measure precision and completeness: end-to-end checks every deployment must pass, plus evals and metrics that show when a plan returns wrong results or misses ones it should have found.

What we're looking for

  • You've worked deep inside a distributed database, query engine, search engine or storage system.

  • Strong grasp of indexing, query planning and optimization, and storage formats.

  • Solid grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: consensus, replication, sharding and fault tolerance.

  • Strong in a systems language (Go, Rust or C++).

  • You profile before you optimize, and you've shipped measured latency wins in production.

  • You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale.

Bonus

  • Graph databases, or combining vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval

  • Compilers, query language design or cost-based optimizers

Example projects

  • Build a system that retrieves and reasons over everything known about any company or person in the world, answering any factual question precisely and completely.

  • Answer precise multi-hop questions over hundreds of billions of claims at thousands of QPS with interactive latency.

  • Build a planner that picks the right mix of graph, vector, full-text and geospatial retrieval for any question, and proves it chose well.

  • Make new knowledge queryable seconds after it's synthesized, without ever serving an inconsistent result.

Logistics

  • Location: This is an in-person opportunity in Zurich.

  • Visas: We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3). While we cannot guarantee your visa, we have historically been successful in sponsoring candidates from all over the world. If you receive an offer, our team will work hard to get you a visa.

  • Benefits: We offer premium healthcare benefits (medical, dental, vision), fertility benefits, 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, and a monthly wellness stipend to all of our employees.

title: Solutions Engineer - German Speaker
descriptionHtml:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

The Role

We’re hiring Solutions Engineers to build Synthesia’s pre-sales function for the DACH region. This is a founding role: you’ll be one of the first SEs, shaping the playbook, tooling and best practices as we scale, not following an established model. If you’re someone who is excited by building whilst scaling, we’d love to hear from you.

As a Solutions Engineer at Synthesia, you will partner with Account Executives, Customer Success and Product Marketing to run discovery, deliver demos, scope POCs and design the technical solution for each deal. You will be a trusted advisor focused on the value customers get from Synthesia, and you’ll take what you learn in the field back to Product.

This is an incredible opportunity to join us as we become a multi-product company for the first time, and continue to scale across DACH.

What You'll Do

  • Co-plan and support discovery calls with your AE to understand customer requirements, technical environment, and business challenges.

  • Design and execute repeatable demo methodologies that prove Synthesia's business value quickly, whether the customer is deploying Studio at scale, building Roleplay Sessions for skill uplift, or integrating Interactive Avatars into their product.

  • Build and maintain strong working knowledge of Synthesia's platform capabilities, roadmap, and positioning across all product lines, so you can speak to the use cases that drive value

  • Deliver demonstrations that speak to customer problems and tell a credible story of why Synthesia is the right solution.

  • Identify technical objections and integration questions as they come up, working with your AE and the broader ecosystem to find a path forward.

  • Contribute your assessment of technical fit and opportunity risk to help your AE shape account and deal strategy.

  • Keep your deal team and manager informed on deal status, timeline, and technical dependencies.

  • Identify, build relationships with, and actively enable technical champions within customer organizations so they can advocate for Synthesia internally.

  • Provide technical guidance on platform capabilities, API and SDK integrations, security, compliance topics (SOC 2, GDPR, enterprise identity), and scalability for global deployments, troubleshooting issues and validating integrations with LMS, HCM, and content systems as they surface.

  • Partner with Enablement to complete certifications, stay current on new releases, and keep your demo and objection-handling skills sharp.

     

We’d love to hear from you if you have

  • 2+ years of pre-sales, solutions engineering, or customer-facing technical experience in a SaaS environment (or equivalent technical customer-facing experience).

  • Delivers a strong standard demo aligned to the discovery points and agenda set with the AE, with a solid grasp of core demo technique (e.g., Tell-Show-Tell).

  • Applies established solution designs and best practices to the customer's use case, working with core ecosystem functions (Product, Customer Success) as the deal requires.

  • Identifies and surfaces deal risk and next steps based on what the customer tells you, escalating clearly to your AE so it gets actioned.

  • Working knowledge of MEDDPICC and Command of the Message, and can articulate why Synthesia is a fit for the prospect.

  • Resourceful: knows how to find the right person or tool internally, and is building their own network across the GTM organization.

  • Comfortable with the technical fundamentals in at least one area (creation flows, APIs, integrations, security, compliance) and eager to build depth quickly.

  • Self-motivated and organized, able to manage a growing book of POCs, demos, and customer conversations while hitting deadlines.

  • Willing to travel for customer discovery and on-site demos as needed.

  • You like staying ahead of the AI-native learning and enablement space, so you can credibly discuss how customers are shifting from static methods to interactive practice and measurable skill development.

  • Strong written and spoken communication in English and German

 

We'd be particularly excited if

  • Like working in a fast pace environment

  • Can also speak Spanish and or Italian

  • Based in Munich or London so you can spend time in our offices. This is a hybrid role, with 2-3 days a week in the office.

 

Compensation

We offer a competitive salary, equity and benefits. Your offer will reflect your experience, skills and the scope of the role.

title: Speaking ops and Trade partnerships specialist - Communication
descriptionHtml:
H Company is an AI research and product company building autonomous agents for the enterprise. We combine proprietary models (Holo), computer-use agents, an orchestration platform and hands-on engineering into a single system designed for production use. Our agents operate any software the way a person does, with no API and no rebuilt stack. They rank #1 on OSWorld-Verified, the leading computer-use benchmark. We were born in Paris, with offices in London, New York and San Francisco. Our team of 100+ researchers and engineers work with enterprises on three continents.

Mission

Put H’s leaders and researchers on the right stages, and build the event and trade partnerships that give H a voice with the audiences that matter: enterprise buyers, investors, policymakers and the AI community. You will own our speaking programme end to end, from first invitation to post-event follow-up.

Responsibilities

  • Run H’s speaking programme:, starting with managing every inbound invitation and distributing them across leaders

  • Proactively pitch H speakers to the right conferences, and keep a clear calendar for our CEO, COO, product and research leaders.

  • Assess each event against clear criteria (audience quality, prestige, format, media reach, strategic fit and geography) and give leadership a recommendation they can decide on quickly.

  • Build and manage relationships with conference organisers, speaker bureaus, trade associations and media partners across France, the UK, the US and the rest of Europe.

  • Negotiate and manage event and trade partnerships, from speaking slots and sponsorships to co-hosted events and media partnerships, working with Marketing and Sales on budget and return.

  • Prepare our speakers for every appearance: bios, talking points, briefing notes, Q&A prep, logistics and audience background.

  • Keep every commitment. Confirm early, plan replacements in advance, and never cancel or downgrade a speaking slot at the last minute without leadership’s decision.

  • Turn each event into value: coordinate with Social and Content on coverage, with Sales on meetings and leads, and with the team on thank-you notes and follow-up.

  • Keep the speaking pipeline, partner contacts and event outcomes up to date in one source of truth, and report on what worked.

Requirements & Outcome

  • 2 to 6 years of experience in events, speaker management, partnerships, communications or business development, ideally in B2B tech, AI or a fast-growing startup.

  • Native-level English, with excellent written and spoken communication. French is a plus.

  • Strong relationship-building skills and comfort dealing with senior executives, organisers and agencies.

  • Highly organised, with attention to detail and reliable follow-through, since you will manage calendars and logistics across several time zones.

  • Good commercial judgement: you can weigh an opportunity, negotiate terms and say no politely.

  • A genuine interest in AI, and the ability to learn enough about our technology to brief a speaker and hold your own with organisers.

  • Nice to have: experience at a speaker bureau, conference or trade-show organiser, or in executive communications.

  • What success looks like: within [6 months], H has a clear, prioritised speaking calendar, every confirmed commitment is honoured, and our leaders appear on the stages that matter most for our customers and investors.

The H mindset: Ship fast, learn faster. Speak honestly, act kindly.

Requirements:

  • 2 to 6 years of experience in social media, content or communications, ideally in B2B tech, AI or a fast-growing startup.

  • Native-level English with excellent writing and storytelling. A portfolio of your work.

  • Real interest in AI, and the ability to explain complex technical topics to different audiences.

  • Experience running campaigns and using analytics to improve them: you have already created content that truly gained traction.

  • Comfort working across research, product, sales and leadership, and moving fast with little supervision.

  • Trustworthy: you will be working on the personal reputation of a senior executives.

  • Nice to have: short-form video editing, community experience with developers, French.

  • What success looks like: within 3 months, H Company has a clear editorial line, a regular publishing rhythm, and a visibly stronger, more engaged audience among our target enterprise and developer communities.

What this role is not

A freelance role, the role requires to be fully integrated to the teams.

A traditional community manager role focused on posting product updates three times a week. We are looking for someone who thinks strategically about reputation, brings original ideas, and understands the difference between visibility and impact.

Location

This role is based in Paris (Grands Boulevards). Our teams work across USA, France and the UK. This role is hybrid, and you are expected to be in the office 3 days a week on average.

What We Offer:

  • Join a European AI company at a pivotal moment, with real ownership over its public voice.

  • Direct access to leadership, the researchers and engineers building the technology.

  • Collaborative, multicultural team that works on AI and real life enterprise problems.

  • Competitive salary and equity.

  • Learning and growth, team hackathons, offsites and moments to celebrate wins together.

If you want to change the status quo in AI, join us.

title: Spécialiste Support Comptable (Télétravail complet possible depuis Amiens)
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière.

Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique comptable, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et tu cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et de cabinets à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.

- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.

- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.

- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.

- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

Compétences requises

- De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul(e) et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

- Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais.

- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

- Volonté d’apprendre et de rester à jour sur les évolutions du produit.

🤝 Process de recrutement

● Une première rencontre avec notre Talent Acquisition Manager (30 min)

● Un second entretien et un case study en direct avec un(e) Associate Team Lead (1h)

● Un entretien final avec un(e) Team Lead (45 min)

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

descriptionHtml:

title: Sr. Forward Deployed Engineer - FDE (Fullstack)
descriptionHtml:
CSQ427R397

As a Sr Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) you will work with customers to build and productionize solutions to their data & AI challenges using the Databricks platform. You will own the architecture, lead design decisions, and implement end-to-end systems spanning data engineering, AI, and application development. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations. FDEs deliver with customer empathy, integrating with client systems, training, and other technical needs to help customers get most value out of their data. 

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for builders who thrive at the intersection of technology and business impact. The ideal candidate combines engineering expertise with adaptability, curiosity, and a passion for working with customers and teammates to solve complex problems that drive measurable outcomes. FDEs are billable and know how to complete projects according to specification with exceptional customer empathy.

The impact you will have:

  • Production Solution Delivery: Lead impactful customer technical projects by delivering production-grade systems, designing and building reference architectures, custom applications and data ingestion and ML/AI model integration
  • Transformational Impact: Guide strategic customers as they implement transformational big data projects including end-to-end design, build and deployment of industry-leading big data and AI applications. Work with engagement managers to scope technical delivery work with input from the customer
  • Empower Customers: Guide customers on architecture and design; bootstrap or implement customer projects which leads to a customers' successful understanding, evaluation and adoption of Databricks.
  • Own the Architecture: Lead architecture and design decisions, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with both customer needs and Databricks best practices.
  • Work with the Databricks technical team, Project Manager, Architect and Customer team to ensure the technical components of the engagement are delivered to meet customer's needs.
  • Work with Engineering and Databricks Customer Support to provide product and implementation feedback and to guide rapid resolution for engagement specific product and support issues.
  • Customer Immersion: Embed with customer teams, engaging with stakeholders from technical ICs to executives to deeply understand challenges and deliver impact.
  • Reusable Assets & Scale: Contribute accelerators, frameworks, and best practices that scale impact across accounts and influence the Databricks product roadmap.

What we look for:

  • 6+ years experience in data engineering, data platforms & analytics, or software engineering
  • Comfortable writing code in either Python, Scala, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks
  • Working knowledge of two or more common Cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP) with expertise in at least one
  • Deep experience with distributed computing with Apache Spark™ and knowledge of Spark runtime internals
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for production deployments
  • Working knowledge of MLOps, ML/AI models and AI APIs
  • Design and deployment of performant production end-to-end data architectures and applications that combine data pipelines, ML/AI models, and user-facing interfaces.
  • Experience with technical project delivery - managing scope, timelines and measurable outcomes, translating complex concepts into actionable solutions.
  • Documentation and white-boarding skills.
  • Experience working with enterprise clients and managing conflicts across a broad stakeholder range
  • Build skills in technical areas, and demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and eagerness to explore new technologies which support the deployment and integration of Databricks-based solutions to complete customer projects.
  • Travel to customers 20% of the time

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. title: Sr. Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
P-1626

Senior Product Designer

At Databricks, we design tools that make complex data and AI workflows intuitive and powerful. Our mission is to simplify how data is connected, understood, and activated so organizations can turn information into business outcomes. Designers at Databricks combine strong visual craft with systems thinking. They shape products used by some of the most advanced data teams in the world, and increasingly by the business users and AI agents working alongside them.

We're hiring Product Designers to join our design team and own design for an area of the Databricks Platform. Teams span the platform, from data engineering and analytics to databases, apps, and AI agents. We match each designer to the area where their skills and interests will have the most impact. You'll design for both technical and business users of data, making powerful capabilities feel clear, controllable, and trustworthy for enterprise customers.

The impact you will have

  • Own your area end to end. Sharpen the problem, set the design direction, and carry the work from framing and interaction models through visual polish and shipped detail.
  • Set the quality bar. Make the critical design decisions in your area, review work from designers, PM, engineering, and AI tools, and have the hands-on skill to improve it yourself.
  • Advocate with evidence. Stay in regular contact with customers, choose research methods that fit the decision, and turn research into insights others can act on.
  • Show the experience got better. Define what success looks like for the key tasks users need to get done, and show the improvement through usability testing, research, and how people actually use what shipped.
  • Influence through the work. Move product and engineering decisions with prototypes, keep design reviews focused, and communicate clearly in writing and in person.
  • Prototype to explore and align. Use interactive prototypes as a primary thinking tool to explore ambiguous problems, reduce risk, and align the team on a direction.
  • Design directly in the codebase with coding agents. Use AI coding agents to ship well-scoped design changes alongside engineers, rather than handing off static mocks.
  • Define reusable UX principles. Create interaction patterns and frameworks other teams reuse, and drive consistency through a strong, cross-platform design system.
  • Raise the level of critique. Give and invite high-quality feedback, and help make clear decisions together with product and engineering.

What we look for

  • 5+ years of product design work experience.
  • A bachelor's or master's degree in design, computer science, human-computer interaction, or a related field.
  • A portfolio demonstrating your end-to-end design process, from inception to production.

title: Staff Data Analyst
descriptionHtml:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

The Role

We're hiring a Staff Data Analyst.

This is not a reporting-only role. Embedded day to day within our commercial team, you'll be responsible for the core metrics that matter to the business - conversion rate, contracted volume, total sales, and margins - building on the pipeline tracking, forecasting and partner reporting that already exists. Priorities are set jointly with commercial; performance and development sit with the Analytics Manager, who you'll report into.

As a staff analyst, you'll take ambiguous commercial questions, decide the right approach, and turn analysis into clear recommendations rather than just presenting numbers. Success isn't measured by dashboards shipped - it's measured by whether stakeholders have metrics they understand and trust, analysis that changes what people do, and a team that can increasingly self-serve the answers it needs.

Responsibilities

Pipeline & Revenue Forecasting Accuracy

  • Monitor the sales pipeline, catching and resolving cases where in-progress and confirmed revenue overlap or deals get double-counted.

  • Define and report on forecast accuracy against annual targets, setting the standard for how commercial metrics are tracked across the team.

  • Diagnose CRM data quality issues, such as parent-child asset relationships, that put pipeline and forecast reliability at risk.

Commercial Analysis & Insight

  • Carry out commercial opportunity sizing and partner performance analysis to support sales and leadership decisions.

  • Identify underperformance, emerging trends and risks in the pipeline before they surface in headline forecast numbers.

  • Serve as the voice of data for the commercial team, translating complex analysis, including retention and renewal trends, into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders.

Partnership & Storytelling

  • Work directly with commercial and sales stakeholders to understand what "good" looks like for their metrics, and translate that into clear, agreed definitions.

  • Translate complex data into clear, compelling stories that inspire action among non-technical stakeholders.

  • Increase data adoption across the commercial team so non-technical colleagues can self-serve for routine needs.

Requirements

Must haves

  • Solid SQL skills, used to investigate complex datasets across modern analytics stacks (e.g. dbt, Omni or similar BI tools).

  • Good commercial understanding, with an ability to connect analytical findings to revenue and margin outcomes.

  • Experience developing forecasts or scenario models, and explaining the drivers behind variance from actuals.

  • Ability to turn ambiguous stakeholder questions into well-defined analytical problems, and to present recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders.

  • Proven experience building trusted metrics or reporting from messy or inconsistent source data (e.g. CRM, transactional systems).

Bonus points

  • Experience in energy, fintech, or another commercially complex, data-heavy sector.

  • Python for deeper statistical or data-quality work.

  • Experience building metric frameworks that connect operational activity to commercial outcomes.

  • Familiarity with CRM systems and parent-child/account hierarchy data structures.

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

Interview Process

descriptionHtml:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

Data isn't a support function at Vibe, it's the fuel. Every decision about which ad reaches which household, and when, runs on it. You'll join the Data Platform team and specialize in identity, turning billions of raw events into coherent, usable entities that power targeting, measurement, and the training sets Vibe's models learn from. You'll report to the Head of Data Platform. This role exists because identity resolution at Vibe's scale is a hard, unsolved problem, and the team needs someone who can build models that catch the right signal across petabytes of events. You'll get direct, measurable impact: your work decides which ad reaches whom and whether it worked, not a metric buried in a research paper. You'll shape the roadmap for a system every team at Vibe depends on, and work on a problem that only gets more interesting as CTV scales.

What You'll Do

Identity Stack Ownership

  • Research and build algorithms that resolve coherent entities, like users and households, from billions of events

  • Turn machine learning, clustering, and statistical approaches into scalable, production-ready systems

  • Lead projects end-to-end, from stakeholder requirements through research, implementation, and post-launch iteration

  • Build platform-level identity-resolution tooling so every team can resolve identity behind their own events

  • Design for scale from the start; treat unscalable local tests as unfinished work

Cross-Team Partnership

  • Help shape and execute the roadmap for Vibe's identity stack

  • Surface tradeoffs, risks, and decisions to stakeholders without burying them in implementation detail

  • Translate ambiguous requests from Product, Sales, ML, and Finance into concrete deliverables

  • Collaborate with other ML engineers on MLOps problems

What You Need

  • 5+ years of experience as an ML engineer or data scientist building and operating production services

  • Experience operating at data scale, using tools like Dagster, Spark, or Iceberg

  • Familiarity with MLOps tooling and practices

  • A track record of leading technical projects end-to-end, from ambiguous requirements to shipped systems

  • Strong cross-functional communication skills, including adjusting detail level for your audience and pushing back constructively

  • Judgment about when to invest in abstraction and when to keep things simple

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in streaming TV advertising or programmatic advertising

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer

The pay range for this role is €99,000 - €171,000. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

  • Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You're building this; you should own part of it.

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect — no surprises, no ghosting.

  1. Recruiter screen — 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.

  2. Manager interview — Meet the person you'd work with directly.

title: Staff Security Operations Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Staff Security Operations Engineer to join our Cybersecurity team at Pleo. In this role, you'll define and deliver the SecOps roadmap, building the detection, response, and investigation capability that protects a fast-growing fintech. If you're excited about owning a security operations function end to end, from framework-based strategy through to the code that makes it run, then this is the opportunity for you!

 

Who you'll be working with and reporting to

You'll report to our VP of Fraud & Security and work closely with Fraud, DevSecOps, Engineering, and Risk & Compliance. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to protecting Pleo's customers and their money. You'll also have the chance to partner with teams across the organisation and to bring less experienced security engineers up with you as the function matures.

 

What you'll be doing

As a Staff Security Operations Engineer, you will:

  • Build and own a structured SecOps roadmap grounded in well-known frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, and CIS benchmarks.

  • Lead security investigations and digital forensics, from suspicious traffic through to full incident response, and bring the findings back into how we detect and prevent.

  • Design, tune, and scale our SIEM and logging pipeline through standardized log ingestion across services so signal isn't lost in the noise.

  • Strengthen our perimeter and authentication posture, including WAF configuration, authorisation tuning, and monitoring for suspicious traffic.

  • Protect sensitive data through DLP controls, and make sure the coverage matches where the data actually lives.

  • Improve our on-call rotation for the team, defining the alerting, escalation paths, and response SLAs that make it work.

  • Automate detection and response workflows, using code and AI to reduce manual toil and shorten time to resolution.

  • Reduce SecOps-attributed risk identified through compliance gaps, and collect the evidence that demonstrates it.

  • Build dashboards and reporting that give the team and leadership real visibility into response times, coverage, and risk reduction.

  • Work cross-functionally with engineers who don't have a security background, translating threat models into changes they can actually ship.

 

What you bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 10+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, or a closely related discipline, with a proven track record of materialised risk reduction through monetary impact, incidents contained, forensics that changed outcomes.

  • A strong development and engineering background. You are comfortable writing the automation, not just specifying it.

  • Hands-on SOC and SIEM management experience, including detection engineering and log pipeline design.

  • Experience in scale-up environments, where you've built capability rather than inherited a mature one.

  • A strong understanding of cloud architectures as we use AWS. With part of our estate on GCP and how infrastructure decisions shape detection and response.

  • Demonstrated experience using AI and/or coding automation to get security controls built, implemented, and operating in practice.

  • Fintech, payments, fraud, or trust & safety experience is a real advantage, as is exposure to highly regulated environments.

  • Backgrounds that tend to do well here: incident response, IR management, SOC engineering, security engineering, DevSecOps, red or blue team.

 

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You want a large blast radius. We have high-impact projects where the outcome shows up in real business metrics, at a pre-IPO company.

  • You're energised by building a function rather than maintaining one, and you'd rather set the roadmap than be handed it.

  • You enjoy raising the bar around you, growing a team of specialists and lifting the people already here.

  • You're equally at home in a threat model discussion and in an editor writing the automation that acts on it.

 

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You need a well-groomed backlog and assigned tasks in order to do your best work.

  • You'd rather stay purely strategic than get hands-on with the tooling.

  • You're not up for participating in an on-call rotation.

  

How you'll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

  • Get deep into Pleo's security landscape and our detection coverage, our logging estate, our cloud footprint to form your own view of where the biggest risks sit.

  • Publish a SecOps roadmap mapped to MITRE, NIST, and CIS, agree with Engineering, Risk & Compliance, and leadership, and start delivering against it.

  • Stand up the on-call rotation and the alert response SLAs that go with it.

  • Ship your first wave of detection and automation improvements, and establish the KPIs that show what changed.

 

We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills. There's genuine room here for the scope of this role to grow, including into people leadership.

 

The location

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

 

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25-28 days of holiday (depending on your location) + public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

 

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

 

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager interview: a 60-minute conversation covering your experience, how you approach security operations, and how you communicate.

  3. Technical deep dive: a 60-minute session with two of our SecOps engineers, going deep on SIEM, detection engineering, your coding and automation experience.

  4. Cross-functional interview: a 45-minute conversation with DevSecOps and Engineering leadership on how you work across team boundaries with other senior engineers.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Stage - Assistant(e) Digital Marketing, WordPress & SEO (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Samcea Voyages est une agence de voyages parisienne spécialisée dans la création et la commercialisation de voyages sur mesure.

Vous participerez principalement à l’administration, à l’enrichissement et à l’optimisation de plusieurs sites internet sous WordPress.

Vos missions pourront notamment comprendre :

  • effectuer un contrôle global des pages et de leur bon affichage sur ordinateur et mobile ;
  • vérifier la qualité, le format, le poids et la cohérence des photos présentes sur les sites ;
  • recadrer, redimensionner, compresser ou remplacer certains visuels ;
  • optimiser les noms de fichiers, les balises alternatives et les formats d’images ;
  • améliorer le référencement naturel directement dans WordPress ;
  • travailler les titres, métadonnées, URLs, mots-clés, liens internes et structures des contenus ;

En fonction de votre profil, vous pourrez également intervenir sur d’autres missions de marketing et de communication digitale :

  • rédaction et optimisation de contenus web ;
  • préparation de newsletters et de campagnes emailing ;
  • création et programmation de publications pour les réseaux sociaux ;
  • mise à jour de supports commerciaux ou de communication ;
  • analyse des performances des sites et des campagnes ;
  • veille concurrentielle et recommandations marketing ;
  • participation à différents projets digitaux de l’agence.

Requirements

Votre responsable direct ne sera pas présent quotidiennement dans les locaux de l’agence. Vous travaillerez avec lui principalement à distance, avec des points réguliers, des objectifs précis et un suivi des missions.

La directrice de l’agence sera présente sur place, mais ne sera pas votre responsable opérationnelle sur les sujets digitaux.

Ce stage nécessite donc une grande autonomie, une bonne organisation et la capacité à avancer seul(e) entre les différents points de suivi.

Profil recherché

Vous préparez actuellement un Master 1 ou un Master 2 en marketing digital, communication, webmarketing, e-commerce ou dans un domaine similaire.

Une première expérience concrète de WordPress est presque indispensable pour ce stage.

Vous êtes capable de :

  • créer et modifier des pages dans WordPress ;
  • travailler sur certains contenus en anglais.
  • intégrer et mettre en forme des contenus ;
  • gérer des images et vérifier leur affichage ;
  • comprendre la structure générale d’un site internet ;
  • utiliser les principales fonctionnalités d’un outil SEO sur WordPress ;
  • travailler avec rigueur sans supervision permanente ;
  • suivre plusieurs sujets en parallèle et respecter les priorités fixées.

Vous êtes également :

  • autonome, organisé(e) et responsable ;
  • attentif(ve) aux détails ;
  • force de proposition ;
  • capable de chercher une solution avant de solliciter de l’aide ;
  • à l’aise dans les échanges à distance ;
  • intéressé(e) par le marketing digital, le référencement naturel et l’univers du voyage ;

Des connaissances en SEO, HTML, CSS, optimisation d’images, responsive design, emailing, réseaux sociaux ou création graphique constitueront un véritable plus.

Benefits

Ce que nous proposons

  • des missions concrètes sur plusieurs sites et projets digitaux ;
  • une expérience complète mêlant WordPress, contenu, SEO et marketing digital ;
  • une réelle autonomie dans l’organisation du travail ;
  • des responsabilités adaptées à un profil de niveau Master ;
  • la possibilité de proposer et de mettre en œuvre des améliorations ;
  • une immersion dans l’univers du voyage et du tourisme ;
  • un stage au sein de notre agence située à Paris.

Merci de nous transmettre votre CV accompagné de quelques lignes présentant :

  • votre formation et votre niveau d’études ;
  • vos dates et votre durée de disponibilité ;
  • votre expérience concrète de WordPress ;

  • votre niveau en SEO et en marketing digital.

descriptionHtml:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Stage Public Affairs bij Burson

Wil jij ervaring opdoen op het snijvlak van politiek, media, bestuur en bedrijfsleven?

Burson staat voor strategie en communicatie, met adviseurs die door opdrachtgevers worden ingeschakeld als het er echt om gaat. Met ons ervaren team van specialisten opereren we op hoog strategisch niveau en helpen we bedrijven en organisaties door de meest complexe situaties: van het versterken of beschermen van reputaties tot het inspelen op veranderende wetgeving, het agenderen van politieke thema’s, het begeleiden van fusies en overnames, productintroducties of crisiscommunicatie. We zijn onderdeel van Burson Group, een internationaal communicatiebureau bestaande uit een groot netwerk met meer dan 95 kantoren in ruim 40 landen. Samen maken wij onderdeel uit van WPP: het grootste marketing- en communicatiebedrijf ter wereld. Sinds 2019 zijn wij onder één dak gevestigd op onze Amsteldok-campus in Amsterdam. Daarnaast hebben wij in Nederland ook een kantoor in Den Haag.

Public Affairs bij Burson is veel meer dan lobbyen op het Binnenhof. In de huidige mediacratie wordt beleid steeds vaker beïnvloed door publieke opinie en politieke sentimenten. Hierdoor verschuift de macht: niet alleen overheid en markt bepalen de agenda, maar ook de samenleving zelf.  Onze adviseurs helpen organisaties om in te spelen op deze dynamiek: maatschappelijke trends signaleren, draagvlak creëren bij uiteenlopende stakeholders, en strategieën ontwikkelen die zowel politiek als publiek overtuigen.

Als geïntegreerd communicatieadviesbureau weten wij hoe we Public Affairs versterken met slimme PR en gerichte communicatie, zodat we de juiste doelgroep bereiken, op het juiste moment, via het juiste kanaal, met de juiste boodschap. Daardoor richten ons op het beïnvloeden van relevante stakeholders via een breed scala aan kanalen.

Burson stelt jaarlijks per 1 februari en 1 september een Public Affairs stage beschikbaar aan een talentvolle student.

Wat ga je doen?

Als stagiair Public Affairs werk je mee aan diverse projecten en ondersteun je onze adviseurs. Je maakt kennis met veel aspecten van het werk binnen een Public Affairs kantoor en krijgt een uniek kijkje achter de schermen van de politieke arena. Je leert hoe organisaties hun belangen behartigen richting politiek, overheid en media. Kortom: een veelzijdige stage op het raakvlak van politiek, bestuur, media en bedrijfsleven.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Monitoren van nieuws en politiek:dagelijks kranten, vakbladen en opinietijdschriften scannen op relevant nieuws voor onze klanten.
  • Volgen van parlementaire agenda’s:bijhouden van vergaderingen en debatten in de Tweede en Eerste Kamer, relevante Kamerstukken signaleren en samenvatten.
  • Verslaglegging: live en achteraf rapporteren over politieke debatten en griffieverslagen verzamelen.
  • Research en analyse: informatie verzamelen via databanken en analyses maken voor onze adviseurs.
  • Stakeholdermapping: relevante politieke en ambtelijke contacten in kaart brengen en up-to-date houden.
  • Ondersteuning bij diverse klantprojecten: bijdragen aan presentaties, pitches en strategische adviezen.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je volgt een HBO- of universitaire opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Politicologie, Bestuurskunde, Geschiedenis, Europese Studies of Internationale Betrekkingen (en staat ingeschreven tijdens de stageperiode).
  • Je hebt een grote interesse in en kennis van de Nederlandse politiek en maatschappelijke vraagstukken.
  • Je bent proactief, nieuwsgierig en analytisch sterk.
  • Je kunt complexe informatie helder analyseren en samenvatten en hebt een vlotte pen.
  • Je beheerst de Nederlands en Engels taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
  • Je kunt goed omgaan met deadlines en werkt nauwkeurig, ook onder druk.
  • Je bent minimaal vier dagen per week beschikbaar in de periode van 1 februari tot en met 30 juni.

Wat bieden wij

Tijdens je stage ontvang je een maandelijkse stagevergoeding van €650 (gebaseerd op een volledige werkweek) en word je begeleid door twee collega’s. Elke maand heb je een coachingsgesprek over je eigen ambities en wensen. Halverwege je stage is er een tussentijds feedbackgesprek waarin genoeg ruimte is om aan te geven wat je nog meer uit je stage wil halen. title: Strategic Account Executive, DACH
descriptionHtml:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

Axon Account Executives are responsible for selling Axon products and services to large and complex Law Enforcement and Public Safety agencies. This is a quota carrying, external field position. Ability to articulate complex solutions, build and maintain senior level relationships, navigate across customer agencies / units, and lead the Axon team to success is required. The position provides technical and administrative product information, demonstrations, and/or product training. You will take charge of a significant proportion of customers and engage in significant complex sales opportunities, often of 7- and 8-digit value. Your success will be built on exceptional relationship building at both operational and board-equivalent levels both externally and internally.

At Axon, our goal is to make each individual feel valued for his or her contributions to the company’s mission to protect life. We are looking for intelligent people who want to do remarkable things. We strive to create an environment where people can succeed and enjoy coming to work every day. Life at Axon is fast paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. You will constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

What You’ll Do

title: Strategic Supply Partnerships Lead (REMOTE)
descriptionHtml:
REPLUG is a Mobile Revenue Growth partner that helps companies turn mobile into a measurable driver of revenue, customer value, and long-term business growth.

Rather than treating acquisition, retention, measurement and app experience as separate disciplines, we help businesses connect them into a unified growth system that improves commercial performance.

From global app publishers to established brands looking to unlock more value from mobile, we partner with companies that want to grow more efficiently, reduce dependency on saturated acquisition channels and build sustainable growth.

Our work combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution across App Store Optimization, Paid User Acquisition, CRM, measurement and mobile growth consulting.

We're now looking for a Strategic Supply Partnership Lead to grow our performance ads business globally.

Tasks

We’re looking for a Strategic Partnerships Lead to own and develop REPLUG’s performance supply ecosystem.

This is not a traditional account management role, and we are not looking for someone whose experience is limited to managing an existing book of supply partners.

We want someone with a genuine hunter mentality.

You should have a proven track record of identifying, approaching, and onboarding new partners, opening doors through your own network, and creating new commercial opportunities from scratch.

Strong industry relationships matter in this role. We are looking for someone who already understands the key players across the mobile performance ecosystem, knows who is worth speaking to, and can use that network to accelerate REPLUG’s access to new supply.

Just as importantly, you should have strong market intelligence. You should know what is happening across the ecosystem, where new inventory is emerging, which partners are gaining traction, where quality is deteriorating, and where the next meaningful opportunities may come from.

You’ll be responsible for identifying the partners we should work with, building the commercial relationships behind them, negotiating the right conditions and ensuring that those partnerships translate into real growth opportunities for our clients and REPLUG.

You’ll operate at the intersection of partnerships, commercial strategy and performance operations.

Your ecosystem will span OEMs, DSPs, SDK networks, publishers, affiliate partners and other alternative acquisition channels.

You’ll work closely with our performance, operations and sales teams to ensure we have the right supply available to support client growth.

You will report directly to the Performance Ads Lead, while working alongside the founders.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Build and Grow Our Supply Ecosystem

You’ll continuously develop the network of partners that powers REPLUG’s alternative acquisition offering.

You will:

  • Identify and evaluate new publishers, networks and inventory partners globally.
  • Develop relationships with OEMs, DSPs, SDK networks, affiliates and other performance partners.
  • Own partner onboarding from initial evaluation through activation.
  • Identify gaps in our current supply and proactively develop new opportunities.
  • Build a diversified ecosystem that allows us to scale without becoming overly dependent on individual partners.

Our goal is to build the right ecosystem to scale brands globally.

Own Commercial Partnerships

You’ll manage our supply relationships as commercial partnerships, not simply operational integrations.

This includes:

  • Managing and developing existing partner relationships.
  • Negotiating payouts, pricing models and commercial terms.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve margins and scalability.
  • Exploring exclusive opportunities, preferred access or new inventory.
  • Holding partners accountable for agreed performance, quality and delivery.
  • Understanding when a partnership should be scaled, renegotiated or stopped.

You should be comfortable protecting REPLUG’s commercial interests while maintaining strong long-term relationships.

Connect Supply With Performance

Supply has value only when it delivers results.

You’ll work closely with our internal teams to:

  • Match client campaigns with the most relevant inventory and partners.
  • Support campaign launches and supply activation.
  • Identify new scaling opportunities based on campaign performance.
  • Analyse partner performance across quality, delivery, scalability and economics.
  • Identify supply-side issues that may be limiting campaign performance.
  • Help teams diversify acquisition when existing channels begin to saturate.

You’ll need to understand both sides of the equation: what advertisers need and what partners can realistically deliver.

Protect Quality

Scaling poor-quality inventory isn’t growth.

You’ll help ensure that REPLUG’s supply ecosystem maintains a high standard of performance and transparency.

You’ll monitor and challenge partners around:

  • Traffic quality.
  • Fraud and suspicious activity.
  • Attribution anomalies.
  • Delivery consistency.
  • KPI performance.
  • Scalability.
  • Communication and operational reliability.

When something doesn’t make sense, we expect you to investigate it rather than accept the explanation you’re given.

Help Build REPLUG’s Own Performance Infrastructure

The role also extends beyond third-party partnerships.

You’ll contribute to the development of REPLUG’s own performance ecosystem, including:

  • Managing and optimizing supply operations for our in-house rewarded app ecosystem.
  • Supporting the development of our internal affiliate and network marketplace infrastructure.
  • Identifying opportunities to build more direct supply relationships.
  • Helping define processes, systems and commercial frameworks that make the ecosystem scalable.

This gives you the opportunity to help build infrastructure rather than simply manage existing relationships.

Requirements

We’re looking for someone who understands that successful partnerships sit somewhere between relationships, numbers and execution.

You should have:

  • At least 3-5 years of experience within mobile advertising, AdTech, performance marketing, or affiliate marketing.
  • A solid understanding of the mobile performance ecosystem.
  • Experience working with publishers, networks, DSPs, OEMs, affiliates, SDK traffic or comparable acquisition partners.
  • Strong commercial instincts and confidence negotiating deals.
  • The ability to evaluate a partnership based on performance and business potential, not just relationship quality.
  • Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with performance data and KPIs.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-management skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple partners and initiatives simultaneously.
  • A proactive approach to identifying problems and opportunities.
  • Excellent spoken and written English.

Nice to Have

  • Existing relationships across the mobile advertising ecosystem.
  • Experience managing international publisher or supply partnerships.
  • Experience with rewarded acquisition or offerwall ecosystems.
  • Understanding of attribution, MMPs and mobile measurement.
  • Experience working with performance campaigns on CPI, CPA, ROAS or revenue-based models.
  • Previous experience within a mobile agency, ad network, DSP, affiliate network or app growth company.
  • Additional languages.

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Thinks commercially.
  • Is comfortable negotiating.
  • Follows through.
  • Makes decisions based on evidence.
  • Can operate independently.
  • Understands when to push and when a partnership simply isn’t worth pursuing.
  • Wants to build systems and relationships rather than inherit a static portfolio.

Benefits

Joining REPLUG means you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Lead the supply partnership strategy for ambitious mobile brands.
  • Work alongside mobile growth specialists, driving growth across the whole mobile ecosystem
  • Help shape one of the industry's emerging Mobile Revenue Growth consultancies.
  • Own and influence how we scale our performance ads business
  • Become one of the public faces of REPLUG through conferences, webinars and industry content.
  • Work remotely with flexibility and a high level of ownership.
  • Continue developing through learning, experimentation and industry events.
  • Access monthly health and fitness benefits
  • Access yearly educational budget
