title: Studio Director
descriptionHtml:
Studio Director



Department: WPP / Ogilvy
Location: London / National
Contract type: Permanent
Full Time/Part time: Full Time
Reporting into: WPP Lead 

The Role
As a Studio Director within the Studio Network—a dynamic WPP-operated brand amplification powerhouse—you will be at the helm of creating and scaling distinctive, platform-native content across Europe. Your core mission is to seamlessly run one of our studios, acting as the trusted partner and strategic advisor for brand marketers. You will lead a talented core team, orchestrate creative delivery, and continuously elevate the quality of our output, ensuring our studio remains the go-to destination for every brand brief.

At Ogilvy, we are guided by David Ogilvy’s core values: Do the Right Thing, Do the Best Work of Our Lives, and Do It Together. If these principles resonate with you, we’d love for you to join us in shaping what’s next.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead with Impact: Direct the studio’s daily operations under the clients leadership, ensuring every brief meets agreed standards and service levels are consistently achieved.
  • Build Lasting Partnerships: Become the trusted face of the studio to brand marketers across your markets. You'll join their planning sessions, showcase results, and proactively remove any roadblocks.
  • Optimize and Orchestrate: Smartly match capacity to demand, balancing your core team, flexible resources, and the wider network bench to handle workflow peaks smoothly.
  • Elevate the Creative Standard: Act as the guardian of quality, overseeing decision gates, tracking compliance to our 100% KPI, and ensuring we hit high scores on the clients Creative Scale.
  • Global Collaboration: Seamlessly manage the daily workflow with our global delivery centres (India and South Africa), ensuring flawless quality control before assets reach client approvers.
  • Drive Continuous Improvement: Own the quarterly studio scorecard, pinpointing and driving at least one major operational improvement each quarter.
  • Champion Your Team: Foster a supportive environment focused on retention and growth. Lead onboarding, ongoing training, and certify the team on every new brand.


Key Skills

  • Proven leadership in running a high-volume, high-quality creative or content studio.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with a knack for building trust with senior brand marketers and navigating complex matrix structures.
  • Strong operational acumen, including capacity planning, resource management, and workflow optimization across global delivery centres.
  • A sharp eye for creative quality and platform-native content, with experience using data and performance metrics to measure and elevate output.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities, capable of turning scorecard data into actionable quarterly improvements.
  • A passion for people development, with a track record of building, retaining, and growing high-performing teams.

About You
You are a natural leader who thrives at the intersection of operational excellence and creative brilliance. You don't just manage processes; you inspire teams and build unshakeable trust with clients. You are commercially savvy, culturally fluent, and possess a proactive mindset that spots opportunities for improvement before they become issues. If you are ready to drive an engine that produces world-class content for one of the world's most iconic brand portfolios, and you love seeing your team grow alongside the work, you'll be right at home here.

Benefits & Culture
At Ogilvy, we are a friendly, collaborative, and eclectic team united by a shared commitment to doing the best work of our lives. Beyond client work, you’ll have the chance to shape our vibrant culture, join active social teams, and contribute to our industry-leading DEI initiatives.

Here is a snapshot of the benefits we offer:

  • Hybrid Working: We embrace a hybrid model that blends collaborative in-office time with the flexibility to work remotely.
  • Annual Leave: 25 days holiday, a paid volunteering day, plus the option to buy up to 5 additional days.
  • Pension: a generous matched scheme. Contribute 4% (Ogilvy pays 6%) up to a maximum contribution of 7% (Ogilvy pays 10.5%—totalling a powerful 17.5%).
  • Healthcare & Wellbeing: BUPA Private Medical Insurance, plus discounted BUPA dental cover or financial contribution towards your physical and mental wellness.
  • Employee Assistance: 24/7 access to remote GPs, mental health support, physio, nutrition consultations, and confidential counselling for you and your family.
  • Free 1-to-1 Coaching: Professional and personal growth coaching sessions annually.
  • Life Assurance & Income Protection: Financial peace of mind for you and your loved ones.

Ogilvy champions innovation and the thoughtful application of AI. We encourage you to use AI tools to enhance your application and achieve the best possible results. During interviews, we may explore how you leverage AI, showcasing your judgment and ability to integrate these technologies effectively.

Please ensure your application authentically reflects your own skills, experience, and unique contributions.

Our ambition is to attract the very best diverse talent to Ogilvy, and to be the employer of choice in the UK. We want everyone to feel welcome when they join us, and once they’re here, for them to want to stay with us, grow their career, and to feel they belong with us.

We are an equal opportunity employer and we’re committed to creating an inclusive, welcoming environment for everyone who wants to work at Ogilvy. For us, diversity, equity and inclusion is integrated into everything that we do. We believe that for creativity to flourish, everything about how we work must have diversity at its core. Your race, colour, ethnic, religion, gender, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, have no bearing on our hiring decisions, but we encourage everyone to feel free to express their true selves in an environment we are consistently striving to make as inclusive as possible.

We aim to facilitate an accessible and positive application experience for all candidates. If you require any adjustments from us to support you through the process or expect to require any adjustments to working conditions to be able to best perform in the role, please let us know. We are happy to consider all reasonable adjustments.

If you live with a disability and you would like to take advantage of our offer of a guaranteed interview under the Disability Confident Scheme, please ensure you fill out our voluntary Equal Opportunities Questionnaire when applying.

title: Superstar - Senior Art Director & Brand Designer
descriptionHtml:
International Brands ist ein schnell wachsendes Schweizer Unternehmen im Bereich Personal Care / FMCG. Mit unseren Marken bringen wir Produkte in zehntausende Verkaufspunkte weltweit, von Drogerien über führende Retail Chains bis hin zu E-Commerce.

Wir bauen Marken, die im Regal funktionieren.

Nicht nur auf Slides. Nicht nur auf Instagram.

Schnell. Sichtbar. Greifbar. Skalierbar.

Wir entwickeln und skalieren Marken, die Design, Produkt und Performance kompromisslos verbinden und genau dort gewinnen, wo es zählt: im Markt.

Über 90’000 Verkaufspunkte weltweit.

Und wir sind noch lange nicht am Limit.

Wir suchen einen Art Director (100%).

Keinen klassischen Designer.

Wir suchen den kreativen Kopf unseres gesamten Brand Powerhouses.

Jemanden mit einem klaren, tiefen Verständnis für FMCG Design. Jemanden, der weiss, was im Regal stoppt, Aufmerksamkeit gewinnt und Produkte verkauft.

Jemanden, der Verantwortung übernimmt. Von Packaging über Markenwelten bis hin zu den kleinsten Details, die am Ende den Unterschied machen.

Jemanden, der Bestehendes hinterfragt, Dinge besser machen will und nicht akzeptiert, „wie es schon immer war“.

Die Rolle ist anspruchsvoll, schnell und sehr hands-on.

Wir suchen keinen Verwalter.

Wir suchen einen Macher.

Jemanden, der Verantwortung übernimmt, Tempo bringt und Dinge mit hoher Qualität konsequent umsetzt.

Jemanden, der Marken aktiv weiterentwickeln will. Nicht nur konzeptionell, sondern bis zum fertigen Produkt im Regal.

Aufgaben

Du verantwortest alles, was unsere Marken visuell und kreativ nach vorne bringt – mit klarem Fokus auf FMCG Performance im Markt.

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung kreativer Konzepte über alle Brands hinweg mit Fokus auf Sichtbarkeit, Wiedererkennung und Wirkung
  • Aufbau, Schärfung und Weiterentwicklung starker Markenwelten mit konsistenter Handschrift

  • Ideen schnell, pragmatisch und effizient umsetzen – ohne sich in endlosen Abstimmungen zu verlieren
  • Aktiver Einsatz von AI und modernen Tools, um Workflow, Geschwindigkeit und Output kontinuierlich zu verbessern
  • Projekte eigenständig steuern und umsetzen – von der Idee bis zum fertigen Produkt im Markt
  • Steuerung von Freelancern und externen Partnern mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Head of Brands sowie dem gesamten Team
  • Blick fürs Ganze: vom Produkt über Kommunikation bis hin zum physischen Umfeld

Du machst aus Design Produkte, die verkaufen. Und aus Kreativität Performance.

Qualifikation

  • 2–5+ Jahre Erfahrung im kreativen Bereich (Design, Art Direction o.Ä.)
  • Starkes Portfolio mit echten FMCG- oder Retail-Projekten und sichtbaren Resultaten
  • Sehr gute Skills in Figma sowie Erfahrung in UI und Web
  • Erfahrung in Packaging, Social Media, Web und Print
  • Tiefes Verständnis für FMCG Design, Retail, Consumer Behavior und Kaufentscheidungen
  • Du hinterfragst Dinge und entwickelst sie weiter
  • Du denkst nicht nur in Ästhetik, sondern in Wirkung, Performance und Ergebnissen
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, schnell, hands-on und lösungsorientiert
  • Du bringst Eigeninitiative mit und treibst Projekte aktiv voran
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung statt auf Briefings zu warten
  • Du nutzt AI als sinnvolles Tool im kreativen Alltag
  • Deutsch & English

Was nicht zu der Rolle passt

  • Rein ästhetisches Denken ohne Verständnis für Markt, Konsumenten und Wirkung
  • Kreative ohne echtes Interesse an FMCG, Retail und marktorientiertem Design

  • Menschen, die primär auf Vorgaben warten statt selbst Verantwortung zu übernehmen

Benefits

  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung und viel Raum, Dinge wirklich zu bewegen

Wenn du etwas bewegen willst, dann bist du hier richtig.

Du wirst hier nicht einfach gestalten.

Du wirst Marken bauen.

Produkte entwickeln, die sichtbar werden.

Produkte, die im Regal stoppen.

Produkte, die gewinnen.

Und Produkte, die Menschen kaufen.

Wenn du jemand bist, der Dinge nicht nur schön machen, sondern erfolgreich machen will, dann sollten wir sprechen.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

We're not your average benefits platform – we're the driving force that uplifts people's lives. Our technology connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers.

Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive, both at work and beyond.

Your Mission

As our talent acquisition partner, you will help build Ben as it scales, hiring bar-raising talent across the business. You'll partner with hiring managers from first-line managers to the C-suite, getting under the skin of what each team needs to grow, and you will equally contribute towards building a best-in-class hiring process.

We're heavily invested in agentic tooling and already run agents and workflows built with Claude, Ashby and other platforms. You'll work with our Strategic Talent Business Partner to keep building and iterating on them, and we want you to think boldly about what an agentic talent function can do.

Things you will be working on…

  • Hire bar-raising talent across the business: you’ll hire for a range of roles, from implementation, support and technical account management to commercial and engineering, bringing in the people who’ll take Ben forward as we scale.

  • Be a true partner to hiring managers: work with hiring managers to agree what we need, when we need it and why, using data to guide those decisions.

  • Bring our employer brand to life: help elevate how Ben shows up, from events to the careers page, so candidates get a real sense of what it’s like to work here.

  • Build AI into how we hire: trial and build agents and workflows that give hiring teams better tools and free up time for the work that matters.

  • Make our hiring process best in class: gather quantitative and qualitative feedback from candidates and hiring managers, spot what’s slowing us down, test changes and keep what works.

You will love this role if you have…

  • Startup recruiting experience: you've spent at least a year recruiting at a startup, ideally in-house, and owned roles from intake to offer.

  • Hired for roles like ours: you've hired for customer roles such as implementation, support or technical account management, for engineering roles such as full-stack or product engineers, or both. You can explain how you judged a candidate's technical work. A bonus if you have it.

  • A sourcing track record: you find and engage passive candidates. Bring a hard search you cracked and walk us through how you did it.

  • Stakeholder backbone: you've managed demanding hiring managers, prioritised competing requests and pushed back when a brief or a process wasn't working. You can point to a time you changed a hiring plan because of what the business needed, and you keep several roles moving at once.

  • Hands-on experience with AI in recruiting (nice to have): you've used sourcing agents and tools like Claude or Cursor, and perhaps built skills or workflows of your own, with the judgement to know when the output is good enough to use. A strong bonus if you have it.

Why join us?

Ben already helps hundreds of thousands of people across 30+ countries get benefits that actually work for them (pensions, insurance, allowances, payroll), at companies like Mondelez, Zalando, Octopus Energy, BA and more. We're now scaling further into the large enterprise space, and this next stage is the most exciting one yet.

You’d be the second person in the talent team, working on finding the bar-raising talent who will take us to the next level, with real influence over how Ben hires as we scale, and the room to grow your role and remit as we do.

We’re all in on building a truly AI native talent function, so you’ll be given the time to learn, experiment and help build the agents and tooling that change how we find and hire great people. If you want to help shape that, we’d love to hear from you.

 

Our Compensation & Benefits

We know what good looks like and we want to provide the best for our team, with a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package. title: Team Lead Sales – SME / KMU (m/w/d) | B2B SaaS Fintech, Berlin
descriptionHtml:
Du willst als Team Lead Sales in Berlin ein Vertriebsteam aufbauen und gleichzeitig mitgestalten, wie Pennylane SME (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) in Deutschland gewinnt? Als Sales-Teamleitung für unser deutsches SME-Segment baust du ein neu geschaffenes Team regionaler Account Executives auf: Du coachst im Kundengespräch – im Berliner Office und vor Ort bei deinen AEs und Kunden –, steuerst die Vertriebsleistung und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Head of Sales den Ansatz für den deutschen Markt – mit dem Rückenwind eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas.

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerkanzleien werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen. SME geben wir die Plattform, mit der sie Buchhaltung, Rechnungen, Zahlungen und Finanzplanung an einem Ort steuern – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit ihrer Steuerkanzlei.

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas – seit 2025 auch in Deutschland. Das haben wir seit der Gründung 2020 erreicht:

  • 💻 Wir haben uns als All-in-One-Plattform für Buchhaltung, Finanzen und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Unternehmen und ihren Steuerberater:innen etabliert – KI-gestützt, cloudbasiert, mit offenen Schnittstellen.

  • 💰 Wir haben rund 360 Millionen Euro Kapital eingesammelt – zuletzt 175 Millionen Euro in unserer Series E im Januar 2026, angeführt von TCV und Blackstone Growth, neben Investoren wie Sequoia, CapitalG (Alphabet) und DST Global. Unsere Bewertung liegt bei 3,5 Milliarden Euro.

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf über 900 Pennylaner:innen angewachsen, davon mehr als 400 in Tech, Data und Product – mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

  • 🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU und über 5.000 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich – bei SME sind wir dort in fünf Jahren zur führenden Finanzplattform geworden.

  • 🇩🇪 Deutschland ist unser wichtigster Wachstumsmarkt: Geführt von Managing Director Tobias Janiesch wächst das deutsche Team in Berlin und München 2026 auf rund 100 Kolleg:innen. Du kommst in der Gründungsphase dazu und prägst, wie Pennylane hier verkauft.

Deine Mission

Du wirst Team Lead Sales (m/w/d) – SME in Deutschland sein und unser neu geschaffenes SME-Team von Grund auf aufbauen. Deine Mission ist es, mit deinem Team von Account Executives SME in ganz Deutschland für Pennylane zu gewinnen – du führst, coachst und baust das Team auf.

In Frankreich nutzen über 900.000 SME Pennylane. Du übernimmst das bewährte Playbook und passt es gemeinsam mit unserem Head of Sales, an den du berichtest, an den deutschen SME-Markt an. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Tobias Janiesch, Managing Director Deutschland, zusammen. Unser Prozess: Erstgespräch, Interview mit dem Head of Sales, Case Study, Abschlussgespräch mit dem Managing Director in Berlin.

Dein Team

Full-Cycle Sales: Deine Account Executives verantworten den gesamten Prozess – von der Qualifizierung über die Produkt-Demo und den Abschluss bis zum Onboarding und Account Management ihrer SME-Kunden.

Im Ausbau: In den kommenden Monaten könnten wir ein eigenes Team für Onboarding und Account Management aufbauen – du gestaltest mit, wie Neukundengewinnung, Onboarding und Bestandskundenbetreuung zusammenspielen, damit deine AEs ihre Zeit wirksam einsetzen.

Regional organisiert: Jede:r Account Executive ist für mehrere Regionen verantwortlich, die von Berlin aus betreut werden – per Inside Sales und Video-Demo, bei wichtigen Kunden auch vor Ort. Rechne mit etwa zehn Reisen pro Jahr in die jeweiligen Regionen.

Im Aufbau: In Deutschland sind bereits zwei Account Executives an Bord, ab Januar kommt ein SDR für die Lead-Qualifizierung dazu. Das Team soll weiter ausgebaut werden: Du stellst gemeinsam mit unserem Talent-Acquisition-Team weitere AEs ein, arbeitest sie ein und führst sie zum Erfolg – das Team wächst mit dir.

Schneller Vertrieb: Klassischer SMB-Sales: Dein Team gewinnt Unternehmer:innen und Finanzverantwortliche in SME – kurze Entscheidungswege, hohe Schlagzahl, überzeugende Demos. Ihr zeigt konkret, wie Pennylane den Finanzalltag eines Unternehmens vereinfacht.

Standort Berlin: Das Team wird aus unserem Berliner Office geführt – du bist an zwei Tagen pro Woche vor Ort, den Rest flexibel. Präsenz ist Teil deiner Führung: Du coachst deine AEs im Office Seite an Seite und begleitest sie bei wichtigen Kunden vor Ort – etwa zehn Reisen pro Jahr in die Regionen deines Teams.

Du wirst für die Leistung dieses Teams verantwortlich sein durch:

  • Du verantwortest die Vertriebsleistung deines Teams – gemessen am MRR aus deutschen SME – und leistest damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zum Wachstum im deutschen SME-Markt.

  • Du schaffst klare Erwartungen, coachst regelmäßig anhand konkreter Kundengespräche und nutzt Pipeline- und Conversion-Daten, um dein Team gezielt weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Head of Sales den Go-to-Market-Ansatz für SME weiter (Inside Sales, Demos, Onboarding) und setzt ihn mit deinem Team um.

  • Du baust die Prozesse deines Teams auf – vom Sales-Playbook über Forecasting bis zur Pipeline-Steuerung.

  • Du begleitest deine AEs bei strategischen Demos und Key Deals – per Video-Call und vor Ort.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem französischen Sales-Team zusammen und überträgst, was vom Playbook für Deutschland funktioniert.

Als Team Lead Sales – SME sind deine Ziele vielfältig:

  • Du erreichst die Vertriebsziele des Teams und steuerst das Tagesgeschäft – mit einem Aktivitätsniveau, das die individuellen und gemeinsamen Ziele erreichbar macht.

  • Du verantwortest das Sales Enablement deiner Account Executives: Techniken, Messaging und der gesamte Pennylane-Sales-Prozess.

  • Du begleitest neue AEs durch Onboarding und Ramp-up und führst sie zu ihren Zielen.

  • Du baust Teamgeist, Engagement und Wohlbefinden auf – mit Challenges, Teambuildings und Formaten, die du selbst gestaltest.

  • Du bringst die Perspektive des SME-Vertriebs in die Sales-OKRs von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

  • Du gehst bei wichtigen Deals selbst mit rein – per Video-Call oder vor Ort beim Kunden.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung als Account Executive im B2B-SaaS-Sales mit – idealerweise im SMB-Segment mit kurzen Deal-Zyklen und hoher Schlagzahl – und hast mindestens zwei Jahre ein Sales-Team (AEs / Full-Cycle) erfolgreich geführt.

  • Ein Plus: Du kennst das Fintech- oder B2B-SaaS-Ökosystem – oder hast an Unternehmer:innen und Finanzverantwortliche in SME verkauft. Wenn nicht, bringst du die Neugier mit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

  • Du führst über Coaching: Du entwickelst Menschen anhand echter Kundengespräche, mit Daten, klarem Feedback und dem Mut, Entscheidungen zu treffen und durchzuhalten.

  • Du besitzt ein unternehmerisches Mindset, fühlst dich in einem noch nicht vollständig strukturierten Umfeld wohl und hast Lust, Dinge von Grund auf aufzubauen.

  • Du bist offen für Selbstreflexion und fühlst dich wohl dabei, Feedback zu geben und zu empfangen.

  • Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit anderen Abteilungen zusammen – Marketing, Customer Success, Product und dem französischen HQ.

  • Du bist hands-on: Du führst nicht nur vom Dashboard aus, sondern gehst selbst mit in Deals – und hast weiterhin Lust, selbst zu verkaufen, um den Markt zu kennen.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau – deine Kund:innen sind deutsche Unternehmer:innen – und sicheres Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris.

  • Du lebst in Berlin oder bist bereit, nach Berlin zu ziehen – und du bist gern vor Ort: zwei Tage pro Woche im Berliner Office und rund zehn Reisen pro Jahr zu AEs und Kunden in den Regionen.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

  • 🏢 Berlin, hybrid: zwei Tage pro Woche in unserem Berliner Office, die übrigen Tage flexibel.

  • 🌴 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.

  • 💵 Ein attraktives OTE-Paket: Fixgehalt plus variabler Anteil, gekoppelt an den MRR, den dein Team erzielt.

  • 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

  • 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln.

  • 🇫🇷 Onboarding im Pariser HQ, regelmäßiger Austausch mit dem französischen Sales-Team und Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

  • 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

  • 🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (alle 3 Monate) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar – plus Team-Events in Berlin.

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información

title: Technical Account Manager - UK
descriptionHtml:
The Role

Geordie is building the platform enterprises rely on to govern their AI agents safely — and we're growing fast. We're looking for a technical, customer-focused Technical Account Manager to own the post-sale relationship with our customers and make sure they get the best from their Geordie deployment, fast.

You'll be the technical face of Geordie for a portfolio of enterprise accounts — guiding onboarding and integration, becoming the go-to expert customers trust for anything technical, and working closely with our sales, product and engineering teams to keep our customers successful and growing. You will turn technical relationships into lasting partnerships.

This is a hands-on, technical role. You'll get deep into our platform, our customers' environments, and everything in between — and you'll help shape how Geordie delivers success for our customers as our first UK-based TAM hire.

We also expect you to work the way we build — intelligently and efficiently. That means embracing AI agents in your day-to-day workflows. We use tools like Claude Cowork to move faster and do more. If you're not passionate about that, this probably isn't the right place for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Technical Relationship — Be the primary technical point of contact for a portfolio of enterprise accounts, building trust from customer kick-off through renewal and expansion.

  • Project Management — Own the project plan for onboarding and major implementations end-to-end: timelines, milestones, resourcing, and risk tracking across customer, engineering, and product stakeholders. Run the cadence of standups/status calls, keep everyone accountable to dates, and escalate slippage before it becomes a surprise.

  • Onboarding & Implementation — Guide customers through deployment, integrations, and configuration, so they see value from day one.

  • Product Mastery — Become a deep expert on the Geordie platform. Troubleshoot issues, answer technical questions, and give customers confidence in how we work.

  • Adoption & Health — Track account health and usage, spot risks early, and drive the actions that keep customers engaged and expanding.

  • Escalation Management — Be the calm, capable owner of technical escalations — coordinating with engineering and product teams to resolve issues and close the loop with customers.

  • Renewals & Expansion — Partner with our sales team to identify expansion opportunities and ensure strong technical health underpins every renewal opportunity.

  • Customer Advocacy — Bring field insights back to our teams — feature requests, friction points, and what's actually happening in customer environments — so we keep building the right things and ensure the customer remains at the centre of everything we do.

  • Documentation & Enablement — Build the runbooks, guides, and best-practice materials that make onboarding repeatable and support scalable.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration — Work closely with sales, engineering and product teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.

  • Build the Function — As our first UK TAM, help shape the processes and playbooks that define how Geordie supports customers as we scale, in step with the wider TAM function.

What We're Looking For

  • You're technical, and you like it. You're comfortable in the details — agents, APIs, integrations, security, governance — and you enjoy figuring out how things really work.

  • You own outcomes. You don't wait — you track account health and get ahead of risk before it becomes a churn conversation.

  • You're a builder. Early-stage means you create structure where there isn't any and find a way to provide value to customers.

  • You're AI-fluent, not just AI-aware. You use tools like Claude Cowork and other agentic AI to run your own workflow — drafting runbooks, triaging tickets, prepping QBRs, chasing account health signals — so you spend your time on judgement calls and relationships, not repetitive admin. You look for the next task to hand off to an agent before you look for the next hire.

  • You earn trust at every level. You can debug an integration issue with an engineer in the morning and brief a CISO on progress in the afternoon, without losing credibility in either room.

  • You listen before you troubleshoot. You ask sharp questions to understand what's actually going on before you propose a fix, then deliver.

  • You communicate clearly and often. Customers always know where things stand.

  • You're focused on success. Not just at renewal time — all the time. You care whether customers succeed, and it shows in how you show up.

  • You embrace new ways of working. You actively use AI tools — especially agents — to work smarter, move faster, and do more. You thrive in ambiguity.

Requirements

  • 2–5 years' experience in a Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, or Customer Success Engineer role at a SaaS or cybersecurity company.

  • Passion and interest in agents, how organisations are utilising them, their security and risk, and their governance.

  • Solid technical fluency — comfortable with agent architectures, agent security, agent tooling, APIs, SaaS/cloud integrations, and cloud environments.

  • Proven track record of owning post-sale relationships with enterprise customers, including onboarding, adoption, and renewal.

  • Experience diagnosing and resolving technical issues, including coordinating with engineering teams on fixes.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work confidently with both technical practitioners and executive stakeholders.

  • Strong discovery and problem-solving skills — able to get to the root of a customer issue quickly.

  • Comfortable delivering polished, tailored product walkthroughs and training sessions independently.

  • Highly organised, with rigorous attention to detail across documentation, account health tracking, and follow-through.

  • Collaborative team player who thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment.

  • Based in the United Kingdom, with the right to work in the UK, and the flexibility to travel to customer sites as needed.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience supporting security, AI/ML, or agentic tooling customers.

  • Active experience creating, deploying and managing agents.

  • Prior experience at a high-growth Series A–B SaaS company.

  • Light scripting or coding ability (e.g. Python) and comfort working with API tools such as Postman.

  • Relevant cloud or security certifications (AWS, Azure, or equivalent).

Why This Role

AI agents are changing how enterprises operate — and the question of how to govern them safely is becoming mission-critical. Geordie is the platform companies are turning to for that answer. As one of our first Technical Account Managers, you won't just be running a playbook — you'll be writing it. You'll have real influence over how we onboard, support, and grow our customers, and a direct line to Product on what to build next. If you want to go deep on a hard technical problem and build something that matters, this is it.

Our Values

Solve What Matters

We listen intently and stay focused on what truly matters to our customers. If it doesn't help them navigate real-world agentic adoption and risk, it's probably not worth building.

Build, Learn, Iterate

We favour momentum over perfection — testing, learning, and evolving through action. It's how we move fast and get better, together.

Kind, Not Comfortable

We're honest, respectful, and unafraid to challenge each other. We believe doing great work should feel good, too. Kindness makes that possible.

sA Platform for Your Best Work

We want this to be the most meaningful chapter of your career. Geordie is the place where you grow, lead and lift others, while building something that truly matters.

title: Technical Instructional Designer (AI Programmes)
descriptionHtml:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

The opportunity

AI can draft a lesson in seconds. It can't tell you whether that lesson will actually land with a nervous career-switcher three weeks into a Data or AI apprenticeship — or whether the concept it just explained is subtly, but fundamentally, flawed.

That's where you come in.

You'll be the human judgement layer sitting on top of our AI-assisted content pipeline — part subject-matter expert, part instructional designer. You'll decide what AI got right, fix what it didn't, and build the parts no AI can: the high-touch, high-stakes, deeply human moments in a learner's journey that make the difference between content that's technically correct and content that actually changes someone's career.

You'll have experience building content in generative and agentic AI, Data Analytics, and Data Science — not just someone who's read about it, but someone who can explain it, question it, and know when the AI-generated explanation of a neural network is actually going to help a learner or quietly confuse them.

What you'll actually do

  • Design outcomes, not just content. Apply end-to-end backward design to build Data and AI programmes where success is measured by what learners can do on the job — not just what they can pass a test on. You'll own the hardest part: turning a job-aligned outcome into a curriculum that actually gets learners there.

  • Chase real-world impact, relentlessly. When a piece of learning isn't landing — when a Data Analyst cohort isn't showing the outcomes it should — you won't wait to be told. You'll spot it, own it, and scope the revisions that bring it up to the standard it needs to hit.

  • Build what AI can't. Design the custom, high-touch programmes and creative assets — branching narratives, bespoke multimedia, high-stakes onboarding moments — that need real human empathy, creativity, and nuance. If AI could've built it, it's not your job; if only a person could, it is.

  • Put AI to work, deliberately. Use AI tools and prompt engineering to accelerate your own content development and uncover learning design approaches nobody's tried yet. This isn't about using AI because it's there — it's about knowing exactly where it earns its place.

  • Advise up, not just build. Work directly with Programme Designers and senior stakeholders on the quality and pedagogical effectiveness of AI and human output. Your feedback doesn't stay in the room — it shapes how our AI rules and frameworks evolve.

  • Prototype for the long game. Lead new learning formats and modalities that don't exist yet — and know how to balance shipping fast against building something sustainable enough to reuse.

What you'll bring

  • Real command of end-to-end ADDIE and backward design — you've built measurable, job-aligned outcomes and the assessments that prove learners hit them, not just theoretical frameworks on a CV.

  • A habit of treating "good enough" as a starting point, not a finish line — you notice when learning isn't driving real outcomes, and you take the initiative to fix it.

  • Genuine fluency with AI-powered tools and prompt engineering, used to accelerate content development and find genuinely new applications in Data/AI learning design.

  • The ability to take a genuinely complex AI, Data Science, or Analytics concept and design a learning experience around it that actually works — for someone with zero technical background.

  • The confidence and track record to influence peers and senior stakeholders toward a specific, measurable curriculum improvement — not just raise a concern and move on.

  • Resilience when things don't go to plan — you can point to a time a project hit a real obstacle (a blocker, a shifting SME, a launch that missed the mark) and describe exactly what you did about it, and what you learned.

What gets you in the door

You'll need at least one of these:

  • Hands-on experience producing technical content for Data Science or generative/agentic AI.

  • 2+ years designing instructional content in a commercial environment or for commercial clients.

  • Plus one of:

    • A Data Science degree (or close cousin of one)

    • Completion of a technical apprenticeship in Data or AI

    • 2+ years working as a practitioner in Data or AI

If you're a strong technical practitioner who's never formally studied instructional design, or a seasoned learning designer who's spent the last year deep in AI tools — either path can get you here. We're looking for the judgment, not a checklist.

What we'll actually explore together

We're upfront about what our process looks for, because we'd rather you come prepared to talk about the real thing than guess what we want to hear. Across the conversations, we'll dig into:

  • Advanced curriculum & applied design — how you turn an end-to-end backward-design process into measurable, job-aligned outcomes, and how you build creative assets that genuinely need a human touch.

  • Impact & excellence — what you do when a piece of learning isn't hitting its real-world mark, and how you weigh speed against building something built to last.

  • AI integration & innovation — where and how you've put AI tools and prompt engineering to work, and what that's actually unlocked.

  • Influence & stakeholder management — how you've moved a curriculum forward through a genuine disagreement or feedback conversation, not just delivered a good pitch.

  • Coachability & resilience — how you've handled a launch that didn't land, or a project blocker outside your control, and what you changed as a result.

 

Benefits

  • Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

  • Health & Wellness- private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

  • Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month

  • Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year

  • Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked!


Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy, our Prevent Policy and all other Multiverse company policies. Successful applicants will be required to undertake at least a Basic check via the Disclosure Barring Service (DBS).

For roles that will involve a Regulated Activity, successful applicants must also undergo an Enhanced DBS check, including a Children’s Barred List check and a Prohibition Order check. Roles involving Regulated Activity may interact with vulnerable groups, therefore are exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 meaning applicants are required to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, and final warnings.

Providing false information is an offence and could result in the application being rejected or summary dismissal if the applicant has been selected, and possible referral to the police and the DBS.

title: Territory Account Executive, Manchester
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Territory Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square’s mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most.

This is a field-driven, execution-focused role designed for individuals who thrive in dynamic, demanding environments. You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.

You will serve as Square’s presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square’s visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.

If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

You will:

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

  • Spend ~80% of your week in the field — walking your territory, engaging local businesses, and driving 50–60 targeted business visits each week.
  • Run a full-cycle, self-sourced sales motion: generate leads, identify needs, deliver compelling demos, and close deals across Square’s full product suite.

Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with local sellers by being present, reliable, and value-driven.
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and fast time-to-value for new sellers.
  • Implement a disciplined referral strategy to turn every new customer into future opportunities.

Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up

  • Develop a repeatable top-of-funnel engine through door-to-door outreach, community engagement, events, networking, and targeted partnerships.
  • Work with channel partners to generate a consistent, high-quality referral stream that grows over time.

Master your verticals and sell with precision

  • Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.
  • Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout the sales cycle.

Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment

  • Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.
  • Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.
  • Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

You have:

  • 3+ years of sales experience in a full cycle closing role with field sales experience
  • Experience exceeding sales targets, selling a diverse ecosystem of products, and closing complex deals
  • Ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment 
  • Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)
  • Since this is a field position, you must have reliable transportation and live in the market you are serving
  • A collaborative and team player mentality
  • Prior Salesforce experience or equivalent
  • Even better:
    • 2+ years of payment processing OR related technology (i.e. payroll, loyalty, time management)
    • 1+ years of relevant audience experience (experience working in/selling to restaurants, retailers or services based businesses)

title: Test Development Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

Here at The Exploration Company, we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refuelled in orbit, and which carries cargo – and potentially humans in the long run. We are also developing different types of propulsion systems to power our future vehicles and missions. As a talented Test Development Engineer, you will be part of the team that is responsible for the development of test facilities for our future propulsion systems.

In your capacity as a Test Development Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties may include:

  • Synthesise test bench requirements from user and operator needs and plan required verification methods and tests.

  • Translate engine test objectives and stakeholder needs into facility-level functional and performance requirements.

  • Perform technical trade-offs to determine the best choice of hardware, software, equipment, component, location etc for various test facilities.

  • Perform risk assessment analyses for future tests and developing mitigation actions to ensure personnel and hardware safety.

  • Provide technical inputs to cost, schedule, procurement, commissioning, maintainability, and facility acceptance planning.

  • Prepare and maintain P&IDs of test facilities based on test bench requirements and selecting components.

  • Undertaking preliminary design of the ground support equipment with minimal oversight.

  • Undertake hazard assessments of the test facility design (FMEA and HAZOPs) to determine if any additional changes to the design are required.

  • Work with the current test bench team to coordinate end-to-end activities of the development of test facilities including design, reviews, manufacturing, installation, commissioning, test operations, ongoing upgrades and maintenance.

  • Work with procurement, AIT and design teams during the development of test facilities to find the right balance of technical solutions, cost and lead time.

  • Presenting findings to team members and participating in design reviews and project discussions.


What we would love to see from you:

  • Bachelor's, master's or PhD in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field (Master’s and above preferred).

  • 2–5 years of experience in propulsion, test facility development, experimental engineering, or a related field.

    • Practical experience in the design, development, commissioning, or operation of test facilities, preferably for rocket propulsion systems.

    • Experience in test facility design for cryogenic propulsion systems is highly desirable. Relevant experience with other cryogenic or high-pressure fluid systems will also be considered.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret technical data, challenge assumptions, and make evidence-based engineering recommendations.

  • Proven ability to work autonomously on assigned technical topics while contributing effectively to a multidisciplinary engineering team.

  • Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts to diverse audiences.

Why you should join us!

title: Transactional Financial Controller
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

The Transactional Financial Controller owns the full Accounts Payable, Billing function, Credit control, working capital management, and banking operations across the group, while also leading the ongoing automation and optimisation of the finance systems that underpin transactional finance. This is a hybrid role based in London combining hands-on operational leadership of AP, Billing and credit control teams and processes with responsibility for driving system-led improvement, control, and efficiency across the wider finance systems landscape along with the Finance transformation team.This role has line management responsibility for a team based in London and Porto, working under hybrid and remote arrangements

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Transactional Finance (AP, Billing and Credit control) Management

  • Full management of the Accounts Payable and Billing and Credit control functions, including team leadership, prioritisation and quality control.

  • Oversight of all banking and expense transactions, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and appropriate controls.

  • Own working capital management, including planning and execution of payment runs.

  • Implement and manage the Purchase Order (PO) system end-to-end, liaising with stakeholders across the business to ensure compliance and efficient processing.

  • Act as the escalation point for AP, Billing and Credit control queries, both internal and external, ensuring timely and professional resolution.

  • Oversee & drive DSO performance improvement, setting and monitoring cash collection targets and driving corrective action where collection is behind plan by using escalation channels with various business stakeholders

  • Overseeing the review AR ledgers regularly, identifying and escalating aged debt in line with credit control policy.

  • Line-manage direct reports based in Portugal & London, while providing day-to-day supervision and quality oversight of AP, Billing and Credit Control activity across the UK, Portugal, Germany and Spain.

  • Partner with the Director of Financial Control and wider Finance team on reporting, audit requirements and process governance.

Finance Systems & Process Improvement

  • Support along with Finance Transformation the finance systems automation roadmap, driving the elimination of manual processes and delivering scalable, efficient finance operations.

  • Own the optimisation of the finance systems landscape, reviewing and enhancing NetSuite integrations with Moss, Precoro, Abacum, Salesforce and QV to ensure scalability, data integrity, and accurate revenue recognition.

  • Drive continuous improvement of finance system integrations and workflows, proactively identifying and resolving issues to enhance performance, reliability, and user experience.

  • Lead the transformation of Billing and AP processes through enhanced controls, automated workflows, invoice validation, credit management, supplier remittance optimisation, and customer communications.

  • Drive continuous improvement of transactional and billing processes, with a focus on automation and efficiency gains.

  • Supporting with Finance Transformation the rollout of a unified Source-to-Procure (S2P) solution — consolidating procurement, support ticketing, contract management, and expense reimbursement into one platform to improve control and user experience

  • Ensure alignment between NetSuite financial reporting (Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet) and Abacum planning and forecasting models to provide consistent financial insights across the business.

  • Establish and maintain effective finance systems governance through the optimisation of user roles, permissions, access controls, and segregation of duties.

  • Partner with Finance, Technology, and Business stakeholders to ensure finance systems effectively support commercial growth, operational excellence, and evolving business requirements.

COMPETENCIES

  • System expertise: Strong proficiency with NetSuite, Salesforce, Moss, Precoro, Abacum and Banking tools.

  • Finance foundations: Solid grounding in financial operations, accounting and finance principles.

  • Problem-solving: Able to troubleshoot system issues and implement effective solutions.

  • Attention to detail: High accuracy in managing data integrity and financial records.

  • Technical & analytical skills: Understanding of databases and being able to analyse processes and data flows to optimise system performance.

  • AI: High level of proficiency in Claude, Gemini

  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Project management: Experience managing system implementations, upgrades or process improvement projects.

  • Prioritisation: Ability to manage competing priorities between multiple scopes.

title: VP Retention
descriptionHtml:
🚀 Why Midnite?

Midnite is a next-generation sports betting and gaming platform built for a new wave of players.

We combine sharp product thinking, bold brand, and fast execution to create experiences that feel modern, intuitive, and built for how people actually play today.

Over 400,000 players have already made the move, and we’re only just getting started.

We’re a high-performance team operating at pace. High ownership. Constant iteration. No hiding behind processes. We move quickly, test relentlessly, and turn ambitious ideas into real impact. If you’re driven, creative, and thrive in fast-moving environments where you can shape meaningful outcomes - keep reading.

Not your grandad’s bookie.

👀 The Role

Title: VP Retention

Team: Growth

Location: UK, remote

We're looking for a VP Retention to lead our global CRM/Retention business unit within Growth, building sustained customer engagement across sportsbook, casino and future markets.

You'll lead an established organisation across Core CRM, Lifecycle and Live Ops, connecting strategy, people, data and execution. This is an opportunity to build on existing expertise, validate what works and shape what comes next. Change should have a clear purpose.

Your focus will be customer and commercial impact, not campaign volume. You'll help customers progress through early life journeys, deepen relevant engagement, improve longer term retention and make reactivation more effective through thoughtful, personalised activity across email, push, SMS and in app.

Working closely with Product, BI and other Growth leaders, you'll bring strong casino insight, a clear view of loyalty and the ability to turn cross functional priorities into delivery. As data, MarTech and measurement capabilities evolve, you'll help demonstrate incremental value, improve reward efficiency and deliver responsible engagement at scale.

You will:

  • Set and evolve global retention strategy across activation, early life progression, engagement, lapse prevention and reactivation, with sustained longer term retention at its heart.

  • Lead and develop Core CRM, Lifecycle and Live Ops; assess the operating model, preserve expertise and shape evidence led changes.

  • Bring casino insight and partner with Product on loyalty and customer propositions that give players reasons to return.

  • Prioritise relevant, personalised lifecycle journeys and higher impact interactions, not contact volume for its own sake.

  • Own performance against outcomes including deposit progression, cash active days, cross sell, lifetime value, reactivation efficiency and cohort retention.

  • Partner with BI to validate baselines, develop useful reporting and assess incrementality through robust experimentation and holdouts.

  • Challenge and prioritise data, segmentation and MarTech capabilities with Product/Engineering, managing key CRM vendor relationships.

  • Build alignment across Product, BI, Growth and market stakeholders, influencing upwards and sideways as well as leading your team.

  • Establish strong standards for contact strategy, QA, consent and customer protection; turn evidence into priorities, investment recommendations and learning.

The next Midniter:

  • Has led CRM, retention or lifecycle activity within iGaming with demonstrable customer and commercial outcomes.

  • Brings deep casino understanding and credible sportsbook knowledge, adapting approaches across products and markets.

  • Ideally has helped design, launch or evolve a loyalty programme with Product.

  • Builds trust, constructively challenges and aligns senior cross functional stakeholders, as well as leading direct reports.

  • Has developed teams and can improve an established organisation while respecting existing expertise.

  • Connects lifecycle strategy with personalised, multi channel execution, favouring meaningful impact over campaign volume.

  • Understands cohort retention, experimentation, holdouts and incrementality, including attribution limitations and incomplete data.

  • Brings commercial judgement around LTV, contribution, promotional cost and reward efficiency.

  • Understands how customer data, segmentation, decisioning and CRM platforms should work together; can challenge dependencies and vendor value with specialist teams.

  • Balances strategic ambition with operational rigour, pace and responsible engagement in regulated markets.

💰 Winnings

  • Private health insurance with zero excess, including optical cover and optional dental.

  • Income protection to protect your earnings and give you peace of mind.

  • Tenure holiday policy. After three years you receive an extra two days leave, increasing to 30 days annually after five years.

  • Flexible working and a fully supported home office setup so you can do your best work from home.

  • Nursery salary sacrifice scheme helping parents save thousands each year on nursery fees.

  • Salary sacrifice schemes for tech and holidays so you can spread the cost of the things you want.

  • Retail discounts and subscription perks across a wide range of brands.

  • Quarterly team socials to connect, celebrate and have fun together.

At Midnite, we're committed to creating equal opportunities for everyone. We actively strive to build balanced teams that reflect the diversity of our communities, including ethnic minorities, people with disabilities, the LGBTQIA+ community and all genders.

We aim to provide an inclusive and supportive interview experience for all candidates. If you require any reasonable adjustments, please let us know in advance so we can ensure you feel comfortable and set up for success.

title: Werkstudent - Technisches Projektmanagement
descriptionHtml:
In the following you'll find information about us and the specific role:

Ort: Büro in Berlin Kreuzberg
Umfang: 20 h/Woche, flexibel einteilbar
Vergütung: 17–20 €/h
Arbeitssprache: Deutsch
Start: ab sofort
Auch als Vollzeit Praktikum möglich!

Was wir lösen

Die Energiewende ist relevanter denn je: Solaranlagen, Wärmepumpen und Wallboxen werden in Deutschland so schnell gebaut wie noch nie. Aber es gibt eine Bremse, die kaum jemand kennt - Bürokratie.

Was heißt das konkret? Jede einzelne Anlage muss beim Netzbetreiber angemeldet werden, bevor sie laufen darf.
Klingt einfach? Ist es nicht: In Deutschland gibt es über 850 Netzbetreiber - jeder mit eigenen Formularen, eigenen Prozessen, eigener Auslegung der Regeln. Kein Standard.
Für Installationsbetriebe heißt das drei bis vier Stunden pro Anlage, in denen ein Handwerker Formulare ausfüllt statt zu bauen.

Wir lösen das mit Software. Unsere Plattform erzeugt die Unterlagen aus den Daten des Installateurs und reicht sie automatisiert beim richtigen Netzbetreiber ein.
Unter unseren Kunden sind die größten Player der Solar- und Wärmepumpenbranche in Europa.
Und weil dieses Problem den Installationsbetrieben so weh tut, konnten wir im letzten Jahr von null auf über 1 Mio. € Umsatz gewachsen - bootstrapped, profitabel und ohne Investorengeld.

Deine Rolle

Du arbeitest im operativen Kern unseres Produkts und trägst Ownership für einen ganzen Bereich.
Dort sorgst du dafür, dass alles sauber durchläuft: Du behandelst die Edge Cases, kommunizierst mit allen relevanten Stakeholdern und betreust den Prozess so, dass er nicht nur jede Woche besser wird, sondern dass wir jede Woche mehr Kunden bedienen können. Denn genau da stehen wir: Mehr Kunden wollen unser Produkt, als wir heute live nehmen können.

  • Prozessbetreuung: Dein Bereich läuft, weil du ihn steuerst - von der Anmeldung bis zur Bestätigung durch den Netzbetreiber, inklusive der technischen Abstimmung, wenn etwas nicht passt.

  • Expansion: Du hilfst dabei, den Rollout in neue Netzbetreibergebiete voranzutreiben - neue Regeln erschließen, im System abbilden, live bringen. Und damit neue Kunden.

  • Produkt: Wenn etwas hakt oder du einen Impuls hast, baust du mit unserem Engineering-Team direkt die Lösung. Du gestaltest das Produkt aktiv mit - und skalierst damit unser Operations-Geschäft.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du studierst Ingenieurwissenschaften: Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik, Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder Ähnliches

  • Du arbeitest dich schnell in unbekannte Themen ein

  • Du treibst gerne eigene Bereiche voran, statt auf Anweisungen zu warten

  • Ausgeprägtes Auge fürs Detail - du findest Fehler, die nicht auffallen

  • Du bist in Berlin und kannst 20 h/Woche im Büro sein

Von Netzanmeldungen musst du noch nie gehört haben. Das lernst du hier in zwei Wochen.

Warum Voltir

  • Mission: Netzanmeldung ist einer der größten Engpässe der deutschen Energiewende. Du bist dabei, ihn zu lösen.

  • Wir leben AI-First: Ganze Bereiche wie Finance oder Go-to-Market sind bei uns One-Person-Teams, weil eine Person mit den richtigen Tools, Working Mode und Automatisierung sie trägt. Du lernst hier, wie das geht und bekommst Werkzeug und Wissen an die Hand, um es dir selbst anzueignen. Im heutigen Arbeitsmarkt ist das unglaublich viel wert.

  • Ein Startup, das durch die Decke geht: Du erlebst direkt mit, wie ein Unternehmen richtig groß wird. Von Fehlern zu gemeinsamen Meilensteinen, du sammelst echte Startup-Erfahrung.

  • Domain-Wissen, das du sonst nirgendwo bekommst: Netzbetreiber-Prozesse, Marktstammdatenregister, VDE-Normen, die Arbeitsweise der größten Solar- und Wärmepumpen-Anbieter Europas - du siehst den Renewable-Energy-Markt von innen.

Was wir bieten

  • echte Flexibilität: Office-first, aber du teilst dir deine 20 Stunden selbst ein

  • Abendessen auf uns

  • Snacks, Obst und Drinks im Office

  • Urban Sports

  • regelmäßige Company-Events

  • Modernes Büro in Kreuzberg

  • absolut flache Hierarchien und ein cooles Team

Dein Onboarding ist perfekt vorbereitet und nach einem ersten gemeinsamen Team-Lunch tauchst du direkt in die faszinierende Welt des E-Commerce ein – innovative und strategische E-Commerce und Digital Marketing Projekte mit führenden Marken aus den Bereichen FMCG, OTC, Fashion und Beauty.

Du hast sofort gemerkt: Hier kannst du viel lernen, etwas bewegen, selbst Strategien entwickeln und Wissen aus dem Studium praktisch anwenden.

ABRIO ist eine der führenden Digital Commerce Beratung mit Sitz in Frankfurt am Main. Unser Ziel: Die E-Commerce-Welt unserer Kunden nachhaltig zu verbessern und skalierbare Erfolge zu schaffen. Dabei kombinieren wir modernste Technologien mit innovativen Marketingansätzen und maßgeschneiderten Lösungen.

In deinem Werkstudium wirst du dich vom ersten Tag an einbringen können sowie Trends und Strategien, die unsere Kunden noch erfolgreicher machen, kennenlernen. Klingt spannend? Dann lies weiter – wir suchen genau dich für unser Team!

  • Start: ab November oder flexibel

  • Stundenumfang: mindestens 16 Stunden, idealerweise 20 Stunden


DAS ERWARTET DICH

  • UI Design & Creative Asset Erstellung: Du unterstützt bei der Gestaltung von Online-Shops und visuellen Creatives für digitale Marketingkampagnen, beispielsweise für Social Ads, Newsletter und weitere Marketingkanäle.

  • UX-Design: Du kreierst Wireframes und Prototypen für verschiedene Anwendungsbereiche im Web und optimierst die User Experience entlang der gesamten Customer Journey.

  • Designsprache: Du entwickelst mit dem Team eine Designsprache für unsere Kunden auf Basis von Corporate Design und Design-Segmenten und baust diese stetig weiter aus.

  • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Testing: Du entwickelst datenbasierte Ideen zur Optimierung von Online-Shops, konzipierst Designvarianten für User-Testings, um die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Nutzererlebnisse voranzutreiben.

  • Shopify Shop-Management & -Optimierung: Du unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung und Pflege von Shopify-Shops, passt bestehende Sektionen und Inhalte an.

  • Research & Marktanalyse: Du analysierst Wettbewerber und Markttrends, recherchierst neue Tools, Apps und digitale Möglichkeiten und bewertest Optimierungspotenziale mit Fokus auf UI/UX und E-Commerce.



IT'S A MATCH, SOFERN DU...

  • dich in einem Studium im Bereich (Kommunikations)Design, Usability, Medieninformatik, Interface Design oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung befindest.

  • dich fürE-Commerce, digitale Trends und die Optimierung von Online-Shops begeisterst.

  • ein gutes Gespür fürnutzerfreundliches Design, visuelle Gestaltung und digitale Nutzererlebnisse hast.

  • idealerweise durch Nebenjobs und Praktika erste Erfahrung im Bereich UI/UX Design sammeln konntest.

  • eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe hast und motiviert bist, dich stets auf dem neusten Stand der Innovationen zu halten.

  • schon Erfahrungen mit UI Design Tools wie Figma oder Adobe XD gemacht hast und dich mit der Adobe Creative Suite sowie Canva gut auskennst.

  • ein echter Teamplayer bist und deine Aufgaben selbstständig, zuverlässig und verantwortungsvoll erledigst.

WAS WIR DIR BIETEN

  • Teamspirit, den man erlebt: Offene Zusammenarbeit, gegenseitige Unterstützung und regelmäßige Teamevents sind bei uns fest verankert. Ob Team-Lunch, Afterwork-Drinks oder gemeinsame Aktivitäten – wir nehmen uns bewusst Zeit füreinander.

  • Gestalte mit und wachse in Verantwortung hinein: Bei uns bekommst du die Unterstützung, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, dich weiterzuentwickeln und wertvolle Praxiserfahrung zu sammeln.

title: Werkstudent:in Business Operations (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Werkstudent:in Business Operations (m/w/d)

Über ELMI:

ELMI ist ein Technologieunternehmen für batteriegestützte Ultra-Schnellladestationen. Unsere Mission ist es, weit mehr als klassische Ladesäulen zu entwickeln: Wir schaffen intelligente Energielösungen, die flexibel mit den Anforderungen von morgen mitwachsen, Ressourcen schonen und Netze entlasten und so die Energiewende Schritt für Schritt in die Praxis bringen.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Als Werkstudent:in im Bereich Business Operations sorgst du dafür, dass an unserem Standort in Niddatal alles rundläuft. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Organisation des Arbeitsalltags: Du behältst den Überblick, packst dort an, wo es gerade nötig ist, und kümmerst dich auch um Finance Themen. Kein Tag ist wie der andere, und du bekommst echte Einblicke in den Alltag eines wachsenden Technologieunternehmens.

  • Mitarbeit an der Optimierung und Automatisierung interner Abläufe

  • Je nach Qualifikation kannst du auch andere Aufgaben übernehmen, als Start-up haben wir viele spannende Themen, die noch vergeben werden können

Qualifikation

  • Du bist an einer deutschen Universität immatrikuliert

  • Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität: Du bist dir nicht zu schade, auch mal körperlich mit anzupacken

  • Organisationstalent und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Zuverlässige, selbstständige und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise

  • Sorgfalt und ein gutes Gespür für Zahlen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft 365, insbesondere Word, Excel und PowerPoint

  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Von Vorteil, aber absolut keine Voraussetzung: Staplerführerschein

Benefits

  • Entspannte Arbeitsatmosphäre: Bei uns geht es professionell, aber unkompliziert zu, wir pflegen einen offenen und lockeren Umgang miteinander.

  • Kurze Wege & flache Hierarchien: Egal, ob Kolleg:in oder Geschäftsführung, bei uns zählt die Idee, nicht die Position.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Du wählst deine Arbeitstage selbst und auch wie du deine Stunden auf die Tage verteilst, bleibt dir überlassen.

  • Eigenverantwortung & Vertrauen: Du bekommst den Freiraum, deine Themen selbstständig voranzutreiben und eigene Ideen einzubringen und umzusetzen.

  • Gemeinsam statt nebeneinander: Wir arbeiten eng zusammen, unterstützen uns gegenseitig und lösen Herausforderungen als Team.

  • Direkter Austausch: Fragen, Feedback und neue Ideen werden offen angesprochen, ohne unnötige Abstimmungswege.

  • Start-up-Mentalität: Wir geben Raum für neue Ideen, mutige Entscheidungen und eigene Lösungen. Nicht alles muss auf Anhieb perfekt sein, wir lernen aus unseren Erfahrungen und entwickeln uns gemeinsam weiter.

  • Technologie mit Sinn: Du arbeitest an innovativen, batteriegestützten Ladelösungen und gestaltest aktiv die Zukunft der Elektromobilität mit.

  • Poolfahrzeuge: Für Fahrten im Arbeitsalltag kannst du unsere Poolfahrzeuge nutzen.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das die Zukunft der Elektromobilität gestaltet.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und vielleicht schon bald als Teil unseres Teams begrüßen zu dürfen!

Bewirb dich jetzt – und bring deine Energie dorthin, wo sie wirklich etwas bewegt!

descriptionHtml:
ORDERMONKEY by SELISE | Zürich | Teilzeit (60+ %)

Du interessierst dich für Technologie, Digitalisierung und Gastronomie und hast Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt?

Du möchtest neben deinem Studium praktische Erfahrungen in einem innovativen Tech-Unternehmen sammeln, Kunden aktiv unterstützen und Teil eines dynamischen Teams werden?

Dann bist du bei ORDERMONKEY genau richtig!

ORDERMONKEY ist eine innovative Self-Ordering-Plattform der internationalen Technologie- und Softwareentwicklungsfirma SELISE. Mit unseren digitalen Lösungen – von Self-Ordering-Kiosks über Webshops bis hin zu Payment- und Loyalty-Systemen – unterstützen wir führende Gastronomieunternehmen dabei, ihre Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten und das Kundenerlebnis zu verbessern.

Für unser Team in Zürich suchen wir eine kommunikative, zuverlässige und serviceorientierte Persönlichkeit, die uns schwerpunktmässig im Kundensupport unterstützt und gleichzeitig unser Schweizer Team im operativen Tagesgeschäft entlastet.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Werkstudent bist du Teil unseres Customer-Support- und Operations-Teams. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der direkten Kundenbetreuung, der Bearbeitung von Supportanfragen sowie der Unterstützung unseres Schweizer Teams.
